jobs.title: AI-Native Platform Engineer - DevOps, Security & Compliance | Zenara Health
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionAI-Native Platform Engineer — DevOps, Security & Compliance, Mid to Senior | Zenara HealthLocation: Remote - India Type: Full-time Working Hours: All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately 6:00 PM and 12:00 AM IST, overlapping US Pacific Time.
jobs.description:
Description

AI-Native Platform Engineer — DevOps, Security & Compliance, Mid to Senior | Zenara Health

Location: Remote - India

Type: Full-time

Working Hours: All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately 6:00 PM and 12:00 AM IST, overlapping US Pacific Time. Attendance in that window is required. Your remaining work is yours to schedule.

Commitment: Approximately 50 hours per week

Industry: Healthcare technology experience is preferred but not mandatory

About the Company

Zenara Health is a technology-oriented mental healthcare organization building clinical software for behavioral-health clinics. We work with sensitive healthcare data, so reliability, security, access control, backups, and compliance are not side concerns — they are part of the product ..

We are a startup, not a department. We move quickly, but we need to move with discipline because customers and patient data depend on us.

About the Role

We are looking for an AI-Native Platform Engineer to own DevOps, production reliability, security operations, and compliance foundations.

This is not a narrow DevOps ticket role.

This is not a compliance paperwork role.

This is a hands-on platform ownership role.

Today, platform, security, and compliance work is spread across people who are already covering other responsibilities. We need one full-time owner who keeps systems running, backed up, updated, monitored, secure, and HIPAA-ready ..

You will work closely with the Head of Engineering and a part-time senior security and compliance consultant ..

Here is the test: can you prove that backups restore, deployments roll back, secrets are controlled, alerts work, access is locked down, and compliance evidence exists before a customer asks for it?

We are looking for a calm, methodical operator who automates the boring things, finds the scary things, and closes the important gaps.

Our Platform Vision

We are building an AI-native healthcare software company. That means our platform must support speed without creating unacceptable risk.

The platform should make the safe path the easy path: reliable deployments, observable systems, tested recovery, controlled access, documented evidence, automated checks, and continuous security awareness.

You will help build this operating system, including:

  • Deployment and rollback workflows
  • Monitoring and alerting
  • Backups and restore verification
  • Secrets and access management
  • Cloud configuration reviews
  • Security checks on new code and infrastructure
  • HIPAA compliance evidence
  • Vendor and AI-tool risk tracking
  • Daily automated security and compliance checks
  • Incident response basics
  • Platform documentation and runbooks

The goal is to create a platform that lets a small engineering team move fast without gambling with production or patient data.

What You’ll Do

  • Own production platform operations: deployments, monitoring, alerts, updates, and reliability.
  • Own backups and regularly prove restores work .
  • Manage access control, secrets, cloud configuration, and security checks.
  • Organize HIPAA-related policies, controls, audit evidence, and customer security documentation .
  • Identify, prioritize, and close platform and security gaps.
  • Build a daily security and compliance agent that sweeps systems and reports findings .
  • Work weekly with a senior security and compliance consultant.
  • Create runbooks, checklists, and automation for repeatable operational work.
  • Support incident response, recovery, and prevention.
  • Help free other team members from ad hoc platform and security work.

What We’re Looking For

  • Hands-on experience keeping startup systems and platforms running.
  • Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, monitoring, backups, and recovery experience.
  • Experience with access control, secrets management, cloud configuration, and security basics.
  • Ability to prove backups restore and systems recover.
  • Ability to code and automate routine platform or security tasks.
  • Comfort using AI agents to build automation and operational workflows.
  • Calm judgment during incidents and production issues.
  • Strong ownership and documentation habits.
  • Practical mindset: you can prioritize risks rather than create endless theoretical lists.

Our Current Stack

  • Azure AKS / Kubernetes
  • Azure Blob Storage
  • Azure Monitor / OpenTelemetry
  • Terraform
  • Helm
  • CI pipelines
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis
  • Some AWS
  • TypeScript applications using Node.js / Hono and React
  • Medplum / FHIR
  • Healthcare data, HIPAA, patient-data protection, vendor risk, and AI-tool risk

What “AI-Native Platform Engineering” Means for This Role

For this role, being AI-native means you can:

  • Use agents to inspect configurations, draft runbooks, and automate checks.
  • Build recurring security and compliance sweeps.
  • Use AI to accelerate infrastructure review without blindly trusting it.
  • Create workflows that surface risks before humans remember to check.
  • Automate operational evidence gathering.
  • Maintain human approval for sensitive actions.
  • Keep permissions, secrets, and production access tightly controlled.
  • AI should help you create a more reliable platform, not become another unmanaged risk.

Nice to Have

  • Healthcare or HIPAA experience.
  • Security background, such as cloud security, SOC, or incident response.
  • Compliance framework experience, especially HIPAA or SOC 2.
  • Azure and AKS production experience.
  • Kubernetes at production scale .

What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will review the current setup, agree the top platform and security gaps, demonstrate a backup restore and deployment rollback, and produce a prioritized improvement list ..

Within your first 90 days, monitoring and alerting will be in place, top security gaps will be closed, the first version of the daily security/compliance agent will be running, and compliance evidence will be organized ..

Over time, success means Zenara has a reliable, secure, HIPAA-ready platform, clean customer security reviews, and platform work no longer depends on non-specialists.

Schedule

Live collaboration requires overlap with the US team. For engineering roles, the current collaboration window is approximately 6:00 PM to 12:00 AM IST, though final expectations should be confirmed during the hiring process.

Production incidents and critical deployments may occasionally require availability outside normal collaboration windows.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, based on demonstrated ability and experience
  • Fully remote work
  • Equipment allowance
  • Direct access to the founder and Head of Engineering
  • Support from a senior security expert

Who Will Thrive in This Role

This role is well suited to someone who:

  • Is calm, methodical, and reliable.
  • Likes automating operational work.
  • Cares about security but can still move pragmatically.
  • Wants broad ownership across DevOps, security, and compliance.
  • Can operate independently without a large platform team.
  • Understands that healthcare data requires discipline.

You may struggle if you want a large ops team around you, only want one narrow specialty, treat compliance as paperwork only, cannot automate, or are careless with secrets and access.

If you want to build the operating foundation for an AI-native health-tech company, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.excerpt: AnewHealth is one of the nation’s leading pharmacy care management companies that specializes in caring for people with the most complex, chronic needs—wherever they call home.
jobs.description:
AnewHealth is one of the nation’s leading pharmacy care management companies that specializes in caring for people with the most complex, chronic needs—wherever they call home. We enable better outcomes for patients and the healthcare organizations who support them. Established in 2023 through the combination of ExactCare and Tabula Rasa HealthCare, we provide a suite of solutions that includes comprehensive pharmacy services; full-service pharmacy benefit management; and specialized support services for Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly. With over 1,400 team members, we care for more than 100,000 people across all 50 states.

Job Details


Pharmacy Technicians in our Patient Care Center of Excellence may hold multiple duties to ensure ExactCare’s patients receive quality care out of their pharmacy services. They will work in a closed-door pharmacy environment, spending their time speaking with patients, doctors and facilities on the phone in addition to the outlined job duties and responsibilities.

Job duties will vary from phone work and navigating multiple pharmacy software systems to supporting the various stages of patient care/contact. These areas of responsibility will fluctuate based on organizational needs, allowing the Pharmacy Technician to develop multiple skillsets.


This is a remote-based environment, allowing the Pharmacy Technician to provide an exceptional patient experience. AnewHealth provides a fast-paced, high-energy environment, allowing Pharmacy Technicians to excel in many areas with a focus on phone-based pharmacy work.


Responsibilities

  • Providing an exceptional customer service experience each day in a phone-based environment.
  • Enter a high volume of data; processing prescription information with speed and accuracy.
  • Utilizing sound drug knowledge to effectively receive prescription authorizations, clarifications or transfers.
  • Perform claim adjudication and auditing duties such as prior authorizations, billing and eligibility checks. Requiring outbound calls to patients.
  • Working through current case queues to problem solve for patient care issues.
  • Serving as a liaison between the clinical pharmacists and other medical professionals on patients’ behalf.
  • Partner with technicians and pharmacists to ensure that new patients are successfully onboarded to ExactCare.
  • Maintaining patient records with strong attention to detail and confidentiality.
  • Accurate retrieval of all prescription information and verifying through doctor calls.
  • Placing welcome calls to newly onboarded patients and establish a trusted point of contact.
  • Placing outbound calls to patients to create, maintain or update their medication profiles.
  • Serve as backup support for times of higher patient call volume.
  • Effectively assist with patient questions over the phone.
  • Performing in a high volume, fast paced environment to support ExactCare’s nationwide patient base.
  • Embody AnewHealth’s Core Values in all communications and interactions.
  • Other duties as assigned.

The above essential functions are representative of major duties of positions in this job classification. Specific duties and responsibilities may vary based upon departmental needs. Other duties may be assigned similar to the above consistent with knowledge, skills and abilities required for the job. Not all of the duties may be assigned to a position.

Qualifications: These represent the desired qualifications of the ideal candidate. They are not meant to limit consideration for candidates who do not meet all of the standards listed. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education

  • High school diploma/GED
  • Certified with the Pharmacy Technician Certification Board (PTCB) or the National Health Association (NHA) and maintain a current certificate
  • Must maintain a pharmacy technician registration with State Board of Pharmacy

Experience

  • Must be 18+ years of age
  • Prior experience in a pharmacy setting

Skills & Abilities

  • Comfortable working in a phone-based environment.
  • Ability to work independently.
  • Self-motivated and goal oriented.
  • Ability to utilize computer equipment, technology and work within multiple software programs to receive medication authorizations, clarifications and/or transfers.
  • Exceptional customer service skills; servicing doctor’s office, pharmacist, and patient needs over the phone.
  • Thorough drug knowledge.
  • Pharmacy billing knowledge.
  • Knowledge of appropriate processes in taking prescriptions, clarifications and transfers including clear written and verbal communication.
  • Strong prioritization and organizational skills.
  • Maintain a high degree of confidentiality.
  • Passion to help people and enrich their lives.
  • Ability to think critically and document pertinent details in a world class manner that is compliant with state and federal regulations.

Physical/Mental Demands: This position is administrative in nature and will present physical demands requisite to a position requiring: hearing, seeing, sitting, standing, talking, and walking. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Must be able to commute to multiple site locations within assigned territory. May be necessary to work extended hours as needed.

Schedule: This is a full-time position with an expectation to work an average of 40 hours per week and be available outside of normal business hours to meet customer expectations on an ad-hoc basis. Schedules are set to accommodate the requirements of the position and the needs of the organization and may be adjusted as needed.

This is a remote position.

AnewHealth offers a comprehensive benefit package for full-time employees that includes medical/dental/vision, flexible spending, company-paid life insurance and short-term disability as well as voluntary benefits, 401(k), Paid Time Off and paid holidays. Medical, dental and vision coverage are effective 1st of the month following date of hire.

AnewHealth provides equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status, or other legally protected classification in the state in which a person is seeking employment. Applicants are encouraged to confidentially self-identify when applying. Local applicants are encouraged to apply. We maintain a drug-free work environment. Applicants must be eligible to work in this country.

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented and knowledgeable Medical Scribe to support healthcare providers with clinical documentation and administrative workflows during patient consultations.

In this role, you will work closely with physicians to document patient encounters in real time, prepare medical charts before appointments, assist with entering orders under physician instruction, and ensure clinical records are accurate, complete, and organized.

The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of medical terminology, excellent typing and listening skills, and experience working with electronic health records (EHRs). You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced clinical environment where accuracy, efficiency, confidentiality, and attention to detail are essential.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Real-Time Clinical Documentation

  • Accompany physicians during patient consultations and examinations to document clinical encounters in real time.
  • Record the patient's chief complaint, history of present illness, relevant medical history, physical examination findings, and assessment and treatment plan.
  • Accurately capture clinical information while listening to conversations between healthcare providers and patients.
  • Adapt to different physicians' documentation preferences and workflows.

Pre-Visit Chart Preparation

  • Review patient medical records before consultations.
  • Check medication lists, previous clinical notes, pending laboratory results, and imaging reports.
  • Ensure relevant information is available to the physician before the appointment.
  • Identify missing information or outstanding results that may require follow-up.

Orders & Referral Entry

  • Enter laboratory, diagnostic imaging, and other medical orders under the direct instruction of the physician and in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Assist with entering referrals and prescription information as authorized.
  • Ensure all entries are accurate and flag discrepancies or missing information for the provider's review.

Post-Visit Documentation & Chart Closure

  • Review and organize clinical notes following patient consultations.
  • Assist with visit summaries and supporting documentation.
  • Identify incomplete sections and flag records requiring physician review, correction, or signature.
  • Help ensure patient charts are completed accurately and within the required timeframes.

Coding, Compliance & Confidentiality

  • Ensure documentation captures the clinical details required to support accurate medical coding and billing.
  • Follow applicable patient privacy, confidentiality, and healthcare documentation requirements.
  • Maintain the accuracy and integrity of electronic medical records.
  • Handle sensitive patient information responsibly and in accordance with applicable privacy regulations, including HIPAA where relevant.

Clinical Workflow Support

  • Assist with patient flow by keeping documentation up to date and helping reduce administrative backlogs.
  • Manage multiple documentation tasks and outstanding items efficiently.
  • Communicate with physicians and relevant clinical staff regarding incomplete records or documentation discrepancies.
  • Maintain organized records and follow established clinical workflows.

Minimum Requirements

  • Previous experience as a Medical Scribe or in a closely related clinical documentation role is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy, physiology, common diagnoses, and clinical abbreviations.
  • Experience using electronic health record (EHR) systems such as Epic, Cerner, Allscripts, or similar platforms.
  • Excellent typing speed and accuracy; a typing speed of 60–80 words per minute is preferred.
  • Strong written English skills and the ability to produce clear, accurate clinical documentation.
  • Excellent listening skills and the ability to capture relevant clinical details during live consultations.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify missing or inconsistent information.
  • Understanding of patient confidentiality and healthcare privacy requirements.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

Essential Skills & Competencies

  • Clinical documentation: Ability to accurately capture patient information and physician instructions.
  • Medical terminology: Familiarity with common clinical terms, diagnoses, medications, and procedures.
  • Attention to detail: Ensures accurate documentation of medication dosages, clinical findings, and patient history.
  • Active listening: Distinguishes important clinical information from general conversation.
  • Time management: Completes documentation promptly while managing multiple tasks.
  • Adaptability: Adjusts to different physician preferences, specialties, and documentation workflows.
  • Confidentiality: Handles sensitive medical information professionally and securely.
  • Communication: Works effectively with physicians and clinical teams to resolve documentation gaps.

About the Role

UCAR is excited to announce the job opening for the CPAESS Scientist III position, supporting NOAA's Climate Prediction Center (CPC) at the National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP) under NOAA's Early Warning Systems (NEWS) program. The incumbent will independently lead the application of advanced forecasting methods (including AI/ML and ensemble post-processing) to improve sub-seasonal to seasonal (S2S) predictions of extreme climate events. The CPAESS Scientist III will serve as a primary point of contact for stakeholder engagement, driving the co-development of impact forecasts and training programs with partners in the Caribbean and Latin America, or Africa, and must demonstrate professional bilingual proficiency in English and French.

CPAESS serves the Earth system science community in three distinct areas of service. CPAESS partners with federal agencies and businesses to hire critical scientific staff, enabling a more robust workforce. Through scientific programs, CPAESS seeks to edify new research with postdoctoral programs, visiting scientist and internship programs, along with interagency support programs. CPAESS also helps build the Earth system science community by convening and managing summer schools and institutes, conferences, and advisory committees. Through Scientific Partnerships, CPAESS supports large-scale partnerships and initiatives in the Earth system science (ESS) community. Currently, there are about 100 scientists in a variety of federal agencies and laboratories across the U.S.

Job Description

Designs and executes scientific analyses; develops, and adapts, and/or tests hypotheses, models and/or tools. Contributes to papers, reports, technical documentation, data sets, findings, and/or proposals. Mentors less experienced colleagues, collaborates across disciplines, and supports proposal development to advance scientific goals through high-quality, methodologically sound work. Engages in mission-aligned activities both within the organization and throughout the broader scientific community. Contributes through a combination of scientific expertise, professional service, and education and outreach efforts.


Responsibilities

  • Designing and executing scientific investigations or analyses using established and/or emerging methods to address defined research, operational, or applied science questions.
  • Developing or adapting tools, models, or methods to support data collection, processing, analysis, system evaluation, or experimental workflows.
  • Performing detailed analysis and interpretation of observational, experimental, or model-generated data, contributing to new insights or improvements in scientific understanding.
  • Leading or contributing to components of a larger project or small project teams through coordination of activities, deliverables, and technical direction across collaborators.
  • Authoring or co-authoring peer-reviewed publications, technical documentation, data sets, findings, project reports, and/or proposals, and presenting findings in internal, sponsor, or scientific community settings.
  • Collaborating across disciplines and institutions, contributing technical expertise to team-based projects and enhancing interdisciplinary research or operational outcomes.
  • Supporting proposal development and project planning activities by contributing to scoping, technical writing, and alignment with programmatic objectives.
  • Providing technical guidance to less experienced staff/students, mentoring on methods, tools, and best practices while engaging in and modeling inclusive team participation.
  • Developing products, tools, instruments and/or technologies for projects and programs.

Requirements


Education


Typically requires a minimum of a Bachelor of Science degree and 8 years related experience, or a Master’s degree and 4 years related experience, or a PhD in a scientific discipline; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.


Knowledge

  • Has solid knowledge in a relevant scientific field, with an ability to apply theories, methods, or frameworks to complex or interdisciplinary problems.
  • Is familiar with project planning and proposal development, including scoping technical work, aligning with program goals, and supporting deliverable management.

Skills and Abilities

  • Is skilled in developing or refining scientific tools, workflows, or models, including quality assurance and integration with broader project efforts.
  • Is skilled in using data analysis tools used for data preparation, visualization, or workflow automation.
  • Is committed to mentoring with the ability to guide less experienced colleagues on methods, tools, and collaborative practices.
  • Is capable of contributing to peer-reviewed publications, sponsor reports, or presentations, with clear and accurate scientific communication tailored to varied audiences.
  • Collaborates effectively within multidisciplinary teams, integrating diverse inputs and fostering productive working relationships.
  • Demonstrates the ability to design and carry out analyses or investigative tasks independently using established methods, adapting approaches as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

Skills & Experience

  • Strong knowledge of the global climate system, with regional expertise in the Caribbean, Latin America, or Africa at S2S timescales.
  • Experience engaging stakeholders in agriculture, water resource management, or food security in developing-world contexts.
  • Familiarity with operational forecast workflows, including model output processing, forecast verification, and communicating uncertainty to end users.
  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and French to effectively communicate technical scientific information to clients and stakeholders.

Program/Project-Specific Details

  • Contribute to the development and delivery of training materials on subseasonal to seasonal (S2S) forecasting for meteorologists, scientists, and stakeholders across agriculture, water resource management, and health sectors.
  • Author technical and scientific reports documenting work related to the PREPARE Early Warning System project.

Role-Specific Responsibilities

  • Apply advanced scientific methods — including model calibration, bias correction, and AI/ML tools — to post-process global ensemble forecasts (GEFS, NMME, and others) and improve precipitation and temperature forecasts at week 2–4, monthly, and seasonal timescales.
  • Verify forecasts using statistical methods and apply multivariate and spectral analysis to observations and model outputs to understand and advance sub-seasonal predictability, including prediction of extreme events.
  • Use GIS tools to map extreme event forecasts and collaborate with stakeholders to co-develop impact forecasts for agriculture, water resource management, and health.

Additional Information

Work Location Expectations: This position is open to candidates seeking in-person, hybrid (combination of 3 days in-person and 2 days of remote), or fully remote opportunities. UCAR requires ALL positions to be performed within the U.S., excluding U.S. Territories. UCAR Staff deployed to federal agencies must abide by their respective federal agency requirements concerning remote/flexible work arrangements.

For full consideration, all application materials must be submitted by 12am (MST) at the start of the application deadline. The Position

Ballotpedia is seeking a full-time, 100% remote Staff Researcher to join our News Team.

The News Team is responsible for identifying and capturing mission-related news events to provide audiences with clear, accurate, and impartial political information. We track and update readers on hard-to-find items, from state legislative candidate declarations and unscheduled officeholder transitions to political party ballot status across the United States and its territories. We strive to provide any interested party with the details that comprise our complex political landscape.

A successful staff researcher will be passionate and knowledgeable about politics. They will be comfortable conducting and organizing extensive research using various media, political websites, and official government sources. They must have the ability to distill complex topics into neutral and concise information for a variety of audiences. They will also be comfortable producing work under regular deadlines and flexible enough to reprioritize work when unexpected events unfold in the political world.

A strong candidate for this role will have a driving desire for accuracy, completeness, innovation, and neutrality. They will demonstrate excellent writing and proofreading skills, as well as a passion for improvement and innovation. Constructive feedback is welcome and taken as an opportunity for growth. The candidate should be comfortable researching obscure information online and conducting direct outreach to government officials as needed. An ideal candidate will also be eager to collaborate within the News Team and across Ballotpedia’s other departments.

Responsibilities

As a News Team Staff Researcher, you will:

  • Monitor a specific list of sources to identify breaking news updates, including media and political websites, and official government sources
  • Update relevant articles based on identified stories
  • Work extensively within Ballotpedia’s database to track and update information
  • Ensure data accuracy on-site and in the database
  • Conduct regular reviews (or “sweeps”) of lists of officeholders and candidates at the federal, state, and local levels of government to ensure Ballotpedia’s data is accurate
  • Follow carefully laid out processes, systems, and procedures as assigned by editors and supervisors
  • Generate content about complex topics in a neutral, clear, and concise manner
  • Conduct systematic research to collect data related to officeholders, candidates, and elections. Data points will include, but are not limited to, campaign or official website addresses, social media handles, and upcoming election dates
  • Proofread content effectively, efficiently, and consistently
  • Interact with co-workers, customers, and the media in a professional, helpful, and pleasant manner
  • Conduct research about jurisdictions not currently receiving detailed coverage on Ballotpedia for potential inclusion on our site and in our database
  • Complete designated tracking spreadsheets to capture the number and types of updates that are made over time

Skills and Qualifications

An ideal News Team Staff Researcher will possess:

  • A demonstrated passion for Ballotpedia’s mission
  • Knowledge of the United States' political system and elections
  • Experience working with databases and spreadsheets
  • Experience in writing and/or editing (with experience as a professional writer and/or editor preferred)
  • Superb organizational skills and a focus on detail
  • Self-awareness and a drive toward constant improvement
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • A desire to work collaboratively with Ballotpedia staff from multiple departments
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to multitask, set priorities, and follow through
  • A drive for innovation and flexibility, and an ability to identify and solve problems proactively
  • A willingness to work periodic evenings and weekends
  • Interest in or experience using AI tools to increase productivity

Environment

The News Team Staff Researcher will work remotely from their home location. All Ballotpedia staff work remotely. To join Ballotpedia, you must have a computer with Internet access. Ballotpedia utilizes Google Suite (Gmail, Google Calendar, Drive, and more), Slack, and Asana to achieve our goals. Some familiarity with the Google Suite, Slack, and Asana is helpful.

Ballotpedia offers a flexible work environment, BP Flex, which allows every employee to enjoy unlimited vacation and flexibility in scheduling. Each employee will be oriented to the principles of Ballotpedia’s flexible environment during new employee training.

Compensation

The starting pay range for the News Team Staff Researcher is $42,500-$44,000, commensurate with experience.

In addition to salary, Ballotpedia offers an annual benefits stipend equivalent to $8,000 that is paid out in equal increments in each paycheck once an employee becomes benefits eligible. The stipend may be used to pay for a full benefits package, including health, vision, and dental insurance; retirement accounts; and more. If benefits are not elected, the stipend is taxed as regular income and added to salary.

To Apply

To apply, click on ‘Apply for this job’ below and fill out the form. Please attach the following in PDF format if possible:

  • résumé
  • cover letter detailing your interest in Ballotpedia’s mission/this position
  • neutral writing sample (under five pages), included in the same file as your cover letter

Please ensure that either your résumé or your cover letter includes your current address.

Please note that if you are hired for this position, Ballotpedia participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, Ballotpedia is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9. For more information on E-Verify, or if you believe that your employer has violated its E-Verify responsibilities, please contact DHS.

About Ballotpedia

Ballotpedia is a mission-driven organization dedicated to providing Americans with accurate, relevant, and unbiased information about politics, elections, and public policy. Our mission is to ensure that the only unknown on your ballot is who gets your vote. We value innovation, humility, intellectual curiosity, drive, and a collaborative spirit and are committed to continuously improving our offerings to better serve our audiences, readers, and candidates.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering at VC-backed motorsport startup
jobs.excerpt: who we areTrack Titan is building the operating system for motorsport – every racer's "personal career mode", from their first casual lap to the pro ranks.
jobs.description:
who we are

Track Titan is building the operating system for motorsport – every racer's "personal career mode", from their first casual lap to the pro ranks. Over 300,000 sim racers use our AI coaching to get measurably faster – recording more than 1M km of racing telemetry daily while doing so, one of the most unique datasets in sports tech – and our ambitions stretch far beyond sim racing. We’re a team of pro-level racers who have also been senior employees in startups of all scales that have raised hundreds of millions of dollars. Together as Track Titan, we raised a $5M seed in late 2025, co-led by Partech and Game Changers Ventures, and we're the only company backed by tier-one VCs going deep on racing – which lets us make the big bets that nobody else in this space can. Now we're building the team to execute on those bets.

your mission

To build and lead the engineering org creating the best product in motorsport – one that ships quickly, predictably, and at a quality the whole team is proud of.

As our Head of Engineering, you'll own the people, delivery, and process side of engineering, across product engineering and ML. We're at the point where engineering leadership becomes a craft in its own right, and we're investing in it accordingly. You'll partner closely with the CTPO, who owns product and AI direction, to build the engineering org itself: the standards, the systems, and the culture.

This is a role for someone who is as passionate about speed, quality, team culture and operational excellence as most engineers are about the tech itself. The best teams are demanding and happy: people do their best work when expectations are high, ownership is real, and momentum is visible. We're not looking for someone to keep a machine running. We're looking for someone who is excited to build and fine-tune the machine in the first place.

Why this role, why now

We ship across web, desktop, and mobile, our ML work is moving from research into the product, and our ambitions are growing faster than the team. Our ways of working need to match: delivery that is predictable and visible, process that creates speed, and big ML bets that reach users in iterative steps along the way. We believe the fastest teams do fewer things, better – with high talent density and real ownership.

Up to now, engineering leadership has been shared between our CTPO and technical team leads, on top of everyone’s other responsibilities. This is the first time it becomes someone's full-time job – with real momentum and full backing from leadership.

What you will do

  • Own and grow the team. Run 1:1s that go beyond status updates, give candid feedback early rather than at review time, and build growth plans people actually follow. Recognise excellence loudly and address underperformance directly and early – and make both feel like the same thing: taking someone's growth seriously.
  • Own delivery. Own engineering's delivery cadence and commitments, across product engineering and ML. Make commitments clear, output predictable, and progress visible – momentum people can see is momentum they can feel. That includes research-heavy work: big bets broken into staged steps with honest uncertainty, so that user value ships along the way and decisions to double down, pivot or stop come early. When something slips, find the systemic cause and fix it rather than managing around it.
  • Build the operating system. Own the culture, rituals and processes that make the team fast – planning, retros, definition of done – improving them by shipping changes, not just writing proposals. You know the difference between process that creates speed and process that creates paperwork, and you treat process debt with the same seriousness as tech debt. This should be the part of the job that excites you most – especially at a time when AI is reshaping how engineering orgs are built and operate.
  • Lead how we build. Own org-wide standards and practices – quality, reliability, infrastructure and cost – and lead how we build as an AI-native engineering org. This is a hands-on management role, especially early on: you'll spend real time in the codebase and work closely with our senior engineers on the technical decisions that matter most.
  • Raise the bar with every hire. Own engineering's hiring and onboarding. Every person you add should lift the average, not just fill a seat, prioritising talent density over headcount. We expect engineering to grow significantly over the next 12–18 months, organically and potentially through acquisitions, and you'll shape who joins and how quickly they're shipping and feeling at home.
  • Put the team on the map. How we show up externally – through an engineering blog, conference talks, open source, or something we haven't thought of – is a fairly blank canvas and yours to shape together with the team. A team proud enough to show its work attracts people who raise the bar further.
This is a management role, but we're not adding management for its own sake. If the team isn't faster, prouder, and more ambitious because you're here, the role has failed. And if your instinct when something's broken is more ceremony, this isn't the fit. If it's more clarity, more ownership, more urgency – it is.

What success looks like in your first six months
  • Delivery is predictable, visible, and measurably faster: commitments are clear and met, and we ship user value in regular increments while also working towards bigger bets with more uncertainty.
  • Our levelling and performance systems are built for a growing org, and the team trusts them.
  • You've made your first hires, and each one lifted the average and delivered user impact.
  • We can absorb new people, teams and codebases – organically or through acquisition – without losing speed.
  • How we build and run things with AI is something the team is proud of, and that others ask us about.

your profile

What you bring:

  • Strong track record of managing software engineers, including leading multiple teams or managing managers – and management is the job you are passionate about, not the one you drifted into. The engineers you've managed would sign up to work for you again.
  • You've both taken over an existing team and built one through hiring, and you know the difference. You can talk concretely about how you earned trust in a team you didn't hire, and how you raised the bar through the people you brought in.
  • You've made a team measurably faster. You can point to delivery you improved – predictability, scoping, cycle time, the quality of commitments – and explain what you changed and why it worked.
  • You hold a high, explicit bar – and people rise to it rather than resent it. You'd rather have a hard conversation this week than a harder one next quarter, and you make performance – strong and weak – visible rather than letting it blur. Your former teams would call the experience demanding, and mean it as a compliment.
  • You've built people-systems, not just used them – engineering ladders, how feedback flows, how work gets planned and reviewed – ideally somewhere they didn't exist yet.
  • You're technically strong and hands-on. Ideally you've been a strong senior or staff engineer yourself: you can go deep in the stack, pressure-test architecture and delivery risk with senior engineers, and be taken seriously. You don't need to out-code the team, but you can't be a pure process manager.
  • Startup-scale pragmatism. You're comfortable in a small, early-stage engineering org while designing for one many times its size. No playbook cargo-culting: you understand the principles behind the processes and adapt them to the stage we're at.
  • Excellent written communicator. As a partially distributed, async-first team, writing is how we work: documentation, expectations, decisions, and feedback all live in writing.
  • Fluency with AI, both in your own work and in how it reshapes engineering orgs. You have a strong point of view on how AI changes how engineering teams should be structured and operate, ideally with concrete examples from previous teams. We're an AI company and we expect everyone to work like one.
  • You're obsessed with the product and its users. You use what you build – regularly and critically. For us that means driving: everyone on our team gets in the sim and uses Track Titan the way our racers do. Dogfooding is part of our culture.
Strong plus (if you bring everything above but not all of the below, we'd still love to hear from you):
  • You've delivered predictably where outcomes are uncertain. You've led ML, data science or research-heavy work into production alongside product engineering. You don't need to be an ML expert, but you know how to run this kind of work.
  • You've operated at the leadership level. You've owned an engineering budget, reported delivery and risk to execs or a board, and been through technical due diligence or integrated an acquired team.
  • Motorsport passion. Ideally you're already a sim racer or motorsport fan. If that’s not the case yet, what matters is genuine curiosity and that you go deep fast. If you don’t think you will find this interesting, then this is likely not the role for you.
  • Based in London. We're fully remote flexible (including some global members), but regular presence at our London HQ is a strong plus for this role.

why us?

  • Build the engineering org at a defining moment. You won't inherit a heavy legacy structure – you'll create the systems the org runs on for years, with org-level ownership from day one.
  • Leadership that wants you to win. You'll partner directly with a technically deep CTPO whose focus is product and AI direction – meaning engineering execution is truly yours to own – and you will also be close with the CEO and the commercial team who count on you for honest views on what engineering can deliver and when.
  • Work worth showing. Exciting technical challenges, one of the most unique datasets in sports tech, and a product that reaches hundreds of thousands of racers across the globe 24/7.
  • Join a team of fellow motorsport fans and sim racers who have backgrounds in top startups, sports data science, tier-one consulting, and professional motorsport, at the only motorsport startup in the world backed by tier-one VCs
  • Quarterly learning day and budget
  • Remote/office flexibility according to what works for you, with a great London HQ
  • Generous options package as a key early employee
  • Private pension (for UK employees)
  • Private health insurance (for UK employees)

Company Overview

Voted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients. We bring solutions to physicians by providing constant enhancement of our products and services including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination and billing.

Job Overview

Voted the #1 EHR by PC Magazine, WRS Health is a physician-owned company delivering a fully integrated, AI-powered cloud EHR and practice management platform to medical practices across 25+ specialties. We support physicians with continuously improving products and services, including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination, and billing.

We are seeking a Marketing Operations Strategist to develop and execute strategic marketing plans that drive brand awareness, customer acquisition, and revenue growth. You will build repeatable, measurable marketing systems that align with company goals, using HubSpot, AI-driven automation, and data science to turn marketing data into smarter decisions. This role is ideal for a results-driven, creative, and collaborative leader with a strong B2B SaaS background who enjoys managing projects, documenting processes, analyzing performance, and optimizing the website for better user experience, conversion rates, and lead generation.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Planning

  • Design and execute a comprehensive marketing strategy aligned with company objectives, target markets, and healthcare IT industry trends.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to define marketing goals, KPIs, and budgets.

AI-Focused Marketing Workflows

  • Design and implement AI-powered workflows for lead scoring, content generation, audience segmentation, chatbots, and campaign personalization.
  • Evaluate and integrate AI tools (including HubSpot's AI features) into the marketing stack, with clear guidelines for quality, brand voice, and HIPAA-conscious data use.

Data Science & Marketing Analytics

  • Apply statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and attribution modeling to forecast pipeline, identify high-value segments, and measure channel effectiveness.
  • Design and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across emails, landing pages, and website experiences, turning results into actionable recommendations.

HubSpot & Marketing Automation

  • Manage HubSpot (Marketing, Sales, Service, and CMS Hubs), including automation workflows, processes, and data hygiene.
  • Analyze reports and dashboards in HubSpot to track KPIs, campaign performance, and ROI for stakeholders.

Campaign & Website Optimization

  • Build and manage the email marketing program from segmentation to execution.
  • Improve forms, email templates, landing pages, and website experiences to increase conversion rates and lead generation.

Project Management & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Manage marketing operations projects from initiation to completion, tracking progress, risks, and bottlenecks to stay on schedule and within budget.
  • Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Service teams to integrate processes and document repeatable workflows.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Management, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of experience in marketing, marketing operations, and project management, preferably in B2B SaaS.
  • Advanced expertise in HubSpot (Marketing, Sales, Service, and CMS Hubs) and strong proficiency in marketing automation technologies.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-assisted marketing workflows (e.g., predictive lead scoring, AI content tools, chatbots, or personalization).
  • Strong analytical and statistical skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
  • Advanced database management and data visualization skills.
  • Solid understanding of customer journey mapping and business processes.
  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple projects at once.
  • Strong communication skills, including knowing how to ask the right questions and turn answers into systems.

Preferred

  • HubSpot certifications (Marketing, Sales, Operations, or related).
  • Experience as a HubSpot trainer or in HubSpot customer support.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, Python, or R for marketing data analysis.
  • Experience with BI tools such as Looker Studio, Tableau, or Power BI.
  • Familiarity with marketing attribution, predictive analytics, or machine learning concepts.
  • Experience marketing to healthcare providers or in health IT, with awareness of HIPAA considerations.

A Day in the Life

Your day blends strategy, systems, and data. You might start by reviewing HubSpot dashboards to check overnight campaign results and pipeline movement, then meet with Sales to refine how AI-driven lead scores route new leads to the right reps. Later, you could be building an automated nurture workflow that personalizes content by specialty, analyzing an A/B test on a demo-request landing page, or running a quick attribution analysis to show leadership which channels are actually driving booked demos. Along the way, you're cleaning up data, documenting processes so they can be repeated, keeping marketing projects on track, and testing new AI tools to see where they can save the team time without compromising quality.

Success Metrics

  • Pipeline and revenue growth: Measurable increases in marketing-qualified leads (MQLs), demo requests, and marketing-sourced revenue.
  • Conversion improvements: Higher conversion rates across the website, landing pages, forms, and email campaigns, validated through A/B testing.
  • AI-driven efficiency: AI and automation workflows in place that reduce manual work, improve lead scoring accuracy, and speed up campaign execution.
  • Data quality and insight: Clean, reliable HubSpot data and accurate dashboards and attribution reporting that leadership uses to make decisions.
  • Operational excellence: Marketing projects delivered on time and within budget, with documented, repeatable processes adopted across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Service.

jobs.description:
INFLUENCER MARKETING SPECIALIST

Location: Remote — Anywhere in the USA

Company:

Department: Marketing

Reports To: Marketing Manager

Type: Full-Time, Exempt
Compensation:$55,000 – $75,000 annually (based on experience)

About Seeking

is the world’s largest premium dating platform. Our business is as much data science and AI as it is storytelling, creative execution, and the science of human connection. We are rapidly expanding our marketing organization across Digital Marketing, Creative, Social Media, Brand, Content Production, Public Relations, and Growth.

Influencer marketing plays an increasingly important role in how we build brand awareness, create authentic storytelling, and engage new audiences. We’re looking for someone who understands creator culture, enjoys building relationships, and thrives in a fast-moving environment where trends, campaigns, and partnerships evolve quickly.

The Role

We’re looking for an Influencer Marketing Specialist to take full ownership of Seeking’s influencer and creator marketing initiatives, driving partnerships, managing campaigns, and overseeing the day-to-day operations of our influencer marketing efforts.

This role will take full ownership of the influencer lifecycle, from sourcing and securing targeted creators to leading negotiations, managing relationships, executing campaigns, coordinating deliverables, and supporting influencer events. This includes overseeing paid and organic UGC initiatives, independently managing the negotiation process from initial outreach through contract execution, and collaborating with talent managers, agencies, photographers, videographers, and internal teams.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, relationship-driven, and passionate about influencer marketing, creator culture, and social media trends. They must be able to take full ownership of initiatives from concept through execution, independently managing timelines, budgets, relationships, and deliverables to ensure successful campaign execution.

Why This Hire Matters

Influencer marketing is one of the most important and effective parts of our marketing strategy, offering an authentic way to connect with consumers and drive brand discovery. With the largest budget within the Marketing Department, this role plays a critical part in driving business growth and maximizing return on investment. This position will lead efforts to scale our influencer marketing program by building long-term creator partnerships, executing impactful campaigns, supporting experiential activations, and ensuring every partnership delivers measurable business value.

As a brand that operates in a sometimes controversial space, we need someone who is comfortable navigating public perceptions, understands the challenges and opportunities that come with marketing a polarizing brand, and can confidently identify, pitch, and secure creators who align with our positioning. The ideal candidate will approach these challenges strategically and creatively, turning potential barriers into opportunities for meaningful partnerships and brand growth.

What You’ll Own
Influencer Recruitment & Relationship Management

  • Own the end-to-end influencer recruitment process, from identifying and evaluating creators to negotiating and securing partnerships and managing long-term relationships.
  • Independently source, vet, and recruit influencers, UGC creators, ambassadors, and content partners across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest and emerging platforms.
  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of influencers and UGC creators aligned with Seeking's brand, target audiences, and marketing objectives.
  • Lead influencer outreach, briefs, pitches, relationship development, and partnership negotiations.
  • Identify and secure high-value brand aligned creators in all tiers, including emerging talent, established influencers, and larger-scale personalities.
  • Develop long-term creator partnerships that extend beyond individual campaigns and support ongoing brand initiatives.
  • Continuously evaluate creator quality, audience demographics, engagement, and historical performance to inform partnership decisions.

Influencer Campaign Management & Execution

  • Independently own and execute influencer marketing campaigns from initial planning and creator selection through launch, reporting, and optimization.
  • Develop influencer campaign concepts, partnership ideas, and activation opportunities that support broader marketing objectives.
  • Translate campaign goals into actionable influencer plans, creator briefs, deliverables, and execution timelines.
  • Manage multiple influencer campaigns simultaneously, ensuring deadlines, deliverables, budgets, and quality expectations are met.
  • Oversee creator content development, feedback, approvals, posting schedules, and campaign execution.
  • Proactively identify and resolve campaign challenges without requiring constant oversight.
  • Ensure influencer campaigns are aligned with Seeking's brand positioning, creative direction, and marketing priorities.
  • Take accountability for campaign execution and performance, identifying opportunities to improve results.
  • Manage campaign timelines and project schedules.

Influencer Partnerships, Negotiations & Agency Management

  • Lead negotiations with influencers, talent managers, and agencies to secure competitive rates and favorable partnership terms.
  • Own day-to-day relationships with influencer agencies and talent management partners.
  • Evaluate creator proposals, partnership opportunities, pricing, and anticipated value.
  • Negotiate content deliverables, exclusivity, usage rights, licensing, and partnership terms in collaboration with appropriate internal teams.
  • Manage agency performance, ensuring external partners deliver against campaign objectives, budgets, and timelines.
  • Identify opportunities to negotiate more efficient deals, establish recurring partnerships, and maximize the value of influencer investments.
  • Build strong industry relationships and proactively bring new talent and partnership opportunities to Seeking.


Influencer Budgets, Contracts & Operations
  • Manage allocated influencer marketing budgets, ensuring campaigns are executed efficiently and within approved spending limits.
  • Evaluate creator pricing, negotiate costs, and recommend how to allocate budgets across partnerships.
  • Oversee the influencer contracting process in collaboration with internal stakeholders and legal partners.
  • Manage partnership agreements, payment schedules, invoices, usage rights, and licensing documentation.
  • Own and continuously improve influencer databases, campaign tracking systems, and creator relationship management processes.
  • Develop efficient workflows for creator outreach, onboarding, campaign execution, reporting, and renewals.
  • Maintain clear visibility into active partnerships, financial commitments, deliverables, and campaign status.
  • Creating and maintaining documented processes and workflows

Social Productions, Activations & Events

  • Support the planning and execution of influencer events, brand activations, experiential campaigns, pop-ups, and creator experiences.
  • Coordinate influencer attendance and travel logistics when applicable.
  • Manage creator itineraries for events and productions.
  • Coordinate creators, agencies, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Coordinate creator content collection following campaigns and events.
  • Ensure influencer deliverables are received, approved, and archived.


Content, Creative Collaboration & Cultural Trends
  • Proactively develop influencer content ideas, creator collaborations, and campaign concepts that align with Seeking's brand identity.
  • Stay deeply connected to influencer culture, emerging creators, internet trends, and evolving social media platforms.
  • Identify timely cultural moments and partnership opportunities where Seeking can participate in relevant conversations.
  • Work with creators to develop authentic, engaging content while maintaining brand messaging and creative expectations.
  • Collaborate with Creative, Social Media, PR, and Brand teams to integrate influencer partnerships into larger campaigns.
  • Recommend innovative influencer formats, content approaches, and creator-led initiatives that differentiate Seeking.
  • Identify opportunities to repurpose high-performing influencer content across paid media, organic social, PR, and other marketing channels, subject to secured usage rights.


Performance Reporting & Optimization
  • Own performance tracking and reporting for influencer marketing campaigns and partnerships.
  • Establish and monitor campaign KPIs, including reach, engagement, impressions, traffic, conversions, and cost efficiency.
  • Evaluate creator performance to determine which partnerships should be continued, expanded, renegotiated, or discontinued.
  • Analyze campaign results and translate performance insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve creator selection, partnership costs, content performance, and overall influencer ROI.
  • Present recurring performance updates, campaign insights, and recommendations to marketing leadership.
  • Continuously test new influencer approaches, creator categories, and partnership formats to improve results.


Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration
  • Serve as the primary owner of influencer marketing execution across Seeking's marketing initiatives.
  • Work independently while maintaining clear communication and alignment with marketing leadership.
  • Partner with Brand, Creative, Social Media, PR, and Lifecycle & Growth teams to identify influencer opportunities within integrated marketing campaigns.
  • Lead influencer-related workstreams and hold internal and external stakeholders accountable for agreed deliverables and timelines.
  • Proactively communicate campaign progress, challenges, opportunities, and recommendations.
  • Contribute to influencer marketing planning, priorities, and future campaign development.

About You

This section matters just as much as your experience.

We’re hiring for someone who understands creator culture and enjoys building relationships.

  • You understand what Seeking stands for and believe in the brand.
  • You enjoy networking and developing relationships.
  • You stay on top of creator trends and influencer culture.
  • You are highly organized and detail-oriented.
  • You can manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
  • You communicate professionally with creators, agencies, and partners.
  • You are proactive and comfortable solving problems independently.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced marketing environment.
  • You understand social media platforms and emerging trends.
  • You are comfortable using AI tools to improve efficiency and workflows.
  • You must be receptive to constructive feedback, maintain professionalism when receiving criticism, and demonstrate a willingness to take accountability, make adjustments, and continuously improve.

Qualifications

Required

  • 3–5 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, performance marketing, or digital marketing, with direct responsibility for managing influencer campaigns.
  • Proven experience independently managing influencer partnerships from sourcing and negotiations through campaign execution, reporting, and optimization.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing fundamentals, including conversion tracking, attribution, marketing funnels, and customer acquisition.
  • Demonstrated ability to measure influencer campaign ROI and evaluate performance using metrics such as CPA, CAC, ROAS, conversion rates, and cost per engagement.
  • Experience managing influencer marketing budgets, negotiating partnership rates, and evaluating creator investments based on expected and actual performance.
  • Experience working directly with influencers, talent managers, and agencies to negotiate deliverables, usage rights, licensing, and partnership terms.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to independently manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, budgets, and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with affiliate marketing, referral programs, promotional codes, and other methods of measuring influencer-driven conversions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present campaign performance, insights, and recommendations to marketing leadership.
  • Willingness to travel at least once per quarter for influencer events, productions, and company meetings as needed
  • Ability to work on a Pacific schedule longterm

Preferred

  • Experience with influencer marketing platforms such as Upfluence, CreatorIQ, or similar creator management and reporting tools.
  • Experience with paid social advertising, particularly Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager, and an understanding of how influencer-generated content can support paid acquisition.
  • Experience with creator whitelisting, partnership ads, and paid amplification of influencer content.
  • Experience executing influencer campaigns for controversial consumer-facing brands in lifestyle, beauty, fashion, entertainment, luxury, or dating.
  • Experience managing high-profile influencers, celebrity partnerships, or large-scale creator activations.
  • Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT to streamline influencer research, campaign management, reporting, and marketing workflows.

Who are we?

The Motley Fool is a purpose-driven financial services company on a mission to make the world smarter, happier, and richer. For 30 years, we’ve been helping people make better investment decisions through transparency, education, and a healthy dose of Foolish fun. We’re a fast-moving, collaborative team that values high-quality work, curiosity, and initiative. We care deeply about what we do, and we’re driven by the impact our work has on real people’s financial futures.

The Role

Once someone becomes a Motley Fool member, the product they use every day is what earns their renewal. Our vision moves us from stock picks to a full investing system and platform experience, this role owns building it.

As a Product Manager for Member Experience, you'll own the daily product surface — dashboard, portfolio tools, personalization, and mobile — built on top of the AI scoring and research engine our Intelligence team maintains.

What you'll do

  • With your cross-functional team, own member engagement as your core metric, the product-side driver of renewal.
  • Anchor the Member Platform team (web and app). You own its backlog and the quality of the member-facing product: dashboard, portfolio tools, community, and mobile app roadmap.
  • Own onboarding and activation — get new members to their first valuable action fast, so the value they signed up for lands in the first days, not weeks. This is where early renewal is won or lost.
  • Build personalized experiences on top of our AI scoring engine, the right research and insight for the right member, partnering with our Intelligence team, who provide the underlying AI/scoring APIs — keeping personalization on the right side of the line between helpful and regulated investment advice.
  • Design and ship features that turn a "read the email" habit into a daily or weekly product habit, across both the in-product and email experience.
  • Run a continuous member-research and usage-analytics practice, so decisions are grounded in behavior, not assumption, and feed what you learn into offering and packaging decisions with our commercial and domain experts.
  • Write specs precise enough for engineers and AI agents to build against, and bring a business case to our weekly product review. This is a decision-making forum, not a status update.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally on a consumer or subscription product with a strong engagement/retention focus
  • A committed active investor with real skin in the game — you understand our members because you are one
  • Experience building personalized or recommendation-driven product experiences is a strong plus

Job Title: Senior Epidemiological Programmer, Real World Evidence - FSP

Job Location: Durham, North Carolina, United States of America

IQVIA is hiring to expand our dedicated Real World Evidence (RWE) FSP team, working fully within the environment of a prominent Pharma company. Epidemiological Programmer role sits within our Real World Solutions team and will be responsible for leading development of datasets and conducting longitudinal analyses for observational studies in the virology therapeutic area under one client portfolio. It is important for this individual to have demonstrated experience and applied proficiency in observational research utilizing EMR and claims data, a strong statistical programming skillset, both knowledge and applied experience with epidemiological study design, terminology, cohort building, and RWE outcome measures, and experience managing multiple studies and complex analyses. In this role, individuals will have access to real-world databases and act as the stewards of the client’s best practices, standards, and methodologies underlying the use of real-world data (RWD).

Essential Functions

  • Lead development of analytic datasets through raw data processing and conduct data checks / cleaning using secondary real world data sources, including claims, EHR, and lab data (e.g. Optum, HealthVerity, TriNetX, IQVIA PharMetrics Plus)
  • Lead the feasibility of real-world data sources to characterize patient population, build patient cohorts, and define and validate key variables specific to study objectives.
  • Conduct and QC analyses, including identification of diagnosis and treatment codes and applying statistical methods to handle censored data, confounding, differing person-time, and missing data
  • Collaborate with epidemiologists on study design and methodology, as well as define specifications for descriptive and complex statistics (e.g. longitudinal analysis, survival analysis, regression models, propensity score methods) in studies using RWD for virology research questions
  • Develop and QC TFLs for protocols/reports/manuscripts using RWD (e.g. claims and EHR)
  • Support development of other study documents including protocols, statistical analysis plans, and study reports
  • Communicate timelines, progress reports, and results to project team and key stakeholders
  • Provide technical, programming, statistical, and epidemiological expertise and independently bring project solutions to team for complex studies

Qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Biostatistics, Epidemiology, Outcomes Research or related field with 5-8 years relevant experience or PhD with 3 years relevant experience required
  • Strong track record of analysis of RWD using EMR and claims data
  • Demonstrated proficiency in advanced statistical programming using SAS and/or R, macros, SQL required
  • Demonstrated experience and applied proficiency of RWE study design, terminology, cohort building, and analytic methodologies
  • Prior pharmaceutical or CRO experience
  • Excellent analytic and communication skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to effectively manage and prioritize multiple tasks and projects

More than 100 organizations across commercial, government, and research sectors trust D-Wave to address complex computational challenges using quantum computing. Learn more about realizing the value of quantum computing today and how D-Wave is shaping the quantum-driven industrial and societal advancements of tomorrow: .

About the role

D-Wave is seeking a Manager, IT Systems to lead a small, high-impact System Administration team. This is a hands-on leadership role for team performance, priorities, and operational delivery. You'll provide technical direction and ensure infrastructure is secure, reliable and scalable. You'll partner with IT leadership and cross-functional teams to align team priorities with business needs and support the company’s growth.

This is a Remote role within Florida, with Boca Raton being a bonus.

Hands-on support

A D-Waver's DNA
