jobs.title: Content Operations Specialist
jobs.excerpt: About Eleanor Health At Eleanor Health we are helping people affected by addiction live amazing lives.
jobs.description:
About Eleanor Health

At Eleanor Health we are helping people affected by addiction live amazing lives. We work to fulfill this goal by building and growing the first addiction and mental health services provider designed to deliver a longitudinal, whole-person, value-based model of care for each community member. Our team is ambitious and committed to this unique opportunity, and understands the importance of attracting strong and experienced talent to make our vision for Eleanor Health a reality every day, and for every recovery journey we are entrusted to be a part of.

About The Role

Most people looking for addiction treatment never see a brochure. They search, they ask an AI assistant, they read an article someone linked in a community. The content Eleanor Health publishes is how we show up in those moments: accurately, warmly, and in language that treats every reader with dignity.

The Content Operations Specialist brings Eleanor Health's content strategy to life by managing the day-to-day production, governance, and publication of accurate, accessible, search-optimized content. Working within our AI-assisted Content Engine and Sanity CMS, this person coordinates the full content lifecycle, from briefs and drafting through editorial and clinical review, publishing, quality assurance, and ongoing optimization.

This role combines strong editorial judgment with operational discipline. The Content Operations Specialist maintains visibility into the production pipeline, ensures that content meets brand, clinical, and technical standards, and improves the processes that help our team publish consistently and responsibly. Written content is the primary focus, with opportunities to support multimedia and cross-channel content as the program grows.

Core Responsibilities

Content Production & Publishing

  • Own the day-to-day content production pipeline, coordinating assignments, deadlines, editorial and clinical reviews, approvals, staging, and publication against priorities established by the Sr. Manager.
  • Produce, build, and publish location pages, service pages, educational articles, FAQs, and guides in Sanity using structured content models, including required metadata, schema inputs, internal links, and calls to action.
  • Conduct pre- and post-publication quality assurance to verify content accuracy, formatting, functionality, and consistency. Coordinate with internal subject matter experts to confirm operational details such as locations, services, and insurance acceptance.
  • Maintain the content library throughout its lifecycle, coordinating scheduled refreshes, consolidation, and retirement of outdated content while documenting publication history, URL changes, and redirects.

AI-Assisted Content Operations

  • Operate Eleanor Health's AI-assisted Content Engine, executing established workflows to develop briefs, generate and refine drafts, and prepare content for editorial and clinical review.
  • Apply human editorial judgment to AI-assisted content, verifying factual claims against approved sources and editing for accuracy, clinical sensitivity, brand voice, and readability. Maintain citations and source documentation.
  • Maintain Content Engine prompts, templates, editorial guidelines, and quality standards. Identify recurring issues, recommend improvements, and implement approved workflow changes.
  • Evaluate Content Engine performance, including output quality, recurring errors, revision requirements, and review efficiency, using findings to recommend improvements to the production process.

Search & AI Visibility (SEO, GEO, AEO)

  • Apply established on-page SEO standards, including titles, headings, meta descriptions, internal linking, image alt text, URL structure, and structured data inputs.
  • Optimize content for traditional and AI-powered search through clear information architecture, direct answers, relevant question-and-answer formats, consistent terminology, and credible citations.
  • Conduct keyword, topic, search intent, and audience-question research to support briefs and recommend content creation or refresh opportunities aligned with established priorities.
  • Monitor content-level performance in Google Search Console, Ahrefs, and approved AI visibility tools. Identify opportunities for improvement and conduct routine content-level SEO quality assurance, escalating technical issues to the appropriate partners.
  • Collaborate with the Reputation & AI Visibility Specialist on content supporting local search visibility, accurate business information, reputation initiatives, and AI citations and recommendations.

Cross-Channel Content Support & Creative Coordination

  • Adapt approved content and messaging for social media, email, video scripts, and downloadable resources in collaboration with channel owners and creative partners.
  • Coordinate content briefs, approved copy, source materials, deliverables, and applicable reviews with designers, video producers, and other creative partners. Support the organization and publication of completed assets in accordance with established standards.

Content Operations & Accountability

  • Maintain a centralized content calendar, intake queue, and production tracker that provide visibility into priorities, assignments, deadlines, dependencies, review status, and publication.
  • Manage day-to-day production schedules and stakeholder coordination, proactively resolving routine bottlenecks, communicating risks or delays, and escalating priority conflicts or decisions requiring strategic direction.
  • Maintain clear, repeatable operational documentation, including publishing checklists, standard operating procedures, workflow instructions, and editorial guidance.
  • Provide regular reporting on content throughput, production timelines, review turnaround, outstanding deliverables, and process improvements, with actionable recommendations for the Sr. Manager.

Language, Privacy & Compliance

  • Apply Eleanor Health's brand voice and person-first, stigma-free communication standards, ensuring content is accurate, compassionate, accessible, and respectful of people seeking care.
  • Follow established privacy and confidentiality policies, including applicable HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2 requirements. Protect patient information and use only appropriately authorized patient stories, testimonials, or other sensitive materials.
  • Identify and escalate sensitive clinical claims, privacy concerns, and compliance questions to authorized reviewers. Document required approvals and ensure unresolved concerns are addressed before publication.

You'll Be A Good Fit If You:

  • Treat documentation, process, and quality assurance as essential parts of producing great content, not administrative afterthoughts.
  • Learn new content systems quickly, enjoy working with structured content, and look for ways to make workflows more efficient and reliable.
  • Take ownership of deliverables from assignment through publication, anticipating dependencies, following up with stakeholders, and keeping work moving without constant direction.
  • Understand that content isn't finished until it's accurate, accessible, discoverable, and properly published.
  • Write and edit plainly, warmly, and accurately, and can adapt approved messaging for different audiences and channels without losing its meaning or intent.
  • Stay organized and proactive when managing competing requests, communicate clearly about capacity and deadlines, and know when to escalate decisions about priorities.
  • Approach the work with compassion and sound judgment, recognizing that clear, trustworthy information can help someone take the first step toward care.

Skills & Competencies

  • Experience: 3+ years in content operations, editorial production, content marketing, or a related field, with demonstrated experience managing content workflows, coordinating stakeholders, and delivering content from assignment through publication.
  • AI-assisted content: Hands-on experience using large language models such as Claude or ChatGPT in content workflows, including prompting, drafting, editing, fact-checking, and evaluating output quality. Ability to follow established AI content governance standards and identify opportunities for process improvement.
  • Content systems: Experience working in a content management system such as Sanity, WordPress, Contentful, or similar. Familiarity with structured content, metadata, and basic Markdown or HTML, with the ability to learn new publishing systems quickly.
  • SEO, GEO & AEO: Working knowledge of on-page SEO, keyword and topic research, internal linking, and content optimization for traditional and AI-powered search. Familiarity with Google Search Console, Ahrefs, or AI visibility monitoring tools is preferred.
  • Writing & editing: Strong editorial skills, with demonstrated ability to write and edit clear, accurate, accessible content, adapt messaging across channels, verify factual claims, and maintain consistent brand voice.
  • Content operations & project coordination: Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex content workflows, coordinate stakeholders, anticipate dependencies, and deliver accurate, approved content on schedule.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Experience coordinating with writers, designers, subject matter experts, and other stakeholders to move content through review, approval, and publication. Ability to communicate clearly, manage dependencies, and follow through on commitments.
  • Judgment & accountability: Sound editorial judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to recognize when content requires additional clinical, legal, technical, or compliance review before publication.

Helpful but not required:

  • Experience creating or managing content in healthcare, behavioral health, substance use disorder treatment, or another regulated industry
  • Familiarity with schema markup, structured data, and technical SEO concepts
  • Experience implementing, managing, or improving AI-assisted content production workflows
  • Familiarity with creative collaboration tools such as Canva or Figma, particularly for reviewing assets, working with templates, or coordinating with design partners

What This Role Is Not

We would rather be clear now than leave it ambiguous.

  • Not a content strategy role. Organic acquisition strategy, editorial priorities, and major content decisions are established by the Sr. Manager. This role owns operational execution and recommends improvements to how the work gets done.
  • Not a prompt-and-publish role. AI-generated content is a starting point. Every deliverable requires human editorial judgment, fact-checking, and applicable reviews before publication.
  • Not a developer role. CMS architecture, technical configuration, and engineering are owned by the appropriate technical teams. This role works within established systems, identifies issues, and coordinates necessary corrections.
  • Not a clinical or compliance approval role. Clinical, legal, and compliance decisions remain with authorized subject matter experts. This role coordinates required reviews, documents approvals, and ensures unresolved concerns are addressed before publication.

Compensation & Benefits

The total target compensation range for this position is $20-25 an hour. The actual compensation offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include, as applicable, the applicant’s qualifications for the position; years of relevant experience; specific and unique skills; level of education attained; certifications or other professional licenses held; other legitimate, non-discriminatory business factors specific to the position; and the geographic location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will perform the job.

Eleanor Health offers a generous benefits package to full-time employees, which includes:

  • Generous Paid Time Off (prorated for new employees) - unplug, relax, and recharge!
    • 12 Vacation days
    • 12 Wellness (Sick) days
    • 3 Floating holidays
    • 9 Company-observed holidays
    • Jury Duty, Voting Leave, and other forms of paid time off may be available
  • Eleanor-paid medical and dental insurance plans, with affordable vision coverage -We are a health first company, and we strive to make our plans affordable and accessible.
  • 401(k) plan with 3% match - We are excited to be able to support the long-term financial well-being of our team in a way that reinforces Eleanor’s commitment to equity.
  • Short-term disability - We understand that things happen, we want you to feel comfortable to take time to get better.
  • Long Term Disability - Picks up where Short Term Disability leaves off (employee paid).
  • Life Insurance - Both Eleanor and employee-paid options are available.
  • Family Medical Leave -Eleanor Health’s Paid Family & Medical Leave (“PFML”) is designed to provide flexibility and financial peace of mind for approved family and medical reasons such as the birth, adoption, or fostering of a child, and for serious health conditions that you or a family member/significant other might be facing.
  • Wellness Perks & Benefits -Mental Health is important to us and we want our employees to have the accessibility you deserve to talk things through, zen with a mindfulness app, or seek assistance from health advocates
    • Mindfulness App Reimbursement
    • EAP with eight face-to-face sessions
    • Virtual health and wellness visits covered by our medical plan.

jobs.title: Senior CRM Specialist - Adobe Experience Cloud
jobs.excerpt: This job posting is available in English and Canadian French.
jobs.description:
This job posting is available in English and Canadian French. Please scroll down for the French version.

Cette offre d’emploi est disponible en anglais et en français (Canada). Veuillez faire défiler pour la version française.

Remote - U.S. & Canada Only | Full-Time

Compensation:

  • $100K USD (U.S.-based candidates)
  • $100K CAD (Canada-based candidates)

The Senior CRM Specialist is a hands-on, technically strong CRM operator who builds, deploys, and maintains email campaigns and customer journeys in Adobe Experience Cloud for Level's clients. This is not a pure engineering role: we are looking for someone who understands why a journey exists, not just how to build it. They should bring a marketer's sense of the customer lifecycle to every build.

About Level

Level Agency is an AI-powered performance marketing agency built for brands ready to shatter yesterday’s wins.

We help complex, high-consideration brands outperform their last result using AI, data science, creativity, and relentless iteration.

We specialize in markets where the stakes are high and the journeys are complex — education, B2B technology, financial services, healthcare, CPG, ecommerce, and more. Our work spans the full performance ecosystem: media planning & buying, performance creative, SEO & AI search, CRM & automation, and advanced analytics.

In 2025, Level acquired BAM Strategy — expanding our capabilities into digital experience, CRM strategy, personalization, and loyalty. The result is a fully integrated growth engine that connects acquisition to retention, media to lifecycle, and performance to long-term customer value.

Today, our 250-person team operates fully remote across the U.S. and Canada, supporting 150+ ambitious brands.

Your Role (and Impact)

Sitting within Level's Martech & Analytics team, this person takes a brief and runs with it. They own their work from setup through deployment, make sound judgment calls without being told every step, and bring forward recommendations when something could work better. The ideal candidate is a self-directed, proven operator who can step into an existing instance, diagnose what is broken, and fix it with minimal oversight.

  • Own the build, QA, and deployment of email campaigns in Adobe Campaign (Classic or Standard) and/or Adobe Journey Optimizer end to end, ensuring every send is accurate, on time, and on brand
  • Translate briefs and journey maps into working builds, filling gaps with sound judgment and raising questions early when a brief is incomplete or a requirement won't work as written
  • Configure audience targeting, personalization, and dynamic content within existing templates and data schemas to improve relevance and engagement
  • Manage the send calendar, including scheduling, dependency sequencing, and deployment-readiness checks for rendering, links, suppression, and compliance (CAN-SPAM, TCPA, CASL)
  • Configure and maintain multi-step, multi-channel journeys (email, plus SMS and push where in scope), implementing segmentation, flow control, and decision logic
  • Run journey QA on logic, timing, and audience entry/exit conditions before activation, so issues are caught before they reach customers
  • Audit existing campaign and journey builds, workflows, and data schemas, diagnose what is broken, redundant, or misconfigured, and fix it without disrupting live sends
  • Recommend improvements to journey logic, segmentation, and program performance, explaining the marketing rationale as well as the technical approach
  • Bring a proposed solution, not just the problem, when escalating structural or data-quality issues that require architecture-level decisions
  • Communicate clearly with internal teams and client stakeholders, setting expectations, flagging risks, and explaining technical trade-offs in plain language
  • Document builds and fixes so the team has a clean, reliable handoff trail

Skills & Qualifications

Must-Haves:

  • Hands-on production experience in Adobe Campaign (Classic or Standard) and/or Adobe Journey Optimizer / Adobe Experience Platform
  • A track record of owning CRM work end to end with minimal oversight; you are comfortable being the person who makes it work
  • Proven ability to step into an existing instance built by others, diagnose problems, and repair prior configuration rather than only building greenfield
  • Strong lifecycle marketing understanding: you can explain why a journey is designed a certain way and spot when it isn't serving the customer or the business
  • Sound judgment on when to make a call yourself and when to escalate, with the confidence to push back on a brief that won't work
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical issues to non-technical stakeholders
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for email template troubleshooting and customization
  • Working knowledge of email/SMS compliance regulations

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (strongly preferred), such as Journey Builder, Email Studio, Automation Studio, AMPscript, and SQL query activities
  • Experience with additional CRM and marketing automation platforms, such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Klaviyo, or Braze
  • Experience with Adobe Experience Platform segments, schemas, and audience activation
  • SQL or scripting (JavaScript) for workflow customization and troubleshooting
  • Telecom or B2C subscription-industry CRM experience
  • Agency-side or client-facing experience

Education & Experience

Must-Haves:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field (or 4 additional years of equivalent professional experience)
  • 5 to 8 years of hands-on CRM and lifecycle marketing experience, with significant production work in Adobe Experience Cloud email and journey platforms

Preferred:

  • Adobe Certified Professional or Expert in Adobe Campaign or Adobe Journey Optimizer
  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud certification (e.g., Email Specialist, Developer, or Consultant)
  • Agency experience supporting CRM programs for multiple clients simultaneously

AI Expectations

At Level, proficiency with AI tools is a core part of your role—not a nice-to-have. Your success in this position depends not only on your functional expertise, but also on your ability to actively integrate AI into how you work.

You are expected to:

  • Experiment continuously with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude, Perplexity) to improve the speed, quality, and impact of your work (e.g., draft briefs, summarize research, analyze data trends, generate initial strategic frameworks, identify patterns in large datasets).
  • Proactively document and share what you learn—your prompts, process improvements, and use cases—so others can benefit and we can grow together.
  • Approach AI with an iterative mindset, refining how you apply it to your work over time. The first idea is rarely the best; testing, tweaking, and improving is part of the process.
  • Lean into discomfort, especially when tools or workflows feel unfamiliar. Growth happens when you're stretching beyond what's comfortable or routine.

AI is not a shortcut—it’s a skillset. You’re expected to use it as a force multiplier for creativity, strategy, and execution, not as a substitute for thoughtful work. As our tools evolve, your ability to adapt and lead through change will be a key part of your performance and growth at Level.

Our Core Values

  • No Ego, All In
    We don't do "that's not my job." We win together, step in where needed, and care more about the outcome than the org chart.
  • Better Every Day
    We want the feedback, even when it stings. We test, learn, adapt, and keep raising the bar.
  • Relentless for Results
    Activity is nothing without outcomes. We care about the work that moves the business forward.
  • Driven by Truth
    We challenge assumptions, follow the data, and tell clients what they need to hear, not just what is easy to say.

Perks & Benefits

At Level, we support our people across the U.S. and Canada with benefits designed to promote flexibility, wellbeing, and long-term growth.

  • Fully remote across the U.S. & Canada, plus monthly WFH stipend and Summer Fridays
  • Generous time off, including unlimited PTO (U.S.), competitive vacation (Canada), and parental/family leave options
  • Comprehensive health benefits, mental health support, and company-paid disability & life coverage
  • Employer retirement contributions (401(k) in the U.S., RRSP match in Canada)
  • Quarterly performance reviews and career advancement opportunities

Remote First

This role is open to U.S. and Canada residents and is fully remote. Occasional travel may be required for company events and team working sessions. We are unable to sponsor visas at this time.

Level Is Built on Inclusion

We celebrate what makes you, you. Level Agency provides reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities during the recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please let us know during your application or interview process.

Ready to Apply?

Click below to submit your resume. You'll also answer a few thoughtful questions, so take your time.

We care more about what you can do than whether your career path was perfectly linear.

Let's build something together.

AI HIRING DISCLAIMER

We use AI-assisted tools to support parts of our hiring process, including resume screening and interview note-taking or summarization. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment. All hiring decisions are made by Level's hiring team.

Télétravail, États-Unis et Canada seulement | Temps plein

Rémunération :

  • 100 000 $ US (candidats et candidates basés aux États-Unis)
  • 100 000 $ CA (candidats et candidates basés au Canada)

Le ou la spécialiste CRM senior est une personne technique, pragmatique et à l’aise en production, qui crée, déploie et maintient des campagnes courriel et des parcours client dans Adobe Experience Cloud pour les clients de Level. Ce n’est pas un rôle d’ingénierie pure : nous cherchons quelqu’un qui comprend pourquoi un parcours existe, et pas seulement comment le construire. Cette personne apporte à chaque projet le sens du cycle de vie client d’une vraie marketeuse ou d’un vrai marketeur.

À propos de Level

Level Agency est une agence de marketing de performance propulsée par l’IA, conçue pour les marques prêtes à faire voler en éclats les succès d’hier.

Nous aidons des marques complexes, dont le cycle de décision est long, à surpasser leur dernier résultat grâce à l’IA, à la science des données, à la créativité et à une itération acharnée.

Nous sommes spécialisés dans les marchés où les enjeux sont élevés et où les parcours sont complexes : éducation, technologies B2B, services financiers, santé, produits de grande consommation (PGC), commerce électronique, et plus encore. Notre travail couvre tout l’écosystème de la performance : planification et achat média, créatifs de performance, SEO et recherche IA, CRM et automatisation, et analytique avancée.

En 2025, Level a acquis BAM Strategy, élargissant ses capacités à l’expérience numérique, à la stratégie CRM, à la personnalisation et à la fidélisation. Le résultat : un moteur de croissance entièrement intégré, qui relie l’acquisition à la rétention, les médias au cycle de vie, et la performance à la valeur client à long terme.

Aujourd’hui, notre équipe de 250 personnes travaille entièrement à distance partout aux États-Unis et au Canada, au service de plus de 150 marques ambitieuses.

Votre rôle (et votre impact)

Au sein de l’équipe Martech et analytique de Level, cette personne prend un mandat et le mène à terme. Elle assume la responsabilité de son travail, de la configuration jusqu’au déploiement, prend de bonnes décisions sans qu’on lui dicte chaque étape et propose des recommandations lorsqu’une approche pourrait être améliorée. La candidate ou le candidat idéal est une personne autonome et éprouvée, capable de prendre en charge une instance existante, de diagnostiquer ce qui ne fonctionne pas et de le corriger avec très peu de supervision.

  • Assumer de bout en bout la conception, l’assurance qualité et le déploiement des campagnes courriel dans Adobe Campaign (Classic ou Standard) et/ou Adobe Journey Optimizer, en veillant à ce que chaque envoi soit exact, livré à temps et fidèle à la marque
  • Traduire les mandats et les cartes de parcours en builds fonctionnels, en comblant les lacunes avec un bon jugement et en soulevant rapidement des questions lorsqu’un mandat est incomplet ou qu’une exigence ne fonctionnera pas telle qu’elle est rédigée
  • Configurer le ciblage d’audience, la personnalisation et le contenu dynamique à partir des gabarits et des schémas de données existants, afin d’améliorer la pertinence et l’engagement
  • Gérer le calendrier d’envois, y compris la planification, le séquencement des dépendances et les vérifications de préparation au déploiement (rendu, liens, listes de suppression et conformité : CAN-SPAM, TCPA, LCAP/CASL)
  • Configurer et maintenir des parcours multiétapes et multicanaux (courriel, ainsi que SMS et notifications push lorsqu’ils font partie du mandat), en mettant en œuvre la segmentation, le contrôle des flux et la logique décisionnelle
  • Effectuer l’assurance qualité des parcours (logique, synchronisation, conditions d’entrée et de sortie des audiences) avant l’activation, afin de repérer les problèmes avant qu’ils n’atteignent les clients
  • Auditer les campagnes, parcours, flux de travail et schémas de données existants, diagnostiquer ce qui est défectueux, redondant ou mal configuré, et le corriger sans perturber les envois en cours
  • Recommander des améliorations à la logique des parcours, à la segmentation et à la performance des programmes, en expliquant la justification marketing autant que l’approche technique
  • Présenter une solution proposée, et pas seulement le problème, lorsqu’on escalade des enjeux structurels ou de qualité des données qui exigent des décisions d’architecture
  • Communiquer clairement avec les équipes internes et les parties prenantes des clients, en fixant les attentes, en signalant les risques et en expliquant les compromis techniques en langage simple
  • Documenter les builds et les correctifs afin que l’équipe dispose d’une trace de transfert claire et fiable

Compétences et qualifications

Incontournables :

  • Expérience pratique en production dans Adobe Campaign (Classic ou Standard) et/ou Adobe Journey Optimizer / Adobe Experience Platform
  • Un historique démontrable de travaux CRM menés de bout en bout avec une supervision minimale : vous êtes la personne qui fait en sorte que ça fonctionne
  • Capacité éprouvée à prendre en charge une instance conçue par d’autres, à diagnostiquer les problèmes et à réparer une configuration existante, plutôt que de seulement bâtir à partir de zéro
  • Solide compréhension du marketing de cycle de vie : vous pouvez expliquer pourquoi un parcours est conçu d’une certaine façon et repérer quand il ne sert pas le client ou l’entreprise
  • Bon jugement pour décider quand trancher vous-même et quand escalader, avec l’assurance nécessaire pour contester un mandat qui ne fonctionnera pas
  • Communication écrite et verbale claire, y compris pour expliquer des enjeux techniques à des interlocuteurs non techniques
  • Connaissance pratique de HTML/CSS pour le dépannage et la personnalisation des gabarits de courriel
  • Connaissance pratique de la réglementation en matière de courriels et de SMS

Atouts :

  • Expérience pratique dans Salesforce Marketing Cloud (fortement souhaitée), notamment Journey Builder, Email Studio, Automation Studio, AMPscript et activités de requêtes SQL
  • Expérience avec d’autres plateformes de CRM et d’automatisation du marketing, comme Microsoft Dynamics 365, Klaviyo ou Braze
  • Expérience avec les segments, les schémas et l’activation d’audiences dans Adobe Experience Platform
  • SQL ou scripts (JavaScript) pour la personnalisation et le dépannage des flux de travail
  • Expérience en CRM dans le secteur des télécommunications ou des abonnements B2C
  • Expérience en agence ou en contact direct avec les clients

Formation et expérience

Incontournables :

  • Baccalauréat en marketing, systèmes d’information, informatique, administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe (ou 4 années supplémentaires d’expérience professionnelle équivalente)
  • De 5 à 8 ans d’expérience pratique en CRM et en marketing de cycle de vie, dont un volume important de travaux en production sur les plateformes de courriel et de parcours d’Adobe Experience Cloud

Atouts :

  • Certification Adobe Certified Professional ou Expert en Adobe Campaign ou Adobe Journey Optimizer
  • Certification Salesforce Marketing Cloud (p. ex. Email Specialist, Developer ou Consultant)
  • Expérience en agence, à soutenir simultanément les programmes CRM de plusieurs clients

Attentes en matière d’IA

Chez Level, la maîtrise des outils d’IA fait partie intégrante de votre rôle, et n’est pas un simple atout. Votre réussite dans ce poste repose non seulement sur votre expertise fonctionnelle, mais aussi sur votre capacité à intégrer activement l’IA à votre façon de travailler.

On s’attend à ce que vous :

  • Expérimentiez continuellement avec des outils d’IA (p. ex. ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude, Perplexity) pour améliorer la rapidité, la qualité et l’impact de votre travail (p. ex. rédiger des mandats, résumer des recherches, analyser des tendances dans les données, générer des cadres stratégiques initiaux, repérer des tendances dans de grands ensembles de données)
  • Documentiez et partagiez de façon proactive ce que vous apprenez (vos requêtes, vos améliorations de processus et vos cas d’usage), afin que les autres en profitent et que nous progressions ensemble
  • Abordiez l’IA avec un état d’esprit itératif, en affinant votre façon de l’utiliser au fil du temps. La première idée est rarement la meilleure : tester, ajuster et améliorer fait partie du processus
  • Acceptiez l’inconfort, surtout lorsque les outils ou les flux de travail vous sont peu familiers. La croissance survient lorsqu’on dépasse ce qui est confortable ou routinier

L’IA n’est pas un raccourci, c’est une compétence. On s’attend à ce que vous l’utilisiez comme multiplicateur de force pour la créativité, la stratégie et l’exécution, et non comme substitut à un travail réfléchi. À mesure que nos outils évoluent, votre capacité à vous adapter et à mener le changement sera un élément clé de votre performance et de votre croissance chez Level.

Nos valeurs fondamentales

  • Pas d’ego, tous engagés
    Chez nous, pas de « ce n’est pas mon travail ». Nous gagnons ensemble, nous intervenons là où c’est nécessaire et nous nous soucions davantage du résultat que de l’organigramme.
  • Meilleurs chaque jour
    Nous voulons la rétroaction, même quand elle pique. Nous testons, apprenons, nous adaptons et continuons de relever la barre.
  • Acharnés pour les résultats
    L’activité ne vaut rien sans résultats. Ce qui compte, c’est le travail qui fait avancer l’entreprise.
  • Guidés par la vérité
    Nous remettons les hypothèses en question, nous suivons les données et nous disons aux clients ce qu’ils ont besoin d’entendre, pas seulement ce qui est facile à dire.

Avantages sociaux

Chez Level, nous soutenons nos employés partout aux États-Unis et au Canada grâce à des avantages conçus pour favoriser la flexibilité, le bien-être et la croissance à long terme.

  • Télétravail complet partout aux États-Unis et au Canada, avec allocation mensuelle de télétravail et vendredis d’été
  • Congés généreux, y compris congés payés illimités (É.-U.), vacances concurrentielles (Canada) et options de congés parentaux et familiaux
  • Assurances collectives complètes, soutien en santé mentale, et assurance invalidité et assurance vie payées par l’entreprise
  • Cotisations de l’employeur à la retraite (401(k) aux États-Unis, cotisation de contrepartie au REER au Canada)
  • Évaluations de performance trimestrielles et possibilités d’avancement professionnel

Remote First : le télétravail d’abord

Ce poste est ouvert aux résidents des États-Unis et du Canada et se fait entièrement en télétravail. Des déplacements occasionnels peuvent être requis pour des événements de l’entreprise et des séances de travail d’équipe. Nous ne sommes pas en mesure de parrainer des visas pour le moment.

Level mise sur l’inclusion

Nous célébrons ce qui fait de vous qui vous êtes. Level Agency offre des mesures d’adaptation raisonnables aux personnes candidates en situation de handicap pendant le processus de recrutement. Si vous avez besoin de mesures d’adaptation, faites-le-nous savoir lors de votre candidature ou de votre entrevue.

Prêt(e) à postuler?

Cliquez ci-dessous pour soumettre votre CV. Vous répondrez aussi à quelques questions réfléchies, alors prenez votre temps.

Nous accordons plus d’importance à ce que vous savez faire qu’à un parcours professionnel parfaitement linéaire.

Bâtissons quelque chose ensemble.

Avis sur l’utilisation de l’IA dans l’embauche

Nous utilisons des outils assistés par l’IA pour appuyer certaines étapes de notre processus d’embauche, notamment le tri des CV et la prise de notes ou la synthèse des entrevues. Ces outils appuient le jugement humain, sans le remplacer. Toutes les décisions d’embauche sont prises par l’équipe d’embauche de Level.

jobs.description:
Salary: £30,000 - £40,000 depending on experience and qualifications

Location: Remote (all UK locations considered) with flexible working arrangements. Our flexible office collaboration spaces, for those wishing to use them, are in London, Bristol and Exeter.

Term/Hours: Permanent (6-month probation). Full-time (40 hours per week)

Right to Work: Must have own right to work in the UK for more than 2 years

Closing date: Monday 9th November 2026

CVs FROM RECRUITERS (INCLUDING THOSE ON OUR PSL) WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED. DIRECT APPLICATIONS ONLY.

We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of sex, gender identity, age, disability, ethnicity, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

We are only accepting direct applications (no recruiters please).

Unfortunately, we cannot consider applications requiring visa sponsorship now, or in the future.


ABOUT US

City Science is an SME founded in 2015 with a core mission of delivering decarbonisation. We help organisations who are committed to decarbonisation achieve meaningful and quantifiable carbon reductions quickly and efficiently.

Our software and product development team produce innovative and uniquely insightful digital tools, like Cadence and our decarbonisation tool, to successfully deliver our projects.

We work collaboratively across our consultancy team made up of transport, energy, sustainability, carbon accounting and applied data science specialists to provide integrated solutions to our clients. Our range of clients is extensive and includes forward-thinking local authorities like Oxfordshire County Council, sub-national transport bodies like England’s Economic Heartland and national organisations like Department of Energy Security & Net Zero (see our full list of projects here).

We have a series of emerging services lines (which are all underpinned by market areas), including the following focused within:

  • Net Zero Strategies & Roadmaps (e.g. Area-based future decarbonisation pathways, green growth strategies)
  • Net Zero Development (e.g. Transport evidence bases for Local Plans and infrastructure strategies)
  • Sustainable Transport (e.g. Local cycle & walking infrastructure plans (LCWIPs), bus service planning and movement strategies)
  • Net Zero Transport (e.g. Electric Vehicle charging strategies and net zero transport pathways)
  • Transport Modelling (e.g. Strategic, freight, micro-simulation and active travel modelling)
  • Heat & Retrofit (e.g. Heat pumps sizing, internet of things)
  • Energy Planning (e.g. Local Areas Energy Plans)
  • Energy Modelling (e.g. DNO capacity, building monitoring/benchmarking)
  • Data Engineering (e.g. Future technology roadmaps)
  • Carbon Accounting (e.g. Business decarbonisation, circular economy)

About the Role

We are looking to grow our team of developers working across the full stack to deliver cutting edge applications and tools to support our decarbonisation mission. This role requires highly talented individuals who can take a proactive role in problem solving. Successful candidates must be able to show extremely high aptitude in mathematics and analytical problem solving.

Existing coding skills are not required but are desirable and driven candidates with self-taught skills are particularly encouraged to apply. City Science predominantly uses JavaScript and Python, but other languages are also used, and all experience is considered. Experience working with cloud-based services is also desirable. Experience using AI to support software development is welcome but we expect candidates to demonstrate and develop independent skills, motivation and communication throughout the application process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain a range of applications and tools that support clients to plan, monitor, evidence and visualise their decarbonisation pathway
  • Energy Modelling (e.g. Home Energy Model, building physics/benchmarking)
  • Support staff internally to provide insights with a high level of automation/digitisation, meeting or exceeding industry standard practices
  • Manage the full development stack and work flexibly to meet emerging need
  • Collaborate across teams and grow relationships between consultancy professionals and software developers
  • Drive new technologies and integrated ways of working
  • Communicate the case for decarbonisation through cutting edge software tools

Requirements

  • BSc 2:1 or better in a STEM subject (1st class degree, PhD or higher-level qualification desirable)
  • Able to demonstrate very strong mathematical and numerical skills
  • Drive to learn and develop coding and technology skills across the full stack (experience and/or self-taught skills desirable)

· Excellent problem solver

  • Can demonstrate ability to work as part of a team, collaborating effectively with both internal and external stakeholders
  • Proven science communicator to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Passion to make the case for, and execute, decarbonisation

Rewards & Benefits

  • Opportunity to work on a diverse range of projects across the consultancy business
  • Opportunity for career progression
  • 25 days annual leave entitlement
  • Competitive salary (based on skills and experience)
  • Ongoing mentoring, training and support from senior professionals within the business (including towards professional chartership)
  • Paid membership of a maximum of two institutions

· Flexible working arrangements

  • Membership of our group pension scheme

FURTHER INFORMATION

We are building a team who are motivated by collaboration with the desire to solve problems for our customers. This one-year position will focus on building and launching a system for preserving and sharing legal scholarship using Digital Object Identifiers (DOIs) within the service.

Perma.cc has provided web citation preservation to the legal community for over a decade. The adoption of DOI—standard elsewhere in scholarly publishing—is increasingly critical in law, with Bluebook requirements on the horizon. The project will design a plan for incorporating DOI into the ecosystem, coordinate the planning and rollout of DOI minting, and document sustainable operational models for the future.

As the Perma.cc Legal Digital Scholarship Project Manager, your responsibilities will include:

Analysis, Requirements Gathering & Standards Tracking

  • Review current practices at HLSL and Perma.cc and identify requirements for DOI assignment to legal scholarship and web materials.
  • Track developments in legal citation standards related to DOI and ensure project alignment.

Evaluation & System/Workflow Design

  • Evaluate options for DOI minting (such as CrossRef membership or other registration methods) and make recommendations.
  • Develop and document criteria and workflows for DOI assignment, in line with existing standards in other fields.

Stakeholder Engagement & Outreach

  • Lead outreach to law journals, faculty, clinics, and other stakeholders to establish procedures for DOI registration.
  • Serve as primary liaison to DOI registration agencies to arrange necessary permissions and clarify technical needs.

Technical Collaboration & Implementation

  • Collaborate with technical teams at Perma.cc and HLSL to design and pilot the integration of DOI processes into existing systems.

Documentation, Policy Development & Reporting

  • Prepare clear documentation and policy recommendations for the ongoing management of DOIs at HLSL and Perma.cc.

jobs.description:
Macmillan is one of the Big 5 Publishers with mission-critical systems running royalties, distribution, and the supply chain that books move through from manuscript to consumer. Those systems cannot be turned off. They also cannot stay as they are. The organization has committed to a multi-year modernization of its core technology platforms, the build of a Publishing Operating System that enables imprints to operate more efficiently, and the productionization of AI capabilities across the publishing lifecycle. This is a rare opportunity to help redefine the technology foundation of a global publishing company in the AI era.

This is a role for someone who has built and shipped AI-powered products at scale and now wants to shape the technical future of an industry that is being fundamentally transformed by AI.

A link to a LinkedIn, GitHub, Hugging Face, or personal portfolio is mandatory for consideration for this role.

THE ROLE

As a Senior AI Engineer (Full-Stack / Applications), you will design, build, and operate production-grade, cloud-native applications with AI at their core. This role sits at the intersection of strong software engineering and deep AI expertise, with a focus on turning state-of-the-art AI capabilities into robust, scalable, and high-quality user-facing products.

This role prioritizes deep AI knowledge alongside strong software engineering skills to ensure an effective utilization of AI capabilities in production systems.

You will work across the full lifecycle of AI-powered systems: from evaluating and optimizing models, to integrating them into end-to-end applications, to deploying, monitoring, and iterating on them in production. Candidates may bring deeper expertise in either application development or applied AI, and we value engineers who are excited to collaborate and grow across disciplines. We do not expect candidates to match every technology or qualification listed below. Strong candidates will bring deep expertise in some areas alongside curiosity, adaptability, and strong collaboration skills.

In this role you will be flexibly assigned to short-term PoC projects, mid-term rapid MVP projects and long-term product development, based on your skills, interests, and company priorities.

Our current and future tech-stack: Google Cloud, AWS, Firebase, Python, Typescript, Django, Terraform, Github, Cloud Firestore, EventArc, PubSub, GCIP, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions v2, React, BigQuery, Github Actions, commercial AI services, Open Source AI Models, Langfuse, Snowflake, PostgreSQL.

What You'll Do:

  • Own AI-powered features end-to-end, from scoping, design and requirements engineering to feature evaluation, deployment and operation.
  • Design, build and maintain cloud-native, event-driven AI applications across the full stack.
  • Evaluate, integrate, and optimize AI models for production use, balancing quality, latency, reliability and cost.
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional team members, including non-technical stakeholders, to refine requirements and align technical solutions with business objectives.
  • Build and maintain robust AI inference, evaluation, and monitoring pipelines.
  • Develop and implement robust, automated AI application evaluation frameworks.
  • Analyze AI application performance data and experiments, using insights for data-driven improvements.
  • Operate and improve production systems, taking ownership of reliability, quality, and technical debt.
  • Stay current with AI advancements and share knowledge to upskill the team.
  • Plan, track, and break down work effectively in an agile team.
  • Provide technical leadership, drive design reviews, write ADRs and contribute to hiring and onboarding.
  • Participate in on-call rotations, incident response and post-mortems for AI-powered systems and help define SLOs and error budgets.

What You'll Bring:

  • Pragmatic, result-oriented analytical problem solving skills that can overcome ambiguity.
  • Friendly, concise, audience-oriented communication in written and spoken form (English) with effective asynchronous communication.
  • Self-organized, purpose-driven individual that likes to collaborate with and enable their team.
  • A T-shaped engineer with strong general software engineering and AI skills, paired with deep expertise in at least one area:
    • Frontend: Advanced experience with React and TS, building high-quality, user-facing apps.
    • Backend: Deep experience designing and operating scalable, event-driven Python systems in cloud-native environments.
    • AI: In-depth knowledge of frontier AI models, evaluation, integration into AI-powered product features, and production best practices.
  • Strong theoretical understanding and practical experience with current AI model internals.
  • Proven experience with AI model deployment & utilization strategies, evaluation methodologies, and monitoring frameworks in production environments.
  • Proven experience owning features end-to-end, from technical design to production.
  • Strong understanding of how to integrate AI into production systems, including the challenges of non-deterministic behavior.
  • Solid understanding and practical application of MLOps and LLMOps best practices for AI applications.
  • Familiarity and hands-on experience with major AI service providers and their offerings.
  • Working knowledge of fine-tuning methods and their appropriate application.
  • Strong software engineering skills with the ability to bridge AI research/concepts and robust, production-ready engineering implementations.
  • Experience breaking down complex AI objectives into requirements & actionable tasks.
  • Experience leveraging and refining agile practices and processes within an AI/ML team context, including effective requirements, design, and code reviews.
  • Proven experience in quickly assessing and adopting new technologies & frameworks.
  • Able to implement Clean Architecture & Onion Architecture principles.
  • Experience building and operating cloud-native systems, ideally on Google Cloud / Firebase with solid DevOps and MLOps fundamentals, including CI/CD, observability, and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Working knowledge of AI safety and security.
  • Solid testing discipline across the stack.
  • Mentorship and technical-leadership experience: growing other engineers, leading design reviews, and influencing technical direction across teams.
  • Working knowledge of AI safety and security: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, prompt injection, data exfiltration risks, content moderation, and PII / GDPR handling.
  • Solid testing discipline across the stack - unit, integration, and contract tests for both deterministic code and AI components.
  • Experience operating production systems on-call

What We'd Love to See:

  • Experience in the publishing or media industry
  • Experience with our entire TechStack
  • Experience with MLOps on Vertex AI & Weights and Biases
  • Experience in applied research
  • Experience applying & implementing SRE methodologies
  • Advanced understanding of ML, LLMs and trends in the AI market
  • Specialized, deep expertise in a relevant area.

This position offers a base salary between $200,000-$225,000 and is eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to applicable plan terms.

This position is classified as remote but is tied to our New York, NY office located at 120 Broadway. Employment is subject to New York State tax withholding under applicable regulations.

This is a strategy and execution role. You will define user journeys, build programs directly in HubSpot, own lifecycle messaging and cadence, and measure results. You will also help shape the lifecycle requirements for our planned email platform and user-profile migration.

We are looking for someone who can set direction, build and optimize programs independently, and use data to prioritize opportunities across lifecycle stages and channels.

What you'll do to make an impact:

  • Define user lifecycle journeys, activation milestones, and progression criteria in partnership with Marketing Operations and Product, with distinct programs for general contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers.
  • Design, build, and optimize HubSpot workflows for onboarding, activation, plan upgrades from Basic to Premier, retention, and win-back.
  • Own lifecycle messaging, copy, cadence, and campaign execution, partnering with Product Marketing and Design on positioning and creative.
  • Segment and personalize communications by trade, geography, behavior, and plan, working with Product on the signals that make project recommendations relevant.
  • Plan and manage communications across email, in-app messaging, and additional channels where they improve results.
  • Run experiments with clear hypotheses, success measures, and appropriate comparison groups to understand the effect on activation, repeat usage, retention, and upgrades.
  • Build and maintain lifecycle reporting in partnership with Marketing Operations, including cohort and funnel analysis, and communicate findings to Marketing, Product, and leadership.
  • Lead lifecycle program requirements for the planned email platform and user-profile migration, partnering with Marketing Operations, Product, and Engineering on event definitions, consent and suppression needs, vendor evaluation, and launch validation.
  • Monitor email engagement, deliverability, and suppression practices, working with Marketing Operations, Product, and Engineering to maintain healthy sending practices.

What you will accomplish in your first 90 days:

  • Audit existing lifecycle programs, workflows, and data availability, and recommend a prioritized lifecycle roadmap.
  • Launch or improve activation programs for general contractor and subcontractor users.
  • Establish a lifecycle dashboard with agreed activation definitions and baseline cohort reporting, including 30-, 60-, and 90-day retention where historical data is available.
  • Deliver a lifecycle requirements document for the planned migration, including program priorities, required events and attributes, consent and suppression needs, and launch acceptance criteria.

What will make you stand out:

  • Five or more years of experience in lifecycle marketing, CRM, or marketing automation, ideally in a marketplace, product-led, or SaaS business with a high-volume user base.
  • Deep, hands-on HubSpot experience, including workflows, lists, properties, segmentation, and the underlying data model.
  • Strong analytical skills, including cohort and funnel analysis, experiment design, and experience using SQL or a business intelligence tool.
  • Experience running high-volume email programs, including campaigns and automated sends, with examples of tests you ran and results you improved.
  • Experience building behavioral and event-triggered programs.
  • A record of setting lifecycle strategy and personally building, launching, and optimizing the programs.
  • Strong copywriting skills and the ability to turn product value into clear, relevant customer communications.
  • Working knowledge of email deliverability, consent management, suppression practices, and compliance requirements.
  • Clear communication and the ability to work effectively with Marketing Operations, Product Marketing, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success.
  • Experience with a customer data platform (CDP).
  • Experience with Braze, Iterable, Klaviyo, or a similar orchestration platform.
  • Experience supporting an email platform migration or implementing new behavioral data and messaging capabilities.
  • Background in B2B marketplaces, construction, or SMB customers.
  • Knowledge of email deliverability and compliance requirements.

How we will measure success:

Success will be measured by improvements in activation, repeat usage, 90-day retention, and upgrades and reactivation attributable to lifecycle programs, alongside healthy unsubscribe, complaint, bounce, and deliverability metrics.

What's in it for you:

Join a company that’s just landed on the Inc. 5000 for the sixth year in a row, recognized among America’s fastest-growing private companies. You can make an immediate impact as PlanHub moves to dominate the industry!

  • Remote friendly
  • An excellent benefit package, including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance

This role offers a base salary of $105,000 - $120,000 per year, depending on experience. This role also includes the benefits described above, including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, a 401(k) with company match, and an open time-off policy.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Project Control Analyst to provide financial analysis, project controls, reporting, and contract-administration support for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This role manages and analyzes funding, invoicing, expenditures, burn rates, estimates at completion, spend plans, tools, travel, other direct costs, and related contract-financial data.

The Senior Project Control Analyst will support SAM.gov service-contract reporting, monitor funding and expenditures by Contract Line Item Number, develop financial information for Monthly Status Reports and Program Management Reviews, and maintain accurate data for program dashboards and approval workflows. This position will work closely with program leadership, contracts, finance, task leads, subcontractors, and Government stakeholders to promote accurate forecasting, compliant invoicing, and timely financial decision-making.

This position is remote, with preference given to candidates located in or near Chicago.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Senior Project Control Analyst will:

  • Prepare and maintain annual service-contract labor reporting data for submission through SAM.gov, including applicable subcontractor labor.
  • Monitor task order funding, expenditures, commitments, and available balances by CLIN, contract period, task, and cost category.
  • Develop and maintain budget-versus-actual analyses, burn-rate calculations, forecasts, and estimates at completion.
  • Prepare spend plans, funding-status reports, financial dashboards, and other decision-support products for program leadership.
  • Develop financial inputs for Monthly Status Reports, Program Management Reviews, Project Management Plan updates, and other recurring program deliverables.
  • Track planned and actual expenditures and identify funding, schedule, or performance variances requiring management attention.
  • Prepare draft invoice backup documentation and reconcile supporting data before submission for Government review and approval.
  • Validate invoice charges against the applicable contract period, CLIN, labor category, rate, quantity, and supporting documentation.
  • Support electronic invoice preparation and submission through the Government-designated invoicing system.
  • Track current-period and cumulative invoicing, subcontracted amounts, billed costs, remaining balances, and final-invoice status.
  • Maintain detailed tracking for tools, travel, and other direct costs, including purchase documentation, approvals, incurred costs, and cumulative amounts invoiced.
  • Support Requests to Initiate Purchase, Consent to Purchase requests, and Travel Authorization Requests.
  • Track whether proposed purchases are commercial or non-commercial items or services and maintain supporting commerciality records.
  • Coordinate with contracts, accounting, finance, procurement, task leads, and subcontractors to validate financial data and resolve discrepancies.
  • Maintain financial data supporting Task Order Management Portal dashboards, management reports, and approval workflows.
  • Establish and maintain consistent financial-control procedures, templates, logs, and reconciliation processes.
  • Support funding and financial-data transitions during transition-in and transition-out activities.
  • Analyze financial trends and communicate potential funding shortfalls, overruns, underruns, invoicing delays, and other risks to program leadership.
  • Maintain organized, complete, and auditable financial records in accordance with contract and company requirements.
  • Protect sensitive Government, corporate, personnel, and financial information.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of relevant professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in project controls, program finance, financial planning and analysis, contract finance, accounting, or a related discipline.
  • Experience supporting Department of Defense, federal civilian, or other Government contracts.
  • Experience monitoring funding and expenditures by CLIN, task, contract period, or cost category.
  • Experience developing budgets, forecasts, burn-rate analyses, estimates at completion, variance analyses, and spend plans.
  • Experience preparing financial inputs for Monthly Status Reports, Program Management Reviews, or comparable executive-level reports.
  • Experience preparing, reviewing, reconciling, or supporting Government contract invoices and invoice backup documentation.
  • Experience with firm-fixed-price, fixed-price-award-fee, cost-reimbursable, tools, travel, or other direct cost CLINs.
  • Experience with SAM.gov service-contract reporting.
  • Experience with Government invoicing or acquisition systems, including ASSIST or comparable platforms.
  • Experience supporting travel authorizations, purchase requests, consent-to-purchase requests, and commerciality tracking.
  • Experience coordinating financial data with contracts, accounting, procurement, task leads, subcontractors, and Government stakeholders.
  • Experience maintaining financial information in program-management portals, dashboards, or automated approval workflows.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data validation, reconciliation, and financial modeling.
  • Experience with Power BI, SharePoint, Deltek Costpoint, Unanet, Microsoft Project, or comparable financial, reporting, and collaboration tools.
  • Knowledge of federal contracting, funding controls, invoicing requirements, indirect costs, and financial-record retention.
  • Familiarity with earned value concepts and project-performance measurement.
  • CPA, CMA, Certified Government Financial Manager, Earned Value Professional, PMP, or a comparable financial or project-controls certification.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, reconciliation, and forecasting abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail, data integrity, and documentation quality.
  • Ability to explain complex financial information clearly to non-financial stakeholders.

jobs.excerpt: Data IdeologyAt DI, we provide Data & Analytics expertise to drive measurable business outcomes, often solving complex business problems for our clients.
jobs.description:
Data Ideology

At DI, we provide Data & Analytics expertise to drive measurable business outcomes, often solving complex business problems for our clients. Our data analytics advisory services enable our customers to transform data into insights by driving a culture of empowerment and ownership of results. Our team consists of highly motivated individuals passionate about learning, understanding, collaborating, and intellectually curious. For more information about Data Ideology, visit

Data Governance Analyst

We are seeking a hands-on Data Governance Analyst to operate at the intersection of data governance, analytics, technology, and the business. This is not a policy-only governance role. The ideal candidate will work directly with business and technology stakeholders to understand data, document and improve how it is governed, analyze issues, and turn governance objectives into practical solutions.The right person will be comfortable moving between stakeholder conversations, data definitions, data quality, metadata, SQL-based analysis, reporting, and governance processes.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will help the organization make its data more:

  • Trusted
  • Understandable
  • Consistent
  • Accessible to the right people
  • Measurable
  • Governed in a practical, usable way

They should be able to take an ambiguous data problem, work with stakeholders to understand it, dig into the underlying data where necessary, and drive the issue toward resolution.For more information about Data Ideology, visit www.dataideology.com

Responsibilities
To perform in this position successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. Other duties may be assigned to meet business needs.

  • Partner with business, data, technology, and governance stakeholders to identify and address data governance needs.
  • Facilitate conversations with data owners and subject-matter experts to establish definitions, ownership, standards, and appropriate usage of data.
  • Support development and maintenance of business glossaries, data dictionaries, metadata, data standards, and governance documentation.
  • Assist with data quality initiatives by identifying, analyzing, documenting, and helping remediate data issues.
  • Perform hands-on data analysis using SQL or similar tools to investigate governance and data-quality questions.
  • Analyze datasets to validate business rules, definitions, completeness, consistency, and accuracy.
  • Help translate business requirements into measurable data rules and governance requirements.
  • Support data access, sharing, and usage-governance processes.
  • Build or maintain reporting, dashboards, or metrics that provide visibility into data quality and governance activities.
  • Work across teams to improve governance workflows and reduce manual or inefficient processes.
  • Communicate findings clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Help move governance initiatives from discussion and documentation into repeatable operational processes.

Supervisory Responsibilities: None

Qualifications

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field required. Advanced degree preferred.

  • Approximately 2–5 years of experience in data governance, data analytics, business/data analysis, or a related discipline.
  • Experience working directly with business stakeholders, data owners, technical teams, or senior leadership.

  • Strong Plus

  • Experience in banking, financial services, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience with enterprise data governance or data-quality platforms.
  • Familiarity with Informatica or comparable governance/data-quality tooling.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms or modern data environments.
  • Experience automating data, reporting, or governance workflows.
  • Exposure to master data management, customer data, hierarchy management, or enterprise metadata.
  • Working knowledge of:
    • Data governance
    • Data quality
    • Metadata and data definitions
    • Data ownership/stewardship
    • Data access and usage
  • Hands-on SQL experience and the ability to investigate and analyze data independently.
  • Experience with reporting or visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to translate between business requirements and technical/data concepts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Organized, curious, analytical, and comfortable in environments where not every requirement is initially defined.

The strongest candidate will have the technical aptitude to investigate data independently while remaining comfortable working directly with business stakeholders.

Work Environment:

  • Remote work from home.
  • Hours of work and days are generally Monday through Friday. Specific business hours will depend on client needs.

Physical Demands:

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.
  • The person in this position must occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, library stacks, office machinery, etc.
  • Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and printer.
  • The person in this position frequently communicates with clients and coworkers. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

Data Ideology is an EEO Employer

jobs.excerpt: We're looking for someone to run our international conference programme and exhibitions, as well as our own customer events and webinars.
jobs.description:
We're looking for someone to run our international conference programme and exhibitions, as well as our own customer events and webinars. Full-time, permanent, UK-based, and fully remote.

Salary £30,000 - £40,000 (depending on experience).

Closing date: Sunday 8th November

Industry: Education and Software, with a focus on medical and health professional education.

Why this role exists

Our customers rely on the risr/ platform to deliver high-stakes and workplace-based assessments that really matter to institutions, professionals, and ultimately patient care.

Events are one of the main ways we meet leads and key decision-makers at organisations we want to work with, and stay close to the customers we have. In 2026, that means around 25 conferences and exhibitions across the UK, Europe, North America, and Australia; our own community days and customer events in each region; and a regular programme of webinars and user groups. Many of these are planned a year or more ahead.

This role exists to give every one of those events a single owner, from first booking to final report. Nothing slips, every deadline is met, and our go-to-market team can focus on conversations rather than logistics.

The role at a glance

As our Events Specialist, you’ll own the delivery of every risr/ event: international conferences and exhibitions, our own in-person community days and customer events, and our webinars and online events.

Our go-to-market team (marketing, business development and account management) decides which events we attend and what we want from them, and you make them happen. You’ll book the space, manage the suppliers, meet every exhibitor deadline, get the right people and materials to the right place, and report back on each event's costs and outcomes.

Most of the work is done remotely from the UK. You’ll attend some UK events in person, and occasionally travel overseas, to see how our events run on the ground and to understand the market and our competitors.

You might currently be an events manager, events executive or conference coordinator. What matters is that you’ve run events from start to finish.

Requirements

Responsibilities

Conferences and exhibitions

  • Turn the go-to-market team’s event decisions into one clear, shared events calendar, planned far enough ahead to secure good space and rates.
  • Book exhibition space, sponsorships, and memberships, and track the contracts, payment dates, and deadlines that come with them.
  • Own the exhibitor portal for every event, ensuring insurance documents, risk assessments, company information, branding, and team registrations are submitted on time.
  • Book stand furniture, power, AV and any other on-site services.
  • Arrange shipping of stand kit and materials, including customs requirements for events outside the UK.
  • Work with the regional marketing leads to order print and collateral, so the right materials arrive in the right place.
  • Coordinate speaking slots with organisers, including abstracts, slide decks and speaker details, so submissions are made on time.
  • Put together a detailed briefing on the event schedule, exhibit hours, contact details, the leads form link, and exhibitor and sponsor information in a team document, including clear goals and outcomes, and review it in a pre- and post-event call.
  • Build strong relationships with event organisers, so we hear about opportunities early and maintain good terms on sponsorships.

risr/-hosted events

  • Plan and deliver our in-person community days, customer lunches, workshops and showcases in each region, working with the regional marketing lead.
  • Find, compare and book venues, and organise catering, AV and accessibility needs.
  • Manage registrations, prepare attendee communications, and coordinate on-the-day logistics.
  • Order and coordinate the print and delivery of event materials and services.
  • Manage event resources and materials

Webinars and online events

  • Set up and run logistics for webinars, user groups, and online events in Zoom, including registration, reminders, and recordings.
  • Act as the main logistics contact for external speakers.
  • Share registrant lists with the regional marketing lead for follow-up.

Planning, reporting and improvement

  • Set up and manage each event as a project in monday.com, so everyone involved knows what’s due and when, and follow up on anything outstanding.
  • Record the spend on every event in one place, so the team can see what each one costs.
  • Run a short review after each major event: what it cost, who we met, what worked and what to change.
  • Keep our event checklists, processes and supplier contacts written down and up to date, so every event gets easier to run.

What success looks like

  • Every exhibitor deadline, portal submission and registration is met, without last-minute scrambles.
  • The team arrives at every event with the stand, materials, bookings and briefing they need, and can focus on networking.
  • Spend is recorded for every event, so the go-to-market team can compare what each event cost with what it delivered.
  • Leads from every event are in the CRM within a week of the event closing.
  • We complete a short review after every major event, and what we learn shapes the next one.
  • The go-to-market team trusts that if an event is on the calendar, you'll handle it.

Who we are looking for

We’re more interested in how you think and work than ticking every box, but experience that will help you succeed includes:

Essential

  • At least 3 years' experience organising events from start to finish, ideally as an exhibitor at conferences or exhibitions, not only as the host or venue.
  • Excellent organisation, with the ability to manage many events at once, each at a different stage and with its own deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail. You spot missing forms before they become a problem.
  • Confidence in building relationships with organisers, venues and suppliers, and with colleagues across different teams and time zones.
  • A calm, structured approach to solving problems when plans change.
  • Experience running webinars or online events in Zoom or a similar platform.
  • The ability to communicate clearly and confidently in written and spoken English.
  • The ability to work autonomously while collaborating openly with others.
  • A curious, practical relationship with AI. You try things, keep what works, and build it into how you actually work.

Desirable

  • Experience organising international events, including shipping, customs or travel logistics.
  • Experience with B2B, SaaS, education or healthcare events.
  • Experience with event registration or digital events platforms.
  • Experience using tools such as monday.com, a CRM, or similar platforms.

About us

The risr/ mission is to provide technology to enable every ambition.

The risr/ platform enables doctors, dentists, nurses, and other health professionals to apply and pay for assessments, be assessed effectively, and advance through their courses and training programmes so they can ultimately provide high-quality patient care and promote health.

Our software and services help institutions, such as Awarding Bodies, Universities and Postgraduate Specialty Medical Colleges, achieve digital transformation of assessment processes, for example, written and practical exams and workplace-based assessments.

We are growing rapidly in international markets in Australia, Canada, Asia, Ireland and beyond. For example, over 60% of doctors in the UK are assessed using risr/ products.

What you can expect at risr/

We keep things brutally simple; we are natural-born collaborators; we’re hungry for innovation; and we always do the right thing - even if it’s harder or requires us to go the extra mile.

As we continue to grow, some business travel will be required to meet our customers in person and nurture strong, effective relationships.

Due to the nature of our work and having teams based in multiple time zones, there will be a requirement for the successful applicant to work outside of regular office hours, in the evening / early mornings or on the weekend. We take care to ensure team members are not required to do this regularly, and with our flexible working arrangements, our team manages their regular working time around any out-of-hours work that may be required.

Benefits

Our people enjoy a very high level of trust, autonomy, flexibility and transparency, including:

  • Work from home, at a co-working space or set up an office near your home.
  • Freedom to choose your equipment and training as you see fit.
  • Freedom from corporate bureaucracy, which slows people down and stops them from giving their best.
  • Access to open-book finances: everyone in the company knows our income, outgoings, what we have in the bank and everyone’s salary.
  • A generous salary, benefits package (including enhanced parental leave policies based on length of service) and participation in profit share.
  • A Health and Wellbeing Allowance of £1,200 per annum.
  • Confidential mental health support
  • Electric vehicle scheme
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • risr/ pays for your internet.
  • risr/ pays for a mobile phone and contract.
  • risr/ provides genuinely flexible working and autonomy.
  • risr/ allows you to set your working routine to suit you based on your role and team.

Who is RTS:

Recycle Track Systems (RTS) was developed with a desire to do better. We are committed to evolving and challenging the waste industry to be better stewards of the environment. We utilize technology, data analytics, sustainability expertise, and operational excellence to help people and businesses incorporate sustainability into their daily routines. Our passion for sustainability and innovation allows for us to guide businesses to a future of reaching a goal of zero waste.

Our technology platform utilizes sensors, GPS tracking, and highly engaged partner haulers to provide waste management and recycling services and track materials from their source to recycling and composting facilities. Our sustainability experts analyze the data generated by the platform to help our customers make tangible improvements to their waste management and recycling efforts. Ultimately, we are innovating to treat waste as a component material for other products in the circular economy so that as little as possible is deposited into landfills or incinerators.

What we need:

This position is a customer and hauling partner approach, excelling not only in the delivery of outstanding client support to both internal and external clients but also in actively executing functions related to account management, procurement, and processing service requests within our customer's processes. Your pivotal role involves managing the entire customer life cycle to ensure business retention. The team oversees a book of business, aiming to establish long-term partnerships and improve profit margins for both customers and vendors. Leveraging strategic thinking, the team maximizes operational efficiencies internally and externally by analyzing data to implement predictive solutions for our customers.
