About the Company

Our client is a U.S.-based private real estate lender that provides short-term, business-purpose loans to real estate investors.

The company finances Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR rental and Ground-Up Construction projects and works with a third-party loan servicer, note buyers and capital partners to manage its loan portfolio.

As its portfolio grows, the company is building out its remote operations team to keep every funded loan accurately tracked and every borrower well supported.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Loan Servicing Specialist to own the post-closing servicing workflow and borrower and partner follow-through.

You will board funded loans with the third-party servicer, manage construction draws, monitor maturities, payments and delinquencies, and answer borrower and partner questions until each one is resolved.

The third-party servicer prepares servicing calculations; this specialist reviews and coordinates them. Speed, accuracy, ownership and exceptional borrower service are central to the role.

What You'll Do

Loan Boarding & Records

  • Board funded loans with the third-party servicer.
  • Validate terms, balances, reserves and maturity dates.
  • Maintain accurate records in the company's loan portal and servicing systems.

Construction Draws

  • Manage construction draw requests end to end: budget and reserve checks, inspections, documentation, review and approvals within delegated limits.
  • Coordinate disbursements and give borrowers proactive updates.

Maturities, Extensions & Payoffs

  • Monitor upcoming maturities and coordinate extensions.
  • Coordinate payoffs and extensions with the servicer, reviewing its calculations, statements and documents for accuracy.
  • Track completion and lien releases.

Portfolio Monitoring

  • Identify inactive or stalled loans with no recent progress, updates or borrower communication.
  • Contact the relevant parties, document status and escalate risks.
  • Monitor missed payments and delinquencies, follow up with borrowers and the servicer, and escalate potential defaults or unresolved issues.

Borrower & Partner Support

Preferred

  • Experience working with a third-party loan servicer.

Please note: conventional consumer mortgage experience alone (FHA, VA, Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac loans) does not meet the experience requirement.

  • Funded loans are boarded quickly and accurately.
  • Draw requests are processed on time and within approved budgets.
  • Maturities, extensions and payoffs are handled before deadlines.
  • Stalled loans, missed payments and potential defaults are flagged early.

jobs.excerpt: Dein PurposeWir betreiben unsere Hosting-Plattform auf eigener Hardware und bauen sie gerade grundlegend neu: Kubernetes auf Bare Metal, alle Ebenen vom Kernel bis zur Plattform in eigener Verantwortung.
jobs.description:
Dein Purpose

Wir betreiben unsere Hosting-Plattform auf eigener Hardware und bauen sie gerade grundlegend neu: Kubernetes auf Bare Metal, alle Ebenen vom Kernel bis zur Plattform in eigener Verantwortung. Du gibst deinem Team dabei die technische Richtung. Deine Urteilskraft kommt aus dem Betrieb, also aus echten Störungen und Kundenproblemen. Daraus entscheidest du im Team, bringst Vorhaben spürbar voran und lässt deine Kolleg*innen fachlich mitwachsen. Personalverantwortung hast du nicht, dafür umso mehr fachlichen Einfluss.

Deine Skills:

  • Du gehst fachlich voran, ohne disziplinarisch zu führen. Du machst Komplexität für Kolleg*innen auf jedem Level greifbar und nimmst sie auf dem Weg mit, durch Feedback, Wissenstransfer und ständiges Sparring.

  • Du beherrschst mindestens eine Ebene richtig tief, ob Kernel, Storage, Netzwerk oder Container-Runtime. Die übrigen verstehst du gut genug, um Wechselwirkungen zu erkennen. Du weißt, wie Kubernetes auf eigener Hardware läuft und was passiert, wenn es das nicht tut.

  • Du analysierst Störungen bis zur Ursache, erkennst Muster hinter wiederkehrenden Problemen und definierst sinnvolle Monitoring- und Alerting-Regeln.

  • Software-Engineering: Du baust Plattformkomponenten und Automatisierung selbst, idealerweise in Go, und kannst die Lösungen anderer fachlich bewerten.

Herausforderungen, mit denen wir uns gerade beschäftigen:

  • Multi-Tenant-Hosting unter echter Last: Tausende Kunden-Workloads teilen sich unsere physischen Server – präzise Ressourcensteuerung (cgroups, Namespaces), CPU-/Memory-Scheduling sowie Storage- und Netzwerk-Performance auf Systemebene gehören zum Alltag.

  • Automatisierter Node- und Cluster-Lifecycle: Vom Provisionieren der Hardware über Kernel- und Runtime-Updates (CRI-O, crun) bis zu unterbrechungsfreien Rollouts im laufenden Betrieb.

  • Eigene Operatoren und Plattform-Services: Statt gemanagte Cloud-Dienste zusammenzustecken, entwickeln wir unsere Kubernetes-Controller, APIs und die Integration in Storage und Netzwerk (CNI, BGP) selbst.

Das bieten wir dir:

Tiefgang statt Standard

Wir arbeiten mit zukunftsweisenden Technologien und bauen Systeme, wenn nötig, lieber selbst, statt auf Fertiglösungen zu setzen. Das bringt Herausforderungen und ein technisches Niveau, das nicht alltäglich ist und dich fachlich weiterbringt.

Expertise, die ihresgleichen sucht

Du diskutierst auf fachlich höchstem Niveau, teilst dein Wissen und lernst gemeinsam mit anderen Experten. Unsere Expertise geben wir nicht nur intern , sondern auch gerne auf Konferenzen, Camps und in der Tech-Community weiter und gestalten so die Zukunft der Branche mit.

Wir lieben Tech

Bei uns triffst du auf Menschen, die Tech genauso feiern wie du. Diese Leidenschaft leben wir im Alltag – und darüber hinaus. Ob Open-Source-Engagement, Community-Arbeit oder der Support von Tech-Events: Wir sind aktiv dabei und bringen uns ein.

Technologische Verantwortung

Deine Expertise zählt. Du prägst Entscheidungen und bleibst nicht beim Offensichtlichen stehen. Du bekommst den Raum, deine Ideen umzusetzen, Systeme mitzugestalten und Verantwortung zu übernehmen – auf Augenhöhe und mit Rückhalt.

Technik trifft Menschlichkeit

Bei uns findest du die coolsten Kolleg*innen, jede Menge Humor und echten Team-Spirit. Zusammenarbeit ist für uns ein fester Teil des Daily Business. Auch nach Feierabend gibt es jede Menge Möglichkeiten, ob Fußball, Padel oder D&D - wer Lust hat, ist dabei.

Rundum-sorglos-Setup

Bei uns soll´s dir richtig gut gehen. Freie Hardwarewahl? Check. Standardpaket an Benefits? Klar. Vitamine, Koffein & H2O? Safe. Und obendrauf: Unbefristeter Vertrag, Gleitzeit, 30 Urlaubstage, bAV , Schulungsangebote und ein faires Gehalt.

Requirements

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du führst die Vorhaben deines Teams fachlich und technisch an, konzipierst neue Funktionen und Stabilitätsverbesserungen

  • Architekturentscheidungen triffst du gemeinsam mit unserer Systemarchitektur und ihr bindet euch bei allen Ideen, Projekten und Veränderungsprozessen gegenseitig frühzeitig ein

  • Mit dem PO übersetzt du Prioritäten in konkrete Arbeitspakete, dabei bewertest du Aufwand und Risiko und sprichst Empfehlungen aus

  • Du bleibst nah am Tagesgeschäft, bist erste Anlaufstelle für technische Fragen an dein Team und spielst Erkenntnisse aus dem Betrieb in die Architektur zurück

  • Du hältst den Qualitätsstandard hoch, steuerst nach, wenn etwas nicht passt

jobs.excerpt: At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs.
jobs.description:
At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

LifeStance Health Values

  • Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.

  • Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.

  • Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.

  • One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

Benefits
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.

ROLE OVERVIEW


The Senior MDM Data Steward serves as the authoritative steward for patient and provider domains for master data across the Enterprise Data Platform, providing leadership for the operational governance, quality, and integrity of enterprise identity data. This role owns the stewardship framework supporting patient and provider master records and is accountable for ensuring that Enterprise Master Patient Index (EMPI) patient global identifiers and MDM provider global identifiers within the Silver (conformed canonical) layer remain accurate, complete, traceable, and trusted for analytics, reporting, regulatory compliance, operational decision-making, and AI-driven use cases.

Operating with a high degree of independence, the Senior MDM Data Steward leads identity resolution activities, establishes and maintains stewardship standards, and exercises judgment in the review and disposition of complex match, merge, and identity exception scenarios. The steward proactively identifies data quality risks, drives remediation efforts across source systems, oversees survivorship rule execution, and serves as the primary escalation point for patient and provider identity-related issues. In partnership with Business Data Owners, Data Governance leaders, and source-system stakeholders, this role influences stewardship practices, promotes data quality accountability, and drives continuous improvement of master data management processes.


The Senior MDM Data Steward also owns the maintenance and ongoing governance of patient and provider business glossary terms, data quality rules and definitions, lineage context, stewardship procedures, issue records, and related governance artifacts within Snowflake Horizon Catalog. Through active monitoring, analysis, and stewardship leadership, the role ensures critical business and technical metadata remains current, actionable, and aligned with enterprise data governance standards and strategic data management objectives.


Consistent with LifeStance’s values, every member of the LifeStance team is expected to support each other and the mission, which may mean participating in projects and initiatives and performing functions and responsibilities not specifically outlined in this job description.

COMPENSATION: $109,000 - $130,000/annually in addition to a competitive bonus plan

KEY RESPONSIBILITES 

Identity Resolution, Match Stewardship, and Operational Leadership (approximately 40%)


  • Lead enterprise MDM stewardship operations by directing work queue activities, adjudicating complex identity resolution scenarios, resolving potential matches and duplicates, correcting improperly merged identities, and establishing consistent record governance practices for manually reviewed records.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for patient identity management issues, investigating overlays, duplicates, and cross-system identity conflicts originating from athenaOne, AdvancedMD, and other source systems; determine root causes, drive corrective actions, and recommend process improvements to reduce recurrence.
  • Own the governance and integrity of the provider master data domain, establishing and enforcing standards for the reconciliation of NPI, taxonomy, licensure, credentialing status, payer enrollment, practice location, employment status, and related attributes across enterprise source systems.
  • Provide leadership for provider data quality and governance initiatives, ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and usability of provider practice, location, and organizational affiliation data supporting operational, analytical, credentialing, reimbursement, and regulatory reporting needs.
  • Partner with Data Architecture to evaluate and tune Verato match thresholds, referential matching configuration, survivorship, and attribute precedence rules; measure the effect on auto-match, potential-match, unmatched, and false-positive rates before changes are promoted.
  • Ownership over establishing and maintaining enterprise standards for data stewardship decisions, ensuring comprehensive documentation of exceptions, adjudication rationale, survivorship outcomes, merge and unmerge activities, and record-resolution actions to support auditability, compliance, and continuous improvement efforts.

Data Quality, Issue Management & Silver Layer Validation (approximately 25%)

  • Establish and own the business acceptance standards for patient and provider mastered records, source-to-global ID crosswalks, identity resolution outcomes, and golden-record quality within the Snowflake Silver layer, ensuring alignment with enterprise data governance and operational objectives.
  • Provide oversight of EMPI patient and provider global ID integrity within the Snowflake Silver layer by proactively identifying data quality defects, validating adherence to business rules, and directing remediation efforts with Data Engineering and DataOps teams to ensure timely resolution.
  • Define, govern, and continuously refine master data quality standards and performance thresholds, including metrics related to unmatched records, duplicate records, orphaned source IDs, stale provider attributes, missing NPI values, invalid affiliations, and incomplete required attributes; communicate performance trends and improvement recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Lead the governance and lifecycle management of patient and provider master data issues, prioritizing remediation activities based on business impact, overseeing issue resolution progress, and providing transparent reporting on ownership, remediation status, risk exposure, and closure outcomes.
  • Independently lead strategic trend analysis and root-cause investigations to identify systemic defects across registration, scheduling, provider onboarding, credentialing, human resources, interfaces, and source application workflows; recommend and influence corrective actions that improve data quality and operational efficiency.
  • Own the maintenance and governance of master data lineage and identifier crosswalks, ensuring accurate traceability between source-system MRNs, provider identifiers, and enterprise global IDs while supporting audit, compliance, and operational reporting requirements.
  • Serve as the primary business lead for identity-related incidents and data quality escalations, coordinating cross-functional resolution efforts, driving stakeholder alignment, and ensuring corrective actions are effectively prioritized, tested, and promoted through established release and change-management processes.

Governance, Metadata & Policy (approximately 20%)

  • Establish and govern enterprise patient and provider master data standards, defining business terminology, required attributes, permissible values, data ownership, attribute precedence, relationship hierarchies, and merge/unmerge policies to ensure consistent and compliant master data management practices across the organization.
  • Own the stewardship framework and metadata management processes for Patient and Provider domains by maintaining business glossary terms, data quality standards, stewardship procedures, issue records, and lineage documentation within the Snowflake Horizon Catalog, ensuring transparency and accessibility for business and technical stakeholders.
  • Serve independently as the primary stewardship leader for Patient and Provider domains within the Data Governance Steering Committee, influencing enterprise governance decisions and partnering with Business Data Owners to establish data definitions, quality expectations, usage standards, and remediation priorities.
  • Provide governance leadership and strategic recommendations to Business Data Owners, enabling informed decision-making regarding business definitions, quality thresholds, and stewardship policy changes while ensuring alignment with enterprise data management objectives.
  • Lead the evaluation and governance of changes impacting master data policies, including data definitions, identity matching criteria, survivorship logic, and quality thresholds; facilitate cross-functional review, stakeholder alignment, risk assessment, and decision-making through established governance processes.
  • Independently ensure stewardship operations adhere to HIPAA minimum-necessary requirements, HITRUST controls, and organizational privacy and security policies, establishing robust auditability and oversight for manual merge, split, correction, and identity-resolution activities.
  • Partner with Privacy, Compliance, and business stakeholders to assess regulatory and policy impacts on identity management practices, providing stewardship leadership for consent restrictions, sensitive data handling requirements, healthcare regulatory obligations, golden-record usage, and downstream data access controls.
  • Drive the development and continuous improvement of master data standards that support regulatory reporting, quality initiatives, reimbursement processes, payer requirements, and broader enterprise business objectives, ensuring data assets remain reliable, compliant, and fit for purpose across the organization.

Source-System Improvement, Reporting & Enablement (approximately 15%)

  • Provide leadership and oversight for enterprise master data remediation efforts, directing corrective actions to registration, provider credentialing, human resources, practice operations, and other source-system owners; ensure timely resolution, accountability, and sustainable process improvements that prevent recurring data quality issues within mastered records.
  • Partner with operational and business leaders to strengthen upstream data governance and capture processes, identifying opportunities to enhance controls, workflows, and accountability measures that reduce the creation of duplicate, incomplete, and conflicting patient and provider records at the source.
  • Develop, own, and present executive-level stewardship performance reporting, delivering monthly scorecards and actionable insights on duplicate rates, unmatched records, match accuracy, exception backlog and aging, source correction effectiveness, provider data completeness, global ID coverage, and recurring root-cause trends to support informed decision-making.
  • Serve as the primary stewardship liaison with MDM vendors and implementation partners, providing leadership in troubleshooting match-quality issues, evaluating configuration recommendations, validating platform capabilities, assessing business impacts, and guiding release planning and implementation decisions.
  • Lead business stewardship activities for MDM platform implementations and enhancements, overseeing data profiling, duplicate remediation strategies, threshold calibration, user acceptance testing, cutover readiness, workflow adoption, stakeholder engagement, and post-production stabilization to ensure successful implementation outcomes and sustained business value.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Information Systems, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in healthcare data stewardship, health information management (HIM), patient identity, provider data management, or MDM operations, including direct responsibility for patient or provider master data quality.
  • Hands-on experience with an enterprise EMPI or MDM platform, including steward queue management, duplicate remediation, merge/unmerge workflows, survivorship, and match-rule evaluation. Verato experience is strongly preferred; Reltio, NextGate/Rhapsody, Profisee, IBM Initiate, or comparable experience is acceptable.

  • Provider data expertise, including NPI/NPPES, taxonomy, state licensure, credentialing lifecycle, payer enrollment, locations, affiliations, and organizational relationships.
  • Proficient SQL skills and the ability to independently query Snowflake to investigate identity issues, validate global ID assignments, profile defects, and verify remediation.
  • Experience defining data quality rules, managing issue backlogs, performing root-cause analysis, and communicating trends and business impact to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Understanding of HIPAA privacy and security requirements as applied to identity data, access, auditability, and merge/unmerge operations.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE

jobs.description:
Although this role is remote, the ideal candidate will be located on the East Coast, US, and will work within the Eastern time zone

Absolute Security is looking for a Sales Engineer (SE) to provide technical sales support as a solution expert within our fast-growing North American Mid-Market East business, supporting our East Coast customers and partners. The SE is a highly technical sales professional who is responsible for working with their account teams to drive significant revenue growth within the region.

The SE owns the end-to-end technical sales process, from initial discovery through validation to commercial win. The SE is a technical evangelist for our software platform, representing the company with potential customers, partners, and at events.

You lead deep discovery that uncovers each customer’s current state, the cost of staying there, and the outcomes they want, then position technical solutions that deliver real business value. You can tailor demonstrations to align with the pain discovered. You can build Proof of Value (PoV) plans that validate the solution is strongly aligned with the customer needs and delivers quantifiable business value. You can lead the PoV with the customer, then partner with your account teams to turn the results into business proposals and wrap-up presentations that clearly demonstrate the value delivered. You can smoothly handle objections while remaining focused on the important differentiators. Finally, you can effectively build technical champions inside accounts and operate independently of them, but in partnership with your AE and CAM.

You will be expected to quickly come up to speed on our Absolute Secure Endpoint (Visibility, Control, Resilience, Resilience for Security and Resilience for Automation tiers) and Secure Access product offerings (Absolute VPN, Absolute ZTNA and Absolute Insights for Network). Your deep product knowledge, as well as in-depth knowledge of security, networking, and operating systems will help you to effectively position our products, while also helping to solve difficult technical problems for potential customers during pre-sales presentations, demonstrations, and evaluations.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end technical sales cycle for your opportunities, from discovery and validation through to commercial win
  • Partner with your account team to establish and execute sales strategy across your assigned East Coast territory
  • Assist with ongoing qualification and discovery to ensure proposed solutions address customer pain
  • Deliver tailored technical sales presentations and demonstrations to prospective customers and partners
  • Plan and execute Proof of Value (PoV, evaluation) activities. This includes scoping the PoV to align with the business pain, defining relevant success criteria and metrics, designing the PoV environment, installing and configuring Absolute’s products, providing technical support to prospective customers, and executing the PoV in accordance with the agreed-upon success criteria
  • Work with leadership to relay data-driven customer insights to Product Management and help prioritize roadmap features
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of all sales activities in Salesforce.com
  • Align tightly with technical counterparts across our channel and OEM business, educating and enabling them to uncover and develop new sales opportunities
  • Provide technical expertise to support renewals, expansion, upsell, cross-sell, and net new business
  • Regularly travel within the assigned East Coast territory to support sales activities, strengthen partner relationships, and engage with customers; up to 30% travel may be required
  • Manage your territory with minimal oversight, independently learning, troubleshooting, and escalating issues when necessary
  • Assist with customer vendor assessments by providing accurate technical and security information and timely, thorough responses to due diligence requests
  • Protect the security and privacy of Absolute and its customers

What You’ll Bring:

  • Hands-on experience administering Windows, Linux, and macOS environments, both endpoints and servers, with a clear understanding of the unique management, performance, and security challenges each platform presents
  • Experience with complex technical sales cycles, including deep discovery as well as scoping, executing, and presenting complex Proof of Value (evaluations)
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to all levels of people, from IT, Network and Security managers to Line of Business owners to CIO and CISOs
  • Strong understanding of data-in-transit security (TLS, IPsec, VPNs, PKI, and certificate management), network services and design (routing, LAN/WAN architecture, and firewall configuration), and authentication protocols (SAML, RADIUS, and related methods)
  • Skilled in endpoint and network troubleshooting, leveraging tools such as cURL, Wireshark, and log analysis to identify, isolate, and resolve complex technical issues across diverse environments

Nice to have skills:

  • Experience with selling methodologies such as Command of the Message and MEDDPICC
  • Experience with Demo2Win methodology
  • Experience selling SASE, SSE, VPN, EDR, Incident Response or other endpoint or network security tools
  • Experience with programming or scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash
  • Experience with Cloud IaaS vendors including networking and security service operation
  • Security (CISSP, GIAC, CompTIA Security+, etc.) or networking (CCNA, CompTIA Network+, etc.) certifications
  • Experienced in patch and configuration management for endpoints and servers to maintain security, stability, and compliance
  • Experience in IT or Security operations

Join the “Get Stuff Done” Culture Shaping the Future of Cybersecurity and Resilience

Are you passionate and committed to cybersecurity and cyber resilience in the new era of Frontier AI? If the answer is yes, then Absolute Security may be the home for you.

In the new AI-driven business world, Absolute Security has emerged as a leader in Autonomous Cyber Resilience. Thousands of customers trust our AI-native platform to defend their organizations against threats, reduce risk, and recover immediately from disruptions before they turn into financial losses. Through partnerships with the world’s leading endpoint device manufacturers, Absolute is embedded in the firmware of 600 million endpoints. This unique position gives us an almost ubiquitous presence in the world’s PC and advanced AI workstation environments.

As part of our mission to become the World’s Most Trusted Security Company, we are shaping the next decade of security, compliance, and resilience through innovations that help customers remain defended against AI-driven threats and challenges, stop downtime when disruption hits, and drive meaningful change in the IT and cybersecurity markets. To further our goals, we are searching for the best and brightest to join our Get Stuff Done (GSD) culture. We seek motivated candidates who are innovators, sellers, marketers, financiers, operators, engineers, developers, and customer professionals to join our world-class team.

Gartner, Forrester, IDC, Frost & Sullivan, and other top industry analyst firms recognize Absolute Security as critical to the emerging Cyber Resilience market, and a key competitor in the endpoint management and security, secure network access, and Zero Trust markets. The company has earned prestigious product and leadership honors including the Frost & Sullivan Competitive Strategy & Leadership award, the Cybersecurity Excellence Award for Cyber Resilience solutions, and the SC Magazine Power Players list.

Absolute Security is headquartered in Seattle, Washington, with international offices in Vancouver, BC; Austin, TX; Ankeny, IA; Reading, UK; Tokyo, Japan; and Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. As a native work-from-anywhere company, we give employees the flexibility to thrive in remote, hybrid, and in-office environments.

About the Role:

One owner for the entire risk function at a fintech operating between crypto and traditional payments. You will own enterprise risk end to end, including the risk framework and appetite, DORA and operational resilience, B2B partner risk, fraud risk appetite, capital adequacy, and risk gating for new products.

It is an individual contributor role reporting directly to the CEO, with a seat on the leadership team. You will work daily with Compliance, Legal, Finance, Technology, and the B2B Partnerships team. The foundations are in place (risk register, appetite framework, DORA workstreams). The function needs an owner who proactively surfaces risk, takes a position, and stands behind it.

What You'll Do:

Enterprise Risk & Governance:

  • Own the enterprise risk framework: risk register, risk appetite statement, taxonomy, and escalation policy.
  • Run the risk reporting cycle: structured updates to the CEO and leadership, plus regulatory risk reporting.
  • Chair or co-chair the risk committee: agenda, cadence, participants, and decision authority.
  • Build risk ownership across business units.

DORA & Operational Resilience:

  • Own the DORA ICT risk framework and lead the Register of Information workstream ahead of the 2027 submission window.
  • Own business continuity and disaster recovery planning.
  • Own third-party and vendor risk: critical providers, concentration risk, and exit planning.
  • Own the PSD2 operational resilience framework, including 4-hour major incident reporting and impact tolerances.
  • Partner with the CTO and Head of Security on technology and cloud risk.

EMI & Regulatory Risk:

  • Lead the operational risk framework and capital adequacy/safeguarding design for two parallel EMI applications (EU and UK).
  • Own ongoing capital adequacy monitoring and escalate breaches.
  • Own preparation for risk-focused regulatory examinations and act as the primary contact for risk-related regulator queries.
  • Coordinate with Legal on regulatory obligations and with the Chief of Compliance on AML/CTF risk appetite.

B2B Partner & Counterparty Risk:

  • Design and own the partner risk assessment framework: onboarding scoring, ongoing due diligence, and risk-tiered monitoring.
  • Own risk sign-off on material partnerships, define thresholds for CEO approval, and keep high-risk reviews fast and credible.
  • Define which industries, geographies, and business models the company will and will not serve.
  • Manage partner concentration risk and delegated-compliance liability as B2B volume scales.

Fraud & Financial Crime Risk:

  • Build a unified fraud risk framework and appetite across relevant functions, with clear ownership and a single escalation path.
  • Set fraud risk appetite by channel, product, and geography, and own decisions when thresholds are breached.
  • Coordinate with the Chief of Compliance on the fraud/AML overlap.
  • Own the sanctions screening risk framework and escalation policy.

Product & Financial Risk:

  • Own product-launch risk gating for new products, markets, and business lines.
  • Manage crypto price volatility exposure: conversion timing, settlement risk, and liquidity buffers.
  • Own counterparty credit risk: liquidity providers, banking partners, card schemes, and B2B clients.
  • Oversee treasury risk: balances, currency exposure, and concentration.

Requirements:

Must have:

  • Senior risk leadership (Head of Risk, VP Risk, or equivalent scope) in financial services or fintech within a regulated institution.
  • Direct ownership of risk obligations in a licensed fintech, EMI, PSP, payment institution, or crypto company, not advisory or consultancy experience only.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: DORA ICT risk framework, MiCA capital adequacy and risk requirements, PSD2 operational resilience, or FCA operational resilience.
  • Fraud risk ownership: has set fraud risk appetite, owned fraud outcomes, and made real decisioning calls.
  • B2B partner or counterparty risk: has assessed and approved high-risk commercial relationships.
  • Ability to make a risk decision and stand behind it under CEO or commercial pressure.
  • High autonomy: surfaces risk proactively, proposes a route, and closes actions without waiting for direction.
  • Ability to give commercial teams a fast, credible risk answer that enables deal velocity.
  • Fluent professional English.
  • Ability to work within European business hours.

Nice to have:

  • Prior Head of Risk, VP Risk, or CRO title at a regulated fintech, EMI, PSP, or crypto company.
  • DORA Register of Information preparation experience.
  • FCA operational resilience framework experience.
  • MiCA post-authorization obligations: capital adequacy reporting, CASP risk framework.
  • Experience building a risk function from scratch or taking an early framework to maturity.
  • Third-party/vendor risk management at scale.
  • Capital adequacy and safeguarding design for an EMI or PI application.
  • Travel Rule risk implementation across multiple jurisdictions.
  • FRM (GARP), PRM, or equivalent qualification.
  • Russian language skills.

We Offer

Location: Remote-first (Baltics preferred), with periodic in-person time at the Riga office.

Contract: Employment contract in Latvia, B2B elsewhere.

Compensation: Up to €10,000 gross/month (based on experience) + performance-based bonus linked to OKRs.

Why Join?

Job Description:

Position Summary

RxSafe / Eyecon is seeking a motivated, results-driven Inside Sales Representative to expand the use of Eyecon pharmacy counting and verification technology and create new opportunities for the broader RxSafe portfolio. This position will spend the majority of its time proactively calling and emailing pharmacies, following up on inbound and marketing leads, conducting virtual discovery and product presentations, and moving qualified Eyecon opportunities through the sales process.


Eyecon is purpose-built for pharmacy workflow and helps pharmacies improve prescription counting accuracy, efficiency, and documentation through visual counting and verification technology. The Inside Sales Representative will become a product expert who can clearly connect Eyecon's capabilities to the day-to-day challenges faced by pharmacy owners, pharmacists, technicians, and managers.


In addition to selling Eyecon, this role will identify pharmacy needs that may be a fit for RxSafe automation solutions, qualify those opportunities, and generate high-quality leads for the RxSafe sales team. This is a fully remote position with no routine customer visits. Success requires a self-starter who is highly organized, persistent, comfortable working independently, and able to create structure and momentum in a remote environment.


About RxSafe / Eyecon

RxSafe provides pharmacy automation and technology solutions designed to help pharmacies improve accuracy, safety, efficiency, workflow, and medication adherence. The product portfolio includes Eyecon visual counting and verification solutions along with RxSafe pharmacy automation systems. This role is an important front-line position for introducing pharmacies to our technology, growing Eyecon sales, and creating new opportunities across the RxSafe portfolio.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong phone presence and confidence initiating outbound sales conversations.

  • Self-motivated, organized, and disciplined, with the ability to thrive in a fully remote work environment with limited day-to-day supervision.

jobs.title: Sales Solution Specialist
jobs.excerpt: JOB DESCRIPTION Compensation 57,100. 00 - 107,200.
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Compensation

57,100.00 - 107,200.00 CAD Annual


Purpose

The Sales Solution Specialist responsible for helping the customer succeed while achieving specific team and individual sales and profit goals set by the company. Provide an exceptional level of business to business (B2B) sales consultation, account management, customer service, and innovative solutions that differentiate Sysco in the marketplace. This role is responsible for the account management and growth of Healthcare & Senior Living independent customer sales with a territory size of approximately 75 Accounts and $18 million.


Responsibilities

  • Accountable for Business Development for independent Healthcare (HC) & Senior Living (SL) customers in the local and surrounding area.
  • Add product lines to existing customers by identifying opportunities and incorporate team selling activities.
  • Develops and delivers sales bids/proposals/presentations and conducts product demonstrations with key decision makers.
  • Executes National Sales Team strategy and collaborates on opportunities to obtain new lines and recover lost lines of business.
  • Identifies opportunities to improve customer account profitability.
  • Manages accurate sales pipeline, consultative activities, and customer contact information in customer relationship management (CRM) tool.
  • Supports quarterly business reviews with local customer headquarters to discuss joint opportunities to grow sales and improve profitability.
  • Ensures customer contract compliance and define action plans to align to master service agreement (MSA) representations.
  • Provides consultative services by providing market trends and insights, identifying integration points with Specialty Companies (Fresh Point, European Imports, SOTF, Buckhead).
  • Engages the Customer Experience Team to escalate all customer issues.
  • Coordinates and leads all activities and resources for targeted accounts and ensures follow-up on all next step agreements.
  • Understands our customers’ business and provides value-added solutions through products, services, tools, and information to help them succeed. Provides education, promotes offerings, and leverages these resources to drive business growth with targeted accounts.
  • Establishes positive working relationships with all departments in the Region.
  • Utilizes CRM tools (Sysco 360) as communication and measurement tool.
  • Complies with Sysco’s Food Safety Policy and procedures to ensure food safety, quality and legality requirements are met.
  • Is willing to work safely with minimal environmental impact and understands the importance of reporting all hazards, incidents, and environmental spills immediately to their supervisor.
  • Understands that they play an integral role in their own safety and that of their colleagues and is willing to speak out when hazards are present.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Skills

  • This role requires full bilingual proficiency in both French and English to communicate with internal and external customers.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook.
  • Professional salesperson with proven ability to cultivate relationships and grow sales.
  • Strong financial acumen and ability to properly plan and execute business plans.
  • Demonstrated skills in consultative selling, networking and negotiations.
  • Business and restaurant operations acumen to manage sophisticated customers.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work with and influence a variety of key stakeholders.
  • Ability to express information in terms of profit and loss, food cost and expense ratio.
  • Persuasive communication skills, ability to effectively communicate with internal and external teams.
  • Demonstrate a high level of business acumen and interpersonal savvy.
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills, including the ability to execute multiple initiatives at the same time.
  • Ability to learn the use of proprietary CRM tools for planning and forecasting sales growth.
  • Solid analytical problem-solving skills, including familiarity with analyzing reports and deriving insights from data.
  • Proactive, self-directed, with the ability to structure a weekly schedule to be successful.

Education

  • Post-Secondary Degree or Diploma in a business-related field; equivalent experience may be considered.

Experience

  • 2 years or more of sales experience required.

Travel Requirements

  • There will be travel required. A valid driver’s license in good standing with access to a vehicle is required.

Rémunération

57 100 $ à 107 200 $ CAD par année


Objectif du poste

Le ou la spécialiste des solutions de vente est responsable d’aider les clients à atteindre leurs objectifs de réussite tout en réalisant les objectifs individuels et d’équipe en matière de ventes et de rentabilité établis par l’entreprise. La personne titulaire du poste offre un niveau exceptionnel de consultation en vente interentreprises (B2B), de gestion de comptes, de service à la clientèle et de solutions novatrices qui permettent à Sysco de se démarquer sur le marché.

Ce poste est responsable de la gestion et de la croissance des ventes auprès de clients indépendants du secteur des soins de santé et des résidences pour personnes âgées, sur un territoire comptant environ 75 comptes et représentant 18 millions de dollars.


Responsabilités

  • Assurer le développement des affaires auprès des clients indépendants des secteurs des soins de santé (SC) et des résidences pour personnes âgées (RPA) dans la région locale et les environs.
  • Ajouter des gammes de produits aux comptes existants en repérant les occasions d’affaires et en intégrant des activités de vente en équipe.
  • Élaborer et présenter des soumissions, des propositions et des présentations de vente, et effectuer des démonstrations de produits auprès des principaux décideurs.
  • Mettre en œuvre la stratégie de l’équipe nationale des ventes et collaborer sur les occasions d’affaires afin d’obtenir de nouvelles gammes de produits et de récupérer des secteurs d’activité perdus.
  • Repérer les occasions d’améliorer la rentabilité des comptes clients.
  • Assurer la gestion d’un pipeline de ventes précis ainsi que des activités de consultation et des coordonnées des clients dans l’outil de gestion de la relation client (CRM).
  • Participer aux revues d’affaires trimestrielles avec les sièges sociaux des clients locaux afin de discuter des occasions conjointes d’accroître les ventes et d’améliorer la rentabilité.
  • Veiller au respect des contrats clients et définir des plans d’action afin d’assurer la conformité aux dispositions de l’entente-cadre de services (MSA).
  • Fournir des services-conseils en présentant les tendances et les perspectives du marché et en repérant les possibilités d’intégration avec les entreprises spécialisées (FreshPoint, European Imports, SOTF, Buckhead).
  • Faire appel à l’équipe Expérience client afin d’assurer le suivi et l’escalade de tous les problèmes soulevés par les clients.
  • Coordonner et diriger toutes les activités et ressources liées aux comptes ciblés et assurer le suivi de toutes les ententes concernant les prochaines étapes.
  • Comprendre les activités de nos clients et leur proposer des solutions à valeur ajoutée au moyen de produits, de services, d’outils et d’information afin de les aider à réussir. Offrir de la formation, promouvoir les offres et tirer parti de ces ressources pour stimuler la croissance des affaires auprès des comptes ciblés.
  • Établir des relations de travail positives avec tous les services de la région.
  • Utiliser les outils CRM (Sysco 360) comme outils de communication et de mesure.
  • Respecter la politique et les procédures de Sysco en matière de salubrité des aliments afin de garantir le respect des exigences relatives à la salubrité, à la qualité et à la conformité réglementaire des aliments.
  • Travailler de façon sécuritaire en réduisant au minimum les répercussions sur l’environnement et comprendre l’importance de signaler immédiatement à son superviseur tout danger, incident ou déversement environnemental.
  • Comprendre son rôle essentiel dans sa propre sécurité et celle de ses collègues et être disposé à intervenir lorsque des situations dangereuses sont présentes.
  • Effectuer toute autre tâche connexe qui lui est confiée.

Compétences

  • Ce poste requiert un bilinguisme complet en français et en anglais afin de communiquer efficacement avec la clientèle interne et externe.
  • Niveau intermédiaire dans l’utilisation de Microsoft Office, notamment Excel, Word, PowerPoint et Outlook.
  • Professionnel(le) de la vente ayant fait ses preuves dans l’établissement de relations et la croissance des ventes.
  • Solide sens des affaires financières et capacité à planifier et à exécuter efficacement des plans d’affaires.
  • Compétences démontrées en vente consultative, en réseautage et en négociation.
  • Bonne connaissance des activités commerciales et de restauration permettant de gérer des clients ayant des besoins complexes.
  • Excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles et capacité à collaborer avec divers intervenants clés et à exercer une influence auprès de ceux-ci.
  • Capacité à présenter l’information en fonction des profits et pertes, du coût des aliments et des ratios de dépenses.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication persuasive et capacité à communiquer efficacement avec les équipes internes et externes.
  • Faire preuve d’un haut niveau de sens des affaires et d’une grande aisance dans les relations interpersonnelles.
  • Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et en gestion de projets, notamment la capacité à gérer et à exécuter plusieurs initiatives simultanément.
  • Capacité à apprendre et à utiliser des outils CRM exclusifs pour planifier et prévoir la croissance des ventes.
  • Solides compétences analytiques et en résolution de problèmes, notamment une bonne connaissance de l’analyse de rapports et de la capacité à tirer des conclusions pertinentes à partir de données.
  • Être proactif(ve), autonome et capable de structurer son horaire hebdomadaire afin d’atteindre ses objectifs.

Formation

  • Diplôme d’études postsecondaires ou diplôme dans un domaine lié aux affaires; une expérience équivalente peut être considérée.

Expérience

  • Au moins 2 ans d’expérience en vente requis.

Exigences relatives aux déplacements

  • Des déplacements sont requis dans le cadre du poste. Un permis de conduire valide et en règle, ainsi qu’un accès à un véhicule, sont requis.

Sysco is committed to Employment Equity. Accommodations during the recruitment process are available upon request for candidates with disabilities.

jobs.excerpt: Together we fight for everyone’s opportunity for a better financial future.
jobs.description:
Together we fight for everyone’s opportunity for a better financial future.

We will do this together — with customers, partners and colleagues. We will fight for others, not against: We will stand up for and champion everyone’s access to opportunities. The status quo is not good enough … we believe every individual and every community deserves access to financial opportunities. We are determined to support both individuals and communities in reaching a better financial future. We know that reaching this future depends on our actions today.

Like our Purpose Statement, Voya believes in being bold and committed to action. We are committed to a work environment where the differences that we are born with — and those we acquire throughout our lives — are understood, valued and intentionally pursued. We believe that our employees own our culture and have a responsibility to foster an environment where we all feel comfortable bringing our whole selves to work. Purposefully bringing our differences together to positively influence our culture, serve our clients and enrich our communities is essential to our vision.

Are you ready to join a company with a strong purpose and a winning culture? Start your Voyage –Apply Now

Partnership Executive

About Benefitfocus:

Benefitfocus, Inc., a Voya company, is a leading provider of cloud-based benefits software solutions for consumers, employers, insurance carriers and brokers. Benefitfocus has served numerous consumers on its platform that consists of an integrated portfolio of products and services enabling clients to shop, enroll, manage and exchange benefits information more efficiently. With a user-friendly interface and consumer-centric design, the Benefitfocus Platform provides one place for consumers to access all their benefits. Benefitfocus solutions support the administration of all types of benefits including core medical, dental, and other voluntary benefits plans as well as wellness programs.

Get to Know the Opportunity:

The Partnership Executive serves as the strategic business owner and executive sponsor for a portfolio of voluntary carrier and ecosystem partners. This role is responsible for maximizing partner value through relationship management, growth strategy, commercialization, governance, contracting, and cross-functional leadership.

The Partnership Executive develops and executes strategies that drive revenue growth, partner retention, platform adoption, and innovation while ensuring alignment between partner objectives and organizational goals. Acting as a trusted advisor to senior executives and key partner stakeholders, this leader identifies opportunities to expand existing partnerships, foster new strategic relationships, influence product direction, and deliver measurable business outcomes for partners, customers, and Voya.

This role is fully remote, with no regular in-office requirement.

The Contributions You’ll Make:

Strategic Partnership Management

  • Serve as the primary strategic relationship owner for assigned carrier and ecosystem partners.
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships that strengthen trust, alignment, and long-term partnership value.
  • Develop and execute partnership strategies that support revenue growth, retention, innovation, and market differentiation.
  • Facilitate regular business reviews and strategic planning sessions with partner leadership teams.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by understanding partner business objectives, challenges, and growth opportunities.

Revenue Growth & Business Development

  • Identify and execute opportunities to expand existing partnerships through new capabilities, product offerings, integrations, and service enhancements.
  • Develop joint business plans that drive adoption, enrollment growth, and increased partner investment.
  • Support pipeline development through strategic introductions and collaboration on go-to-market initiatives.
  • Analyze market trends, competitive dynamics, and customer needs to uncover new growth opportunities.

Contracting & Commercialization

  • Lead negotiation and management of partnership agreements, renewals, amendments, and commercial discussions.
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Product, and leadership teams to ensure contract terms align with business objectives and risk tolerance.
  • Drive commercialization efforts for new and existing partnerships, including business case development, pricing strategies, SKU development, and launch readiness.
  • Ensure partner commitments and contractual obligations are clearly understood and executed.

Governance & Risk Management

  • Lead partnership governance processes and maintain accountability for partnership performance.
  • Manage executive-level escalations related to operational, financial, technical, compliance, or reputational risks.
  • Coordinate internal reviews and approvals involving Legal, Compliance, Security, AI Governance, and Enterprise Risk teams.
  • Monitor partnership health and proactively identify risks, mitigation strategies, and improvement opportunities.

Product Strategy & Innovation

  • Gather and synthesize partner feedback, market intelligence, and customer insights to influence product strategy and roadmap prioritization.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to evaluate business opportunities and define requirements for new functionality.
  • Advocate for partner and customer needs while balancing organizational priorities and scalability considerations.
  • Drive alignment between partnership objectives and future platform capabilities.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Operations, Marketing, Sales, Finance, Legal, and Customer teams to execute partnership initiatives.
  • Coordinate resources and stakeholders to resolve complex business challenges and drive successful outcomes.
  • Ensure internal teams are informed, prepared, and aligned to support strategic partner initiatives.
  • Promote accountability and effective communication across organizations.

Performance Management & Analytics

  • Analyze sales, enrollment, revenue, premium, and other partnership performance metrics.
  • Develop executive-level reporting, dashboards, and business reviews that communicate performance, risks, and growth opportunities.
  • Monitor key performance indicators and identify actionable recommendations to improve business outcomes.
  • Leverage data-driven insights to support decision-making, resource prioritization, and strategic planning.

Minimum Knowledge & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • 10+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, account management, carrier relations, benefits administration, healthcare technology, or a related field.
  • Experience managing complex partner relationships and engaging executive-level stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated success negotiating contracts, renewals, and commercial agreements.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex business data into actionable recommendations.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence outcomes without direct authority.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, relationship management, and executive influencing skills.

Preferred Knowledge & Experience:

  • Experience within benefits administration, insurance, HR technology, employee benefits, healthcare technology, or carrier operations.
  • Experience managing high-value strategic partnerships generating significant recurring revenue.
  • Knowledge of carrier integrations, enrollment technologies, digital health solutions, and benefits ecosystems.
  • Experience supporting commercialization, product strategy, or go-to-market initiatives.
  • MBA or other advanced business degree.

How This Role Aligns to Our Core Four:

At Voya, our Core Four guide how we work, collaborate, and create value. This role contributes to those expectations through strategic partnership leadership, business growth, innovation, and operational excellence.

  • Instill Customer Obsession – Build strategic partnerships that enhance customer experiences, expand benefit solutions, and deliver measurable value to employers, employees, and partners.
  • Transform with Automation/AI – Leverage analytics, automation, AI-enabled insights, and digital capabilities to improve partnership performance, identify opportunities, and support informed decision-making.
  • Drive Higher Performance Through Our People – Foster alignment across partners and internal stakeholders to drive accountability, collaboration, and successful execution of strategic initiatives.
  • Execute on the Fundamentals – Maintain strong governance, risk management, financial discipline, and operational rigor while ensuring contractual commitments and business objectives are achieved.

Compensation Pay Disclosure:

Be Well. Stay Well.

Voya provides the resources that can make a difference in your lives. To us, this means thriving physically, financially, socially and emotionally. Voya benefits are designed to help you do just that. That’s why we offer an array of plans, programs, tools and resources with one goal in mind: To help you and your family be well and stay well.

What We Offer

jobs.title: Mid-Level Data Engineer (Ontologist )
jobs.excerpt: Olá, nós somos o CESAR! Somos um centro de inovação e de educação que há quase 30 anos forma pessoas e impulsiona organizações, potencializando suas estratégias digitais.
jobs.description:
Olá, nós somos o CESAR!

Somos um centro de inovação e de educação que há quase 30 anos forma pessoas e impulsiona organizações, potencializando suas estratégias digitais. Resolvemos problemas complexos e desafiadores em um ambiente de trabalho descontraído, descentralizado e repleto de benefícios para nossos colaboradores, que atuam como protagonistas, interagindo diretamente com clientes de escala global.

Como Pessoa Engenheira de Dados (Ontologista), sua missão será criar ontologias, taxonomias e estruturas de relações semânticas robustas. Você unirá o mundo da Engenharia de Dados com a modelagem do conhecimento, assegurando que as informações ofereçam uma cobertura abrangente para ingestão e inferência por máquinas.

Buscamos um profissional capaz de compreender processos complexos e traduzi-los de forma simples, expandindo técnicas de recuperação de dados e atuando diretamente com IA Generativa e Grafos de Conhecimento. Você fará parte de um time ágil, otimizando pipelines e garantindo a qualidade do produto de ponta a ponta. Topa? Vamos nessa!

Como será o seu dia a dia (Responsabilidades)

  • Ontologia e Modelagem Semântica: Criar ontologias, taxonomias e modelos de dados lógicos, semanticamente ricos e extensíveis. Garantir a cobertura de subdomínios para inferência de máquinas, atuar na otimização de Grafos de Conhecimento e criar novos esquemas utilizando IA Generativa.
  • Engenharia de Dados e Pipelines: Desenvolver produtos analíticos utilizando Airflow, DataProc, PySpark e BigQuery (GCP), aplicando padrões de ingestão streaming e batch sob princípios sólidos de Data Warehouse.
  • Qualidade e Governança: Realizar mapeamento, linhagem de dados e documentação dos fluxos de informação. Proporcionar visibilidade sobre problemas de qualidade e trabalhar com os donos do negócio para resolvê-los.
  • Otimização e DevOps: Otimizar soluções existentes (pipelines e infraestrutura) buscando alto desempenho, segurança e baixo custo. Atuar em um ambiente Ágil com entregas frequentes utilizando TDD e pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Comunicação e Liderança Técnica: Coordenar projetos multifuncionais, comunicando requisitos de conhecimento para equipes de engenharia. Compreender processos complexos, defender soluções bem projetadas e manter-se atualizado sobre o domínio dos produtos, IA e serviços conectados.

O que precisamos que você tenha (Requisitos Obrigatórios)

  • Experiência Prática: Atuação comprovada no mercado (2 anos ou mais) em Engenharia de Dados, trabalhando desde o conceito até as operações em produção.
  • Recuperação e Modelagem: Habilidades comprovadas em técnicas de recuperação e pesquisa de dados, com base sólida para alinhar as melhores práticas de modelagem de ontologias em toda a organização.
  • Ecossistema Cloud (GCP) e Dados: Experiência na construção de pipelines escaláveis e custo-efetivos utilizando Google BigQuery, ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow/Astronomer) e bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server).
  • Streaming e Mensageria: Vivência com plataformas de streaming de dados em tempo real, como Apache Kafka e GCP Pub/Sub.
  • Cultura DevOps: Ferramentas de CI/CD e infraestrutura como código, incluindo Tekton, GitHub Actions, Git/GitHub, Terraform e Docker.
  • Metodologia Ágil: Ferramentas de gerenciamento de projetos como Atlassian Jira.
  • Idioma:Inglês Avançado para comunicação diária com times globais.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Certificações Profissionais ativas do Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Mestrado ou pós-graduação equivalente em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência/Engenharia de Dados ou áreas correlatas.

Aqui no CESAR, nós temos algumas práticas que proporcionam uma rotina mais positiva para a pessoa colaboradora:

  • Horário flexível e estrutura horizontal;
  • Programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento;
  • Cultura voltada para a Diversidade & Inclusão, onde você pode ser livre pra ser quem é!

DEPARTMENT: Marketing

LOCATION: Durham, NC, Fully Remote

COMPANY:Humacyte Inc (Nasdaq: HUMA) is developing a disruptive biotechnology platform to deliver universally implantable bioengineered human tissues, advanced tissue constructs, and organ systems designed to improve the lives of patients and transform the practice of medicine. The Company develops and manufactures acellular tissues to treat a wide range of diseases, injuries, and chronic conditions. Humacyte’s initial opportunity, a portfolio of Acellular Tissue Engineered Vessel (ATEVs), is currently approved for use in vascular trauma repair and is in late-stage clinical trials targeting multiple other applications including AV access for hemodialysis and peripheral arterial disease. Preclinical development is also underway in coronary artery bypass grafts, pediatric heart surgery, treatment of type 1 diabetes, and multiple novel cell and tissue applications. Humacyte’s 6mm ATEV for AV access in hemodialysis was the first product candidate to receive the FDA’s Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) designation and has also received FDA Fast Track designation. Humacyte’s 6mm ATEV for urgent arterial repair following extremity vascular trauma also received the RMAT designation. For more information, visit www.Humacyte.com.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Marketing Manager/Senior Marketing Manager, Marketing Communications and DTC will play a key role in developing and executing integrated marketing programs that elevate brand awareness, engage key stakeholders, and support commercial objectives. This individual will lead social media strategy, content development, digital marketing campaigns, and support direct-to-consumer (DTC) initiatives while helping bring Humacyte's innovative science and products to life through compelling storytelling and data-driven marketing.

Working cross-functionally with Commercial, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Market Access, and Product Marketing teams, this individual will develop audience-focused campaigns and content that educate, inspire, and drive engagement across healthcare professional, patient, caregiver, investor, and public audiences. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and has experience within the biotechnology, biologics, pharmaceutical, medical device, or life sciences industries.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Social Media Strategy & Management
    • Develop and execute Humacyte's social media strategy across LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, and emerging platforms.
    • Build annual and quarterly social media content plans aligned with corporate, commercial, educational, and awareness objectives.
    • Monitor social media performance and audience engagement, providing regular reporting and optimization recommendations.
    • Partner with internal stakeholders to identify and create timely content tied to clinical milestones, conferences, product initiatives, disease awareness campaigns, and corporate news.
    • Manage social media publishing and listening platforms and maintain editorial calendars.
    • Oversee agency support for social content development.
  • Content Development & Storytelling
    • Lead creation of high-quality content across digital and traditional channels, including social media posts, website content, blogs, infographics, videos, email campaigns, presentations, patient stories, and thought leadership materials.
    • Translate complex scientific, clinical, and healthcare information into accessible, audience-appropriate content.
    • Collaborate with internal subject matter experts and external agencies to develop compelling content that aligns with brand standards and regulatory requirements.
    • Support congresses, speaker programs, awareness campaigns, and commercial initiatives with targeted content assets as needed.
  • Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) Marketing
    • Support development and execution of future direct-to-consumer marketing strategies and patient engagement programs.
    • Assist in the planning and implementation of patient-focused education and awareness initiatives across digital channels.
    • Coordinate with external agencies, creative partners, and media vendors to execute DTC campaigns.
    • Contribute to patient journey mapping, audience segmentation, and campaign optimization activities.
  • Digital Marketing & Advertising
    • Develop and manage multi-channel digital marketing campaigns, including paid social, display advertising, search engine marketing (SEM), retargeting, and email marketing.
    • Support website strategy, search engine optimization (SEO), content optimization, and user experience initiatives.
    • Analyze campaign performance and digital metrics to inform future strategy and investment decisions.
    • Manage agency partners, media budgets, and project timelines to ensure successful campaign execution.
  • Public Relations Support
    • Support corporate communications and public relations activities, including press releases, media monitoring, award submissions, executive visibility opportunities, and thought leadership programs as needed.
    • Assist with promotion of company milestones, scientific publications, clinical data presentations, and conference participation.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Compliance
    • Partner closely with Commercial, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Market Access, and Corporate Communications teams to develop aligned messaging and campaigns.
    • Ensure all promotional materials comply with applicable regulatory, legal, and company requirements.
    • Manage marketing projects through review, approval, and implementation processes.
    • Maintain strong knowledge of industry trends, competitive activity, and best practices in healthcare marketing.
  • Other Duties as assigned.

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Business, or related field.
  • 4-6+ years (Manager) or 6-10+ years (Senior Manager) of experience in biotechnology, biologics, pharmaceutical, medical device, or healthcare marketing.
  • Experience supporting commercial product launches and growth-stage healthcare organizations preferred.
  • Demonstrated success leading social media strategy, content development, and digital marketing campaigns.
  • Experience managing agencies, creative vendors, and marketing budgets.
  • Working knowledge of SEO, SEM, digital advertising platforms, web analytics, CRM systems, and social media management tools.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience operating in highly regulated healthcare environments preferred.
  • Familiarity with patient engagement, disease awareness, and/or direct-to-consumer healthcare marketing initiatives strongly preferred.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Possess a positive roll-up-the-sleeves attitude and optimistic outlook.
  • Strong ability to work in a fast-paced team environment with fluctuating priorities and demonstrated ability to collaborate within cross functional teams.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills with ability to set own priorities in a timely manner.
  • High degree of flexibility and adaptability.
  • Self-motivated and organized critical thinker with solid interpersonal and business communication skills.

jobs.description:
About Us

Flourish and Thrive Labs is a woman-owned and led consulting firm specializing in public health solutions. Our team, composed of former public health officials, works with state and local health departments across the country, building resilient public health operating systems. We pride ourselves on being different, holding ourselves to high ethical standards, and taking care of each other.

We view our company as an urban neighborhood—a diverse group of individuals coming together to live and work, embracing the beauty in that diversity. We are a wacky bunch who are intent on spreading joy! (We just mailed out stickers to over 200 local health health professionals because we felt they could use more joy!)

As Salesforce, Microsoft, Snowflake, and AWS partners, we specialize in technology implementation with a strong people focus. We combine this with strategic planning, data analysis, coaching, and facilitation to effectively support local public health department staff.

Our core values are:

  • People First
  • Focus on Capacity Building
  • Belief in Continuous Experimentation
  • By Public Heath; For Public Health
  • We Do What Is Right. Always.

We're seeking passionate, joyful individuals who align with our ethos of being different and making a difference.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A TEAM MEMBER WITH PUBLIC HEALTH EXPERIENCE (LOCAL/ TRIBAL/ STATE/ FEDERAL).

About Consulting at F&T Labs

If you're new to consulting, we want to help you understand what makes F&T Labs different and why our approach might be perfect for you. We know transitioning from government and non-profit to consulting can be a big step, but we've designed our work environment to blend the best of both worlds.

First, let's talk about how we work. Unlike traditional consulting firms, we hire you for a role, not a specific project. This means you can contribute to various initiatives that match your expertise and interests. Think of it as bringing your public health superpowers to different challenges where they're needed most.

We believe in measuring what matters. While many consulting firms focus on billable hours, we care about the quality and impact of your work. Time sheets don't measure your success with us – it's measured by the meaningful solutions you help create for our clients and their communities.

Yes, we have utilization targets (consulting speak for how much of your time is spent on client work), but we view these as guideposts rather than strict rules. They help us ensure we're making a sustainable impact while maintaining a healthy business. These targets are meant to motivate, not to create stress.

One of the most dynamic aspects of consulting is its natural rhythm. Some weeks might be bustling with activity, while others might be quieter. We embrace these ebbs and flows because they create space for both intense, focused work and time for learning, reflection, and personal growth. This is part of our philosophy that work and life shouldn't be at odds – they should be integrated in a sustainable and energizing way.

At our core, we're built on a simple belief: when our team members flourish, our clients flourish, and ultimately, communities thrive. That's why we've created an environment that supports your growth, values your expertise, and understands that the best solutions come from people who feel empowered and energized by their work.

If you're passionate about public health and excited about the possibility of expanding your impact through consulting, we'd love to talk with you. Your experience in public health is valuable, and we're here to help you apply it in new and meaningful ways.

Notice

No 3rd Party Recruiters. No Phone Calls. We are unable to do informational interviews at this moment. Candidates who call or schedule a "coffee chat" will be considered disqualified.

Solutions Analyst / Business Analyst

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A TEAM MEMBER WITH GOVERNMENT PUBLIC HEALTH EXPERIENCE, IDEALLY IN ENVIRONMENTAL HEALTH AT A LOCAL HEALTH DEPARTMENT. IF YOU HAVE THAT EXPERIENCE, PLEASE ENSURE IT IS CLEAR ON YOUR RESUME.

Compensation Note: If a salary range is listed for this position, please note that we will offer at the starting point of the band. We cover 100% of your health insurance!

Role Overview

We're seeking a Solutions Analyst who deeply understands how public health departments work and can translate that understanding into technology solutions that actually fit their needs. This role goes beyond gathering requirements. It requires immersing yourself in the workflows, challenges, and realities of public health practice, then figuring out how technology can make things better.

We're especially interested in candidates who have worked in environmental health programs at a local health department. You know what it's like to manage inspections, track permits, navigate compliance workflows, and juggle the reporting demands that come with environmental health. That firsthand experience will shape how you approach every solution you design.

This is a role for someone who naturally translates needs into action. You're the person who listens to a health department director describe their frustrations and can see the solution taking shape. You're the one who watches staff navigate a clunky process and immediately starts thinking about how it could work better. You take the messy, complex reality of public health operations and turn it into clear direction for a technical team to build against. If you've ever found yourself thinking "I know exactly what they need, I just need to explain it in a way the developers will understand," this role is for you.

You'll work on our PH360 platform and various client initiatives, serving as the critical bridge between what health departments need and what our technical teams build. Your lived experience in governmental public health will help you ask the right questions, spot the real problems behind stated requests, and advocate for solutions that work in the real world.

We're looking for someone who thinks holistically about problems, can synthesize input from multiple stakeholders, and isn't afraid to push back when a proposed solution doesn't quite fit. As a consulting firm, we value candidates who are passionate and eager to dive into the work. While this role focuses on solutions analysis, you may also contribute your unique talents to other firm initiatives.

How You'll Work

You'll join an Agile Release Train (ART) that follows SAFe principles. This means:

  • Program Increment (PI) Planning: You'll participate in quarterly planning sessions, helping shape the roadmap based on your understanding of client needs.
  • Sprint Collaboration: You'll work in two-week sprints with daily standups, regular backlog refinement, and sprint retrospectives.
  • Cross-functional Teams: You'll collaborate closely with developers, architects, and QA analysts to ensure solutions meet the real need.
  • Continuous Discovery: You'll maintain ongoing conversations with clients and stakeholders to refine your understanding of their challenges.

Key Responsibilities

  • Immerse yourself in client workflows to understand how public health staff actually do their work, with particular depth in environmental health programs
  • Identify pain points, inefficiencies, and opportunities that clients may not have articulated
  • Synthesize input from multiple stakeholders into coherent solution recommendations
  • Translate complex public health processes into clear user stories and acceptance criteria
  • Lead discovery sessions and workshops with health department staff
  • Serve as the voice of the client within our technical teams
  • Develop process flows, documentation, and visual aids that communicate the "why" behind solutions
  • Challenge assumptions and push back when proposed solutions don't fit client realities

Experience Required

  • 2+ years working in governmental public health (local, state, federal, or tribal)
  • Demonstrated ability to understand complex systems and workflows
  • Strong facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Experience translating between technical and non-technical audiences
  • Self-motivated with strong initiative
  • Adaptability in dynamic environments
  • Comfort working with AI tools and large language models

Strongly Preferred

  • Direct experience in environmental health programs at a local health department (e.g., inspections, permitting, compliance, complaint response)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agile methodologies
  • Familiarity with user story development and acceptance criteria writing
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or similar platforms
  • Background in process improvement or system implementation
  • Understanding of public health data systems and reporting requirements (e.g., environmental health tracking, inspection databases)
  • Experience with discovery techniques (journey mapping, interviews, observation)

Notice

Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. Willingness to adhere to our no-drug workplace policy. You must agree to undergo eVerify for employment status at hiring.

No 3rd Party Recruiters. No Phone Calls. We are unable to do informational interviews at this moment. Candidates who call or schedule a "coffee chat" will be disqualified.

For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment. Our mission, to make digital transformation attainable for everyone, drives a culture of innovation and exploration. We have one simple goal: help organizations simplify processes through automation and integration.

So we created simple, cost-effective, and easy-to-implement digital tools that work together, removing bottlenecks and improving efficiency. And we’re always on the lookout for new people who can help us innovate, grow, and reach our goal.

About the role

Vasion is looking for a Technical Account Manager who becomes the technical point of contact for our healthcare customers after the sale, working with hospital and health-system IT teams, from day-to-day administrators to IT directors, to keep the platform healthy, adopted, and growing long after go-live. We modernize how organizations handle documents, print, and content workflows, replacing fragmented legacy tools with a single, secure platform. In healthcare, that means print and document workflows that clinicians never have to think about, and IT teams that are never surprised.

At a Glance
  • Segment: Healthcare accounts: hospitals, health systems, and multi-site provider networks
  • Vertical focus: Healthcare
  • Engagement model: Post-sales technical ownership across adoption, retention, and expansion
  • Work model: Remote; ability to travel up to 20% [confirm]
