What Success Looks Like

You find problems before our customers do. Every account in your book has a current technical plan that the customer's own technical owner has agreed to, and that plan already accounts for the EHR upgrade, the new clinic opening, and the audit that are coming. Escalations end with a root cause and a fix that holds. Renewals are a confirmation, not a negotiation, because the technical trust was built a year earlier.

What you'll do

Ownership of the technical relationship across healthcare accounts: preventing risk, driving adoption, and growing customers over time.

  • Proactive technical advisory: Anticipate deployment, adoption, and stability risk across your accounts before the customer raises it. Turn release changes, configuration drift, and usage patterns into recommendations that name the risk, the likely impact, and the choice available to the customer, and be clear about which conclusions are firm and which need more evidence.
  • Technical account planning: Own a twelve-month technical plan for each account, grounded in the health system's real growth, projects, and constraints, and agreed with the customer's technical owner. Keep a forward calendar of EHR upgrades and cutovers, new site openings, acquisitions, audits, and clinical change freezes, so Vasion hears about them before they arrive as escalations.

  • Domain expertise: Print, Workflow, and Output Automation in cloud and hybrid environments; familiarity with EHR platforms (Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner) and the print and document patterns around them.

jobs.description:
A Note on How to Reach Us

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

Where You’ll Work:

  • As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
  • With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.
WhatYou’llDo:
  • Lead our client community strategy, creating ways for clients to connect, learn, share expertise, and build relationships that strengthen their work and the broader sector
  • Bring clients and sector leaders together through flagship events, peer learning, smaller convenings, advisory groups, and digital communities
  • Build and activate our client advocate network, creating opportunities for clients to mentor, share stories, provide references and referrals, advise Foundant, and contribute to product development
  • Connect community across the client experience, bringing together events, education, digital communities, communications, and in-product experiences into a cohesive journey
  • Shape Foundant’s presence in the sector, setting the community strategy and standards for conferences, sponsorships, partnerships, and other industry gatherings
  • Lead client communication planning, aligning cross-functional teams around a coordinated strategy and calendar
  • Measure and strengthen community impact, using client insights and data to guide priorities, investment, and continuous improvement
  • Perform other duties as assigned
WhatYou’llNeed:
  • Significant experience in philanthropy, nonprofits, associations, community building, or the broader social good sector, with a strong understanding of the people and issues shaping the field
  • A track record of building communities, networks, events, or engagement strategies that create measurable value
  • Strong relationship-building and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage practitioners, partners, clients, and senior leaders
  • Strategic thinking paired with the ability to turn ideas into experiences, programs, and results
  • A collaborative leadership style and the ability to influence across teams and organizations
  • Curiosity and strong listening skills, grounded in a belief in the value of people learning from one another
  • Comfort using client insight and data to measure impact and guide decisions
How We'll Measure Success:
  • Community health: reach, engagement, repeat participation, and contribution
  • Client value: connection, learning, experience, and satisfaction
  • Advocacy: client contribution, referrals, recommendations, and participation
  • Business impact: influence on retention, expansion, referrals, and brand affinity
WhatYou’llBring to our Team Dynamics:
  • Strategic Thinking: Translates the potential of community into a focused strategy that creates greater connection, learning, and value for clients and the sector
  • Collaboration & Learning: Builds trusted relationships and brings people together across teams, clients, and the sector to learn and create shared value
  • Decision-Making: Combines client insight, sector knowledge, and data to make clear choices about priorities and investment
  • Performance Advancement: Defines meaningful outcomes, measures progress, and strengthens the strategy based on what we learn
  • Change Management: Creates clarity and alignment as the strategy evolves, helping others understand where we’re going and why
Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:
  • At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not-for-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real-world change.
  • We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.
  • With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well-being and professional success.
  • We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries.
  • As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals
  • You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.
  • Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it!

Foundant is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse workforce that represents the communities we serve. jobs.excerpt: At JC Davis Ventures, LLC dba JC Davis Power, we keep work moving with smart, reliable solutions that allow our people and our partners to stay safe, focused, and ahead.
jobs.companyName: JC Davis Ventures LLC dba JC Davis Power
jobs.description:
At JC Davis Ventures, LLC dba JC Davis Power, we keep work moving with smart, reliable solutions that allow our people and our partners to stay safe, focused, and ahead. Powering a jobsite shouldn't be a hassle. But too often, crews are left waiting, equipment breaks down, vendors go dark, and deadlines slip.

We started JC Davis Power to fix all of that. We're a full-service jobsite operations partner, delivering and maintaining temporary power, climate control, and tower lighting. All with one reliable crew. No handoffs. No confusion.

We show up, solve problems, and do the work the right way. Whether you're supporting customers in the field, building systems behind the scenes, or helping drive the business forward, you'll be part of a team that values reliability, accountability, and getting the job done.

Simple - Reliable - Done Right!

The Role

We're growing fast, and with each new employee we hire, our IT support needs to grow and evolve. Every new hire needs a laptop, a phone and working accounts on day one. Every crew member in the field needs quick help when a login or permission gets in the way. As our IT Help Desk Associate, you'll be the first stop for both. You'll triage and fix everyday IT issues, and execute new hire onboarding from ticket, to account setup, to shipped devices.

This role is a good fit for someone with a few years of help desk experience, and is ready to learn our systems and processes fast. You'll start with core support and onboarding. Over time, you'll grow to take on more advanced work across our systems.

This is a fully remote role, but candidates MUST be located here in Texas in either the Austin, DFW, or San Antonio metro areas. Travel to Austin is required for quarterly in-person department meetings.

Working schedule: Monday - Friday, 8am - 5pm with future on-call rotation for weekend support.

What You'll Do

  • Frontline support: Monitor our IT and helpdesk channels and fix everyday issues such as password resets, login problems and access requests across Salesforce, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Quo, Slack and custom internal apps such as TechForms.

  • New hire onboarding: Work each onboarding ticket in Linear from start to finish. Follow our role-based checklist to create accounts, set up MacBooks, iPhones and Windows Toughbooks, and configure cell lines. Responsibility also includes offboarding and device recovery processes.

  • User accounts and permissions: Create user accounts and set permissions in our core platforms, so each person has the access their role needs.

  • Ticket triage and routing: Sort incoming requests, resolving what falls within your scope. Then, following SOPs, route higher level tickets to the right team (IT, Solutions Engineering, or Software Development).

  • Device inventory and shipping: Assist in tracking device stock and flag when it needs reordering. Ship equipment directly to new hires or to the yards where they will be working, and log tracking details in the hire's ticket.

  • New hire IT support: Help new team members get comfortable with our tools and platforms.

What We're Looking For

  • 1-3 years of help desk or IT support experience, plus hands-on troubleshooting experience

  • Comfortable supporting macOS, Windows and iOS devices

  • Familiar with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Apple Business Manager, and/or Mosyle

  • Patience in supporting remote users. Providing clear, friendly communication to help diagnose, document, escalate, or resolve issues.

  • Organized and detail-oriented, clearly records your work in tickets

  • Adaptable and eager to learn new tools and processes as we grow

  • Available to provide on-call weekend support on a rotational schedule

  • Self-directed and reliable when working remotely

  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated, distraction-free workspace

Preferred

  • Admin experience in Mosyle, Apple Business Manager, Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365

  • Experience with a ticketing system (Linear, Jira or similar)

  • A recent degree or certificate in IT, computer science or a related field

  • CompTIA A+, Google IT Support Certificate or a similar certification

  • Located near our Elgin or DFW locations and willing to visit on-site as needed

What Success Looks Like

  • New hires have their devices, accounts and access ready on day one

  • Common requests (resets, logins, permissions) are fixed quickly without needing escalation

  • Tickets that need another team reach the right one the first time, with clear notes

  • Device stock stays above minimum levels, so onboarding is never held up waiting for equipment

  • Every ticket is documented well enough that anyone on the team could pick it up

  • Your skills grow steadily, and you take on more advanced systems work over time

What We Offer

We take care of our team so you can take care of the work. Our benefits are designed to keep you safe, supported, and set up for success.

  • Health & Wellness – 100% company-paid medical coverage premiums for you and your family, including spouse or partner and children

  • Life Insurance – Company-paid group life insurance for every employee

  • Additional Coverage – Employee-paid dental, vision, short and long term disability, additional life, accident, illness, and hospital indemnity options available

  • 401k – plus 4% matching

  • Time Off – PTO, paid holidays, plus your birthday off

  • Tools & Equipment – Company-provided tools, equipment, and technology

  • Supportive Culture – Safety-first mindset, people-first values, and a team that looks out for one another

jobs.description:
Brightside Health delivers life-saving virtual mental healthcare to everyone who needs it. We are powered by proprietary AI, purpose-built technology, a world-class clinician network, and a care model that rivals the best of in-person treatment. When combined with precision psychiatry and leading-edge therapeutic techniques, we’re able to improve outcomes for those with mild-to-severe clinical depression, anxiety, and other mood disorders. Our innovative approach has earned recognition from leading publications such as Healthline, Fortune, and Forbes, naming us 'Most Comprehensive,' and 'Best Online Therapy for Anxiety and Depression.'

We take an action-oriented, purposeful approach with everything we do and seek out team members who value collaboration and thoughtful prioritization. This role will report directly to our Manager, Credentialing and Enrollment and will serve as an experienced cross-functional operator within the team. In this role, you will manage the full range of credentialing and enrollment production work with minimal supervision, including more complex cases across the provider lifecycle. You will also serve as a resource for Credentialing Specialist I team members and may take on limited subject matter expert responsibilities to support team operations. This position represents the experienced production role within the unified credentialing and enrollment team and plays an important part in ensuring the continued growth and quality of our national provider network.

Provider Lifecycle Execution

  • Prepare and submit initial credentialing and re-credentialing applications
  • Submit and monitor primary source verifications through CVO
  • Perform PSV according to departmental policies and NCQA standards when not completed by CVO

  • Process provider status changes, terminations, and reactivations
  • Collect and follow up on missing provider documentation
  • Track and manage provider expirables and renewal timelines

Provider Experience

Revenue Protection Support

  • Support enrollment-related claim denial triage
  • Assist with provider billing activation coordination

Compliance Execution

  • Gather audit evidence as directed by Senior IC
  • Prepare delegated credentialing files
  • Perform credentialing file QA
  • Collect and verify provider malpractice policies and insurance documents
  • Track insurance expiration dates and follow up on renewals

Systems & Data

  • Ensure provider demographic data is current across credentialing systems, CAQH, and payer records
  • Maintain credentialing platform records and internal trackers
  • Maintain payer portal accounts

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in credentialing and/or enrollment operations
  • Experience with group-level Medicaid enrollment
  • Working knowledge of NCQA standards, CAQH, and payer enrollment processes
  • Experience with both commercial and government payer enrollment preferred
  • Proficiency with payer portals (CAQH, PECOS, Availity, payer-specific)

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines consistently

  • 401k Plan
  • Unlimited PTO and sick leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Work remotely and whatever schedule works best for you

Work Environment & Culture

At Brightside Health, you’ll join a fully remote, mission-driven team that values flexibility and impact. You’ll collaborate with professionals across engineering, product, and clinical teams, all dedicated to transforming mental healthcare. Our culture fosters continuous learning, empathy, and cross-functional collaboration.

jobs.excerpt: About ImprovadoImprovado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams.
jobs.description:
About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

  • Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).
  • Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.
  • Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

  • Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.
  • Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.
  • Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).
  • Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.
  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.
  • Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

  • Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.
  • Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

  • Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

  • 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.
  • Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.
  • Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.
  • Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.
  • Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.
  • ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.
  • Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).
  • Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.
  • Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.
  • HubSpot to Salesforce migration.
  • Attribution or CS health score data.
  • Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

The Sr. Director, Implementation serves as a strategic and operational leader of the implementation function. The role helps shape and translate implementation strategy, priorities, operating-model requirements, and governance standards into coordinated portfolio execution across regulatory, technology, vendor, and operational workstreams. The Sr. Director directly leads the Implementation Manager, Technology & Vendor Integrations and the Sr. Regulatory Implementation Manager and is accountable for team performance, development, capacity, portfolio delivery, reporting accuracy, readiness validation, risk escalation, and post-launch stabilization. The role influences portfolio priorities and leads the assigned portfolio within approved scope, schedule, quality, budget, regulatory, and operational-readiness expectations. Participates in development of enterprise strategy, final operating-model design, preparation of investment approval for final launch decisions to be approved by the Vice President and executive governance bodies.

Job Duties/Responsibilities:

Portfolio Execution Leadership

  • Partner to shape and influence enterprise priorities, then translate them into integrated portfolio plans, delivery commitments, resource assignments, milestones, dependencies, and measurable outcomes
  • Own execution performance for the assigned portfolio, including scope, schedule, quality, budget adherence, regulatory readiness, operational readiness, adoption, stabilization, and transition to operations

People Leadership & Development

  • Directly lead the Implementation Manager, Technology & Vendor Integrations and the Sr. Regulatory Implementation Manager
  • Establish goals, priorities, decision rights, workloads, performance measures, development plans, succession plans, and continuity coverage; coach, evaluate, recognize, and hold team members accountable for results

Integrated Implementation Management

  • Integrate regulatory, technology, vendor, operational, and cross-functional activities into coordinated plans with clear ownership, dependencies, decision points, and handoffs
  • Ensure both manager functions operate under common planning, governance, reporting, readiness, and escalation standards

Governance, Controls & Decision Support

  • Establish, evolve, and oversee implementation governance standards and methodologies in alignment with enterprise direction, including intake, portfolio reviews, stage gates, change control, risk and issue management, readiness reviews, launch preparation, stabilization, and transition-to-operations requirements
  • Consolidate readiness assessments, validate evidence, and provide documented go-live recommendations

Regulatory Implementation Oversight

  • Hold the Sr. Regulatory Implementation Manager accountable for timely impact assessments, requirements traceability, implementation planning, evidence management, cross-functional coordination, and readiness by required effective dates
  • Ensure material compliance gaps, audit findings, corrective actions, delegated-entity obligations, and regulatory risks are documented, monitored, and escalated

Technology & Vendor Implementation Oversight

  • Hold the Implementation Manager, Technology & Vendor Integrations accountable for vendor onboarding, integration planning, requirements coordination, testing, defect remediation, operational readiness, deployment, stabilization, and transition to accountable operational owners
  • Ensure implementations meet approved contractual, technical, privacy, security, data, operational, and regulatory requirements

Operational Readiness & Change Management

  • Ensure business owners develop and execute readiness plans addressing workflows, procedures, staffing, training, communications, controls, testing, contingencies, adoption, and performance measures
  • Oversee stabilization and formal transition to operations, including documented ownership and closure plans for residual items

Portfolio Governance & Executive Reporting

  • Provide the Vice President and senior stakeholders with accurate, timely, and decision-ready reporting covering milestones, dependencies, capacity, budget status, regulatory readiness, risks, decisions, adoption, stabilization, and expected outcomes
  • Escalate material risks with clear impact analysis, corrective options, and recommended action

Resource & Financial Management

  • Develop team capacity and staffing plans, allocate approved resources across the portfolio, and manage assigned work within approved budget and resource parameters
  • Anticipate capacity gaps, evaluate conflicting priorities, vendor support needs, and investment requirements, and influence portfolio and investment decisions through evidence-based recommendations to the Vice President

Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and evolve implementation tools, methodologies, procedures, controls, competencies, and quality standards that advance the enterprise framework and portfolio strategy
  • Use performance results, quality reviews, stakeholder feedback, and lessons learned to improve execution effectiveness and organizational maturity

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build effective relationships across Operations, Information Technology, Regulatory Affairs, Compliance, Product, Finance, Clinical Services, Network Management, Sales, Legal, Procurement, Information Security, business leadership, executive sponsors, vendors, and delegated entities

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • This role directly manages the Implementation Manager, Technology & Vendor Integrations and the Sr. Regulatory Implementation Manager, as well as other implementation professionals assigned to the function, typically 2–6 direct reports
  • Fulfill supervisory responsibilities in accordance with organization policies and applicable laws
  • The Sr. Director retains accountability for team performance, reporting accuracy, risk escalation, portfolio delivery, and implementation outcomes when execution is delegated to direct reports. The role partners with functional and vendor leaders through matrixed relationships but does not exercise direct supervisory authority unless formally assigned

Decision-Making Authority:

  • Recommend resource priorities and allocate approved resources, enforce delivery standards, direct recovery actions, and manage execution within approved scope and budget.
  • Establish, evolve, and oversee governance, stage gates, reporting, and controls and recommend process improvements.
  • Validate readiness evidence, require remediation, and recommend go-live, delay, scope adjustment, or additional controls to the Vice President.
  • Resolve execution risks within delegated authority and influence enterprise priority, investment, capacity, and risk-tolerance decisions through recommendations and escalate final launch approval to the Vice President or designated executive governance body.
  • Manage direct-report selection, development, performance, and accountability within organization policy and delegated authority.

JOB REQUIREMENTS


Experience:

Required:

  • 8–10 years of progressively responsible experience in implementation, program management, healthcare operations, regulatory implementation, technology delivery, vendor integration, or a related discipline.
  • 4–5 years of people leadership experience, including direct leadership of managers, senior professionals, or complex matrixed teams.
  • Demonstrated experience translating executive strategy and governance requirements into coordinated, measurable portfolio execution.

  • Experience managing resources, capacity, approved budgets, vendor relationships, and performance accountability in a regulated environment.
  • Healthcare, managed care, health plan, or healthcare technology experience; Medicare Advantage or a comparably regulated environment strongly preferred.

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting CMS audit readiness, corrective action plans, NCQA accreditation, state regulatory readiness, or delegated oversight.
  • Experience leading managers with distinct regulatory and technology/vendor implementation accountabilities.

Education:

Preferred:

Training:

Preferred:

Specialized Skills:

  • Portfolio Execution - Integrates multiple initiatives and workstreams, balances competing demands, and delivers within approved commitments.
  • Judgment & Escalation - Distinguishes execution issues from enterprise decisions and escalates material risks with practical recommendations.
  • Regulatory & Operational Readiness - Understands how regulatory, operational, technology, vendor, data, and control requirements affect implementation readiness.
  • Executive Communication - Synthesizes complex information into concise, accurate, decision-ready reporting and recommendations.
  • Cross-Functional Influence - Builds alignment and accountability across functions and external partners without relying solely on direct authority.
  • Financial & Resource Stewardship - Manages approved budgets, forecasts, capacity, and resource tradeoffs with sound business judgment.
  • Data & Reporting Discipline - Ensures portfolio information is complete, current, validated, and suitable for executive decision-making.
  • Change Leadership - Promotes adoption, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement through complex organizational change.
  • Problem Solving - Anticipates dependencies, identifies root causes, directs recovery, and drives issues to documented resolution.

The next part of your journey is right around the corner — with The Standard.

A genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others is the foundation for everything we do. With a customer-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams, we’ve been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. Our high-performance culture focused on operational excellence thrives thanks to remarkable people united by compassion and a customer-first commitment. Are you ready to make a difference?

Job Summary:

As an Actuarial Developer II on the Actuarial Reporting, Workflow, and Analytics (RWA) team, you will lead efforts to expand adoption of the Actuarial Technology Platform (ATP). This position provides direct oversight of solution design and implementation for process enhancements in Employee Benefits financial reporting and pricing. Close collaboration with Actuarial Data Management, Enterprise Data & Analytics, and Platform Enablement teams is essential to transitioning legacy processes successfully to ATP technology stacks.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead with AI - everyday use of AI and generative-AI tools (such as coding assistants and large language models) a default part of how you work — for development, analysis, testing, and documentation.
  • Promote the integration of advanced AI capabilities to strengthen actuarial processes and analytics.
  • Act as the actuarial technology lead while continually expanding expertise in Databricks.
  • Lead financial reporting and pricing initiatives by translating solution designs into actionable change requirements.
  • Create and present future-state process maps for stakeholders.
  • Provide operational support for the RWA team and legacy actuarial solutions, maintaining governance and reliability while resolving issues promptly.

Skills & Background You’ll Need:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in actuarial science, Business, Information Systems, or a related field; minimum five years’ experience in the actuarial or insurance industry.

Skills:

  • Proven experience in actuarial transformation, process improvement, and technology implementation.
  • Experience in actuarial pricing, financial reporting, and underwriting (preferred)
  • Proficiency in Databricks, Python, SQL, SAS, Jira, and Agile methodology (required)
  • Experience with Codex or Claude Code (preferred)
  • Familiarity with accounting under Statutory, U.S. GAAP, or Economic bases (preferred)

Key Behaviors of a Successful Candidate

Winning Together: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to build strong relationships within the team and across the organization. Effectively collaborates with stakeholders and is able to translate complex ideas into easily understandable concepts for non-technical stakeholders to accomplish common business goals.


Driving success: Drives team performance toward goals and provides training and development to immediate team members.  Serves as a significant resource and mentor to others on the actuarial team. Establishes clarity, sets ambitious goals, and champions execution with purpose and urgency.


Improvement Mindset: Acts independently to research, identify, assess, and recommend methods and procedures on new assignments. Thinks innovatively, brings ideas to life, and proactively identifies and resolves business issues — designing certain solutions with limited input from leadership. Applies knowledge of actuarial business systems across the full development cycle and designs solutions that make complex business problems easier to analyze.


Customer Focus: Understands and anticipates the needs of internal and external customers and develops customer-inspired solutions that exceed expectations.



Why Join The Standard?

We have built an enduring legacy of stability, financial strength and exceptional customer service through the contributions of the service-oriented people who choose to work at The Standard. To ensure we can attract and retain the best talent, when you join The Standard you can expect:

  • A rich benefits package including medical, dental, vision and a 401(k) plan with matching company contributions

  • An annual incentive bonus plan

  • Generous paid time off including 11 holidays, 2 wellness days, and 8 volunteer hours annually — PTO increases with tenure

  • A supportive, responsive management approach and opportunities for career growth and advancement

  • Paid parental leave and adoption/surrogacy assistance

  • An employee giving program that double matches your donations to eligible nonprofits and schools

In addition to the competitive salary range below, our employee-focused benefits support work-life balance. Learn more about working at The Standard.

The actual compensation for this role will be based on a combination of education and experience, knowledge and skills, position budget, internal equity, and market data.

$109,750.00 - $160,500.00

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Identity and Authorization
jobs.excerpt: Who we areAt Domino, we build software that helps the largest, AI-driven organizations build and operate advanced data science and AI solutions at scale.
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Domino, we build software that helps the largest, AI-driven organizations build and operate advanced data science and AI solutions at scale. Our platform integrates a streamlined model development environment, MLOps capabilities, and novel features for collaboration, reuse, and reproducibility — all of which make data science teams more productive, reduce time to value, and ensure compliance. Our customers — like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bristol Myers, UBS, FINRA and the US Navy — are using our software to solve some of the most important challenges in the world, such as developing new medicines, securing our financial markets, or protecting our country. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, NVIDIA, Snowflake and other leading investors, we have been in business for a decade but are still a small team operating with the spirit of a startup. Especially in the world of AI today, we believe that the future is still being invented — and we want to be the ones building it. For more information, visit www.domino.ai

What we are building

Domino’s Identity and Access platform (IDSM) is the foundation for how customers in some of the world’s most regulated industries manage who can see and do what. We’re evolving it into a centralized, relationship-based authorization framework built on SpiceDB, and you’d be the technical anchor for its next phase.

  • A unified authorization model. Extend a centralized, fine-grained, relationship-based model across the platform, replacing feature-specific permission checks with consistent, reusable primitives.
  • Production-grade operations. Harden the authorization layer for the scale, reliability, and security that enterprise and public-sector customers expect.
  • A thoughtful migration path. Make the sequencing and design calls that let us retire legacy access checks without disrupting customers along the way.
  • Groups and organizations that mirror real customers. Rethink how we model groups and organizational hierarchies so large enterprises can represent their teams the way they actually work.
  • Cloud-native identity. Deepen integration with cloud workload identity, starting with AWS IRSA and extending to Azure and GCP equivalents.
  • Foundations other teams build on. Design core identity and access capabilities, with clean interfaces and flexible abstractions, that engineers across the company can adopt with confidence.
  • A stronger way of building. Set the patterns for how the team uses AI-assisted development to ship high-quality features faster, without compromising security or code quality.

What your impact will be

  • Set the architectural direction. Design identity and access solutions that meet customer demands for managing user and group access, and are secure, scalable, and built on primitives teams can reuse.
  • Bring clarity to complex decisions. Articulate the architecture clearly enough that the rest of Engineering can rally around it.
  • Be the go-to authority. Engineers and teams building on IDSM will bring their auth questions to you, and your technical judgment will carry real influence.
  • Raise the engineering bar. Lead design reviews, unblock engineers facing ambiguity, and champion flexible abstractions and well-thought-out interfaces.
  • Increase velocity and reduce maintenance. Improve our architecture, including removing tech debt, so the team ships faster with less ongoing maintenance.
  • Shape how we build with AI. Establish patterns for using AI-assisted development to deliver high-quality features faster without compromising security or rigor.
  • Foster ownership and urgency. Help the team know what to build and value both quality and speed of iteration and contribute to experiences that make identity and user management easier for the enterprises we serve.

What we look for in this role

  • A track record of evolving an enterprise-grade authorization system under real production traffic, with strong opinions about the architecture of these systems
  • Experience designing a new auth system and migrating to it from a legacy approach (a plus)
  • Experience on a platform team supporting other services within a larger engineering organization
  • A background at a company that builds authentication or authorization products (a plus)
  • A concrete example of an auth system you helped build that solved a recurring class of customer challenges
  • A history of helping teams become better engineers by improving designs, velocity, and quality
  • Authorization systems: Hands-on experience with relationship-based or fine-grained authorization, including schema design (relations, permissions, caveats) and the tradeoffs versus traditional RBAC
  • Identity protocols: Solid grounding in OIDC and SAML, and ideally experience with an IdP such as Keycloak, Auth0, Okta, or ForgeRock
  • Cloud identity: Practical experience with workload identity patterns such as AWS IRSA, Azure Workload Identity, or GCP Workload Identity Federation
  • Secrets management: Familiarity with a credential management system such as Vault
  • Backend engineering: Strong Go, Java, or a comparable language, comfort running services on Kubernetes, and API design instincts from owning a platform others build on
  • System architecture: Experience architecting auth frameworks that scale to enterprise customers
  • AI-assisted development: Considered, real-world experience using AI coding tools while maintaining code quality and security rigor

What We Value

  • We value a growth mindset. High-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and see the opportunities for success
  • We believe in individuals who seek truth and speak the truth and can be their whole selves at work
  • We value all of you that believe improving is always possible At Domino Everything is a work in progress – we can do better at everything
  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company
  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply

Interested? Click here to apply now!

About the Role:

At TELUS Digital, we help the world’s biggest brands build smarter technology. As a E-commerce Product & Search Relevancy Expert, your mission is to help an AI learn how to suggest the perfect products to online shoppers. You will look at massive catalogs across various industries and decide which items belong together. You act as the "human logic" that ensures a customer sees a matching set or compatible accessories instead of a random, incorrect suggestion.

What You’ll Do:

  • Create Pairs: Match products based on color, pattern, and style so they are visually consistent.

  • Check Compatibility: Ensure products actually work together for the same use case. (Example: Matching the right technical gear for specific sub-disciplines like gravel biking vs. road cycling).

  • Review Metadata: Look at gender, price segment, and seasonality to ensure recommendations are logically and commercially sound.

  • Maintain Data Integrity: Keep a clean, structured list of matches that follow strict brand and category guidelines.

  • Category Research: Quickly learn the nuances of new product domains to pick the best matches. (Example: Researching technical differences in skiing, cycling, or gym fitness gear).

Qualification path

Mandatory Qualifications:

  • Experience: A proven track record in search relevancy, product categorization, or e-commerce content moderation and annotation.

  • Education: A minimum of a Bachelor's in any field.

  • Analytical Skills: The ability to learn and differentiate between technical product categories quickly.

  • Attention to Detail: High sensitivity to visual aesthetics and the ability to spot subtle mismatches in style or price positioning.

  • Efficiency: Comfortable navigating large datasets and high-volume SKU catalogs while maintaining quality standards.

  • English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level to navigate technical documentation and product attributes.

Professional Experience: Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following:

  • E-commerce product catalog management or product data analysis.

  • Product recommendations, search relevance, or product matching.

  • Online retail merchandising, product categorization, or taxonomy management.

  • Product compatibility analysis or technical product research.

  • Fashion, sporting goods, consumer electronics, or other product-specific retail domains.

Required Skills:

  • Strong analytical and research skills.

  • Ability to assess product similarity, compatibility and relevance.

  • Attention to detail when reviewing product attributes, metadata and categorization.

  • Ability to interpret product specifications and apply category-specific guidelines.

  • Strong written comprehension and decision-making skills.

Assessment:

In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification.

Why Join the TELUS Digital AI Community:

  • Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts.

  • Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day.

  • Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies.

  • Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects.

  • Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology.

TELUS Digital AI Community:

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

jobs.description:
AI2IO helps organizations navigate the complex landscape of technology solutions, from foundational IT services and system support to advanced software integration, automation, and cutting-edge AI implementations. Our expertise spans IT infrastructure management, custom software development, seamless system integrations, and optimization of low-code business automation, empowering clients to maximize their existing technology investments.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title

Product Owner

Position Location

Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Job Summary

AI2IO is seeking a Product Owner to own the day-to-day product and delivery operating model for a software development team. You will partner with engineers, designers, QA specialists, project managers, client-facing teams, and business stakeholders to discover meaningful problems, define valuable solutions, prioritize work, facilitate Agile delivery, and validate outcomes.

This role combines product ownership, requirements analysis, Agile facilitation, and delivery coordination. Project Managers own roadmap updates and integrated delivery coordination, Client Success Managers assist with stakeholder communication, and Product Adoption & Training partners own documentation, training, and adoption support. The Product Owner serves as the central source of product context, decisions, priorities, requirements, and outcome validation.

Essential Functions

This role combines hands-on product ownership with increasing responsibility for discovery, prioritization, Agile team facilitation, cross-functional coordination, and delivery effectiveness.

Own Product Direction & Priorities

  • Own backlog prioritization and work readiness for an assigned software delivery team.
  • Collaborate with users, stakeholders, and others to understand business needs and desired outcomes.
  • Translate business problems into actionable product work.
  • Evaluate competing priorities, risks, dependencies, and delivery constraints.
  • Ensure delivered work aligns with product goals and user needs.

Lead Discovery & Requirements Development

  • Facilitate discovery sessions with stakeholders, users, and subject-matter experts.
  • Create workflows, user stories, business rules, acceptance criteria, and supporting requirements.
  • Identify assumptions, dependencies, risks, and edge cases early.
  • Help the team understand the problem before committing to a solution.
  • Validate proposed solutions against intended outcomes.

Facilitate Agile Delivery

  • Facilitate Agile team ceremonies and maintain a healthy delivery process.
  • Help the team remove blockers and resolve delivery issues.
  • Promote continuous improvement through retrospectives and delivery feedback.
  • Maintain visibility into team priorities, commitments, dependencies, and risks.
  • Improve predictability, transparency, and team effectiveness.

Coordinate Across Teams & Functions

  • Partner with Product Design, QA, Engineering, Client Success, Product Adoption & Training, and Project Management.
  • Align stakeholders around product decisions and delivery priorities.
  • Coordinate dependencies affecting delivery outcomes.
  • Ensure handoffs remain clear and product intent remains consistent throughout implementation.

Validate Outcomes

  • Participate in release-readiness activities.
  • Validate delivered functionality against approved requirements and intended workflows.
  • Gather feedback after release and incorporate learning into future priorities.
  • Help ensure completed work achieves meaningful user and business outcomes.

Grow Your Product Leadership Capability

  • Take on increasingly complex initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, workflows, integrations, and business processes.
  • Develop stronger prioritization, facilitation, discovery, and delivery-leadership skills.
  • Build readiness for future advancement into Senior Product Owner, Product Management, or Solution Delivery leadership opportunities as ai2io continues to grow.

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

What Success Looks Like

  • Teams consistently receive clear, actionable, prioritized, and testable work.
  • Product decisions reflect user needs, business outcomes, technical realities, and informed tradeoffs.
  • Agile ceremonies produce alignment, decisions, learning, and improvement rather than administrative overhead.
  • Risks, blockers, and dependencies are surfaced early and addressed proactively.
  • Stakeholders understand priorities, decisions, constraints, and delivery expectations.
  • Cross-functional teams trust the Product Owner as a reliable partner.
  • Delivered solutions achieve intended user and business outcomes.

Position Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in product ownership, business analysis, Agile delivery, software product development, solution delivery, or a related discipline.

  • Experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, requirements, and backlog-ready work.
  • Working knowledge of Agile and Scrum delivery practices.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an experienced Senior SAP FICO Consultant to lead the SAP ECC FI/CO workstream for the integration of a recently acquired subsidiary and the implementation of dual-ledger financial reporting to support both International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP).
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior SAP FICO Consultant to lead the SAP ECC FI/CO workstream for the integration of a recently acquired subsidiary and the implementation of dual-ledger financial reporting to support both International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP).

The successful candidate will act as the SAP FI/CO Project Lead, functional implementation specialist, and business super user, taking ownership of the end-to-end FI/CO delivery lifecycle, including solution design, data migration, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live hypercare.

The role will work closely with the DT (Digital Technology) lead, who is responsible for overall SAP integration and administration, as well as Finance, Controlling, and other relevant business stakeholders, to ensure a controlled, accurate, and successful integration.

Who Are We?

Decision Inc. is a global digital partner that enables businesses to reinvent themselves to realise their full potential.

We deliver agility, resilience, and intelligence to any enterprise, enabling them to adapt quickly and thrive through innovation and opportunity. Our teams have engaged with more than 400 clients globally over the past 15 years, providing them with the expertise to build, operate, and optimise their digital businesses.

We achieve this by leveraging the world's best technology to drive our client's business ambitions forward into tomorrow's reality. These technologies include but are not limited to: Microsoft, SAP, Qlik, Snowflake, Alteryx, Automation Anywhere, and Workday Adaptive Insights.

Our success is ultimately driven by our entrepreneurial culture, industry exposure, and the passion of our people. We have three key cross-functional teams – Functional and Specialist Consulting, Development, and Engineering teams. Based in four global offices, our exceptional consultants focus on delivering value to clients by keeping them at the centre of our service delivery. To find out more about our exciting fast-paced culture visit: Careers at Decision Inc.

What Will You Do?

Key Responsibility:

SAP FI/CO Workstream Leadership

  • Lead the SAP ECC FI/CO workstream for the integration of the acquired subsidiary.
  • Own the FI/CO project plan, deliverables, milestones, risks, dependencies, and issue resolution.
  • Serve as the primary functional point of contact for SAP FI/CO design decisions and implementation activities.
  • Partner closely with the DT lead to align FI/CO requirements with the overall SAP integration architecture, technical delivery, and system administration.
  • Coordinate with Finance, Controlling, and business process owners to ensure operational and reporting requirements are met.

Dual-Ledger Accounting and Multi-GAAP Reporting

  • Design and implement SAP ECC solutions to support parallel accounting and dual-ledger reporting under IFRS and US GAAP.
  • Assess existing financial processes and identify the configuration and process changes required to accommodate multiple accounting standards.
  • Define and validate ledger structures, accounting principles, posting approaches, and reporting requirements, as applicable to the existing SAP ECC landscape.
  • Ensure appropriate treatment of accounting adjustments, intercompany transactions, financial postings, and period-end activities.
  • Support reconciliation between IFRS and US GAAP financial results and ensure the integrity and traceability of financial data.
  • Collaborate with Finance stakeholders to validate accounting treatments and obtain sign-off on the proposed solution.

SAP ECC FI/CO Functional Design and Configuration

  • Lead functional assessments, requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, solution design, and configuration of SAP ECC FI/CO.
  • Provide deep functional expertise across relevant areas, including:
    • Financial Accounting (FI): General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, and Bank Accounting.
    • Controlling (CO): Cost Centres, Internal Orders, Profit Centres, and relevant management accounting processes.
    • Master data governance, chart of accounts alignment, posting controls, document processing, and financial close.
  • Assess the acquired subsidiary's existing SAP and finance processes and define the target-state solution.
  • Ensure consistent financial master data, accounting structures, and business processes across the integrated environment.

Data Migration and Reconciliation

  • Lead FI/CO data migration planning and execution for the acquired subsidiary.
  • Define and validate data mapping, transformation rules, cleansing requirements, and migration controls.
  • Oversee mock conversions, migration rehearsals, validation activities, and final production migration.
  • Reconcile migrated balances and transactions against source-system records and approved financial control totals.
  • Validate master data, opening balances, open items, fixed assets, and other relevant financial data.
  • Investigate discrepancies, identify root causes, and drive corrective actions within agreed project timelines.

Testing, Cutover, and Go-Live

  • Develop and manage the FI/CO testing strategy, including functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing.
  • Prepare test scenarios covering financial postings, ledger-specific accounting, reconciliations, period-end processing, and financial reporting.
  • Coordinate defect management, prioritisation, resolution, retesting, and business acceptance.
  • Lead FI/CO cutover planning, readiness assessments, data validation, reconciliation sign-offs, and go-live activities.
  • Provide hands-on support during deployment and stabilisation to ensure business continuity and financial data integrity.
  • Lead post-go-live hypercare, resolving functional issues and supporting the transition to business-as-usual operations.

Governance, Controls, and Compliance

  • Ensure SAP FI/CO changes comply with SOX requirements, internal financial controls, and established change and release management procedures.
  • Maintain appropriate documentation of solution designs, configuration decisions, migration reconciliations, testing evidence, and approvals.
  • Support audit requirements by ensuring financial transactions and accounting adjustments are traceable and appropriately controlled.
  • Identify project risks and control gaps and implement mitigation measures in collaboration with Finance and DT stakeholders.

Who Do You Need to Be?

  • Minimum 10 years of SAP FI/CO functional consulting experience, with substantial hands-on experience in SAP ECC.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering SAP integrations arising from mergers, acquisitions, or subsidiary integrations.
  • Proven experience implementing or supporting parallel accounting, dual-ledger solutions, and multi-GAAP financial reporting environments, specifically IFRS and US GAAP.
  • Strong SAP ECC FI/CO configuration and functional design expertise.
  • Extensive understanding of financial master data, transaction processing, general ledger postings, period-end close, and financial reconciliation processes.
  • Proven experience managing financial data migration, including mapping, mock conversions, validation, and reconciliation.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead testing, cutover, go-live, and hypercare activities.
  • Experience working in controlled corporate environments with SOX compliance, audit requirements, and formal change and release management processes.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and resolve critical issues under tight project deadlines.

jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an intelligent, articulate, and deeply empathetic Virtual Practice Admin Specialist to run the daily administrative operations and patient engagement for our specialized functional medicine practice.
jobs.description:
We are seeking an intelligent, articulate, and deeply empathetic Virtual Practice Admin Specialist to run the daily administrative operations and patient engagement for our specialized functional medicine practice. We need an independent thinker who can view a schedule like a strategic game of Tetris, master our software systems, and connect with our patients with warmth and respect.

In this pivotal position, you will execute our daily workflow "circle"—handling patient communication via phone calls, emails, and portal messages, navigating Charm EHR, managing lab ordering and uploads, processing payments, and strategically maintaining the calendar. The ideal candidate possesses an accent-neutral, polished phone presence, a strong grasp of functional medicine or naturopathic clinic workflows.

Working Environment & Core Schedule

  • Role Title:Virtual Practice Admin Specialist (Functional Medicine)
  • Practice Specialty: Functional Medicine / Naturopathic Care
  • Status: Full-Time (31 Hours / Week)
  • Core Schedule (PST):
    • Monday – Thursday: 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM PST & 1:30 PM – 4:30 PM PST (7 hrs/day)
    • Friday: 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM PST (4 hrs)
    • Off on major holidays and pre-scheduled practice closure dates.
  • Core Systems & Software:Charm EHR (Required), Fullscript, MailChimp, Canva, LabCorp/Quest Portals

Top 3 Daily Tasks

  1. Strategic Calendar & Patient Management: Proactively manage return-visit intervals and appointment lengths according to billing notes. Look 1–2 weeks ahead to align visit timing with lab turnaround schedules so patients remain continuously supported without missing care milestones.
  2. Patient Communication & "Acknowledge and Steer": Triage incoming phone calls, emails, and portal messages. Deliver warm, personal outreach that acknowledges patient requests while guiding them toward optimal appointment and care options.
  3. Daily Administrative "Circle" Execution: Review voicemails/messages, collect payments, process lab downloads/uploads, manage Fullscript order signals, and update MailChimp lists.

Core Responsibilities

  • Phone & Portal Communication: Answer inbound calls and respond to patient inquiries with an accent-neutral, articulate, and empathetic voice. Handle sensitive conversations regarding scheduling, practice policies, and care plans without sounding transactional.
  • Mastery of "Acknowledge and Steer": Connect deeply with patients by validating their concerns or preferences, explaining available scheduling or clinic options clearly, and guiding them to decisions that serve their health journey while maintaining firm practice boundaries.
  • Precision Scheduling & Lab Tracking:
    • Cross-reference billing/encounter notes to execute exact return-visit intervals (e.g., 6–8 weeks) and visit lengths (e.g., 30 vs. 60 minutes).
    • Monitor lab completion timelines (e.g., accounting for 3-week lab turnaround times). Adjust visit lengths or reschedule appointments proactively if labs will not arrive in time, verifying with the provider when needed.
  • Daily Administrative Scope
    • Triage and clear all voicemails, portal messages, and emails
    • Process billing, collect payments, and follow through on task items in billing notes.
    • Download, upload, and link laboratory results (Quest, LabCorp, specialty labs) in Charm EHR.
    • Monitor Fullscript order notifications as outreach triggers, cross-referencing previous encounter notes to send thoughtful, customized check-in notes.
    • Maintain email lists in MailChimp and assist with basic creative or marketing materials in Canva as needed.
  • Independent Problem Solving: Evaluate daily variables—such as lab delays, partial lab completion, or split visits—by referencing clinic guides and cross-checking work independently before escalating issues to the provider.

Requirements

  • Functional/Naturopathic Medicine Tenure: Minimum 2+ years of direct experience supporting a U.S.-based Functional Medicine or Naturopathic medical practice.
  • EHR Proficiency: Direct, hands-on administrative experience navigating Charm EHR (non-negotiable).
  • Communication & Accent: Fluent, highly articulate spoken English with a neutral accent that allows patients to communicate comfortably over the phone.
  • Autonomous Judgment & Problem-Solving: Ability to evaluate clinical/administrative variables, cross-check details independently, and execute complex schedule adjustments without relying on constant oversight.
  • Remote Workspace Setup: Dedicated, private, HIPAA-compliant home office equipped with a reliable computer (PC/Mac), high-speed internet, backup power/internet solutions, and a noise-canceling headset.

Strong Plus Qualifications

  • Practice Tool Stack Experience: Prior experience using Fullscript, MailChimp, Canva, and major laboratory portals (LabCorp, Quest Diagnostics).
  • Growth Potential: Interest in taking on creative projects, marketing materials, and practice expansion tasks once daily operations are mastered.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You are a warm, sharp, and intuitive practice manager who genuinely cares for patients. You navigate Charm EHR smoothly, handle calendar logistics with foresight, and possess the communication finesse to guide patients thoughtfully through their functional health journey.

Wir sind ein ganzheitlicher Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum. Statt Paid Social nur über die Ad zu betrachten, entwickeln wir starke Neukundenangebote, produzieren die Ads und bauen den Funnel bis zum Kauf. Jedes Angebot rechnen wir auf Deckungsbeitrag durch, damit wir für jeden Kunden das beste Ergebnis erzielen.

Das wirst du tun

  • Kampagnensteuerung: Du planst und steuerst Paid-Social-Kampagnen auf Meta und TikTok, entwickelst skalierbare Strategien für ROAS, POAS und CAC und optimierst sie täglich

  • Skalierung und Profitabilität: Du skalierst Accounts auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets, optimierst auf Profitabilität statt auf Ad Spend und bewertest alle Maßnahmen anhand der Performance-Daten

  • Creative und Testing: Du entwickelst mit dem Creative Team Konzepte wie UGC und Founder Ads nach Direct-Response-Prinzipien, bringst sie auch in Advertorial-Copies und Skripte ein, arbeitest eng mit den Copywritern an der Verkaufspsychologie und testest Hooks, Formate und Narrative laufend

  • Kunden: Du analysierst wöchentlich die Kampagnendaten, führst die Kundenreportings und berätst deine Kunden ganzheitlich, nicht nur auf Kanalebene

  • Weiterentwicklung des Bereichs: Du entwickelst Social Ads über SOPs und Qualitätsmanagement weiter und kannst, wenn du möchtest, perspektivisch Verantwortung für das Team übernehmen und es fachlich führen

Deine Rolle und deine Ressourcen

Du setzt die Richtung für Ads und Funnels und entscheidest, was getestet wird, stehst damit aber nicht allein. Für jeden Schwerpunkt steht dir ein eigener Experte zur Seite: Creative Strategist, Copywriting, Grafik und Video, alle im eigenen Haus.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Paid-Social-Erfahrung als Hauptkanal, mit nachweisbarer Skalierung von E-Commerce-Accounts auf hohe fünf- bis sechsstellige Monatsbudgets, dazu ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung im Marketing- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld, Meta Blueprint ist ein Plus

  • Tiefes Wissen im Meta Business Manager, idealerweise auch im TikTok Ads Manager, und Routine mit Tracking-Tools wie Triple Whale, Tracify oder admetrics

  • Verständnis für Direct-Response-Mechanismen, UGC-Formate und Founder Ads

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Margen, Deckungsbeitrag, Retention, CAC und POAS, mit Praxis darin, aus Daten Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten

  • Praxis in der Kundenführung und in der eigenständigen Betreuung mehrerer Accounts, Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau, fließend Englisch, Eigenverantwortung und die Motivation, perspektivisch ein Team zu führen

Der Rahmen

  • 30 Tage Urlaub
