jobs.title: HEOR Director
jobs.excerpt: Lantheus (NASDAQ: LNTH) is the leading radiopharmaceutical-focused company, delivering life-changing science to enable clinicians to Find, Fight and Follow disease to deliver better patient outcomes.
jobs.description:
Lantheus (NASDAQ: LNTH) is the leading radiopharmaceutical-focused company, delivering life-changing science to enable clinicians to Find, Fight and Follow disease to deliver better patient outcomes. Headquartered in Massachusetts with offices in New Jersey, Canada, Germany, Sweden, Switzerland and United Kingdom, Lantheus has been providing radiopharmaceutical solutions for nearly 70 years.

Today, we’re expanding our portfolio and pipeline across oncology, neurology and cardiology. Through recent acquisitions, along with strategic partnerships across the life sciences ecosystem, we are accelerating our efforts to advance precision medicine and improve patient outcomes around the world.

At Lantheus we are purpose-driven, and every employee plays a vital role in our success. We’re dedicated to cultivating a high-growth, forward-thinking culture where innovation thrives and diverse perspectives drive meaningful progress.

Join us and be part of a company where your contributions make a real impact, because we know someone’s health is in our hands.

Summary of role

Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) Director is responsible for developing outcomes strategies and executing research projects that demonstrate the value of Lantheus portfolio assets throughout the lifecycle. This role will serve as the HEOR representative to Prostate Franchise and its specific brand teams and will partner closely with cross-functional teams, particularly with Commercial Franchise leaders, Medical Affairs, and R&D to develop and execute fit-for-purpose HEOR evidence strategies to support both pipeline and in-line assets. The HEOR Director will ensure that clinical, economic, and real-world evidence are synthesized into clear, compelling value narratives appropriate for both internal cross-functional stakeholders as well as external key stakeholder audiences.

This is a remote position open to applicants authorized to work for any employer within the United States.

Role Description

The successful candidate will have a unique mix of skills including HEOR technical skills, ability to develop and articulate HEOR strategy aligned to product strategy, and strong cross-functional collaboration to drive value for Lantheus stakeholders both internally and externally

Key Responsibilities

  • As the HEOR Prostate Franchise lead, establish and maintain strong partnership with cross-functional teams to ensure key HEOR initiatives are understood and strategically aligned, and represent HEOR at various cross-functional meetings (e.g., Asset Teams, Commercial and Medical Teams)
  • Develop “fit for purpose” HEOR strategies for both inline and pipeline products to ensure the right evidence is available to the right decision-makers at the right time
  • Oversee the design and conduct of HEOR projects and effectively communicate the findings and strategic impact to internal and external audiences. Identify and collaborate with external key thought leaders in Lantheus HEOR projects to develop study design, execute protocols, conduct analysis, interpret results, and/or publish findings
  • Work with Marketing, Market Access, and Medical teams to develop field materials using HEOR data following appropriate FDA guidance (e.g., Payor Guidance for healthcare economic information, HCEI).
  • Manage assigned budget and ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget
  • Provide HEOR thought leadership and support to other franchise and pipeline priorities as business needs evolve

Requirements

  • MS or MPH required; Pharmacoepidemiology, Health Services Research, or related fields
  • At least 7 years of relevant experience (or 10 years with Master’s level degree) conducting HEOR research across different types of methodologies
  • Technical expertise in HEOR with a proven track record of successfully implementing and executing HEOR projects using secondary databases (e.g., claims, EHR, registries), pharmacoeconomic modeling, and systematic literature reviews and synthesis
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills both in verbal and written forms; ability to translate complex HEOR strategy and research to cross-functional teams and continually drive alignment to overall brand strategy
  • Knowledge of the US regulatory, health technology assessment and payer landscapes as well as understanding of other development-related functions as they relate to all phases of drug development
  • Strong project management skills and ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously and proactively identify risks and seek solutions to align with manager and internal stakeholders
  • Self-starter with ability to work independently and organize own work without continuous direct supervision
  • Sense of urgency and uncompromising commitment to quality
  • 25-30% travel required

Core Values:

The ideal candidate will embody Lantheus core values:

  • Let people be their best
  • Respect one another and act as one
  • Learn, adapt, and win
  • Know someone’s health is in our hands
  • Own the solution and make it happen

The pay range for this position is between $172,000 and $287,000 annually.

Actual base pay offered may vary depending on a number of factors such as job-related knowledge, skills and experience. Employees in this position may be eligible for a discretionary performance-based cash incentive. Benefits for this position include a comprehensive health benefits package that includes medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage. Other offerings include life and disability benefits, pre-tax accounts, a 401(k) with company contribution, and a variety of other benefits. In addition, employees are eligible for a generous time off package including paid vacation, holidays, sick days, and paid parental leave. Interested candidates can apply at Lantheus.com. Applications for this position will be accepted until October 18, 2026.

Lantheus is an equal opportunity employer that provides a workplace free from discrimination. All qualified applicants and employees are considered without regard to race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Any applicant requiring an accommodation in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which the applicant has applied should make a request to the Lantheus Talent Acquisition team at .

Lantheus is an E-Verify Employer.

jobs.description:
About Remote Legal

At Remote Legal, our 40-year legacy is built on the expertise of seasoned attorneys and dedicated court reporters who are passionate about transforming the legal process. We're not a flash-in-the-pan tech startup. Instead, we blend time-honored legal experience with innovative technology to redefine how depositions are conducted. Our team spans legal professionals, product owners, engineers, client-success leads, and security specialists, all collaborating seamlessly to ensure every deposition is a success. Join us, and become part of a community where rich experience meets forward-thinking innovation, and where your talents help make the legal journey better for everyone.

Production Specialist - Job Summary

The Production Specialist ensures that all transcripts and work products are complete, accurate, and delivered to clients on time. Responsibilities include performing a final check of each transcript and converting it into the client’s requested file format(s). Reporting to the Production Manager, the Production Specialist partners closely with the Production Manager, Order Review Specialist, and Assignment Specialists to manage workflow and the work product pipeline, ensuring all orders are prepared and delivered within their designated timelines.

Duties/Responsibilities

  • Prepare and deliver the final transcript package within expected timelines, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and compliance with client-specific instructions.
  • Produce and deliver additional client-requested outputs (e.g., alternate file formats and add-ons such as PDF, Word, text, condensed versions, indexes, exhibits/attachments, and certification pages) in accordance with established procedures.
  • Perform standard quality control checks prior to delivery following checklist protocols.
  • Follow established departmental protocols, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and checklists to ensure consistent, compliant, and high-quality deliverables.
  • Ensure deliverables and processes comply with applicable jurisdiction-specific rules.
  • Respond to emails and phone calls from clients and other external users through Remote Legal's CRM, providing exceptional customer service for every client.
  • Escalate issues promptly to the Production Manager or designated lead when required information is missing; instructions conflict, deadlines are at risk, or system errors occur.
  • Communicate and collaborate with other internal teams to coordinate delivery on special requests, such as rush orders.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality of all company, client, and business information accessed or handled in the course of employment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Performance Expectations

Performance in this role will be evaluated based on consistency, accuracy, timeliness, adherence to departmental procedures, and effective communication when issues or workflow risks arise. Specific targets may be established and updated separately as department standards and operational needs evolve.

Key Success Measures
  • Consistently prepares and delivers complete transcript packages within expected timelines, including rush timelines when applicable.
  • Maintains a high level of accuracy and completeness in final deliverables, with minimal post-delivery corrections or revisions required.
  • Follows client-specific instructions, required formats, naming conventions, add-ons, and departmental checklist requirements before delivery.
  • Uses established SOPs and quality control processes to support consistent, compliant, and reliable work product.
  • Escalates missing information, conflicting instructions, deadline risks, or system issues in a timely and appropriate manner.
  • Communicates effectively with internal teams to support workflow reliability and timely resolution of special requests.

Required Skills/Abilities

  • File management and organization.
  • Strong attention to detail and active listening.
  • Professional, client-focused demeanor.
  • Reliability and strong work ethic.
  • Proficiency with common workplace software (e.g., Microsoft Word, Excel, Teams, videoconferencing platforms, Adobe Acrobat, and CRM systems).
  • Comfort with day-to-day technology (e.g., typing, softphone operation, and learning new tools).
  • File type management and conversion.
  • Adaptability to process changes in an evolving legal technology environment.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize client needs by time sensitivity.

Education and Experience

Required
  • High school diploma or equivalent required, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
Preferred
  • Experience with Salesforce
  • Experience with YesLaw
  • Special consideration will be given to candidates who have prior experience in both legal transcription/scoping/proofreading and/or court reporting.

Work Environment

  • This is a primarily remote position performed from a home office or approved remote work location; limited travel may be required periodically for training, meetings, or other business needs.
  • All work is conducted through secure, company-approved technology platforms via computer, phone, and video conferencing platforms.
  • Reliable high-speed internet access and a private, secure workspace are required.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to work for extended periods at a computer workstation in a remote, home-based environment.
  • Ability to perform repetitive motions, including frequent typing, keyboarding, and use of a mouse or other input devices.
  • Ability to view computer screens, read digital documents, and analyze information for prolonged periods.
  • Ability to occasionally adjust or move home office equipment weighing up to 10 pounds.
  • Some evening or weekend work may be required depending on client needs or emergency situations.
  • Ability to travel to surrounding areas or states as needed.

The hardest problem in operations data isn't producing the insight; it's the last mile: the gap between an insight existing and the operation acting on it. That gap closes only when someone inside operations owns the problem and the outcome, not just the analysis. This is that person. You bring the operational fluency, the relationships, and the judgment to turn data and AI capability into changes that show up in how the contact center and back-office run, while a central data and engineering team handles the build. You frame the problem and own whether it lands; they own production. Both names on the work, never thrown over a wall.

How You’ll Contribute:

What you Own

  • The portfolio. Translate the operations strategy into a prioritized set of the problems most worth solving with data, analytics, and AI. Separate a structural opportunity from quick win noise and own the call on what's worth doing.
  • The interpretation. Turn data into a narrative that changes a specific decision. Be the point of insight operations leadership turns to and hold your ground when the data contradicts the plan.
  • The last mile. Drive insight into the real workflow and the moment of decision; you own whether it gets adopted, not just whether it gets delivered.
  • The hand-off. Qualify what's worth putting into the build queue, write the specs that make a hand-off succeed (clear definitions, the rules a shared data dependency must hold, and what “done" means), and judge whether what comes back is right.
  • The AI agenda for ops data. As more of the work involves AI, help shape and qualify where it’s worth applying, and represent operations in how those capabilities get used and governed.
  • Success is measured on outcomes, not output- Decisions are changed and value is realized in the operation.
  • The right problems - the most important data problems are the ones being worked, in priority order.
  • Adoption – insight is embedded in real workflows and trusted by the people making the calls
  • Partnership health – use cases are co-owned with the central data team and land cleanly, with no work thrown over the wall. One operational decision changed for the better is the job working

What We’re Looking For:

  • 8+ years in a data product owner, analytics, or data-SME role, with a track record of data work that changed a business outcome, not just reports delivered.
  • Real fluency with operational data and reporting; you can read a messy data landscape and say what matters.
  • Analytical judgment: you can interrogate data and models critically and interpret them soundly without needing to build them yourself.
  • Comfortable partnering with a central data organization without turf friction; ideally, you’ve sat as the embedded data owner next to a central data team before.
  • Communication and influence: you turn analysis into decisions, earn the trust of senior stakeholders, and can hold a point of view, including an unpopular one.
  • Applied AI fluency: conversant in what AI and agentic capability can and can't do, and where it’s worth applying.
  • Working knowledge of the modern data stack (Snowflake and the tooling around it) so you can speak the builders' language.
  • Intellectual curiosity: you ask why the data looks the way it does, dig into discrepancies, and keep learning.
  • How you work with people matters as much as what you know: empathy and the instinct to read the room; you give feedback as a question and take it without ego; you stay flexible when plans shift, because they always

Preferred:

  • Insurance, financial services, or other regulated-industry background
  • Contact center or operations domain experience (Amazon Connect, Snowflake-based analytics
  • Hands-on experience defining dashboards or data products that teams use

The base pay for this position ranges from $130,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $160,000/year plus bonus in our highest geographic market. The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.

Who we are

Asylum Access works alongside forcibly displaced people as they seek safety, dignity, and the opportunity to shape their own futures.

Through legal empowerment, policy advocacy, and collaboration to improve global systems, we support refugees as they assert their rights—to live in safety, move freely, work legally, and access education. Our work aims to contribute to sustainable, rights-based solutions that respect autonomy and honor refugees’ ability to make decisions about their own lives.

Our work is rooted in partnership. Asylum Access is a global team and a family of locally-led civil society organizations across Asia and Latin America. Our national organizations are primarily staffed and led by people from the communities where we work, and our relationships with clients and partners are grounded in mutual trust, respect, and accountability. Globally, we collaborate with institutions and allies to help strengthen systems and policies so they better uphold the rights of refugees. Through our work on rights and governance, we work to support lasting systemic change that helps shift power toward refugees and their communities.

Our impact

We envision a world where every forcibly displaced person has their dignity and rights respected, their voices lead change, and they have the safety, support, and opportunity to rebuild their lives.

Novi AMS helps associations amplify the impact they create for their members and industries. We started in an association boardroom, and everything we build is designed with our association partners in mind.

About the role

Our Customer Support team is small, close-knit, and evolving in how we work.

We’ve embraced AI and smarter technology to handle more of the repetitive work, giving our team more time to focus on what matters most: solving complex problems, building customer confidence, and creating better experiences.

Support at Novi is about much more than answering questions or closing tickets. We’re technical problem-solvers, educators, advocates, and partners to our customers. We investigate challenging issues, help customers make the most of Novi, develop resources that make learning easier, and turn what we learn from customers into meaningful product improvements.

You’ll join a collaborative, curious team that enjoys turning complicated problems into clear, approachable solutions. We care about getting the answer right, but we care just as much about how we get there and how the customer feels along the way.

Our goal isn’t simply to resolve the issue. It’s to leave customers more confident, capable, and excited about what they can accomplish with Novi.

What you’ll do

  • Own the customer experience. Manage support conversations in Pylon across chat, email, phone, and screen-share sessions, from initial response through resolution, balancing technical accuracy, thoughtful communication, and timely follow-through.

  • Solve challenging problems. Investigate issues involving customer configurations, data relationships, integrations, and unexpected system behavior. Connect the dots across available tools and resources to identify root causes and practical solutions.

  • Work alongside AI. Use AI agents as part of your daily workflow to research, troubleshoot, draft, and analyze. Apply your own judgment to validate results, improve outcomes, and help shape how our team uses AI.

  • Collaborate across teams. Partner with Onboarding, Success, developers, and other internal teams to investigate escalations, communicate findings, advocate for customers, and move issues toward resolution.

  • Teach and empower customers. Help customers understand not just how Novi works, but how to use it effectively. Lead or co-host live Office Hours, webinars, and training sessions that build confidence and encourage adoption.

What you’ll need to be successful

Exceptionalwrittencommunication

You communicate clearly, warmly, and with purpose. You know how to make technical concepts understandable, adapt your approach to different audiences, and provide answers that feel both personal and actionable. Because much of our support happens asynchronously, your writing is one of your most important tools.

Technicalcuriosityandindependenttroubleshooting

You enjoy figuring out how things work and why they sometimes don't. You approach problems methodically, ask thoughtful questions, and use available resources to investigate before escalating. You're comfortable saying "I don't know yet" because you're confident in your ability to find out.

PracticalAIfluency

You have hands-on experience using AI tools to research, solve problems, or improve workflows, with the ability to evaluate their output and recognize when human judgment is needed.

Job Description Summary

As a Global Procurement Category Lead – External Manufacturing, you will lead the strategic sourcing and procurement activities for external manufacturing (CMO) services within the GE Healthcare Pharmaceutical Diagnostics across the globe.

You will be responsible for developing and implementing procurement strategies, managing supplier relationships, and ensuring the efficient and cost-effective procurement of contract manufacturing services to support the company's global operations.

Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Developing, implement, and manage global procurement strategies for all external manufacturing categories, including contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs) for finished goods, sub-assemblies, and specialized components.
  • Leading complex negotiations with key suppliers to secure favorable terms, pricing, and service level agreements (SLAs), driving significant cost reductions and value creation.
  • Conducting market analysis, supplier evaluations, and risk assessments to identify new sourcing opportunities and mitigate supply chain risks.
  • Establishing and maintaining strong, collaborative relationships with external manufacturing partners, fostering innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance and Operations teams to ensure alignment on product requirements, supplier capabilities, and delivery timelines.
  • Driving supplier performance management, including regular business reviews, key performance indicator (KPI) tracking, and corrective action implementation.
  • Identifying and implement best practices in procurement and supplier management to optimize efficiency and effectiveness across the external manufacturing category.
  • Managing the contract lifecycle for external manufacturing agreements, ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Leading and participate in strategic projects aimed at supplier consolidation, dual-sourcing initiatives, and supply chain resiliency improvements.
  • Staying abreast of industry trends, technological advancements, and geopolitical factors impacting the external manufacturing landscape.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
  • Progressive experience in global procurement, strategic sourcing, or supply chain management, specifically focused on external manufacturing or contract manufacturing.
  • Proven track record of success in leading complex negotiations, managing large spend categories, and delivering significant cost savings.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, quality systems (e.g., ISO 13485, GMP), and regulatory requirements within the medical device or healthcare industry.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute global sourcing strategies.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Exceptional communication, influencing, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders at all levels.
  • Proficiency in procurement software (e.g., SAP Ariba) and advanced Excel skills.
  • Ability to travel globally as required.

jobs.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:


The Data Insights (DI) team is seeking a highly motivated Senior Data Scientist to transform trusted enterprise data into AI-enabled decision intelligence that drives faster, smarter, and more effective decisions across Clinical Development and Operations.

Going beyond traditional data science and business intelligence, this role combines advanced analytics, AI, domain expertise, and product thinking to design, develop, and continuously improve scalable decision products, intelligent automation, and AI-powered analytical solutions.

As a hands-on contributor, you will partner with business stakeholders, product managers, data engineers, software engineers, AI scientists, statisticians, and clinical experts to solve complex business challenges, identify high-value opportunities, and translate insights into actionable decisions and measurable outcomes.

Success will be measured not only by analytical excellence, but also by product adoption, business impact, AI-enabled productivity gains, and the ability to turn data into meaningful decisions.

This role offers an opportunity to apply emerging AI technologies to real-world challenges in biotechnology and pharmaceuticals - helping accelerate drug development and ultimately improve patient outcomes.


Major Responsibilities:

Decision Intelligence & Advanced Analytics

· Turn complex business and clinical challenges into actionable insights and AI-enabled decision solutions that improve business performance and support better patient outcomes.

· Design, develop, and enhance analytical products by combining trusted data, advanced analytics, business context, and AI capabilities.

· Apply statistical analysis, predictive modeling, trend analysis, segmentation, and root cause analysis to uncover opportunities, identify risks, and support better decisions.

· Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations and compelling data stories that help stakeholders take action.

AI-Enabled Analytics & Intelligent Automation

· Explore and apply emerging AI technologies, including large language models (LLMs), AI agents, conversational analytics, and workflow automation, to solve real-world business problems.

· Build and experiment with AI-powered analytical experiences, such as conversational BI, automated insights and narratives, intelligent recommendations, and proactive alerts.

· Identify opportunities to simplify repetitive analytical tasks and develop AI-enabled workflows that improve efficiency, scalability, and user experience.

Decision Products & Business Impact

· Contribute to the end-to-end development of decision intelligence products, from understanding user needs and defining requirements to building, launching, and continuously improving solutions.

· Partner with business stakeholders and product managers to identify high-value opportunities and prioritize solutions that deliver meaningful business impact.

· Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs), product adoption, and business outcomes to understand what works and guide continuous improvement.

· Develop reusable analytical tools, frameworks, and capabilities that can be applied across business functions.

AI Quality, Evaluation & Responsible AI

· Evaluate the accuracy, reliability, and business usefulness of AI-enabled analytical solutions using practical testing, evaluation metrics, and user feedback.

· Support the development of AI evaluation approaches, including benchmark datasets, human-in-the-loop (HITL) reviews, and ongoing performance monitoring.

· Apply responsible AI principles and appropriate data quality, privacy, and compliance practices when developing solutions in a regulated environment.

Collaboration, Innovation & Continuous Learning

· Work closely with colleagues across Clinical Development, Statistics, Scientific Programming, Medical, Data Engineering, Product Management, and AI Engineering to solve meaningful business challenges.

· Communicate complex analytical concepts and AI capabilities in clear, practical terms to technical and non-technical audiences.

· Stay curious and experiment with new analytical methods, AI tools, and technologies, bringing promising ideas into practical applications.

· Share knowledge, contribute to technical best practices, and mentor colleagues through collaboration and hands-on problem-solving.

Qualifications:

· Experience: 2+ years of experience in Data Science, Advanced Analytics, Business Intelligence, Product Analytics, Machine Learning, or a related analytical field.

· Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience analyzing complex datasets, developing analytical solutions, and building reusable code or tools.

· Analytical Problem-Solving: Strong analytical thinking and problem-structuring skills, with the ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses, meaningful insights, and actionable recommendations.

· Business Analytics: Experience defining and analyzing KPIs, developing performance metrics, identifying trends, and using data to support business decisions.

· Communication & Collaboration: Ability to communicate complex analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences and collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.

· Ownership & Learning Mindset: A proactive, hands-on approach to problem-solving, with curiosity, adaptability, and enthusiasm for learning and applying emerging AI technologies.

Preferred Qualifications — AI, Data Platforms & Domain Experience

· Generative AI & Intelligent Automation: Experience or hands-on exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), conversational AI, or AI-enabled analytical workflows.

· AI-Native Development: Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or similar tools to accelerate coding, experimentation, and analytical solution development.

· AI-Enabled Analytics: Exposure to Databricks AI/BI Genie or similar conversational analytics and natural-language data exploration platforms.

· AI Product Development: Experience prototyping, developing, or improving AI-enabled analytical applications, decision-support tools, or intelligent automation solutions.

· AI Quality & Evaluation: Familiarity with AI evaluation methods, human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows, model monitoring, or responsible AI practices.

· Modern Data Platforms: Experience with Databricks, Spark, cloud data platforms, or large-scale data processing and exploratory data analysis.

· Statistical & Development Tools: Experience with R, Posit/RStudio Workbench, Git, collaborative development environments, or automated analytical workflows.

· Life Sciences Domain: Experience in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, clinical development, healthcare analytics, or other regulated industries is a plus.

Education Required:

Master’s or PhD preferred in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Information Systems, Life Sciences, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

jobs.excerpt: Who You AreYou are a seasoned solutions architect who thrives in complex, multi-domain environments and enjoys guiding clients towards outcomes that align technology with business strategy.
jobs.description:
Who You Are

You are a seasoned solutions architect who thrives in complex, multi-domain environments and enjoys guiding clients towards outcomes that align technology with business strategy. You bring a consultative mindset to every engagement, asking the right questions and influencing decisions rather than leading with products. You are comfortable owning solution strategy end to end, partnering closely with Account Executives and technical leaders to drive successful deal outcomes. You also take pride in mentoring others, helping elevate technical rigor and consultative skills across the organization.

About The Role

At Myriad360, the Client Solution Architect (CSA) is essentially the technical quarterback for the account and the right-hand technical partner to the Account Executive. The AE owns the overall account relationship and sales strategy; the CSA owns helping turn client needs into a coordinated technical strategy. That aligns directly with how Myriad leadership has described the role internally: CSAs support the sales regions, qualify opportunities, connect technical specialties, and bring the right technical resources into the sales process early.

Must be based in the United States and reside in Austin or Dallas Texas. Travel up to 40% may be required.

Other responsibilities include:

  • Own technical discovery
    The CSA should be able to lead a conversation with the client and understand their current environment, business objectives, technical challenges, upcoming initiatives, budget/timeline considerations, and where Myriad can provide value. The CSA shouldn't simply wait for the customer to tell us which product they want.
  • Uncover and qualify opportunities
    A major part of the job is asking the right questions to turn conversations into opportunities. Internally, Myriad has highlighted CSA success specifically around uncovering client pain points and connecting those problems to solutions across Data Center, Networking, Security, Cloud, and Professional Services.
  • Be broad technically—not necessarily the deepest SME
    The CSA needs enough technical breadth to have credible conversations across Myriad's portfolio. They don't need to personally design every solution.
    • For example, if a conversation moves deeply into security, the CSA should recognize the opportunity, ask enough questions to establish what is needed, and then bring in the appropriate Security SE/SME. The same applies to networking, cloud, services, automation, observability, data center, etc.
  • Orchestrate Myriad resources
    This is one of the most important distinctions of the role. The CSA should know who needs to be involved, when they need to be involved, and why
    • Think:Client → AE + CSA → appropriate SMEs / SEs / Services / PMO / Partners
    • Rather than having the AE independently chase five different engineering teams, the CSA helps coordinate the technical side of the opportunity.
  • Stay engaged through complex opportunities
    The CSA shouldn't disappear once an SME gets involved. For larger or more complicated engagements, internal Myriad guidance specifically calls for CSA participation in client kickoff calls and weekly status meetings.The CSA helps maintain continuity from discovery → architecture → proposal/SOW → implementation handoff.
  • Translate technical conversations into business outcomes
    A strong CSA connects technology back to what the customer actually cares about: reducing risk, improving resiliency, lowering cost, modernizing infrastructure, improving operational efficiency, supporting growth, increasing security, or simplifying management.
    • Instead of "You should buy Pure Storage," the conversation becomes "Here's the operational problem we're solving, here's the architecture we recommend, and here's why."
  • Help the AE grow the account
    The CSA is a technical extension of the sales team. That means understanding the account well enough to recognize adjacent opportunities.
  • Complete ongoing security awareness training and comply with company policies to the requirements section
  • Identify and escalate security risks to the appropriate Executive Leadership Team member and actively contribute to remediation efforts
  • Other duties as assigned

Desired skills and experience:

  • 7–10 years of experience in solution architecture, pre-sales engineering, or technical consulting
  • Demonstrated success in designing and selling comprehensive, multi-domain enterprise solutions
  • Advanced consultative discovery skills with a proven ability to guide client decision-making processes
  • Broad technical proficiency across at least two Myriad360 core practice areas
  • Capability to independently manage complex technical sales cycles
  • Relevant OEM certifications are highly preferred

A Little About Us

Our mission is to challenge and enable our employees to achieve great things.

We live and breathe our core values:

  • We Before Me: We demonstrate empathy through our actions and solicit diverse voices and opinions. We put ourselves in each other’s shoes, readily admit our mistakes, and generously share our time and knowledge.
  • Dare To Be Great: We are big-picture thinkers who focus on solutions to problems. We solicit and offer actionable feedback to others without hesitation. We embrace opportunities to improve ourselves, our teams, and our work. We aim to be the best of the best.
  • Own It: We set clear expectations, communicate proactively, and follow through on our commitments. We take pride in the experiences we create and the outcomes we deliver. We are personally invested in the success of our team and our clients. We iterate to deliver ever better results.

We are consistently listed among Inc & Crain's "Best Places to Work" and we're proud of our accessible & engaged executive team. We believe in cultivating an atmosphere of inclusion and providing an environment that enables every employee to work to the best of their ability.

Some of Our Benefits

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Incentive compensation plans for all employees
  • Company-funded 401k contributions
  • Zero-cost employer-covered health insurance
  • Annual BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) reimbursement up to $500
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Transparent, candid culture with 1:1 coaching, performance reviews, and a consistent feedback loop
  • Quirky, diverse, respectful, high-performing coworkers you’ll want to achieve greatness with!

Pursuant to the NYC Pay Transparency Law, the base salary range in New York City for this position is $250,000 – 300,000, plus opportunities for profit-sharing bonus and/or commission. Compensation in other geographies may vary.

Myriad360 is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
What are we building?
Hard Rock Digital is a fiercely focused team working to become the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a deeply curious team with a passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We're customer-obsessed — we care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight, and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

What’s the position?

As the Senior Analyst - Internal Controls, you will report to the Internal Controls Director and support the execution and continued development of the Internal Controls program. You will perform assigned recurring second-line reviews, including evaluating evidence, testing controls, documenting findings and conclusions, and following up on corrective actions. You will partner with stakeholders across Finance and the broader organization to identify control gaps, recommend practical improvements, and support process owners in addressing identified issues.

In this role, you will apply strong internal controls and risk judgment to evaluate processes and identify control gaps and inefficiencies. You will partner with process owners to recommend practical solutions, including opportunities to use data analytics, AI, and automation to reduce manual effort and strengthen controls.

The ideal candidate will be a self-starter and critical thinker who is comfortable working independently, solving problems, challenging existing processes, and taking ownership of assignments from start to finish.

Key responsibilities:

  • Internal Controls & Second-Line Reviews: Execute risk-based reviews of processes and controls, including walkthroughs, control testing, data analysis, documentation of results, identification of control gaps, and follow-up on identified issues.

  • Risk Identification & Remediation: Identify financial and operational risks within the processes reviewed and work with process owners to develop practical corrective actions. Track agreed actions and deadlines, follow up on progress, and assess whether completed actions address the identified control gaps. Escalate overdue actions or unresolved issues to the Internal Controls Director.

  • Process Improvement, AI & Automation: Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual or duplicative activities, and strengthen controls. Partner with process owners and Financial Systems to evaluate practical improvements, including the use of AI, automation, and data analytics, and support implementation as appropriate.

  • Policies, SOPs & Documentation: Support the development and maintenance of policies, SOPs, process narratives, flowcharts, and internal control documentation to ensure key processes, controls, and responsibilities are clearly and consistently documented.

  • Projects & Change Initiatives: Support Internal Controls projects, transformation initiatives, system implementations, and significant process changes, including evaluating the impact of changes on processes, risks, and controls.

  • Internal & External Audit Coordination: Support the Internal Controls Director in coordinating internal and external audit requests, gathering documentation, arranging walkthroughs with process owners, and tracking outstanding requests. Maintain organized supporting evidence and provide status updates on progress and items requiring attention.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in internal controls, internal audit, external audit, risk assurance, or a related Finance role, including hands-on experience evaluating and testing controls and documenting findings and conclusions.

  • Big 4 or other public accounting experience is a plus.

  • Strong understanding of financial processes, internal controls, risk identification, control testing, and remediation.

  • Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex processes, identify root causes, and develop practical solutions.

  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently, take ownership of assignments, exercise sound judgment, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear internal controls workpapers, support conclusions with evidence, summarize findings and recommendations, and build effective relationships across functions and levels of the organization.

  • Experience performing process walkthroughs, evaluating controls, and identifying opportunities to strengthen processes and improve efficiency.

  • Interest or experience leveraging AI, automation, data analytics, and technology to improve end-to-end business processes.

  • Experience working with ERP systems, financial applications, and other technology-enabled Finance processes.

  • Professional certifications such as CPA, CIA, CISA, or other relevant credentials are preferred but not required.

  • Experience within gaming, fintech, technology, or another highly regulated environment is desirable.

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.

  • Flexible vacation allowance.

  • Remote or Hybrid Flexibility: Enjoy the flexibility of remote work, with opportunities for in-person collaboration at our various headquarter locations.

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand.

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

At Mechanical Orchard, we specialize in safely rewriting the most critical and complex business applications—the software that runs the world as we know it today—so they’re ready to adapt quickly and easily to market challenges and opportunities. We’re applying the same thoughtfulness and rigor in applying AI pragmatically where it helps. We believe in the durable principles behind Agile, and embrace the power of cross-functional teams, collective ownership, test driven development, short feedback loops, and continuous improvement.
We’re bringing joy to beleaguered IT teams everywhere. Together, we’re seeing how applying craft, expertise, and technologies we’re building can fundamentally transform the way companies operate, innovate, and win. Our values are: Do the right thing. Do what works. Be kind.

We need a PM to help us evolve this part of our platform from MVP to enterprise-scale, making it robust enough to succeed in environments at some of the largest and most well-known companies around the world.
    Product Managers at Mechanical Orchard are dedicated to one team and work closely with a team of software engineers, as well as cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing and our forward-deployed engineering teams. They balance long-term strategy with tactical delivery and apply modern product thinking to problems that have resisted innovation for decades. They identify and mitigate risk through effective stakeholder communication, cross-discipline collaboration, and by providing clarity and focus for teams. They apply an entrepreneurial and iterative mindset to the complex and highly technical problems of legacy software modernization.

  • Defining the product vision and strategy for your team

  • Identifying and prioritizing product investments based on user needs and business goals
  • Partnering with engineering and technical leadership to define your team’s roadmap
  • Driving execution of the team's work in close collaboration with technical leadership
  • Representing your product internally and externally with executive stakeholders, technical partners and customers
  • Articulating customer value and benefits of your team’s offering and help position it within an evolving market landscape

  • A Bachelors or Masters degree in a technical field
  • 4+ years in a product management role in a highly technical environment, preferably with strong exposure to data products
  • A strong technical background, ability to grasp technical concepts and establish credibility with engineers
  • Experience building products at enterprise-scale
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills and comfort with presenting to various audiences across seniority levels
  • The ability to navigate ambiguity and deliver high-quality product experiences on tight timelines and in line with our business aspirations
  • A bias for action - you’re not afraid to jump from writing a spec or story to talking to a customer or figuring out a new way to use AI tools to your advantage
People in this role will have a high degree of autonomy and responsibility, with frequent team-to-team communication and interaction with all levels of leadership.
Mechanical Orchard is a remote-first company, with employees working across time zones and locations. This role does not have a requirement for in-office attendance, but is expected to work hours that maximize collaboration with their team (specifics can be discussed during the interview process). There will be travel to company and team meetings, as well as customer visits (1-2 times per quarter, up to ~20% of the time).
Please Note: The appropriate role level and compensation will be determined at the time of offer, following completion of the full interview process, based on an assessment of the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and demonstrated skills.

A note on recruitment fraud

We have been made aware of scams in which people impersonate Mechanical Orchard to send fake job offers, interview invitations, and recruitment messages. Some use the name "Mechanical Orchard Staffing," which is not a company we operate. Some include our real office address to appear legitimate. We are not affiliated with these messages in any way.

Here is how to recognize a real message from us:

  • All communication from our team comes from an @ email address. We do not use any other domain.
  • Every open role is listed on our Careers page. If a role is not posted here, we are not hiring for it.

  • We never ask candidates to make a payment, deposit a check, or purchase equipment at any stage of our process.

If you receive a message using our name and something feels off, do not reply to it and do not click its links. You can forward it to so our team can look into it.

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Global Pharmacovigilance Senior Manager


What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will work with the Therapeutic Safety Teams for safety assessment activities for medical/scientific operations.


Responsibilities:

  • Directs the planning, preparation, writing and review of portions of aggregate reports
  • Organize and direct liaison for activities with affiliates and other internal Amgen partner regarding products
  • Supports and provides oversight to staff with regards to safety in clinical trials to: Review and provide input and support on study protocols, statistical analysis plans and other clinical study-related documents
  • Review of AEs/SAEs from clinical trials as needed
  • Review standard design of tables, figures, and listings for safety data from clinical studies
  • Participate in development of safety-related data collection forms for clinical studies
  • Participate in study team meetings as requested or needed
  • Signal detection, evaluation, and management- Perform data analysis to evaluate safety signals and write up analysis results
  • Documents work as required in the safety information management system
  • Author Safety Assessment Reports and other safety documents and regulatory responses in collaboration with the GSO
  • Search and review adverse event data, literature, and other safety-relevant data for the purpose of signal detection
  • Prepare presentation of the Global Safety Team’s recommendations on safety issues to the cross-functional decision-making body
  • Assist GSO in the development of risk management strategy and activities:

- Provides contents for risk management plans

- Develop or update strategy and content for regional risk management plans

- Assist GSOs to oversee risk minimization activities including tracking of activities as needed.

- Evaluate risk minimization activity

- Prepare response to regulatory inquiries related to risk management plans under the guidance of GSO

- Support activities related to new drug applications and other regulatory filings: Assist GSO in developing a strategy for safety-related regulatory activities, Provide safety contents for filings

- Inspection Readiness

- Undertake activities delegated by the QPPV as detailed in the PV System Master File and maintain a state of inspection readiness

- Be representative and point of contact for Health Authority Inspection and Internal Process Audits within the remit of role and responsibility


What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The pharmacovigilance professional we seek is a leader with these qualifications.


Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree and 2 years of industry pharmacovigilance experience

OR

Master’s degree and 4 years of industry pharmacovigilance experience

OR

Bachelor's degree and 6 years of industry pharmacovigilance experience

OR

Associate’s degree and 10 years of industry pharmacovigilance experience

OR

High school diploma/GED and 12 years of industry pharmacovigilance experience


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s in life science and Master’s and 6 years of related experience
  • 2 years of managerial experience directly managing people or projects and/or mentoring experience
  • Clinical or medical research experience
  • 6 years of experience in the biotech/pharmaceutical setting

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

ISHIR helps bold businesses move into an AI-native world. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Dallas–Fort Worth, Texas, ISHIR is a Digital Product Innovation Studio and AI-Native System Integrator with more than 26 years of turning ideas into measurable business results.

Every ISHIR client relationship starts with a conversation, and you’ll be the one having it. As our Inbound Sales Development Representative, you’ll be the first point of contact for US businesses that reach out through our website looking for help with software, AI, data, or engineering talent.
You’ll respond quickly, lead the introductory call, and qualify each opportunity. Qualified prospects move on to a project discovery session with ISHIR’s senior leadership. Once leadership takes over a deal, you stay the prospect’s point of contact for scheduling, follow-ups, and coordination, so every prospect gets a smooth, professional experience from first inquiry to handoff.
This role suits someone with US market and IT services experience who enjoys real conversations with business buyers, works quickly and accurately, and wants a front-row seat to how AI is changing the way companies build technology.

What You’ll Do
Inbound Lead Response and Qualification

  • Respond to new web leads within [1 business hour] by email and phone.
  • Lead 15–30 minute introductory calls to understand each prospect’s business needs, challenges, project scope, budget, timeline, and decision-makers.
  • Match prospect needs to ISHIR’s services, such as custom software, AI and data solutions, application modernization, or dedicated engineering teams.

Point of Contact After Handoff

CRM and Reporting

  • Log every interaction in HubSpot and keep lead records, stages, and next steps accurate.
  • Report weekly on lead volume, response times, qualification outcomes, meetings booked and held, and lead quality trends.
  • Use approved AI tools for company research, call preparation, email drafts, and meeting notes, and review all output for accuracy before it reaches a prospect.

What We’re Looking For

Nice to Have:

Why Join ISHIR?

About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

  • Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).
  • Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.
  • Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

  • Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.
  • Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.
  • Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).
  • Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.
  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.
  • Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

  • Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.
  • Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

  • Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

  • 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.
  • Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.
  • Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.
  • Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.
  • Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.
  • ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.
  • Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).
  • Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.
  • Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.
  • HubSpot to Salesforce migration.
  • Attribution or CS health score data.
  • Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

  • Lifecycle Hazard Mitigation: Apply Safety in Design (Safety in Design) principles and the Hierarchy of Controls to eliminate or substitute hazards at the design stage, prioritizing physical engineering solutions over administrative controls and personal protective equipment (PPE). Evaluate designs to ensure safety across all lifecycle phases: construction, installation, commissioning, operation, maintenance, and eventual demolition.

  • Hazard Identification & Workshops: Lead or actively participate in systematic, multidisciplinary hazard identification exercises. Facilitate collaborative sessions with architects, engineers, construction managers, maintenance technicians, and operational end-users to ensure designed systems are highly practical and error-proof.

  • Regulatory & Code Verification: Verify that all facility and equipment designs strictly adhere to applicable local, regional, national, and international standards, codes, and legislation, including but not limited to OSHA, NFPA, IBC, and ADA regulations.

  • Performance Monitoring & Analytics: Oversee Safety in Design performance monitoring, capturing project lessons to refine client design guides and safety standards for continuous improvement. Track and analyze injury, illness, and incident data to provide leadership and regional management with actionable guidance on compliance, trends, and improvement strategies.

Coordinate work efforts and impact the quality of both individual output and the wider team's performance, ensuring objectives are met within standardized procedures and established timelines.

  • Risk Transfer & Safety Handover: Provide robust safety oversight during commissioning and handover processes. Ensure that critical risk control information developed during the design phase is successfully documented and transferred to operational end-users and facility maintenance teams.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Senior Travel & Purchasing Coordinator to manage travel-authorization and purchasing-request documentation for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Travel & Purchasing Coordinator to manage travel-authorization and purchasing-request documentation for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This role prepares and performs quality-control reviews of Travel Authorization Requests, Requests to Initiate Purchase, and Consent to Purchase requests while tracking Government concurrence, purchasing activity, travel status, costs, and supporting documentation.

The Senior Travel & Purchasing Coordinator will work closely with program leadership, travelers, task leads, finance, procurement, subcontractors, and Government stakeholders to ensure requests are complete, accurate, timely, and compliant with applicable task order requirements. The successful candidate will maintain organized records, monitor approval workflows, support trip reporting, and provide accurate data for program reports and Task Order Management Portal dashboards.

This position is remote, with preference given to candidates located in or near Chicago.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Senior Travel & Purchasing Coordinator will:

  • Prepare, review, and process Travel Authorization Requests, Requests to Initiate Purchase, and Consent to Purchase requests.
  • Perform quality-control reviews to verify that requests are complete, accurate, adequately supported, and submitted using the required templates.
  • Coordinate request development and correction with travelers, task leads, program leadership, finance, procurement, and subcontractors.
  • Route requests through established approval workflows and track Government review and concurrence.
  • Confirm that travel and purchases do not proceed before required Government concurrence is received.
  • Maintain current logs of submitted, pending, approved, returned, rejected, completed, and closed requests.
  • Monitor request dates, approval status, funding information, costs, vendors, travelers, destinations, and other required data.
  • Support timely submission of travel and purchasing requests to allow adequate Government review.
  • Track whether requested purchases involve commercial or non-commercial products or services.
  • Maintain documentation supporting commerciality determinations, purchase approvals, and associated cost tracking.
  • Track tools and other direct-cost purchases from initial request through approval, acquisition, invoicing, and closeout.
  • Maintain travel records, including traveler name, location, trip duration, purpose, approval authority, estimated cost, actual cost, and destination point of contact.
  • Prepare, coordinate, consolidate, and track trip reports requested by the Government.
  • Reconcile travel and purchasing records with financial reports, invoices, approval documentation, and Task Order Management Portal data.
  • Provide travel and purchasing information for Monthly Status Reports, Program Management Reviews, spend plans, forecasts, and other program-management products.
  • Maintain accurate portal content, dashboards, approval records, supporting documents, and audit-ready files.
  • Identify incomplete documentation, approaching deadlines, delayed approvals, cost discrepancies, and other workflow risks.
  • Communicate request status, required corrections, approval decisions, and outstanding actions to relevant stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain travel and purchasing procedures, checklists, templates, trackers, and document-control standards.
  • Support the transfer of travel and purchasing records, procedures, and open actions during transition-in and transition-out activities.
  • Protect sensitive Government, financial, procurement, travel, and personnel information.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Minimum of 8 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Administration, Logistics, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience coordinating Government travel, purchasing, procurement, logistics, document management, or administrative workflows.
  • Experience preparing or processing Travel Authorization Requests, Requests to Initiate Purchase, Consent to Purchase requests, or comparable approval packages.
  • Experience performing quality-control reviews of travel, purchasing, or financial documentation.
  • Experience supporting Department of Defense, federal civilian, or other Government contracts.
  • Knowledge of Government concurrence and approval requirements for contractor travel and purchases.
  • Familiarity with the Federal Travel Regulation, Joint Travel Regulations, Department of State Standardized Regulations, or comparable Government travel guidance.
  • Experience tracking tools, travel, other direct costs, vendors, approvals, and expenditures by CLIN or contract period.
  • Experience preparing, consolidating, or maintaining formal trip reports.
  • Experience distinguishing and tracking commercial and non-commercial products or services.
  • Experience maintaining audit-ready records, approval histories, and supporting documentation.
  • Experience supporting firm-fixed-price, fixed-price-award-fee, travel, tools, or other direct-cost CLINs.
  • Experience maintaining content in document repositories, program portals, dashboards, or automated approval workflows.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Experience with SharePoint, Power BI, Adobe Acrobat, workflow-management tools, or comparable collaboration platforms.
  • Strong document-control, records-management, and quality-assurance capabilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational, coordination, and time-management skills.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent requests, deadlines, approvals, and follow-up actions.
  • Ability to identify documentation gaps and communicate required corrections clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with travelers, program leadership, finance, procurement, subcontractors, and Government stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining accountability, discretion, and consistent follow-through.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.

Role Overview

The Database Manager leads the team responsible for designing, building, and operating the database architecture that powers Intelerad's medical imaging solutions. This role owns the database strategy and standards behind our PACS, RIS, and enterprise imaging platforms, ensuring the systems that store and serve healthcare data remain scalable, secure, and highly available. Beyond technical direction, this role builds and develops a high-performing team of database engineers and architects — hiring, coaching, and setting clear goals that connect individual growth to team and business outcomes. The Database Manager partners closely with software engineering, DevOps, infrastructure, and product leadership to align database strategy with product roadmaps, and represents database considerations in decisions that affect system reliability and patient care.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, hire, and develop a team of database engineers and architects, setting clear performance and development goals, conducting regular check-ins, and building a team capable of supporting Intelerad's current and future database needs.
  • Own the database architecture strategy and standards for Intelerad's medical imaging platforms, ensuring designs are scalable, secure, and reliable across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid deployment models.
  • Drive operational excellence and reliability for all production database systems, setting performance benchmarks, overseeing capacity planning, and ensuring robust backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity practices are in place.
  • Establish and enforce database security protocols and compliance frameworks, including HIPAA and healthcare interoperability standards such as DICOM, HL7, and FHIR, to protect data integrity and confidentiality across all systems.
  • Partner with software engineering, DevOps, infrastructure, and product leadership to align database strategy with product roadmaps, evaluate and select database technologies, and lead major migrations, upgrades, and modernization initiatives.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in database architecture, design, and administration
  • 2+ years directly managing or leading database engineers or architects.
  • Demonstrated expertise with both relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra) in large-scale, high-availability environments.
  • Proven experience setting database security protocols and compliance frameworks, with direct experience in healthcare data protection and HIPAA compliance.
  • Experience with cloud database platforms and services on AWS, Azure, or GCP, including database migration strategies and hybrid architectures.
  • Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, and develop technical talent, and to communicate database strategy and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

  • Experience with medical imaging systems architecture (PACS, RIS, VNA, or enterprise imaging platforms) and healthcare data standards such as DICOM, HL7, and FHIR.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation, and CI/CD pipelines for database deployments.
  • Professional certification such as AWS Certified Database Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, or Oracle Certified Professional.
  • Experience leading distributed, remote-first teams across time zones, within Agile development environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or equivalent
  • Occasional travel (up to 10%) for team offsites and cross-functional planning sessions.

jobs.description:
Especialista em Capital e Liquidez terá papel-chave na gestão de riscos e do capital regulatório da RecargaPay e na correta parametrização das contas COSIF nos sistemas de risco, garantindo aderência plena às normas prudenciais vigentes. Atuará como responsável técnico pelos reportes regulatórios ao Bacen — com ênfase em DLO, DDR, DLI, DRM, DRL, assegurando a consistência entre dados contábeis, financeiros, gerenciais e regulatórios.


RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Responder tecnicamente pelos reportes regulatórios ao Bacen — elaborar, revisar e transmitir DLO, DDR, DLI, DRM, DRL, assegurando prazos, qualidade e consistência entre dados contábeis, financeiros, gerenciais e regulatórios.
  • Conduzir a parametrização e a manutenção das contas COSIF nos sistemas de risco, garantindo classificação correta das exposições (crédito, mercado e operacional), atribuição adequada dos Fatores de Ponderação de Risco (FPRs) e aderência às Resoluções CMN nº 4.955 e 4.966 e normativos correlatos.
  • Calcular e monitorar os requerimentos de capital — risco de crédito (RWACPAD), mercado (RWAMPAD) e operacional (RWAOPAD) — e acompanhar Índices de Basileia, capital mínimo, buffers e razão de alavancagem, antecipando pressões de capital e de liquidez.
  • Acompanhar mudanças regulatórias do CMN, BCB, CVM e Receita Federal, avaliando impactos em capital, liquidez e processos e conduzindo a implementação das adequações
  • Atuar como referência técnica da área: orientar analistas, disseminar boas práticas de cálculo e reporte e elevar a automação e o controle dos processos regulatórios.

Requirements
