Sur La Table is seeking a Director, Ecommerce and Marketing Analytics to define how data, insight, and AI drive decision-making across the company.

This role serves as the analytical hub of the organization, supporting eCommerce, Marketing, Finance, Retail, Merchandising, Inventory Planning, and Operations. While embedded within the eCommerce organization, the mandate of this role is company-wide: to transform data into insight, insight into implications, and implications into clear recommendations that drive action.

This is not a reporting role. It is a foundational leadership role responsible for establishing analytical standards, governing AI-enabled workflows, ensuring data integrity, and elevating how decisions are made across the business.

This position will report into the Senior Director of Ecommerce.

What you get to do:

    Company-Wide Insight Leadership

    • Serve as the primary analytics leader across eCommerce, Marketing, Finance, Retail, Merchandising, Inventory Planning, and Operations.
    • Own problem definition for analytics - determining which business questions matter and what decisions insights should inform.
    • Move analysis beyond “what happened” to “why it happened,” “how it happened,” and “what we should do next.”
    • Proactively mine data to identify risks, opportunities, inefficiencies, and performance drivers.
    • Influence senior leaders through clear implications and actionable recommendations.

      • Data Integrity, Metrics & Standards

      • Own the integrity, governance, and usability of core commerce, customer, and operational datasets across platforms (eCommerce, POS, CDP, email, data warehouse).
      • Validate insights using business context and commercial logic — not just technical correctness.
      • Define, document, and continuously evolve company-wide KPI frameworks in partnership with Finance and functional leaders.
      • Identify and resolve cross-functional metric misalignment to ensure a single, trusted understanding of performance.
      • Establish standards for data quality, documentation, and analytical transparency across the organization.

        • AI-Enabled Analytics & Insight Workflows

        • Leverage AI as a core component of advanced analytical work, including hypothesis generation, exploratory analysis, pattern detection, insight synthesis, and narrative development.
        • Design, operationalize, and scale repeatable AI-assisted workflows that support recurring company-level decisions (growth, margin optimization, inventory productivity, forecast alignment).
        • Establish validation frameworks to pressure-test AI-generated outputs against source data, historical performance, customer behavior, and commercial logic.
        • Embed AI-enabled insights into planning, forecasting, and executive performance reviews.
        • Promote responsible, explainable, and outcome-driven AI usage across analytics workflows.

          • Web, Customer & Commerce Analytics (Heap)

          • Own web and digital analytics strategy using Heap, including funnel performance, customer journey analysis, and conversion optimization.
          • Ensure tracking integrity and event schema accuracy, including review of structured data formats (e.g., JSON, data layers) in partnership with Product Engineering.
          • Translate behavioral data into commercial implications that influence merchandising, marketing, inventory, and operational decisions.
          • Ensure behavioral insights are aligned with downstream systems and financial realities.

            • Cross-Functional Integration

            • Reconcile demand, margin, inventory, and operational perspectives into cohesive performance narratives.
            • Support planning, forecasting, and performance alignment across Finance, Retail, Merchandising, and Operations.
            • Challenge assumptions and reframe business narratives using data-backed insight.
            • Serve as a connector between commercial strategy and operational execution.

              • Leadership & Enablement

              • Establish analytical standards that prioritize clarity, trust, commercial relevance, and decision impact.
              • Reduce reactive ad hoc work by building scalable, decision-focused reporting and automation frameworks.
              • Design the structure, workflows, and expectations for the analytics function.
              • Hire, mentor, and develop junior analytics talent once foundational systems are established.
              • Champion a modern, insight-driven analytics culture across the company.

What you bring:

    • 8+ years of experience in Analytics, Strategy, or Data Leadership roles.
    • Demonstrated experience leading analytics across multiple business functions.
    • Strong experience in commerce-driven businesses (retail, eCommerce, CPG, marketplace).
    • Comprehensive knowledge of all traffic acquisition channels and their downstream impact on site behavior, using that expertise to develop reliable forecasts that drive strategic decision-making.
    • Advanced SQL and strong analytical modeling capabilities.
    • Demonstrated experience designing and governing AI-enabled analytics workflows.
    • Strong capability to pressure-test AI-generated insights against data, customer behavior, and commercial logic.
    • Hands-on expertise with Heap or similar event-based web analytics platforms.
    • Comfort working with structured data formats (e.g., JSON), event schemas, and data instrumentation.
    • Experience defining KPI frameworks and resolving cross-functional metric misalignment.
    • Proven ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling stories that inform and influence executive decision-making - moving leadership from insight to action with confidence and conviction.
    • Track record of proactive insight generation, not reactive reporting
    • Ability to work standard Eastern Time business hours

What’s in it for you? Joining Sur La Table isn’t just about having a seat at the table—it’s about helping redesign the table entirely. You’ll be challenged, stretched, and supported as you grow faster than you thought possible. In addition to competitive compensation, we offer:

  • Executive Access: Work directly with brand CEOs and senior leadership, solving real business problems and earning mentorship from top operators.
  • AI-First Skill Building: Get hands-on with the most advanced AI tools in the market. From automation to prompt engineering, you’ll build a modern tech stack that sets you apart in any industry.
  • Accelerated Career Path: High performers are quickly entrusted with greater responsibility, new challenges, and leadership opportunities across our portfolio of brands.
  • Competitive benefits: Paid time off policies, 401(k)/RRSP match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts at our portfolio companies.
  • Salary: $130,000 - $145,000 plus bonus

Our interview process:

  • 📞 Step 1: If you align with our vision and meet the qualifications, we’ll reach out to schedule a conversation and introduce Sur La Table.
  • 🧠 Step 2: You’ll complete a short AI or product-building challenge so we can understand how you approach problems and execution.
  • 💬 Step 3: Participate in deep-dive interviews with Sur La Table leadership focused on your experience, product mindset, and operational thinking.
  • 📩 Step 4: Offer. We’ll move fast for the right candidate.

jobs.title: Strategic Alliance Lead - Director
jobs.excerpt: Strategic Alliance Lead (Associate Director or Director) Location(s) – Europe (UK, France or Belgium) or United States (East Coast) Do you get more energy from building something than from maintaining it?
jobs.description:
Strategic Alliance Lead (Associate Director or Director)

Location(s) – Europe (UK, France or Belgium) or United States (East Coast)

Do you get more energy from building something than from maintaining it? Can you sit across the table from a global pharma executive one day and roll your sleeves up with a project team the next? Ready to own a strategically relationship in our business, and write the playbook as you go, rather than inherit someone else's?

At Cerba Research, we are committed to finding the best talent to join our team. We have partnered with Vector Talent to manage the recruitment process for this role. If you're interested in applying, please direct all applications and questions to Vector Talent.

Cerba Research is looking for a Strategic Alliance Lead to take ownership of our most strategic partnerships, preferred-provider relationships, and sole-source alliances across Central and Specialty Laboratory Services. This is a build role: you'll be the executive and operational bridge between Cerba Research and our most important partners; designing the governance, framework, and cross-functional alignment that doesn't fully exist yet, while elevating the team around you into a more strategic way of working.

About Cerba Research

With over 40 years of clinical research expertise, Cerba Research has built a unique offering of services, which includes clinical trial management, specialty lab & biomarkers services and medical devices & diagnostics offerings.

Cerba Research supports clients from research and development all the way through clinical studies and commercialization of therapies. We combine the deep therapeutic understanding and agility of a specialist with the capacity, breadth and global reach of a central lab.

Our extensive experience in central & specialty laboratory services is key to our success, allowing us to provide clients with early scientific insights that optimize protocol development.

We provide key laboratory services to biopharma, government and not-for-profit organizations, supporting clinical trials. Our global accredited laboratory network and connected logistical infrastructure covers the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Australia and Africa.

Our aim is to transform clinical research to deliver the promise of precision and predictive medicine to help people live healthier lives. It's our passion, expertise, and commitment to quality that drive Cerba Research. We want to change the shape of clinical development, and help patients around the world get access to new treatments faster.

Why Join Us?

  • Real Ownership, From Day One – You'll be the named executive lead for a landmark strategic partnership generating multi-million-dollar bookings today, with a clear path to significantly more as the relationship expands.
  • A True Blank Slate – This isn't a role you're inheriting, you're building the governance framework, the relationship model, and the playbook that Cerba Research will use for its most important partnerships going forward.
  • Executive Access – You'll operate at the level of global pharma procurement, vendor management, and clinical leadership.
  • Global Reach, Real Impact – Join a business with 40+ years of clinical research heritage and a global accredited laboratory network spanning the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Australia and Africa.

How You Will Add Value

As Strategic Alliance Lead, you will contribute to:

  • Owning strategic alliance leadership across Cerba Research's highest-value partnerships, sole-source relationships, and preferred-provider agreements
  • Building and running the governance model - QBRs, executive steering committees, escalation pathways; from the ground up
  • Acting as the voice of the customer internally and the voice of Cerba Research externally, translating what each side actually needs into action
  • Driving strategic account growth - new services, new therapeutic areas, and expanded scope, in partnership with Commercial leadership
  • Coaching and elevating the existing portfolio oversight team into a more strategic, alliance-first way of working

Your Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated executive and operational lead for assigned strategic partners, sole-source relationships, and preferred-provider agreements
  • Lead the implementation and onboarding of newly signed strategic partnerships, coordinating cross-functional readiness and governance structures
  • Monitor and ensure compliance with MSA commitments, service levels, and contractual obligations - proactively identifying and closing gaps
  • Define, track, and report KPIs including study award rates, turnaround time, quality indicators, and customer satisfaction, translating them into executive-ready insight
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Procurement, Vendor Management, Clinical Operations, and Executive Leadership
  • Lead resolution of complex operational, quality, or commercial issues affecting strategic partners, coordinating cross-functional teams to close them out
  • Develop and maintain Strategic Alliance Plans covering stakeholder mapping, growth targets, competitive positioning, and expansion opportunities

Travel:

Significant in the early phase of this role, as you build relationships and governance structures in person across our labs and our partners' sites. This typically settles to around 30% once a quarterly governance cadence is established.

Requirements

About You

You've owned a strategic alliance relationship in CRO or central/specialty lab services from the point it was awarded. You're as comfortable in the detail with a project team as you are across the table from a senior procurement or clinical leader. You'd rather build the framework than be handed one.

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Business Administration, Clinical Research, or a related field (advanced degree preferred)
  • Minimum 5 years in strategic account management, alliance management, or business operations within CRO, central laboratory, or a related life sciences environment, lab alliance experience preferred, CRO alliance experience essential
  • Demonstrated experience owning a strategic partnership, preferred-provider agreement, or sole-source relationship end to end
  • Comfortable operating in a heavily matrixed organization. You’re able to influence delivery teams and senior leadership in both directions without formal authority over either
  • Executive-level stakeholder engagement experience, ideally including pharma procurement or vendor management
  • A genuine interest in mentorship and team development, this role includes elevating the capability of the wider team
  • Fluent in English

At Cerba HealthCare, we believe that the diversity of people, backgrounds, and perspectives is an essential asset in fulfilling our mission: to improve the health of everyone, everywhere.

We are committed to providing an inclusive work environment that guarantees equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of age, background, sexual orientation, disability, or any other personal characteristic. All talented individuals are encouraged to apply.

Drive Enterprise Growth. Shape the Future of Healthcare.

About Carenet Health

Carenet Health is a San Antonio based healthcare engagement company, and we are growing fast. For more than 30 years we have helped health plans, health systems and healthcare companies engage their members and patients at every step of their journey. Today we serve more than 500 clients, we have grown 500%, and we have delivered 18 straight years of profitability. We operate multiple nearshore and offshore locations alongside our U.S. teams. Our services span member and patient engagement, contact center and BPO services, clinical support and nurse advice, telehealth, advocacy and navigation, patient access and scheduling, and digital and AI-enabled engagement. With Invene and Orbita now part of Carenet, we also bring healthcare data, AI and conversational technology to the table.

Why This Role Exists

We are growing. 2027 is a step change for Carenet, and we are adding executive sales talent who open doors and keep opening them. We are making a real investment in this role, and in you. In return, we are looking for the best talent in the industry: sellers who build relationships every day. This role owns new logo and expansion growth with national and regional health plans.

The Engine Behind You

You will not be selling alone. Carenet has invested heavily in building a growth engine around every seller.

  • Marketing: A dedicated Marketing team, a refreshed brand and website, targeted campaigns and a calendar of industry events, all built to put you in front of the right buyers.
  • Sales Development: An SDR team that works with you 1:1 and provides outbound calling support on your accounts, with an expectation of at least 2 net new meetings per week on your calendar.
  • Deal support: Sales Engineering, executive sponsorship and a Deal Desk that helps you shape and win large pursuits.

Who We Are Looking For

Your network.

You already know the people who run member experience, operations and quality at health plans. You have relationships with Chief Customer and Member Experience Officers, VPs of Member Services, Stars and Quality leaders, Medicaid and Medicare operations leaders, and procurement at national and regional plans. These are people who see you as a leader and a champion of their business.

Your work ethic.

You have grit. You keep going through a long and demanding sales journey. You are always on offense: you build your own pipeline, you do not wait for leads, and you bring the next idea to the client before they ask. You are intellectually curious. You learn the client's business, the market and our solutions deeply enough to have a different conversation than everyone else in their inbox. You take ownership of your number and your word. You are a trusted advisor.

What You Will Do

  • Build and execute a territory plan across national and regional health plans: Medicare Advantage, Medicaid managed care, Blue plans and commercial.
  • Open new logos and expand within existing health plan clients.
  • Lead large, RFP-driven, multi-year pursuits for member engagement and contact center services (domestic and offshore), Stars and quality outreach, medication adherence, nurse advice and care management support, Medicaid redetermination and digital engagement.
  • Build multi-threaded executive relationships, become the partner a plan calls before an RFP exists, and build account strategies for large clients.
  • Bring deals to Deal Desk early and shape the win strategy with the executive team.
  • Work with your SDR, Marketing and Sales Engineering to build pipeline through targeted campaigns and events.
  • Keep Salesforce and HubSpot current and forecast accurately every week.

How You Will Be Successful

  • Bookings (ACV) against an annual quota, set each year
  • Qualified pipeline created and coverage against your number
  • Executive meetings held with decision makers
  • Forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene in Salesforce and HubSpot
  • Growth of your relationships into multi-threaded account relationships

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of enterprise sales to health plans, with BPO, outsourcing, member engagement, contact center or care management services strongly preferred
  • Experience closing multi-year deals with large, complex buying committees
  • Working knowledge of Medicare Advantage Stars, Medicaid and member experience economics
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • A track record of exceeding quota, with results you can show
  • Comfort running complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, including RFPs
  • Regularly working deals that exceed $5M in annual revenue
  • Fluency with Salesforce, HubSpot and LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or the ability to get there fast

How We Hire

Our process looks at the whole picture: your talent, experience, network, relationships and account leadership. In your second interview, bring a written network plan: 25 named relationships at organizations in this segment, their title, how you know them, and how you would turn each into a first meeting. We will walk through it together. It tells us more than a resume.

Carenet Health is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Professional Services Manager (Implementation Manager)
jobs.excerpt: At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do.
jobs.description:
At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members. Operating with empathy and compassion, First Advantage fosters a global inclusive workforce devoted to the diverse voices that make up our talent and products. Our team members empower each other to be their authentic selves and treat all with respect, integrity, and fairness.

Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.


What You’ll Do:

As Professional Services Manager (Implementation) you will be the connective tissue between customer requirements and successful onboarding to the First Advantage program. Owning implementations from discovery through go-live, you will translate technical and operational requirements into practical business solutions, align customers and internal teams around clear decisions, and accelerate time to revenue without compromising quality or customer outcomes.

This is a customer-facing role for someone who can move confidently between business strategy, solution design, project execution, and stakeholder influence. You will bring structure to ambiguity and guide customers toward scalable best-practice solutions.

This is a 100% remote position; however, the individual must be based in the United States and be available to travel up to 25%.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead implementations across the First Advantage product portfolio, from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, go-live, stabilization, and transition to Customer Success.
  • Turn customer business and technical requirements into scalable, supportable solutions. Lead discovery, explain trade-offs and constraints, and guide customers toward best-practice decisions.
  • Build and govern customer-centric implementation plans with clear scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, decisions, and success measures.
  • Negotiate scope, priorities, timelines, responsibilities, and solution choices with customers and internal stakeholders while maintaining trusted relationships.
  • Orchestrate delivery across Sales, Product, Technology, Operations, Customer Success, ATS/HRIS partners, and customer teams, resolving blockers and holding stakeholders accountable.
  • Lead integration planning, configuration, and pre- and post-production testing. Coding is not required, but technical fluency and strong solution leadership is essential.
  • Drive progress toward go-live and first revenue, proactively managing scope creep, delivery risk, customer dependencies, and recovery plans.
  • Use lessons learned and customer insights to improve implementation playbooks, reusable solutions, and delivery processes, while sharing expertise with peers.

How You’ll Work:

  • High Emotional Intelligence: Listen actively, adapt your communication, and navigate challenging discussions while maintaining trust.
  • Collaborative Influence: Build alignment without relying on authority and move teams toward clear decisions and shared accountability.
  • Business Acumen: Connect implementation choices to customer outcomes, operational impact, revenue, risk, and scalability.
  • Creative Curiosity: Ask incisive questions, explore root causes, and design practical solutions that balance customer needs with delivery standards.
  • Learning Agility: Experiment thoughtfully, learn from setbacks, and adjust quickly without losing momentum.

What Success Looks like:

  • Customers understand the implementation path, decisions required, and responsibilities needed to adopt the agreed solution.
  • Projects are tightly scoped and actively governed, with transparent ownership, risks, decisions, and next steps.
  • Solutions are technically feasible, commercially sound, scalable, and aligned with best practice.
  • Cross-functional teams align early, blockers are resolved quickly, and avoidable rework and customization are reduced.
  • Implementations reach go-live and first revenue with speed, predictability, and customer confidence.

What You Will Need to be Successful:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent professional work experience.
  • 5+ years leading complex implementations, professional services engagements, solution delivery, or comparable customer onboarding programs in B2B SaaS.
  • Demonstrated strength in discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, scope and risk management, project governance, testing, and launch readiness.
  • Proven ability to negotiate, influence through expertise and data, and hold customer and internal stakeholders accountable to commitments.
  • Ability to translate integrations, APIs, data exchange, configuration, and ATS/HRIS concepts into clear business implications and actionable recommendations. Coding experience is not required.
  • Excellent facilitation, executive presence, presentation, written communication, analytical judgment, and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Experience partnering with Sales or pre-sales, Product, Technology, Operations, and Client Success.

Helpful, But Not Required

  • Experience in background screening, HR technology, HCM, identity, compliance technology, or another complex or regulated B2B environment such as financial services or healthcare.
  • Solutions consulting, technical account management, or pre-sales solutioning experience.
  • Experience using AI-enabled tools, automation, or analytics to improve implementation speed, quality, documentation, or decision-making.
  • Formal project or change management certification.

Why First Advantage is Your Next Big Career Move:

First Advantage is going through a technology transformation! We are looking for experts who are excited to work with advanced technologies and provide best-in-class user experience, drive the development and deployment of scalable solutions, and smoothly guide our agile teams and clients through meaningful changes as we continue to expand our impact.
Additional benefits offered to our eligible people include:

  • Ability to work remotely with occasional business travel.
  • Medical, Vision, Dental, and supplementary benefit plans
  • 401k with an employer match, and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
  • Competitive and flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) and 9 paid company holidays
  • Access to tech and growth opportunities, and leaders who want you to succeed!


What Are You Waiting For? Apply Today!
You have learned a little about us today – we want to learn about you! If you think this position and our company are a great fit for your areas of interest and expertise, tell us about you by applying now!

The salary range for this position is approximately $80-90K USD annually. This range reflects our good faith estimate to pay fairly as to what our ideal candidates are likely to expect, and we tailor our offers within the range based on the selected candidate’s experience, industry knowledge, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the interview process.

We have great people here and are looking for more. Come join us!

Alongside partners with organizations to drive digital transformation and build high-performing tech teams.

We're building a real-time facility navigation and asset-tracking platform for industrial and logistics sites - GPS/BLE-based positioning, live forklift and asset overlays, zone/dwell analytics, and a driver-facing mobile app, backed by a distributed-systems (actor-model) backend.


The Role

We're looking for a Fullstack Engineer with a strong frontend focus to join the development of a real-time, data-driven platform.

Most of your work will focus on the React Native driver app, Mapbox GL JS features and the web-based admin portal, while also contributing to C#/.NET backend services when needed.

You'll work on interactive, real-time experiences involving live location, sensor and asset data, with a strong focus on performance and usability.

Responsibilities: Frontend (Primary)

  • Build and maintain the React Native driver app: QR onboarding/consent flows, GPS/BLE data display
  • Implement Mapbox GL JS features: live position overlays, zone/dwell visualization, realtime map layers
  • Own frontend performance and reliability for realtime, sensor-driven UI

Responsibilities: Backend (Secondary)

  • Build and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services in C#/.NET
  • Support GPS/BLE positioning data ingestion pipelines
  • Support telemetry ingestion and zone/dwell analytics processing
  • Work within an actor-model distributed backend (built on Microsoft Orleans) designed by the tech lead

Requirements

  • 2–5 years of professional software development experience;
  • Strong experience with React and/or React Native, with solid knowledge of modern frontend development practices;
  • Experience building interactive, data-driven user interfaces;
  • Experience with Mapbox GL JS or other mapping/geospatial technologies such as Leaflet or Google Maps is highly valued;
  • Experience consuming and integrating REST APIs;
  • Comfortable working with real-time data, such as WebSockets, live updates, telemetry or similar;
  • Some professional experience with C#/.NET, or a strong willingness to work with it as part of a fullstack role;
  • Strong written and spoken English for daily collaboration with a distributed team.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with distributed systems / actor-model concepts (e.g., Orleans, Akka)
  • Experience with BLE positioning or beacon technology
  • Background in industrial, logistics, or IoT/telemetry domains
  • Security-conscious development practices (authentication, PII handling

Benefits

  • Remote work (Vietnam-based)
  • Estimated project duration: 19 weeks
  • Full-time schedule: 8 hours per day, with mandatory availability for at least 4 hours
  • Freelance / Service Agreement
  • Hourly Rate: 12$-16$

jobs.description:
Reports to: Controller

Department: Finance

Location: This is a fully remote U.S.-based position. Candidates must reside and work in one of the following states due to tax and compliance requirements: AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, ID, IL, LA, MD, MO, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OH, TX, VA, WA, WI, or WY.

FLSA Classification: Salaried, Exempt

Compensation: This position has geographic-based pay ranges. Final compensation and geographic tier placement are determined based on the candidate's primary work location, skills, experience, and qualifications.

Tier 1 (Higher Cost Markets): $58,000 - $69,000

Tier 2 (National Markets): $53,000 - $63,000

Tier 3 (Lower Cost Markets): $48,000 - $56,000

About the Company

Paleovalley and Wild Pastures were born from a simple but radical idea: real food can heal — people, animals, and the planet. When Paleovalley co-founders Autumn and Chas Smith saw how industrialized food was affecting human health and the health of the land, they refused to play along. Autumn’s own journey of healing through nutrient-dense foods lit a fire that became Paleovalley. From there, the mission grew roots, sprouted wings, and eventually expanded into Wild Pastures to bring regeneratively raised meats directly to families nationwide.

Today, Paleovalley crafts deeply nourishing snacks and supplements made with organic ingredients and honorable sourcing. Wild Pastures connects small American farmers practicing regenerative agriculture with customers who believe better food is worth fighting for. Every product, every partnership, and every decision is guided by a commitment to real ingredients, regenerative practices, and the belief that health is built from the soil up.

We’re a team of grounded doers, curious thinkers, bold builders, and warm humans who like to laugh while doing meaningful work. We're growing quickly, fueled by purpose and a shared desire to repair the food system one thoughtful choice at a time. If you feel energized by impact, drawn to mission, and ready to join a company rewriting the future of food, we’d love to meet you!

About the Opportunity

As the Accounts Payable Specialist, you’ll help keep our financial operations accurate, timely, and well controlled by owning key activities across the accounts payable cycle for Paleovalley and Wild Pastures. You’ll work across a multi-entity, inventory-driven environment to process vendor bills, resolve discrepancies, maintain clean vendor records, and support accurate month-end reporting in Acumatica.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys bringing order to high-volume details, following issues through to resolution, and partnering closely with Accounting, Supply Chain, Operations and our vendor community.

What You’ll Do

  • Ensure timely and accurate vendor bill processing in Acumatica across multiple entities, ensuring bills are recorded in the correct company and supported by appropriate documentation and approvals.
  • Perform three-way matching of vendor invoices, purchase orders, and receipts, investigating and resolving price, quantity, receiving, and other discrepancies with Supply Chain, Operations, and vendors.
  • Manage AP approval workflows, the Acumatica Incoming Documents module, and shared AP inboxes to ensure vendor invoices, bills, and other AP requests are captured, routed, and addressed within established timelines.
  • Review and code non-PO vendor invoices and other expenses to the appropriate entity, general ledger account, warehouse, and other required dimensions while maintaining accurate supporting documentation.
  • Apply and allocate landed costs, including freight, processing fees, discounts, and taxes, to purchase order receipts using the appropriate allocation method.
  • Reconcile the AP subledger to the general ledger, vendor statements, received-not-invoiced purchase accruals, landed cost clearing accounts, and work-in-progress balances; research and resolve reconciling items.
  • Support month-end close by preparing accurate and timely AP accruals, aging reports, reconciliations, and supporting schedules.
  • Maintain accurate vendor records, including W-9s and banking information, and follow established controls.
  • Build responsive working relationships with vendors and internal partners, addressing invoice, payment, and account questions promptly and following issues through to resolution.
  • Support annual 1099 reporting, sales and use tax reviews, audit requests, and other AP-related compliance activities by maintaining complete, organized, and audit-ready records.
  • Identify practical opportunities to optimize AP processes, controls, and efficiency while maintaining accuracy in a high-volume environment.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 4 - 6 years of hands-on, full-cycle accounts payable experience, ideally in a manufacturing, CPG, distribution, or other inventory-intensive environment.
  • Hands-on experience working in Acumatica or another large ERP environment, including purchase order, inventory, and accounts payable modules.
  • Demonstrated experience with three-way matching, landed cost allocations, and resolving invoice, purchase order, and receiving discrepancies.
  • Strong reconciliation skills, including AP subledger-to-GL, vendor statements, purchase accruals, and related clearing or work-in-progress accounts.
  • Solid understanding of accrual accounting and the accounts payable month-end close process.
  • Intermediate Excel skills, including PivotTables and formulas such as VLOOKUP and SUMIFS.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through, with the ability to manage a high volume of transactions with competing deadlines.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with vendors and cross-functional partners with little direction.

Bonus Points

  • Associate’s degree or higher in Accounting, Business, or a related field.
  • Direct experience with Acumatica, particularly within Purchase Order, Inventory, and Accounts Payable modules.
  • Experience in manufacturing, e-commerce, CPG, or a multi-entity environment with multiple warehouses or locations.
  • Experience supporting 1099 reporting, sales and use tax reviews, or financial audits.

Our Commitment to You

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage with 100% employer-paid dental/vision and a small monthly medical premium for employees; dependents may be added at employee cost
  • Generous Paid time off to support balance and rest
  • Paid sick time for when you need it
  • Six (6) company-paid holidays each year & two (2) floating holidays
  • Paid parental leave after 6 months of service for eligible employees
  • 100% company-paid Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and Life Insurance
  • Referral bonuses up to $1,500 when you refer great people who join our team
  • 401(k) or Roth Plans with up to a 4% company match after one year of service

Working alongside a founder who built and exited Cyprus's largest recruitment agency, you're not just filling a role. You're building equity in your own reputation and earnings, under a brand that gives you the platform to do it faster than starting alone.

Role Overview

The Database Manager leads the team responsible for designing, building, and operating the database architecture that powers Intelerad's medical imaging solutions. This role owns the database strategy and standards behind our PACS, RIS, and enterprise imaging platforms, ensuring the systems that store and serve healthcare data remain scalable, secure, and highly available. Beyond technical direction, this role builds and develops a high-performing team of database engineers and architects — hiring, coaching, and setting clear goals that connect individual growth to team and business outcomes. The Database Manager partners closely with software engineering, DevOps, infrastructure, and product leadership to align database strategy with product roadmaps, and represents database considerations in decisions that affect system reliability and patient care.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, hire, and develop a team of database engineers and architects, setting clear performance and development goals, conducting regular check-ins, and building a team capable of supporting Intelerad's current and future database needs.
  • Own the database architecture strategy and standards for Intelerad's medical imaging platforms, ensuring designs are scalable, secure, and reliable across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid deployment models.
  • Drive operational excellence and reliability for all production database systems, setting performance benchmarks, overseeing capacity planning, and ensuring robust backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity practices are in place.
  • Establish and enforce database security protocols and compliance frameworks, including HIPAA and healthcare interoperability standards such as DICOM, HL7, and FHIR, to protect data integrity and confidentiality across all systems.
  • Partner with software engineering, DevOps, infrastructure, and product leadership to align database strategy with product roadmaps, evaluate and select database technologies, and lead major migrations, upgrades, and modernization initiatives.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in database architecture, design, and administration
  • 2+ years directly managing or leading database engineers or architects.
  • Demonstrated expertise with both relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra) in large-scale, high-availability environments.
  • Proven experience setting database security protocols and compliance frameworks, with direct experience in healthcare data protection and HIPAA compliance.
  • Experience with cloud database platforms and services on AWS, Azure, or GCP, including database migration strategies and hybrid architectures.
  • Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, and develop technical talent, and to communicate database strategy and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

  • Experience with medical imaging systems architecture (PACS, RIS, VNA, or enterprise imaging platforms) and healthcare data standards such as DICOM, HL7, and FHIR.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation, and CI/CD pipelines for database deployments.
  • Professional certification such as AWS Certified Database Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, or Oracle Certified Professional.
  • Experience leading distributed, remote-first teams across time zones, within Agile development environments.

This role is heavily focused on Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization and local SEO, particularly for businesses in the storage, parking, and local-service industries.

This is not a strategy-only account management position. You’ll personally execute optimizations, analyze local search performance, prepare reports, lead monthly client conversations, and identify opportunities to improve both client retention and account growth.

The ideal candidate combines strong digital marketing execution skills with the confidence to independently manage client relationships and communicate performance clearly.

Google Business Profile & Local SEO

  • Strong understanding of local SEO, including:
    • Local ranking factors
    • Citations
    • NAP consistency
    • Review strategies
    • Local search performance
  • Experience independently managing multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Previous client-facing or account management experience
  • Strong ability to select, operate, and evaluate digital marketing tools
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret marketing performance data
  • Ability to quickly learn new software platforms and extract relevant performance information
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Self-directed and comfortable working without micromanagement
  • Professional spoken English suitable for client-facing communication

  • Experience with storage, parking, local-service, or other location-based businesses
  • Experience presenting monthly marketing reports directly to clients
  • Experience identifying upsell and client retention opportunities
  • Experience working with Google Business Profile, local SEO, reporting, and analytics tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Are a hands-on marketer who enjoys executing and optimizing, not just creating strategies
  • Have strong practical knowledge of Google Business Profile and local SEO
  • Can independently manage 15–20 client accounts without losing attention to detail
  • Are comfortable being accountable for marketing performance
  • Can turn performance data into clear, actionable improvements
  • Confidently present results and recommendations directly to clients
  • Proactively identify opportunities instead of waiting for instructions

jobs.description:
About the team

The Agentic AI team at Zillow is transforming the real estate industry by helping millions of people navigate one of the most important decisions of their lives with AI-powered guidance. Our mission is to redefine the home shopping and transaction experience through an always-on assistant that combines deep real estate expertise, grounded data access, advanced reasoning, and the ability to take meaningful action on behalf of customers.

Within the Agentic AI organization, the Applied Reasoning team builds the foundation for agents that perform complex, multi-step reasoning and for proactive, long-running agents that can anticipate customer needs and complete valuable work over time. We focus on advancing agent depth, breadth, proactiveness, and reliability through rigorous experimentation, evaluation, and production innovation

About the role

As a Principal Applied Scientist, you will set the science direction for advanced reasoning and long-running agent systems within the Agentic AI organization. You will partner closely with applied scientists, machine learning engineers, software engineers, product leaders, and senior stakeholders to define the science roadmap for Zillow’s agentic experiences. This is a high-impact principal individual contributor role responsible for translating emerging advances in agentic AI into reliable, differentiated customer experiences.

You will get to

  • Define and drive the end-to-end applied science strategy for advanced reasoning and long-running agent systems, balancing innovation, customer value, reliability, safety, and business priorities.

  • Advance agent capabilities through agent architecture and harness design, context and memory engineering, test time scaling, post-training, evaluation and data flywheel.

  • Establish rigorous evaluation frameworks for agentic systems, including task- and trajectory-level evaluation, long-horizon benchmarks, controlled experiments, ablation studies, and online measurement.

  • Influence senior and executive stakeholders by clearly communicating scientific insights, technical trade-offs, risks, and recommendations that shape Zillow’s Agentic AI product and platform strategy.

  • Stay at the forefront of research in agentic AI and foundation models, selectively introducing advances that materially improve Zillow’s customer experiences.

  • Represent Zillow’s work through publications, conference presentations, open-source contributions, patents, and external technical engagement.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $191,300.00 - $305,700.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $181,800.00 - $290,400.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • You have a PhD degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent experience demonstrating comparable depth of technical expertise, scientific leadership, and impact in production AI systems

  • 8+ years of industry experience building and deploying large-scale, high-impact AI systems.

  • You have deep expertise in large language models and agentic AI, with experience turning research ideas into reliable customer-facing systems.

  • Experience developing AI agents with capabilities such as multi-step reasoning, long-running execution, and proactive behavior.

  • Extensive hands-on experience across agent architecture and harness design, context and memory engineering, test-time scaling, and post-training.

  • Extensive experience establishing rigorous evaluation frameworks for complex AI systems, including benchmark design, experimentation, measurement of reliability and end-to-end impact

  • You have a proven track record of leading complex, ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives from scientific framing and prototyping through production deployment, monitoring, and measurable customer or business impact.

  • Demonstrated technical leadership, mentorship, and ability to influence across science, engineering, product, and executive audiences.

  • You demonstrate science leadership through high-impact production systems, patents, publications, open-source contributions, conference presentations, or equivalent industry impact.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help customers navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the country. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

jobs.title: Director of Accounts
jobs.excerpt: ION is looking for a Director of Accounts to own end-to-end account management and partner success across HIP and Neon Canvas, including retention, expansion, and renewals, service standards, and partner support and onboarding, for a large portfolio of dental and orthodontic practices.
jobs.description:
ION is looking for a Director of Accounts to own end-to-end account management and partner success across HIP and Neon Canvas, including retention, expansion, and renewals, service standards, and partner support and onboarding, for a large portfolio of dental and orthodontic practices. If you've led an account function at scale, unified two brands under one operating model, and want a seat where you set the standard instead of following one, we want to talk to you.

This is not a day-to-day account management role.

The best fit has run an account management or partner success function at a similarly sized agency or recurring-revenue business, owning a book of business across 500+ accounts, and has personally run two brands or service models under one umbrella on a single operating standard. You won't carry a day-to-day book; your Team Leads, Practice Growth Advisors, and Account Managers own those relationships. Your job is to lead the leaders, set the strategy, own the numbers, and keep HIP and Neon Canvas partners staying and growing.

As Director of Accounts, you'll lead the account teams across both brands (Practice Growth Advisors at HIP, Account Managers at Neon Canvas) through a Senior and Team Lead ladder, run both under one consistent standard without blending their distinct service models, and own gross and net revenue retention, expansion and renewals, and the efficiency of the function. You'll also own innovation for the seat, making the account teams leaders in AI adoption for risk detection, call prep, and follow-up. You'll report to the COO and sit on the senior leadership team.

If you're a leader of leaders who thinks in playbooks, margin, and what's next, this role was built for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own gross and net revenue retention across HIP and Neon Canvas, with net revenue retention as your number to move.
  • Own upsell, upgrade, and renewals across both books, including the growth path between the two brands and cross-sell of each brand's services into the other's book.
  • Run both account teams under one pod structure, servicing standards, and scorecards, without blending their distinct service models.
  • Diagnose churn at the portfolio level and fix the pattern behind it, instead of saving accounts one at a time.
  • Own the escalation path and internal response standards, and serve as the final escalation point before the COO or Founders.
  • Own the servicing standard end-to-end (monthly partner calls, logging, follow-up, and outreach to non-responsive partners), backed by playbooks, scorecards, and QA.
  • Lead Partner Support and Onboarding, and shape what it owns so tactical work moves off the account teams, and every new partner starts strong.
  • Own the hiring bar, the ladder (Account Manager, Senior, Team Lead), book-load standards, and variable comp tied to real benchmarks; make the promotion, development, and exit decisions that follow.
  • Partner with Finance on account-team efficiency and how retention connects to margin.
  • Lead AI adoption across the account teams, tools, workflows, and training, and set the standard for safe, high-quality use so speed never comes at the cost of client trust.
  • Run 1:1s with each Team Lead for coaching, scorecard review, and unblocking; personally work the handful of largest or highest-risk partners while the leads own the rest.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • You've run an account management or partner success function at a similar-size agency or recurring-revenue business, owning a book across 500-plus accounts, and can hit the ground running from day one.
  • You've personally led account teams across two brands or service models under one umbrella, and can speak to how you built one standard without flattening them into one model.
  • You're a leader of leaders, not just a leader of account managers; you know how to hire, level, coach, and hold Seniors and Team Leads accountable.
  • You think in retention rates, book loads, and scorecards, and you can spot where a portfolio is at risk before it shows up as churn.
  • You're commercially literate; expansion, renewals, payroll-to-billings, and margin aren't foreign concepts; they're how you already think about the function.
  • You're steady in the room with practice owners, leadership, and sales, and you can handle hard conversations or escalations with confidence.
  • You're genuinely AI-forward; you've put real AI workflows in your team's hands, not just followed the trend.
  • You hold your Team Leads to a high bar because you hold yourself to one.

WHAT YOU NEED TO HAVE

  • 3+ years as a Director of Accounts, Partner Success, or equivalent at an agency or recurring-revenue business of similar size and scope, managing a book across 500+ accounts.
  • Direct experience running account or success teams across two brands or service models under one umbrella on a single operating standard.
  • 6+ years in account management, client success, or partner success, including 3+ years leading people; dental, orthodontic, or healthcare experience is a plus.
  • 2+ years leading other managers (Seniors or Team Leads), not only individual account managers.
  • A portfolio-level retention track record (GRR and NRR) you can put numbers to, including an expansion, upsell, or renewal number you carried and hit.
  • Experience setting performance benchmarks and running variable compensation against them.
  • Proven change-management ability and experience standardizing two teams.
  • Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills.

COMPENSATION

This role includes base pay plus variable compensation.

BENEFITS

  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental Insurance
  • Health Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • PTO eligibility after 90 days of hire (10 vacation days the first year of service, unlimited PTO starting year two, flexible partial days, and sick/ personal days)
  • Remote position (You MUST be located in the US.)

SCHEDULE

  • 8 am- 5 pm CST
  • Monday to Friday

Overview

LMI is seeking an experienced and highly adaptable Program Manager to support a U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) program focused on suicide prevention and mental health. This role will serve as a deputy and trusted right hand to the Sr Program Manager, helping lead day-to-day contract operations, client delivery, workforce management, technical execution, and strategic growth. The successful candidate will independently lead major aspects of the program, maintain visibility across multiple projects and workstreams, supervise and develop staff, anticipate and resolve delivery challenges, and step in for program leadership as needed. This individual must be comfortable operating with limited direction, bringing structure to ambiguity, making sound decisions, and moving seamlessly between client engagement, team leadership, internal operations, technical delivery, and business strategy.

A significant part of this role is people leadership. The Program Manager will supervise employees across different roles, disciplines, levels of seniority, and career stages. The successful candidate must be comfortable setting clear expectations, coaching and developing employees, recognizing strong performance, addressing performance or behavioral concerns directly, and having difficult conversations when necessary.

The ideal candidate brings strong federal program management experience, operational discipline, business acumen, and an interest in helping grow LMI’s VA portfolio. Experience with Agile delivery and familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Power Platform, SharePoint development, and/or program evaluation is strongly preferred. Prior experience supporting VA is a significant advantage.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and intelligence sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Directly supervise and manage employees across different job families, technical disciplines, titles, experience levels, and levels of seniority.

  • Build and sustain trusted relationships with VA stakeholders, program leadership, technical teams, partners, and LMI leadership.
  • Translate evolving client priorities into actionable requirements, work plans, deliverables, and resource needs.
  • Lead and support Agile delivery using Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid approaches, including backlog management, prioritization, dependency management, and continuous improvement.
  • Use Jira, Azure DevOps, SharePoint, dashboards, and related tools to maintain visibility into milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and delivery performance.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams that may include developers, analysts, data scientists, evaluators, technical leads, and subject matter experts.
  • Partner with technical teams delivering solutions involving Microsoft Power Platform, SharePoint, analytics, data, workflow automation, and program evaluation.
  • Proactively identify and resolve operational, technical, staffing, client, and delivery risks before they affect program performance.
  • Develop executive briefings, program reviews, status reports, dashboards, recommendations, and decision materials for VA and LMI leadership.
  • Facilitate client and internal leadership meetings, drive decisions, assign accountability, and ensure follow-through.
  • Ensure program activities and deliverables meet applicable contractual, VA, federal, security, privacy, and LMI requirements.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve program operations, delivery processes, team effectiveness, and client outcomes.
  • Support account strategy and organic growth by identifying emerging client priorities, unmet needs, and opportunities for expanded LMI support.

jobs.description:
Product Designer – UX/UI, Figma & Design Systems | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Product Designer to create intuitive, scalable, and visually polished digital experiences across web and mobile products.

This is not a purely visual UI design role. You’ll own the product design process from user research and UX flows through wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity interfaces, design systems, and developer handoff.

You’ll work closely with product managers and engineers to simplify complex workflows and create experiences that are functional, accessible, user-friendly, and aligned with business goals.

If you combine strong UX thinking, UI craftsmanship, product problem-solving, and Figma expertise, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

User Research & Product Discovery

  • Conduct user interviews, usability tests, surveys, and product research
  • Identify user pain points, friction, and product improvement opportunities
  • Create:
    • Personas
    • Journey maps
    • User flows
    • Interaction models
  • Analyze user behavior using tools such as:
    • Mixpanel
    • Amplitude
    • Hotjar
  • Translate research and product insights into actionable design decisions

UX Design & Product Flows

  • Design intuitive workflows across web and mobile products
  • Translate product requirements into:
    • User flows
    • Wireframes
    • Interactive prototypes
  • Simplify complex interactions into clear, easy-to-use experiences
  • Consider edge cases and different user states throughout the design process
  • Iterate quickly based on user, product, and stakeholder feedback

UI Design & Prototyping

  • Create polished, high-fidelity product interfaces using:
    • Figma
    • Adobe XD
    • Sketch
  • Design responsive experiences across:
    • Desktop
    • Tablet
    • Mobile
  • Establish clear:
    • Visual hierarchy
    • Interaction patterns
    • Micro-interactions
    • Interface consistency
  • Balance visual quality with usability and product functionality

Design Systems & Scalability

  • Build and maintain scalable design systems
  • Develop reusable component libraries
  • Define standards for:
    • Typography
    • Spacing
    • Color
    • Icons
    • Components
    • UI patterns
  • Maintain consistency across products and features
  • Improve collaboration between design and engineering through structured systems

Product & Engineering Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define requirements and priorities
  • Collaborate with engineers throughout implementation
  • Prepare developer-ready:
    • Designs
    • Assets
    • Specifications
    • Documentation
  • Use Figma Dev Mode or similar workflows for efficient handoff
  • Review implementations and help resolve design discrepancies
  • Support QA and refinement through development and release

Testing & Continuous Improvement

  • Conduct usability reviews on existing and newly launched experiences
  • Gather user and stakeholder feedback after releases
  • Run or support A/B tests to validate design decisions
  • Analyze product performance and identify UX improvements
  • Continuously iterate to improve:
    • Usability
    • Engagement
    • Retention
    • Task completion

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional Product Design or UX/UI Design experience
  • Strong proficiency with Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch
  • Experience designing responsive web and mobile products
  • Strong understanding of:
    • UX principles
    • Interaction design
    • Usability
    • Accessibility
    • Responsive design
  • Experience creating:
    • User flows
    • Wireframes
    • Prototypes
    • High-fidelity interfaces
  • Experience collaborating directly with product and engineering teams
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating product thinking and UX problem-solving, not just visual design
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable working remotely during U.S. business hours

Preferred Experience

  • Experience designing:
    • SaaS platforms
    • B2B products
    • Consumer applications
  • Experience building or maintaining design systems and component libraries
  • Familiarity with product analytics and experimentation tools such as:
    • Mixpanel
    • Amplitude
    • Optimizely
    • Hotjar
  • Understanding of HTML/CSS or front-end development fundamentals
  • Experience working in Agile or sprint-based product teams

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Think about user problems before pixels
  • Can simplify complicated workflows into intuitive experiences
  • Balance user needs with business and technical requirements
  • Think in systems, components, and scalable patterns
  • Communicate and defend design decisions clearly
  • Collaborate effectively with product managers and engineers
  • Care about implementation quality, not just the Figma file
  • Move quickly while maintaining attention to detail

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may:

  • Review user behavior and identify UX opportunities
  • Map user journeys and product flows
  • Create wireframes and interactive prototypes
  • Design polished interfaces in Figma
  • Review requirements with Product Managers
  • Collaborate with engineers on implementation details
  • Review builds and resolve UX/UI inconsistencies
  • Maintain reusable components and design systems
  • Conduct usability testing and analyze feedback
  • Iterate on existing features based on user and product data

In short: you turn product ideas and user problems into intuitive, scalable, and polished digital experiences that people can use effortlessly.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Improved usability and task completion rates
  • Increased user engagement and retention
  • Design system consistency and adoption
  • On-time delivery of designs and prototypes
  • Reduced design-related implementation rework
  • Successful product and engineering handoffs
  • Positive user and stakeholder feedback

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Own the complete product design lifecycle
  • Work directly with product and engineering teams
  • Solve meaningful UX and workflow challenges
  • Influence both product experience and design systems
  • Design across web and mobile environments
  • High ownership in a remote product environment
  • Opportunity to grow into:
    • Senior Product Designer
    • Lead Product Designer
    • UX Lead
    • Head of Design

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Portfolio Review + Practical Task
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you:

  • Have a strong Product Design or UX/UI portfolio
  • Enjoy solving complex user and workflow problems
  • Are highly proficient in Figma and modern product design practices
  • Think beyond visual design and understand the complete user experience
  • Enjoy collaborating closely with product and engineering teams

We’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build intuitive, scalable digital products that deliver exceptional user experiences.

Important: Spark Hire Video Interview

As part of our application process, qualified candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

This is your opportunity to introduce yourself and highlight your experience with product design, UX/UI, Figma, user research, prototyping, design systems, and collaborating with product and engineering teams.

Please complete your Spark Hire interview promptly after receiving the invitation. Candidates who do not complete the video interview may not move forward in the hiring process.

Insomniac Games is looking for a Flow Production Tracking Administrator. In this role, the Flow Administrator is responsible for stabilizing and maintaining our Flow Production Tracking (formerly ShotGrid) environment, with an initial focus on the Flow/Jira Bridge that underpins our daily production workflow. Flow is the system of record for production tracking across 300+ users and thousands of tasks per month. The initial scope of the engagement is 6 months, prioritizing bridge stability before expanding to broader Flow improvements.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Stands up a studio-owned instance of the Flow/Jira Bridge so that bridge configuration, deployment, and recovery can be managed internally without dependency on Sony Interactive Entertainment HQ.
  • Stabilizes and maintains the Flow/Jira Bridge as the first priority of the engagement, ensuring data integrity between Flow and Jira.
  • Re-architects the Flow automation and event listener layer for reliability and security, including migration off the current virtual machine to infrastructure that is not prone to unscheduled restarts.
  • Troubleshoots Flow and Jira Bridge issues for internal developers and external development partners; serves as the primary point of escalation when the system is not behaving.
  • Audits and documents the current Flow and Jira Bridge configuration, integration architecture, and recovery procedures.
  • Fixes broken or degraded areas of the Flow pipeline as scoped with pipeline engineering, beginning with the Character workflow.
  • Sets up and improves Flow pipelines for upcoming work, including VFX, and contributes ongoing improvements to the Cinematics pipeline.
  • Administers Flow Production Tracking day-to-day: schema, permissions, page layouts, custom fields, entity relationships, and project setup.
  • Configures and supports vendor (external partner) permissions and workflows, ensuring information access is appropriate to each partnership.
  • Designs and builds Flow dashboards, reports, and custom pages to meet production and leadership reporting needs.
  • Other duties may be assigned.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION

  • Five plus years of professional experience administering Flow Production Tracking, ShotGrid, or Shotgun in a games, VFX, or animation production environment, or an equivalent amount of education and experience.
  • Demonstrated experience operating in a multi-vendor co-development environment.
  • Shipped at least one AAA title with Flow/ShotGrid as the production system of record preferred.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

  • Hands-on experience with the sg-jira-bridge or a comparable Flow/Jira integration, including reading, modifying, and deploying the Python service independently.
  • Working knowledge of the Flow Python API and Toolkit (tk-core, pipeline configurations, YAML configuration).
  • Experience deploying and operating the Flow event listener and automation framework as a reliable service rather than as a fragile script on a virtual machine.
  • Proficiency with Jira administration, including workflows, custom fields, issue types, and the Jira REST API.
  • Comfort designing permissions and information access for mixed internal and external (vendor) user populations.
  • Familiarity with Perforce, Maya, and standard DCC pipelines.
  • Experience with self-hosted services, containerization, or CI/CD for pipeline tooling is a plus.
  • Experience with RV, Deadline, or other render/review tool integrations is a plus.
  • SQL and reporting or BI tool experience is a plus.

OTHER SKILLS

  • Strong written communication; able to produce documentation that others can use to operate and recover the system.
  • Ability to triage between time-sensitive production issues and longer-term platform work without losing momentum on either.
  • High degree of autonomy and accountability; proactively identifies and resolves production issues without requiring close oversight.
  • Collaborative and solutions-oriented mindset with a track record of building strong working relationships with internal teams and external partners.
  • Ability to work effectively across time zones with overseas external development partners.

The Elevator Pitch

If you are an excellent relationship builder, passionate about the customer experience, and inspired to help make the world a safer place, then this is the role for you! Customer success is vital to Evolv’s long-term mission and profitability. Our customers must experience clear, measurable value from their Evolv systems, not only at deployment, but throughout their lifecycle. As a Customer Enablement Manager (CEM), you will build strong relationships with your portfolio of customers and ensure they onboard successfully, adopt consistently, operate confidently and realize meaningful outcomes from their investment.

You will work alongside Senior Customer Enablement Managers and the broader CX team in helping customers onboard successfully, adopt consistently, operate confidently and realize meaningful outcomes from their investment. This role is designed to flex across multiple customer engagements rather than owning a dedicated portfolio.

Your work will help drive customer satisfaction, system utilization, risk mitigation, and ultimately successful subscription renewals.

What are performance outcomes over the first 12 months you will work toward completing?

First 30–90 Days:

  • Become fully competent in Evolv’s products, workflows, and enablement methodology.
    Training includes in-person technical instruction at HQ, online self-study, structured learning paths, and peer shadowing.
  • Learn the CX operating model (onboarding, enablement, training, adoption, renewal readiness, customer health).
  • Build relationships with Sales, Program Management, Support, Technical Sales & Solutions, Channel Operations, and Marketing to understand customer history, deployment context, and value drivers.
  • Begin engaging with customers - supporting onboarding activities, training preparation, and early adoption.

3-6 Months:

  • Contribute to day-to-day customer onboarding, training and value-realization activities across the install base, ensuring progress towards key outcomes.
  • Deliver virtual and onsite training sessions covering system operation, best practices, and Evolv Academy learning paths.
  • Begin developing baseline success plans for your accounts that focus on adoption, learning milestones, and operational excellence.

6-12 Months:

  • Fully own your customer portfolio, including onboarding new customers, building proactive success plans, and driving adoption of learning resources such as Evolv Academy, MyEvolv Portal, and other customer platforms
  • Monitor customer health, usage signals, and feedback to identify risks early and mitigate them through cross-functional collaboration.
  • Lead regular performance reviews and business value conversations using customer dashboards (visitor scans, alerts, detections, engagement metrics).
  • Manage a smooth renewal readiness process by ensuring strong adoption, value realization, and risk reduction.

1+ year:

  • Be recognized as a strategic customer advocate with deep account relationships across accounts.
  • Maintain an internal network of cross-functional partners you can pull in to accelerate customer outcomes.
  • Consistently deliver measurable impact across your accounts—including improved system usage, reduced friction, higher training completion, and strong renewal rates.
  • Operate independently while driving scalable improvements to the broader customer enablement program.

The Work: What type of work will you be doing?

As a Customer Enablement Manager, your regular activities may be modified to suit the needs of your customer portfolio, however, you can expect a variety of the following:

Customer Onboarding & Training

  • Customer onboarding, and go-live activities with Program Management, TSS, and Support.
  • Deliver structured training sessions (onsite and virtual) tailored to each customer’s operational environment.
  • Ensure customers complete the right Evolv Academy learning paths and certifications.

Customer Adoption & Value Realization

  • Build and execute proactive success plans to drive consistent system usage, optimized detection performance, and operator confidence.
  • Continuously guide customers to evolve their workflows, staffing, and operating procedures to maximize value.
  • Promote adoption of MyEvolv, training content, and all customer enablement resources.
  • Conduct scheduled check-ins, performance reviews, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).

Customer Health & Risk Management

  • Work with Red Accounts team to identify at-risk accounts and help develop get-well plans to get them in good health
  • Coordinate with Support, Technical Sales & Solutions and other teams to ensure escalations are handled promptly
  • Maintain clean, accurate CRM documentation including contacts, milestones, health scores and renewal context.

Renewal Readiness & Growth Support

  • Proactively identify and engage the appropriate customer stakeholder’s day-to-day champions, operational owners, and economic buyers to ensure each clearly understands and is realizing the full value of their Evolv investment.
  • Lead the enablement workstream that ensures customers achieve the outcomes required for renewal, including validating success criteria with decision-makers, reinforcing business value with champions, and ensuring all stakeholders are informed, trained, and confident in their ability to operate and sustain their systems.
  • Minimize renewal friction by driving strong adoption, ensuring operators are well trained, and clearly demonstrating ongoing business value.

What is the leadership like for this role? What is the structure and culture of the team?

This role reports to the Senior Scaled Program Manager and sits on our Customer Experience team in the Revenue Organization.

The team is distributed across the United States and is entering an exciting phase of growth, with many new opportunities ahead. Most team members work remotely when they are not traveling to meet with customers. Our collective experience is exceptional spanning technical experts to seasoned business leaders with firsthand customer-facing expertise.

Where is the role located?

Location:

This is a remote position based in the Northeast, ideally near Boston, Providence, Hartford, New York City/Northern New Jersey, or Philadelphia. We are also open to exceptional candidates elsewhere in the Northeast with convenient access to transportation to support regional travel.

Travel:
Travel will vary based on customer engagement, trade shows, and your territory strategy, and may reach 25–30% of your time. Because some customer operations run outside normal business hours, flexibility for occasional nights, weekends, and holidays may be required.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $79,000- $129,000. In addition to base salary, this role offers a competitive target bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. This range reflects our commitment to pay transparency and equity, in alignment with applicable state laws. The successful candidate will contribute directly to the Upstream Asset Valuation team, while also supporting the broader research, content, analysis and insights produced by the Africa team.

Responsibilities and Impact:
