Job Posting Closing Date: Open until Filled

Where do you belong?

Your career is more than just a job, it's part of your life. Whether you’re a clinician, or non-clinical professional, at USACS you'll feel a sense of connection working with clinicians and office staff who share your interests and values. We want you to love coming to work each day because you believe in what you do and the people with whom you work. We care about your success.

USACS also understands that location is important. We offer career opportunities for clinicians and non-clinical support staff from New York to Hawaii and numerous points in between. Our supportive culture, outstanding benefits and competitive compensation package is best in class.

Job Description

The Clinician Scheduler develops and manages schedules for clinicians at hospital locations to ensure that all shifts are fully staffed for the expected patient volume. This role will work with Clinicians, Leadership, and Site Directors to ensure appropriate clinician coverage is in place to treat expected patient volumes. The clinician scheduler contributes to the corporation’s financial performance by managing schedules based on tiered prioritization of clinician utilization, optimizing clinician availability, assisting in requesting and planning future over/under staffing needs, and adjusting as needed on a continual basis.

Location: Remote


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Creates and maintains schedules for multiple hospital locations 45 days before the start of the month.
  • Works independently utilizing scheduling software (Shift Admin) to auto-generate schedules based on customizations, rules, and weightings.
  • Establish relationships with all providers to learn their scheduling preferences and hard stops. Use discretion to determine reasonable asks and when medical director approval/denial is necessary.
  • Analyze requests, identify potential conflict areas, and determine the best solution. If unsuccessful in resolving independently, implement an escalation process.
  • Compile standard reports based on historical data to determine future staffing needs.
  • Collaborate with credentialing, RDO, Directors, or others to ensure available staffing.
  • Work with other clinician schedulers to ensure coordination of the utilization of cross-credentialed providers and days of availability.
  • Work with Scheduling Optimization to schedule traveling physicians and to optimize the site allocation process.
  • Ensure distributed days of availability allow for complete staffing of all shifts. Optimize trades and shift blocking to minimize costs of traveling physician expenses.
  • Responsible for ensuring continuity of care, shift equity, and distribution in accordance with site-specific scheduling policies.
  • Schedule providers based on budgeting tiers. Maximize the use of local FT clinicians based on contractual obligations, followed by PT, STAT, and locums in descending priority.
  • Responsible for coordinating and securing the use of outside clinician resources through locum companies within budgeted goals as necessary to complete the schedule.
  • Modification of shift maps as directed by site leadership
  • Work with the President/VP/Site Directors/RDOs to adjust the schedule for service/budget under immediate deadlines.
  • Work directly with site Physician/APP leaders to ensure optimal schedules before publication.
  • Responsible for ensuring anticipated and last-minute open shifts are filled. Responsible for communicating changes to schedule and providing all necessary parties are aware and in agreement.
  • Responsible for maintaining provider satisfaction regarding the monthly schedule. Ensures expectations are clear of clinician scheduling requirements and expectations from scheduling.
  • Ability to investigate the source of any complaints, analyze the underlying reasons, and resolve them as appropriate.
  • Responsible for setting up Shift Admin and properly applying shifts with pay codes to automate payroll through Workday integration.
  • Utilize strong judgment when deviations from established policies and procedures are necessary to complete schedules based on established deadlines.
  • Communicates terms and premium rates with providers to ensure all shifts are covered after the provider is scheduled to contract max by site leadership.
  • On Call responsibilities may be required.
  • Discretion in the escalation process when clinician leadership support is necessary to create a schedule effectively.
  • Responsible for ensuring all parties agree with scheduling policies and decisions surrounding specific issues, including local and support clinician leadership.
  • Analyze metrics and reporting, able to communicate results

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Ability to navigate and function under a dual and remote reporting structure
  • Strong organization and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to prioritize competing needs
  • Uses critical thinking skills to make decisions
  • Professional presentation/phone savvy
  • High-level analytics skills
  • Ability to effectively perform in a multi-task work environment
  • Ability to maintain patience and composure in difficult situations
  • Ability to identify and communicate emerging issues to management
  • Knowledge and skills in using personal computers (Windows) with a strong emphasis on Microsoft Office
  • Programs- Outlook, Word, Excel and Adobe Acrobat
  • Technical ability with scheduling software

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Experience creating/managing complex fluid schedules
  • Shift admin scheduling experience preferred
  • Previous experience working with clinicians preferred

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • This position requires long periods of sitting and reviewing data on computer monitors
  • Required to have close visual acuity to perform the job

Hourly Rate: $21.59-$39.94

Hourly rate may be determined on several factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills, experience, education, geographical location and requirements stated in job description.

USACS offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our employees.

Benefits may vary based on role, location, and employment status, but generally include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance options

  • Health savings accounts (HSA) and flexible spending accounts (FSA)

  • 401(k) employee and employer contributions

  • Paid time off, including vacation, sick leave, and company holidays

  • Paid parental leave & family support benefits

  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance

  • Life and accidental death & dismemberment (AD&D) insurance

  • Employee assistance programs & wellness resources

Additional compensation may include bonus eligibility, equity, or other incentive programs, depending on the role.

Specific benefit offerings and eligibility will be provided during the hiring process and may be subject to change in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Senior ITSM / Service Management Lead to own the Information Technology Service Management Plan and Service Management System for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Senior ITSM / Service Management Lead to own the Information Technology Service Management Plan and Service Management System for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This role provides enterprise-wide leadership for IT service-management governance, process integration, service-quality improvement, performance management, and ITIL best-practice adoption across all required service-management processes.

The ITSM / Service Management Lead will establish the operating model for consistent service delivery across ENLIST tasks, define process ownership and accountability, oversee SLA/SLO performance, and lead the program’s service-management maturity evolution. The successful candidate will work closely with program leadership, service owners, process owners, technical teams, quality personnel, tool administrators, subcontractors, and Government stakeholders to improve service outcomes and advance the program toward ITIL Version 5 practices.

This position is remote, with preference given to candidates located in or near Chicago.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The ITSM / Service Management Lead will:

  • Own the development, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the program ITSM Plan.
  • Establish and govern the Service Management System, including its policies, processes, controls, roles, responsibilities, technologies, and reporting structure.
  • Lead implementation and integration of the 21 required service-management processes across ENLIST tasks and technical service areas.
  • Define process ownership, accountability, governance forums, escalation paths, interfaces, and decision authorities.
  • Develop and maintain an ITSM maturity roadmap aligned with program priorities, Government requirements, and recognized industry practices.
  • Lead the adoption and practical application of ITIL best practices and the program’s progression toward ITIL Version 5.
  • Promote consistent, efficient, effective, measurable, and well-documented service delivery throughout the service lifecycle.
  • Govern service strategy, service design, service transition, service operations, and continual-improvement activities.
  • Oversee service portfolio, technology strategy, cost control, service catalog, service-level, availability, capacity, continuity, and information-security management.
  • Oversee project transition, service asset and transition, change, release and deployment, knowledge, and service-validation processes.
  • Oversee event, incident, request, problem, and access-management processes.
  • Define, negotiate, document, monitor, and improve Service Level Agreements, Service Level Objectives, key performance indicators, and operating-level expectations.
  • Establish performance thresholds, measurement methods, reporting requirements, service-review procedures, and escalation criteria.
  • Analyze performance trends, service risks, recurring failures, bottlenecks, customer-impacting issues, and systemic process gaps.
  • Lead continual-improvement planning and maintain a prioritized register of improvement initiatives, owners, benefits, milestones, and outcomes.
  • Coordinate corrective and preventive actions and verify that implemented solutions address root causes.
  • Ensure that service-management processes respond effectively to changing mission requirements, priorities, technologies, and user needs.
  • Identify opportunities to improve service quality, reduce disruption, increase automation, strengthen integration, and realize cost efficiencies.
  • Govern development and quality review of Daily System Status Reports and other operational service reports.
  • Ensure timely communication of system performance, upcoming events, outages, maintenance, risks, and activities affecting user access to services.
  • Provide ITSM status, performance metrics, risks, decisions, and improvement updates for Monthly Status Reports, project status meetings, Program Management Reviews, and executive briefings.
  • Coordinate with the Quality Manager and QA personnel on process audits, service-quality reviews, findings, corrective actions, and improvement opportunities.
  • Guide configuration and use of ITSM platforms, workflows, service catalogs, dashboards, knowledge bases, automation, and reporting capabilities.
  • Establish and maintain ITSM policies, standard operating procedures, process maps, knowledge articles, templates, control matrices, and governance records.
  • Facilitate service reviews, governance meetings, process-owner forums, maturity assessments, and continual-improvement workshops.
  • Provide coaching and guidance to service owners, process owners, task leads, and technical teams on ITSM responsibilities and practices.
  • Support transition-in and transition-out activities by ensuring that service-management processes, records, tools, responsibilities, and knowledge are transferred effectively.
  • Protect sensitive Government, program, operational, performance, and personnel information.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Management, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Current ITIL Foundation certification or higher.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading enterprise IT service management, service delivery, IT operations, or Service Management System implementation.
  • Experience owning or leading an ITSM Plan in a complex, multi-team technology environment.
  • Experience supporting Department of Defense, federal civilian, or other large Government IT programs.
  • Experience leading ITIL adoption, process integration, maturity improvement, or service-management transformation.
  • Experience establishing process-owner governance, responsibility matrices, decision authorities, escalation procedures, and cross-process interfaces.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.excerpt: Overview Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development.
jobs.description:
Overview

Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.

Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.

As our Customer Success Manager, you will align our goals with those of our clients, maximizing the value we transfer to each other. You will ensure that we understand our clients’ problems and needs, and that they understand and benefit from our software solutions. You will be in the center of a hexagon, moving information among internal and external expert stakeholders: P21 Business Leaders, Product Managers, and Clinical Data Consultants; and also client-side department heads, IT administrators, and end users.

Your challenge is to optimize the tradeoffs between each stakeholder’s respective goals: help P21 renew and expand contracts, communicate product features and user feedback, and meter out limited consulting resources; and also help clients get their preferred fixes and features on our roadmap, navigate the bureaucracy of version upgrades, and train many thousands of people to use our software well.

As the hub of vendor-client intelligence, you will be relied on to guarantee feature adoption and client business success—which should result in customer satisfaction, retention, and revenue growth, as well as direction for our product development efforts. Note: As the market leader, we have almost all the major clients that exist, and the pressure is real. You’ll be doing about four different jobs.


Responsibilities

Account Manager: Escort clients along their journey with us.

  • Serve as point of contact starting after initial sale and onboarding clients from their first install (implementation) to expanded use and later version upgrades (adoption).
  • Build professional client relationships, facilitating online meetings and offline emails and tickets; follow or create scripts for standard steps in the client journey.
  • Move clients through the admin steps surrounding installs and upgrades in tandem with our Implementation Managers and Technical Operations Teams; provide ongoing support for all clients, and extra care for those who are new and/or at-risk. Note: Some of this extra care involves working beyond or outside of normal hours for clients who have emergencies, operate overseas, or require off-hours system maintenance.

Product Evangelist: Educate clients on our features and their intended use.

  • Study our documentation and experiment in our testing environments to learn our selling points, the differences between versions, and the steps for using each feature.
  • Route clients through our knowledge libraries to circulate our marketing, training, and informational content, generating excitement and preempting FAQs.
  • Represent our Product Managers and Clinical Data Consultants in training users in our intended use cases and supporting their adoption of our advanced features.
  • Lure clients onto the latest version of our software by negotiating for their IT resources and articulating our value propositions. Note: One challenge of your role will be to help clients time their upgrades amidst uncertain or delayed release schedules.

Customer Advocate & Communicator: Move key info between clients and our teams.

  • Research each client extensively, writing your findings in our CRM system and triaging which questions we should ask next; facilitate interviews with existing clients biweekly for premium accounts and annually for small pilot accounts.
  • Document all discussions with pre-call agenda, post-call notes/minutes, and service desk tickets to track bug reports, feature ideas, or information requests; triage the resulting action steps based on client account size, urgency, and scalability of the solution.
  • Escalate or deescalate issues wisely to direct the right staff to the right problem; kindly “remind” your peers to follow through with responses, either in the form of future code changes, temporary workarounds, or the production of more informational content. Note: Another challenge of your role will be to hear clients’ problems and be able to communicate effectively with other P21 teams who are non-client facing to resolve client needs within timelines specified.
  • Find answers independently by troubleshooting bugs, shadowing our experts, and teaching yourself about our products; remain humble and know when to defer to an expert—which will be most of the time at first.

Business Analyst: Ask good questions and listen to clients’ pain points.

  • Drive client satisfaction by tracking both stories and stats that show account health.
  • Gather qualitative intel from direct observation of client environments and anecdotal evidence from routine interviews, e.g., pain points, nuances in their use cases, feedback on features, and opportunities for more training. Note: We often go off script for our largest clients in helping them resolve emergencies, so it will be a challenge to promote long-term health while dealing with the short-term “crisis of the week.”
  • Gather quantitative intel from analysis of client click paths and usage metrics to identify patterns of (mis)use, interpreting these insights in light of their stories.
  • Identify gaps and overlaps between clients’ existing processes and our intended use cases to advise their scope and sequence in adopting our solutions.

Out of Scope: Things we already have covered.

  • Our key value proposition is that we offer the same software to every client and regulatory authority to standardize data handling across industry and government. Note: Unlike some software boutiques, we do not create custom apps or novel interfaces client-by-client. Instead, we focus on educating and informing clients to better use the features they all already share, and we reject the majority of one-off change requests.
  • Because our sales and product lifecycles are constrained upstream of you, and because you will be busy with your core duties, expect to not be tasked with dealing with leads, preparing pricing tables and statements of work, handling contract renewals, gathering product requirements, making design mockups, coordinating engineering R&D, running usability focus groups, determining “best practices” for use of our software, authoring guides and documentation, and producing marketing content. Of course, if you master your duties and want to surprise us with more, be our guest!
  • Some of our clients are national regulatory agencies (FDA in the USA, PMDA in Japan, etc.), and we also offer an opensource product, but you will not interact with these teams. You will work with our commercial P21 Enterprise clients, predominantly Top Pharma, Biotechs, and CROs.

Qualifications

• Must
o Speak fluent Portuguese & have related industry experience

o Curious about our clients and products, cautious with our brand and industry goodwill, conscientious in follow-through
o Willing to learn and serve, flexible in adapting to rapid organizational change, receptive of constructive criticism
o Thick skin in being able to take heat from big clients when things go wrong outside of your control, unafraid to ask (and re-ask) team members to deliver on their promises
o High tolerance for ambiguity, low tolerance for mess; able to create order out of chaos, attend to details, and push quality higher
o Service-obsessed, motivated to go above and beyond to assist clients, able to gain client trust as an advisor while also furthering our company goals
o Smooth and exact in communicating, writing, presenting, and facilitating; able to shift from calming “bedside manner” to exuberant sales-mode to calculating negotiator
o Relentlessly resourceful and discerning in solving problems independently vs. seeking help from others; brave yet humble in working across multi-disciplinary teams where each person is more of an expert than you in their

chosen field

o Candidates who live on the East Coast of the United States

• Plus
o Ability to work in a remote position requiring constant spoken and written communication; skill in exerting influence (even on company founders, owners, and partners) without leverage or managerial authority
o Education or qualifications relating to business, programming, data science, health sciences, medical writing, customer support, project management, or corporate communications
o Experience working for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) vendor, clinical laboratory, pharmaceutical company, or Contract Research Organization (CRO), specifically in functions supporting Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, or CDISC data submissions

Certara bases all employment-related decision on merit, taking into consideration qualifications, skills, achievement, and performance. We treat all applicants and employees without regard to personal characteristics such as race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, nationality, marital status, pregnancy, physical or mental condition, genetic information, military service, or other characteristic protected by law.

Fivestaff is looking for a Digital Marketing Manager who will take full ownership of marketing activities that directly impact the bottom line of our client’s business in the holiday homes space.

This role is for someone who understands that marketing is not about vanity metrics, posting content, or running ads in isolation. The goal is simple and measurable: Impact supply and demand to help grow the business.

This is a high-impact role where you will be kickstarting the marketing function, taking full ownership of growth initiatives and driving measurable results across the business. You will work hands-on across paid ads, retargeting, social media, landing page optimization, marketing automation, and content. You are expected to strategize, execute, test, optimize, and think commercially at all times.

As the first hire in marketing, you will have the creative freedom to drive the company’s marketing efforts as per your expertise and research. This role is excellent for someone who is a self-starter, go-getter and can work independently without much oversight and is comfortable taking decisions when necessary.

Your Key Responsibilities

Performance Marketing & Acquisition

  • Plan, execute, and optimize paid campaigns across Google and Meta and potentially other platforms in future.
  • Manage property owner acquisition campaigns with messaging focused on yield, hands-off management, and revenue transparency
  • Manage guest acquisition campaigns targeting Dubai travelers and short-stay intent audiences
  • Own channel strategy, budgets, targeting, creative testing, and CAC goals
  • Run continuous A/B tests on creatives, hooks, formats, and audience to improve campaign performance
  • Launch new experiments to identify scalable growth angles and high-performing segments
  • Ensure guest and property owner audiences are never mixed

Retargeting, Funnels, & Conversion Optimization

  • Set up and manage pixel-based retargeting for property page visitors, search and booking abandoners
  • Run dynamic ads tied to specific units viewed and availability, pricing, and seasonal demand
  • Reduce funnel drop-offs and recover lost revenue through smart retargeting strategies
  • Optimize funnels to increase booking completion and conversion rates

Landing Pages & Direct Booking Growth

  • Optimize landing pages focused on Property Owners and Travelers to increase conversions.
  • Ensure pages are mobile-first, fast loading, and conversion focused
  • Improve booking CTAs, trust signals, reviews, and pricing clarity
  • Continuously test and improve conversion rate and booking completion

Organic Social Media

  • Manage organic social media accounts across Meta, TikTok, and LinkedIn
  • Stitch up short-form content using existing property assets: property walkthroughs, guest experiences, and location highlights
  • Use tools like Canva and CapCut to produce static and video content
  • Coordinate influencer collaborations with clear deliverables and measurable impact
  • Focus on trust, demand generation, and faster decision

Email Marketing & Marketing Automation

  • Leverage existing guest data to drive repeat bookings and lifetime value
  • Set-up automation flows for post-stay follow-ups, rebooking nudges, seasonal offers, and referral incentives
  • Ensure booking journey is seamless, trackable, and low-friction
  • Use email as compounding ROI channel alongside paid media

Listing Optimization (Airbnb & )

  • Regularly optimize property listings on Airbnb and by improving content structure and language based on research and signals
  • A/B test cover images, titles, and descriptions
  • Optimize listings for click-through rate, conversion rate, and ranking signals
  • Track impact on occupancy, ADR, and booking velocity
  • Make data-driven improvements to increase platform-based revenue

What You’ll Need to Bring

  • 3-6 years of hands-on experience in digital and paid ads marketing
  • Proven experience executing and coordinating campaigns
  • Experience running campaigns for hospitality, travel, real estate, marketplaces, or e-commerce is a strong plus
  • Strong proficiency in Meta Ads, Google Ads, and (preferably) TikTok Ads
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization, funnels and retargeting, email marketing and automation
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze results and iterate quickly
  • Strong execution skills with a commercial, results-focused approach
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Reliable internet connection (25+ Mbps), a dependable laptop, and a focused workspace to get started.

You’ll Thrive Here If You

  • Care more about bookings and revenue than likes and impressions
  • Enjoy testing, optimizing, and owning outcomes
  • Can balance creativity with performance thinking
  • Take accountability for results end-to-end
  • Prefer hands-on execution over high-level planning
  • Love to work in start-ups with the make fast, break fast mindset.

This might not be a good fit for you if you

  • Cannot operate independently
  • Rely on day to day guidance and are not comfortable taking decisions
  • Don't move fast
  • Prefer an org chart that feels comfortable

What We Offer

  • A full-time, long-term remote role with global exposure
  • Excellent starting salary
  • Health coverage
  • Work with top tooling (you get to decide the tools)
  • Hardware, gear, whatever you need to be productive
  • Access to a nearby coworking space of your choice (just in case)

Important Details

Provide technical guidance, coaching and quality assurance oversight to Compliance Officers and Analysts, including review of complex cases and identification of skill development needs.

Support Squad Lead in attending business scrums to assist business divisions to achieve their business goal and tackle inefficiencies by providing compliant solutions in consultation with Squad Lead and management.

Act as delegated backup for the Squad Lead during periods of absence, ensuring continuity of advisory support, case allocation, escalation management, stakeholder engagement and delivery against SLAs.

Support Head of CIBG Compliance to prepare and submit management reports as guided by HO- Compliance from time to time.

Support Head of CIBG Compliance in expediting operational risk activities including but not limited to Operational Risk Register review, RCSA, Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Planning.

Act as the LEAN Champion for CIBG Compliance to ensure alignment of its periodic huddle meetings with the LEAN Sustain requirements.

Ensure timely periodic SOP review to align CIBG Compliance processes and controls with the applicable regulatory or bank policy/standards updates in coordination management for timely approval of the SOP updates.

Role has solid reporting line to Head of CIBG Compliance and dotted reporting line to Squad Lead whose guidance and feedback on performance is key for satisfactory appraisal of this role’s performance.

Key Result Areas

Maintaining proactive relationships with business and operations stakeholders, facilitating timely involvement to ensure compliant solutions to business issues are adequately in order.

Timely review and updating of SOP as well as review of bank-wide compliance policies and standards when assigned by management.

Lead periodic huddle meetings to raise staff awareness and ensure all staff understand their obligations as per bank’s policies and standards and ensure satisfactory Lean Sustain audit outcome.

Timely submission of all reports/MIS on issues relating to CIBG Compliance.

Pro-active coordination with the relevant business or operations stakeholders to ensure timely response to Compliance related queries/investigations of UAE Central Bank/HO/Other regulators as and when assigned by management.

Timely and professional representation of CIBG compliance in any ad hoc projects as directed by CIBG Compliance Management.

Satisfactory internal audit outcome for the role’s responsibilities.

Operating Environment, Framework and Boundaries, Working Relationships

Operates in complex environments that are characterized by diverse local and international regulations; thus requiring multi-jurisdictional knowledge.

Familiarity with banking law and practices as well as MB policies and procedure and systems.

Working relationships with the Business Management, Departmental Managers, and other Officers without compromising on independence and professionalism.

Problem Solving

Analytical thinking is key and educative judgment on regulations and their branch wide implementation in coordination with Squad Lead

Clear understanding of business transactions, initiatives and relationship requirements with close coordination with relationship team without losing focus on risk, regulations and control issues.

Decision Making Authority & Responsibility

Contribute in the development of systems, policies, standards and procedures related to compliance

Maintain and develop proactive relations with business and operations units.

Responsible for administrative and office support as detailed above.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience

Graduate with 5-10 years of corporate banking compliance experience.

Knowledge and understanding of local regulatory rules and legislation, and various international requirements relevant to corporate and investment banking business including but not limited to FATCA/CRS Compliance requirements

Computer literate with proficient command over spoken and written English.

Good presentation skills.

Efficient and logical risk-based approach to problem solving.

Informed decision-making capability.

jobs.description:
CEO Lawyer Personal Injury Law

The CEO Lawyer Personal Injury Law Firm is dedicated to educating, empowering, and fighting for victims. With offices across the country, no matter where you are injured, our team of experienced lawyers is here to help you.

CEO Lawyer is a rapidly growing personal injury law firm headquartered in downtown Atlanta. We are known for our innovative approach to legal services and our commitment to operational excellence.


Our Core Values

We are guided by a strong set of values that shape our culture, decisions, and the way we work together:

  • Trust – We build strong relationships through honesty, transparency, and reliability.
  • Humility – We stay open to learning, feedback, and continuous improvement.
  • Ethics – We act with integrity and always do what’s right.
  • Hunger – We are driven, ambitious, and committed to excellence.
  • Education – We value growth, development, and knowledge-sharing.
  • Accountability – We take ownership of our actions and deliver on our commitments.
  • Respect – We treat everyone with professionalism, empathy, and fairness.
  • Teamwork – We collaborate and support each other to achieve shared success.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Staff Lawyer to join our Personal Injury team remotely.

This position is designed for a tenured legal professional with substantial U.S. Personal Injury experience, including hands-on exposure to both pre-litigation and litigation. This is a senior-level role requiring greater independence, case ownership, legal knowledge, and the ability to manage complex responsibilities with limited supervision.

Depending on experience and department needs, the Senior Staff Lawyer may perform responsibilities similar to those of a Senior Legal Assistant, Personal Injury Case Manager, or Paralegal, while providing direct support to attorneys and managing Personal Injury cases throughout different stages of the case lifecycle.

We are specifically looking for candidates who already understand the Personal Injury process and can contribute their experience from day one.

Key Responsibilities

Personal Injury Case Management

  • Manage and support a caseload of Personal Injury matters with attorney supervision.
  • Assist with cases throughout the pre-litigation and litigation stages.
  • Maintain consistent client communication and provide case status updates.
  • Conduct welcome calls and regular follow-up calls with clients.
  • Monitor client treatment and follow up to help prevent gaps in care.
  • Coordinate treatment with medical providers when necessary.
  • Maintain detailed, accurate, and timely case notes.
  • Keep case files, documents, and case statuses organized and updated in the firm's case management system.
  • Identify case-related issues and escalate them to the supervising attorney when appropriate.

Claims & Insurance

  • Set up insurance claims and follow up on coverage and policy limits.
  • Draft and send Letters of Representation (LORs).
  • Obtain police reports and relevant accident documentation.
  • Request and follow up on declaration pages.
  • Request and follow up on Medical Payments coverage (MedPay).
  • Coordinate with insurance companies, medical providers, and other parties involved in the case.
  • Ensure required client documentation is collected and properly maintained.

Medical Records & Case Documentation

  • Order and follow up on medical records and bills.
  • Obtain balances from medical providers.
  • Request final lien amounts when applicable.
  • Coordinate medical referrals.
  • Maintain clean and organized client files.
  • Review case documentation for completeness and accuracy.
  • Assist with disbursement-related documentation and case resolution processes.

Demand & Pre-Litigation Support

  • Compile medical records, bills, case documentation, and supporting evidence.
  • Draft and prepare demand packages.
  • Assist with Letters of Protection (LOPs).
  • Communicate with providers regarding balances and case-related matters.
  • Support attorneys throughout settlement preparation and case resolution.
  • Assist with cases transitioning from pre-litigation into litigation.

Litigation Support-Depending on experience and assignment, responsibilities may include:

  • Drafting complaints and initial discovery.
  • Drafting discovery responses.
  • Coordinating complaints with process servers and monitoring service of process.
  • Sending and following up on non-party discovery requests.
  • Drafting and filing standard motions and motion responses under attorney supervision.
  • Calendaring litigation deadlines and important case milestones.
  • Calendaring and noticing depositions.
  • Assisting with deposition preparation.
  • Preparing case files and documentation for hearings.
  • Supporting attorneys with trial preparation.
  • Maintaining communication with clients throughout the litigation process.

Attorney & Department Support

  • Provide direct support to attorneys and the assigned legal department.
  • Manage competing deadlines and priorities across an active caseload.
  • Assist with legal and administrative tasks according to department needs.
  • Communicate effectively with attorneys, paralegals, case managers, clients, providers, insurance representatives, and other parties.
  • Take ownership of assigned matters and proactively identify outstanding tasks or next steps.
  • Maintain strong documentation standards throughout every stage of the case.

Required Qualifications

  • Law degree or equivalent legal education.
  • Several years of hands-on Personal Injury experience, preferably 3+ years.
  • Strong experience working with U.S. Personal Injury cases.
  • Experience with pre-litigation is required.
  • Litigation experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing or supporting a significant Personal Injury caseload.
  • Experience communicating directly with clients regarding active cases.
  • Experience with insurance claims, medical records, medical bills, and treatment coordination.
  • Strong understanding of the Personal Injury case lifecycle.
  • Ability to work independently while following attorney direction and established firm procedures.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Filevine experience or experience with comparable legal case management software.
  • English/Spanish bilingual proficiency required.

What We're Looking For

  • This position is best suited for an experienced legal professional who has already developed a strong foundation in Personal Injury and is ready to operate at a higher level of responsibility.

Member Success Manager: Subscription Retention & Growth

Salt Strong | Insiders Club Membership | Full-Time | Florida Preferred

Want to Be the Reason Insiders Never Want to Leave The Largest Saltwater Fishing Club In America?

Most retention jobs are reactive: watch a churn dashboard, send a few win-back emails, hope for the best.

This isn't one of those jobs.

At Salt Strong, our mission is simple: help anglers catch more fish, save time on the water, and create unforgettable memories with the people they love. The Insiders Club is how thousands of anglers live that mission every day, and we need someone to own what happens after they join.

The Role

A subscription retention and customer success role at a direct-to-consumer (DTC) company that owns engagement, satisfaction, and retention for our existing Insiders Club membership base: onboarding, the subscription lifecycle, churn, member sentiment, and surfacing expansion opportunities to Sales.

Sales and Marketing bring members in the door. From there, it's yours. You make every member feel at home in the world's largest private inshore saltwater fishing club, keep their time on the water great, and give them every reason to stay.

What You'll Need

  • 3+ years in customer success, account management, or retention for a subscription or membership business
  • Direct-to-consumer (DTC) experience strongly preferred, ideally in e-commerce, memberships, or subscriptions
  • Hands-on experience with subscription billing systems; Chargebee is a strong plus
  • A track record running onboarding and retention programs
  • Comfort owning strategy and execution; this is a hands-on seat with a small team reporting in
  • Energetic and self-directed; you don't need someone standing over your shoulder

Your Mission

Primary KPI: Member Retention & Engagement. Sales owns the revenue number. You own making sure the members behind it are engaged enough to want more.

What You'll Own

Onboarding & Lifecycle

  • Build onboarding that gets new Insiders to real value immediately, and own onboarding CSAT
  • Own the subscription lifecycle end to end, including dunning and payment retries
  • Own renewal outcomes so members stay through every billing cycle

Churn Management

  • Track member health signals and reach out before a member goes quiet
  • Own the save flow for voluntary cancellations, deploying the right offer at the right moment
  • Own recovery for members lost to failed payments, not lost interest, and know the difference

Engagement & Sentiment

  • Own why engagement is high or low, and fix friction across teams wherever it lives
  • Own CSAT and NPS, and close the loop on what they reveal

Engagement-Driven Expansion

  • Spot members ready for an upgrade and hand them to Sales as warm, qualified leads
  • Partner with Sales to build growth programs like referrals

Exit Experience

  • Make sure the cancellation moment protects future reactivation and referral value

What Success Looks Like

  • Churn trending down, save rate climbing, involuntary churn recovered before it's lost
  • Members who stay longer, spend more, and tell their friends

Bonus Points If You Have

  • HubSpot or similar CRM and lifecycle marketing experience
  • Experience building a customer success function from scratch

Why This Role Is Different

Most retention jobs ask you to manage a churn report. This one asks you to build a membership experience people don't want to leave. If owning that excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

Vesta Software Group acquires, manages, and builds software companies in a variety of vertical markets, enabling them to be clear leaders in their industries. Your work will shape the clinician experience and, through it, the quality and accessibility of care our patients receive. You'll report to the Senior Director of Analytics and work most closely with the central Network product team.

You'll help us anticipate where patient need is heading and make sure we have the right clinicians in the right places to meet it. jobs.excerpt: About PrePassPrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform.
jobs.description:
About PrePass

PrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform. We’re transforming how the transportation industry operates—creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It’s what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day.

That’s why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation.

About the Role

As PrePass scales from a bypass-and-tolling provider into a unified compliance ecosystem, the complexity of delivering software has grown dramatically. Multiple product lines, a newly acquired codebase, state agency integrations, and partner marketplace commitments all compete for engineering capacity. We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to bring structure, predictability, and cross-team alignment to how we plan, execute, and ship.

This is a high-visibility role working at the intersection of engineering, product, and operations — someone who can translate roadmap ambitions into realistic delivery plans and hold the organization accountable to them.

Problems You'll Help Solve

Unpredictable Release Cadence

Teams building across bypass, tolling, compliance, and hardware-integrated systems operate on different rhythms. Create and maintain a structured release calendar to reduce surprises for customers, state agency partners, and internal stakeholders.

Engineering Capacity Visibility

Leadership needs to make portfolio-level tradeoffs (new integrations vs. platform stability vs. compliance features) but lacks a consistent view of what teams are working on and when it will land.

Cross-Team Dependency Management

A delay in any one integration/update/tool can block multiple teams. Dependencies need owners and visibility.

Essential Responsibilities

Program Planning & Delivery

  • Own the integrated delivery roadmap across PrePass product lines: bypass, toll management, safety alerts, INFORM analytics, and compliance.
  • Establish and maintain a dependable release schedule, coordinating across engineering, product, QA, and operations.
  • Drive program kickoffs, milestone reviews, and retrospectives — creating accountability without unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Translate product roadmap priorities into phased, executable plans with clear owners, timelines, and risk mitigations.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Map and track cross-team dependencies, escalating blockers before they become delays.
  • Facilitate alignment between engineering teams.

Visibility & Reporting

  • Build and maintain program dashboards that give engineering leadership and the CTO a real-time view of delivery health.
  • Produce clear, concise executive status updates — surfacing risks, decisions needed, and milestone progress without noise.
  • Define and track engineering KPIs: cycle time, release frequency, defect escape rate, and on-time delivery percentage.

Process Improvement

  • Identify and eliminate recurring sources of delay — unclear requirements, late dependency discovery, incomplete acceptance criteria.
  • Standardize Agile ceremony practices across teams to improve sprint predictability and retrospective follow-through.
  • Lead post-incident reviews on missed releases, building a culture of blameless learning.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of program or project management experience in a software product company.
  • Demonstrated track record of improving release predictability across multiple engineering teams.
  • Strong command of dependency mapping, risk management, and critical path analysis.
  • Ability to communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to non-technical executives and external partners.
  • Proficiency with Agile methodologies and tooling (Jira, Confluence, or equivalent).

Bonus Points For

  • Background in transportation, logistics, fleet technology, or regulatory compliance software.
  • Experience managing integrations with third-party telematics or marketplace platforms.
  • Exposure to post-acquisition integration programs.
  • Familiarity with .NET / Azure cloud environments (enough to understand engineering discussions, not to code).

What Success Looks Like in 90 Days

  • Published and socialized an integrated program calendar covering all active product lines through end of year.
  • Identified the top 3 recurring sources of delivery delay and proposed mitigation plans.
  • Established a weekly program health report used by the CTO and product leadership.

Benefits

How We Will Take Care of You

  • Robust benefit package that includes medical, dental, and vision that start on date of hire.
  • Paid Time Off, to include vacation, sick, holidays, and floating holidays.
  • 401(k) plan with employer match.
  • Company-funded “lifestyle account” upon date of hire for you to apply toward your physical and mental well-being (i.e., ski passes, retreats, gym memberships).
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program.
  • Voluntary benefits, to include but not limited to Legal and Pet Discounts.
  • Employee Assistance Program (available at no cost to you).
  • Company-sponsored and funded “Culture Team” that focuses on the Physical, Mental, and Professional well-being of employees.
  • Community Give-Back initiatives.
  • Culture that focuses on employee development initiatives.

Join Us

At PrePass, our mission drives us.

We invest in relationships. We challenge ourselves to innovate and improve. We win together. Simply put, we live our Core Values.

Ready to help move the transportation industry forward? Join us and let’s drive progress—together.

jobs.description:
About NOCD

NOCD is an award-winning digital health company focused on identifying people with obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and managing them using evidence-based treatment. OCD affects over 181 million people globally and is ranked by the World Health Organization as one of the top 10 most disabling conditions. Despite this, over 90% of people with OCD are unable to access effective care due to stigma and misdiagnosis—earning it the nickname “the secret illness.”

NOCD is solving this global problem by identifying OCD patients online and managing them using our evidence-based OCD treatment platform. Members can access licensed mental health professionals with specialized training in OCD, receive video-based teletherapy, and engage with tech-enabled tools and moderated communities for continuous support.

Today, NOCD manages the largest community of OCD patients in the world—and we’re just getting started.

About the Role

This is a 100% REMOTE OPPORTUNITY!

This is not a traditional, transactional customer service or call center role. As a Member Advocate (Intake Specialist), you are the critical bridge between a person suffering in silence with OCD and the life-changing evidence-based Exposure and Response Prevention (ERP) therapy they desperately need.

When a potential member calls NOCD, they aren't just looking to schedule an appointment—they are often sharing their deepest anxieties, fears, and vulnerabilities with you. Your job is to sit in empathy with them, deeply listen to their experience, and build instant trust. At the same time, you are an advocate who must confidently navigate their hesitations, handle complex objections, and guide them to make a life-changing commitment: scheduling their first therapy session before the call ends.

This role requires a rare combination of exceptional emotional intelligence and a goal-oriented, consultative sales mindset. You will be held to clear key performance indicators (KPIs) centered on enrollment conversion rates, because every conversion represents a life saved from OCD.

What You’ll Do (Responsibilities):

  • Conduct Elevated Consultative Intake Conversations: Make outbound calls to individuals seeking help, guiding them from a place of vulnerability to a place of action.
  • Empathic Deep Listening & Value Messaging: Listen to highly sensitive accounts of OCD symptoms with an empathetic ear, and clearly articulate how NOCD’s specialized ERP therapy can help them regain control of their lives.
  • Navigate Complex Objections: Confidently address common barriers to care (e.g., financial concerns, scheduling hesitations, fear of starting therapy) using advanced objection-handling techniques to keep the member moving forward.
  • Drive Enrollment Conversions: Own the entire initial relationship with the goal of connecting the member to care and scheduling their first session by the end of the initial contact.
  • Implement Feedback: Openly receive and rapidly implement regular coaching from leadership regarding call quality, metric tracking, and conversational delivery.

Who Thrives Here (Preferred Backgrounds): We find that the professionals who excel in this role don't come from high-volume, resolution-focued customer service. Instead, they usually have a unique blend of human-centric interviewing and goal-driven conversion experience. You will be a strong fit if you have a background in:

  • Intake / Investigative Interviewing: Experience handling highly sensitive client stories while needing to qualify and "close" the client for the firm.
  • Crisis Hotlines / Peer Support Specialist / Treatment Coordinator: Deeply trained in active listening, de-escalation, and holding space for raw human emotion, combined with a desire to work in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
  • Consultative Inside Sales / Admissions: Experience in high-consideration sales (like higher education admissions or medical counseling) where your success relies entirely on building deep trust and overcoming heavy emotional or financial objections.

Minimum Requirements:

  • 1–3 years of experience in a consultative sales, enrollment, or high-stakes intake environment where you were measured against performance metrics/KPIs.
  • Exceptional emotional stamina and the ability to pivot seamlessly from a deeply empathetic emotional conversation to a structured enrollment close.
  • Superb communication skills—able to speak about complex mental health topics with authority, clarity, and warmth.
  • Technologically nimble; able to manage multiple software platforms, scheduling systems, and communication channels simultaneously in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • High School Diploma or GED required; Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Social Work, Communications, or a related field is strongly preferred.

Why Work for NOCD

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. With an inclusive culture and ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life. At NOCD, you will:

  • Help scale one of the fastest-growing specialty behavioral health organizations in the world.
  • Work directly with operational, clinical, product, and business leaders to solve meaningful challenges at scale.
  • Use data, technology, and critical thinking to drive measurable improvements in member outcomes and business performance.
  • Contribute to a mission that helps people reclaim their lives from one of the world's most disabling mental health conditions.
  • Build your career in a high-growth environment where ownership, innovation, and execution are valued and rewarded.
  • Play a role in shaping the future of NOCD as we expand beyond OCD into additional behavioral health specialties.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, NOCD is the place for you.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package, including Medical, Dental, Vision, and a 401K plan with a Company Match.
  • Employee Assistance Programs, including Mental Health, Wellness, Financial, Legal, and Pet Insurance
  • Generous PTO policy with 11 observed company holidays
  • 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for the primary caregiver, and 6 weeks of fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver, for qualifying full-time employees.

Current Shift-

  • Off Tues/Wed
    • 12:30 PM-9:00 PM CST on weekdays
    • 9:00 AM- 5:30 PM CST on weekends

Laptop and Equipment will be provided. Compensation for this role is $50,000.

jobs.description:
Senior consultant, health & welfare benefits (remote)

THE ORGANIZATION
Purchaser Business Group on Health (PBGH) is an action-oriented non-profit with a track record of improving health outcomes, experience and affordability for consumers and purchasers across the United States. PBGH advances quality, drives affordability and fosters equity in partnership with its members, who are some of the largest and most innovative private and public purchasers of health care, including The Boeing Company, Amazon, Intel, eBay, Walmart and CalPERS.

PBGH and its members are on the forefront of implementing innovations in the health care system through purchaser-led solutions. PBGH partners across stakeholders to continuously identify, create and put into practice new strategies to support the health and overall wellbeing of employees, their families and the public.

THE ROLE
The Senior Consultant, Health & Welfare Benefits supports PBGH’s mission to advance high-value, affordable, and equitable health care by delivering independent, purchaser-focused advisory services to employers and other health care purchasers. Serving as a strategic advisor—not a broker—this role provides objective analysis, market insight, and evidence-based guidance to support employer’s fiduciary decision-making across the health and welfare benefits lifecycle.

Working closely with PBGH senior leaders and subject-matter experts, the Senior Consultant is responsible for executing and managing day-to-day advisory engagements, producing rigorous, insight-driven analyses and recommendations, contributing to solution development, translating complex health data into actionable strategies for employers and helping shape purchaser-relevant insights that can scale across PBGH’s employer community.

This role requires strong technical expertise, analytical depth, comprehensive knowledge of employee benefits, well-established relationships with employers and the health markets, and polished client-ready communication skills, along with the ability to operate independently with minimal oversight, demonstrate agility in handling shifting priorities and dynamic environments, collaborate across internal and external stakeholders, and uphold PBGH’s independent advisory posture.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Client Engagement, Satisfaction, and Delivery
Under the guidance and oversight of senior leadership:
  • Independently manages multiple client engagements and owns defined workstreams from start to finish.
  • Develops client-ready analyses, insights, and deliverables across health and welfare strategies, including medical, pharmacy, wellbeing, and point solutions.
  • Develops and monitors engagement work plans, timelines, and milestones; proactively identifies risks, dependencies, or scope changes and escalates as appropriate to project and practice leadership to support on-time, high-quality delivery.
  • Collaborates with internal project teams, subcontractors, and external partners, coordinating closely with senior leaders to ensure effective execution of assigned projects.
  • Maintains organized project documentation, data files, and work products.
  • Prepares materials and presents findings to client teams with clarity and confidence, alongside and with review from senior leadership.
  • Partners with leadership to ensure recommendations are practical, data-driven, and aligned with client objectives and PBGH advisory principles.
  • Translates key findings into externally facing white papers, briefs, and presentations, with senior leadership input, to advance collective impact.

Financial Mastery, Data Analytics and Insights
With review and guidance from senior leadership and subject-matter experts:
  • Analyzes employer demographics, claims, utilization, cost, quality, and performance data, including self-funded medical and pharmacy claims.
  • Leads financial evaluations, including pricing, budgeting, forecasting, premium-equivalent rate setting, contribution modeling and working knowledge in IBNR and stop-loss.
  • Applies analytical tools, methodologies and comprehensive health and welfare benefits knowledge to assess plan performance, vendor effectiveness, cost drivers, and improvement opportunities, aligning findings with PBGH advisory principles.
  • Supports development and application of analytic solutions leveraging emerging datasets (e.g., Transparency in Coverage, Hospital Price Transparency).
  • Translates complex data into clear narratives, executive summaries, and actionable insights for employer audiences, incorporating feedback from senior leadership as appropriate.
  • Contributes to standardized tools, templates, and methodologies to support scalable consulting delivery.

Solutions Development and Strategic Impact
With input and review from senior leadership and subject matter experts:
  • Creates and documents methodologies, analyses, and insights to ensure rigor, consistency and alignment with PBGH advisory principles.
  • Stays current on market trends, regulatory developments, and innovations across the health benefits landscape, sharing relevant implications with leadership and colleagues.
  • Creates resources and tools that build knowledge base for continued intellectual capital development.
  • Shares learnings and best practices with colleagues to continuously improve service delivery.

Vendor Management
  • Has deep knowledge of the health care market ecosystem and well-established relationships with vendors, including carriers, TPAs, data platforms, data warehouses, and point solution vendors.
  • Manages the RFP/RFI process, including drafting questionnaires, interfacing vendors, evaluating proposals and responses, preparing and presenting results and recommendations to employers, and conducting vendor/finalist interviews, with input and oversight from senior leadership.
Compliance and Regulatory Oversight
  • Possesses fundamental knowledge of health and welfare program compliance and regulations, including but not limited to, ERISA, ACA, CAA, HIPAA, COBRA, Section 125, and MHPAEA.
  • Applies analytical rigor to conduct reviews of plan fiduciary and health plan compliance, contracts and agreements, identify potential risks and liabilities, and develop and implement strategic corrective action plans to address non-compliance issues.
  • Demonstrates track record of self-directed professional development and a commitment to staying current in a rapidly changing legal landscape and utilizing legal and industry research tools (e.g., Bloomberg Law, Federal Register, National Conference of State Legislatures) to independently resolve complex compliance inquiries.
  • Contributes to internal knowledge base or advisory service offerings regarding new regulatory trends.

Growth and Sales
  • Supports prospecting efforts and proposal development, including drafting scopes, workplans, timelines, and fee estimates.
  • Assists with responses to RFPs, RFIs, and grant-funded opportunities as needed.
  • Participates in client relationship development through excellent service delivery and responsiveness.
  • Identifies opportunities for follow-on work and flags potential expansion areas.
  • Supports technical learning opportunities for members.
  • Tracks activity with current and potential clients in Asana and Salesforce.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES & EXPERIENCE
  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • A minimum of 8+ years of experience in a consulting or similar environment advising large/jumbo employers on health and welfare benefits.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve Fortune 500 companies’ complex health and benefits issues.
  • Strong working knowledge of the health benefits ecosystem, including carriers, PBMs, point solutions, and consulting/brokerage models.
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing employer medical and pharmacy claims data and translating results into client-ready insights.
  • Solid technical expertise across health and welfare topics, such as financial and actuarial concepts, plan design, vendor evaluation, compliance (e.g., ERISA, CAA), pharmacy and PBM strategies, mental health, wellbeing, and emerging solutions.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams and adapt to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience developing polished PowerPoint presentations and executive summaries.
  • Mastery of Microsoft Office Suite
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive.
  • Ability to travel approximately 10–15%.
  • Life & Health Insurance License

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY
PBGH is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. PBGH strongly encourages applicants with diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

COMPENSATION

  • A stronger way of building. Set the patterns for how the team uses AI-assisted development to ship high-quality features faster, without compromising security or code quality.

jobs.description:
Wir suchen Senior Developer, die in unserem vollständig remoten Team an unseren Agenten arbeiten. Wenn du Komplexität magst und willst, dass deine Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegt, passt du zu uns.

Über uns
ist eine All-in-One-Plattform für Hausverwaltungen, mit Funktionen wie Inbox, CRM, Dokumenten, Telefonie, Video Calls, Team Chat und KI-Agenten. Unsere Mission ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was ein Hausverwalter tut.

Über die Rolle
Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Bevor wir überhaupt die UI geplant haben, haben wir geplant, wie Agenten mit der Software arbeiten. Denk dran – unser Ziel ist, die ganze Branche zu automatisieren, und das meinen wir ernst.
Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten.
Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr.

Woran du arbeiten wirst

  • Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren. Aber wann sollte ein Agent an einen Menschen abgeben, statt selbst zu Ende zu machen? Wie stellen wir sicher, dass er sich an den Prozess hält? Das sind deine Fragen.

  • Harness Engineering: Der Agent hat über 100 Tools. Aber er muss eine Anfrage so verstehen, wie ein Hausverwalter sie versteht, und nicht so, wie die Begriffe außerhalb der Branche klingen. Was gehört in den System Prompt, was in Skills?

  • Knowledge Base: Unsere Plattform hat eine eigene Knowledge Base, ähnlich wie Notion. Komplett selbst gebaut und gedacht als kollektives Gehirn des Unternehmens. What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We’re building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We’re taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

What’s the position?

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our growing Product & Technology organization at Hard Rock Digital. In this role, you will help build and scale the internal developer platform that powers our gaming and entertainment products—making it faster and safer for every engineering team to ship.

This is a platform engineering–focused role: rather than only maintaining infrastructure, you’ll design and build self-service workflows, golden paths, and developer tooling on top of Backstage, our internal developer platform (IDP) of choice. You’ll partner with product engineering teams to understand their pain points and turn them into paved-road, self-serve capabilities—provisioning, CI/CD, environments, observability, and more—so teams can move independently without sacrificing security or compliance.

You’ll also model what it means to operate at the pace of AI-enabled engineering: fluently using AI coding assistants, agentic tooling, and LLM-powered workflows to design platform capabilities faster, automate toil, and raise the bar for the entire team.

What will you do?

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineering, you will:

  • Design, build, and operate our internal developer platform on Backstage, including software catalog, templates, plugins, and scorecards that give engineers a consistent, self-service experience across the stack.

  • Create golden-path templates and self-service workflows (Backstage Software Templates, Terraform/Terragrunt modules, CI/CD scaffolding) that let product teams provision infrastructure, services, and environments without filing a ticket.

  • Architect and implement scalable AWS and hybrid-cloud infrastructure using Terraform/Terragrunt and related Infrastructure as Code tools, exposed to engineering teams through self-service platform interfaces.

  • Design, build, and optimize highly available containerized environments leveraging EKS, Kubernetes, and Docker, and surface them as consumable platform primitives.

  • Lead the automation strategy for CI/CD pipelines (TeamCity, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, and similar), building reusable, self-service pipeline patterns that scale across teams.

  • Champion security and compliance by design, embedding guardrails, identity/access controls, and policy-as-code directly into the self-service platform so "paved road" is always the secure road.

  • Partner with product engineering, SRE, QA, security, and operations teams to identify friction points and convert them into platform capabilities that improve developer experience and velocity.

  • Define and track developer experience (DevEx) and platform adoption metrics (lead time, self-service usage, ticket deflection) to demonstrate platform impact.

  • Leverage AI tools fluently as a core part of your daily workflow—using AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex), agentic automation, and LLM-powered tooling to accelerate platform delivery, generate and review Backstage plugins/templates, and help the broader team adopt AI-enabled ways of working.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

We’re seeking an experienced engineer who is genuinely energized by platform engineering—building tools and paved roads that make other engineers more productive, not just running infrastructure. You should be comfortable owning architecture and implementation decisions for internal developer platforms while helping elevate the DevOps discipline across the organization. Critically, you’re someone who has embraced AI tooling not as a novelty but as a genuine force multiplier—and who can help others do the same.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles, with at least 2 years in a senior or lead capacity.

  • Hands-on experience building or operating an internal developer platform (IDP)—Backstage strongly preferred—including catalog design, software templates, and custom plugin development.

  • A track record of designing self-service workflows and golden paths that reduce toil and ticket volume for product engineering teams.

  • Expert-level knowledge of AWS services and cloud-native architectures (multi-account setups, VPC design, IAM policies, networking).

  • Strong experience with Kubernetes (EKS preferred), Docker, and Helm for container orchestration and management.

  • Advanced Infrastructure as Code (IaC) expertise using Terraform/Terragrunt, with deep understanding of modular design and reusability suitable for self-service consumption.

  • Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, TypeScript/ (useful for Backstage plugin development), or other relevant languages.

  • Experience leading CI/CD initiatives and designing scalable, self-service delivery pipelines with GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, or comparable tools.

  • Strong understanding of observability practices and performance monitoring frameworks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog, etc.), ideally surfaced through platform tooling.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of networking, security hardening, and compliance in regulated industries, and experience embedding these as automated guardrails.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction in cross-functional teams.

  • AWS Professional Certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or SysOps Administrator) strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated fluency with AI development tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar), including practical experience integrating AI assistants into infrastructure workflows, platform tooling, code review, incident response, or documentation. The ability to operate at AI-enabled development velocity is a core expectation of this role, not a nice-to-have.

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

  • A hybrid / remote working environment

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play.
