jobs.excerpt: Space Inch is looking for an Engineering Engagement Lead to look after our engineers within a long-standing partnership with one of the largest investment managers in the U.
jobs.description:
Space Inch is looking for an Engineering Engagement Lead to look after our engineers within a long-standing partnership with one of the largest investment managers in the U.S, who is a S&P 500 company. Our engineers work embedded in the client’s teams, and the client directs their day-to-day work. Your job is everything around that work: making sure each engineer meets Space Inch’s standards, understanding what they’re building and why it matters to the client’s business, helping them grow, and keeping communication clear between our people and the client.

This is a people, communication, and account role, which means that you won’t assign tasks, run sprints, or make architecture decisions. An engineering background is a preference, but it’s not a disqualifying criteria. What really matters is an engineer’s mindset: you can sit down with an engineer or a client’s engineering manager, understand what’s being built, and have a real conversation about it.

Our mission, vision, and values

At Space Inch, we prioritize alignment with our clients and team, ensuring a deep understanding of their needs. We are committed to delivering exceptional work while supporting the personal and professional growth of our team members.

Working at Space Inch

  • Our remote-first team of around 80+ people is based across the EU (mostly Croatia), the US, and Latin America, with a growing presence in Brazil.
  • Occasional travel for client visits and company retreats.
  • This role is embedded within a single long-standing client partnership, though you'll draw on Space Inch's broader engineering community and practices.
  • We support work/life balance for our team.

Requirements

  • Experience: 10+ years in engineering and people leadership, engagement or account management, or technical project/product management in an agency, consultancy, nearshore, or client-embedded environment; preferably coming from an engineering background, but not a must.
  • An engineer’s mindset: you understand modern software development (SDLC, common architectures and stacks) well enough to follow what engineers are building, hold your own with client engineering and product managers, and notice when something is off. You don’t need to write code.
  • Real curiosity about the client’s business: you invest the time to learn the domain, why each application matters, and what workflow it replaces, so client stakeholders see you as someone who adds value.
  • A clear system for evaluating people: you can explain how you know someone is doing a great job, using standards, evidence, and feedback from several sources, and how you turn that into specific, actionable coaching.
  • Exceptional communicator and mediator who handles sensitive topics (compensation, retention, disengagement, underperformance) directly and with care, across written, async, live, and cross-cultural communication.
  • Proven track record of growing engineers: you’ve guided engineers along their career paths, from junior to senior and from individual contributor toward leadership, built development plans that led to real promotions, and can point to people who grew under your leadership.
  • Experience managing senior client stakeholders: gathering honest feedback, managing expectations, and showing the value our people bring.
  • Practical fluency with AI as a working tool: you can assess whether engineers are using AI well against defined practices and push them to improve.
  • Experience leading distributed or remote people, including those who work mostly on their own.

Key responsibilities

  • Evaluation against our standards: Regularly assess every engineer and project against Space Inch’s project success standards, and whether we’re meeting both the client’s needs and our team members’ needs.
  • Client feedback loop: Work with the client’s engineering and product managers to gather feedback on each engineer, including quality of work, taking into account how each client team operates.
  • Coaching and growth: Run regular 1:1s, give candid feedback, and build development plans that help engineers level up. Work with Engineering Leads, who coach informally, to round out evaluations.
  • Retention and connection: Keep engineers engaged and connected to Space Inch, especially those working alone on client projects. Spot retention risks early and resolve them.
  • Coaching and career growth: Run regular 1:1s, give candid feedback, and build development plans tied to Space Inch’s career paths. Identify engineers who are ready for the next level, build their promotion cases, and support those moving toward leadership roles. Work with Engineering Leads, who coach informally, to round out evaluations.
  • Account management: Act as Space Inch’s senior point of contact with the client on how our people are doing; manage expectations and help tell the story of the impact of our work.
  • Facilitating communication: Help engineers navigate shifting priorities, unclear ownership, and unrealistic timelines, and bridge communication gaps between our team and the client.
  • AI practice: Check that engineers follow the AI practices we define, help them improve, and share what works across the team.

Typical challenges you’ll be solving

  • Understanding a wide range of client applications well enough that client managers take your input seriously.
  • Keeping engineers who work individually within client teams motivated and connected to Space Inch.
  • Helping engineers handle a fast-changing client environment: shifting priorities, unclear ownership, and tight deadlines.
  • Growing engineers’ careers when the client directs their daily work, and making their progress visible enough to support promotions.
  • Turning feedback from engineers, Engineering Leads, and client managers into fair, specific evaluations and coaching.
  • Raising the bar on how the team uses AI, measured by outcomes rather than adoption for its own sake.

Qualities for success

  • Strong people instincts: engineers trust your guidance, feel supported in 1:1s, and are honest with you about what isn’t working.
  • Adapts communication style across coaching, difficult conversations, and client discussions.
  • A systems thinker who builds repeatable ways to evaluate and grow people, and spots broken communication loops before they escalate.
  • Comfortable making decisions and owning the outcome, even when the first attempt fails.
  • Calm under client pressure, and doesn’t pass that pressure to the team.

The role is right for you if

  • You lead through trust, conversation, and presence, and you enjoy helping people get better at what they do.
  • You like learning how a business works and connecting people’s work to what the client actually needs.
  • You enjoy building a clear system for evaluating and developing people, and refining it over time.
  • You find it rewarding when someone you’ve coached takes the next step in their career.
  • You’re comfortable in a setup where the client directs the day-to-day work and your impact comes through people and relationships.

The role is not right for you if

  • You want to run delivery, assign work, or own a product roadmap.
  • You want a primarily hands-on engineering role.
  • You aren’t interested in learning the client’s business in depth.
  • You’d rather wait for direction than propose a way forward.

What’s in it for you

  • Work closely with leadership on one of Space Inch’s most important client partnerships.
  • Shape how Space Inch evaluates, develops, and supports engineers in client-embedded work.
  • Leadership team that values people-first thinking and technical excellence.
  • Remote-friendly, collaborative, pragmatic culture.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Monthly salary: 6,500.00–9,000.00 USD for a full-time B2B collaboration, based on experience and skills
  • Remote-first setup
  • Health & Wellbeing: PTO + 100% paid sick leave + annual health checkup budget
  • Stay active: Wellness subsidy
  • Continuous Growth: An education budget specifically designed to fuel your learning and help you expand your knowledge base.

Marketing & Proposal Coordinator

Company Overview
Would you enjoy helping a growing national consultancy tell its story, pursue new opportunities, and strengthen how it connects with clients?

Connico is a national construction consultancy known for its experienced team and commitment to exceptional client service. With deep experience in aviation and complex infrastructure, we are continuing to expand our work across energy, federal, and defense markets.

Our marketing function plays an important role in positioning Connico for new work by developing strong proposals, communicating our technical expertise, and supporting business development efforts across our markets.

Our work is technical, but how we do the work matters just as much as the quality of what we deliver. Our core values of Respect, Integrity, Innovation, Resiliency, Inclusivity, and Thoughtfulness guide how we work with our clients and with one another.

The Role
Connico is seeking a Marketing & Proposal Coordinator with professional proposal-development experience to join our Business Development/Marketing team.

This is a growth-oriented position for someone who already has a strong proposal and communication foundation and is ready to take on increasing responsibility. You will work closely with our Senior Marketing Specialist, technical professionals, and leadership across proposals and pursuits, opportunity research, project information, marketing content, digital communications, and broader business development support.

AEC experience is preferred but not required. The role is designed to grow in scope and independence over time, with a career path to Marketing Specialist and Senior Marketing Specialist.

What You’ll Do
  • Develop proposals, qualifications packages, and other pursuit materials, including gathering project experience, staff qualifications, resumes, technical information, approach content, graphics, and reusable proposal resources.
  • Write, edit, format, and organize client-focused content and coordinate proposal activities with technical staff and other contributors to support accurate, responsive, and timely submissions.
  • Support client interview and presentation preparation and federal pursuit activities as Connico continues to expand its federal market presence.
  • Research upcoming projects, clients, procurement activity, and potential teaming opportunities, and complete prequalification packages, vendor registrations, teaming documentation, MBE/SBE information, and related pursuit requirements.
  • Maintain, research, and validate client, project, pursuit, and marketing information within CRM, project database, and other information systems, including project closeouts, routine reporting, and identification of data gaps.
  • Translate technical project information into compelling marketing content and support project profiles, one-sheets, case studies, presentations, brochures, articles, award submissions, and other collateral.
  • Help maintain reusable marketing content, templates, project information, and brand resources while ensuring materials reflect Connico’s established messaging, brand standards, and core values.
  • Assist with website and social media content, outside marketing partners, client-facing events, conferences, presentations, and other marketing and brand-building activities.
  • Manage multiple concurrent priorities while building deeper knowledge of Connico’s projects, clients, markets, services, systems, and differentiators and taking on greater ownership as your experience grows.
What We’re Looking For
  • 2–4 years of professional marketing, proposal, or communications experience, including direct experience developing proposals, qualifications packages, marketing collateral, or similar client-facing pursuit materials.
  • Strong ability to translate technical or complex information into clear, persuasive written and visual content.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly InDesign, with working knowledge of Illustrator, Photoshop, or related Adobe applications.
  • Strong writing, editing, proofreading, layout, research, and visual communication skills.
  • Experience with CRM, project database, or marketing information systems; experience with AEC-specific systems is a plus.
  • Ability to locate, organize, evaluate, and validate information from multiple sources.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.
  • Ability to successfully manage multiple assignments and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Preferred Experience
  • Marketing or proposal experience within the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry.
  • Experience with public-sector procurement, prequalifications, qualifications-based selection processes, or similar pursuit requirements.
  • Experience with website content management systems and professional social media platforms.
  • Federal marketing, proposal, or procurement experience.

Growth Opportunity
This position is designed for someone who wants to continue developing professionally rather than remain in a narrowly defined proposal-production role. You will initially work closely with the Senior Marketing Specialist while building greater independence and judgment across proposals, pursuits, marketing content, project information, digital communications, and broader marketing operations.

The career path for this position is Marketing & Proposal Coordinator → Marketing Specialist → Senior Marketing Specialist.

Who Will Be Successful in This Role?
You may be a strong fit if you:
  • Enjoy turning technical information into clear, compelling content for clients and pursuit teams.
  • Can manage multiple deadlines and competing priorities while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Are comfortable researching information, asking good questions, and working across technical teams to find what you need.
  • Take ownership of your work while recognizing when additional review or guidance is needed.
  • Enjoy both the creative and organizational sides of marketing and proposal work.
  • Are motivated to deepen your knowledge, expand your responsibilities, and become increasingly independent over time.

Work Location Options
Hybrid:
  • Hebron, KY (Cincinnati area)
  • Mt. Juliet, TN (Nashville area)
Hybrid employees work in the office Tuesday through Thursday.

Fully Remote:
  • Fully remote opportunity for the right candidate.
  • Must reside full-time in the U.S.

Why Join Connico?
This is an opportunity to build on your proposal and marketing experience while developing broader responsibility across proposals, pursuits, marketing content, project information, digital communications, and business development support.

You will work closely with an experienced Senior Marketing Specialist and technical professionals across Connico, giving you the opportunity to learn the company’s projects, markets, clients, and approach while progressively taking greater ownership of the work.
We value people who take ownership, ask good questions, communicate clearly, care about the quality of their work, and continue looking for ways to improve.

If you have a strong proposal foundation and want a role where you can contribute now while continuing to grow, we would like to hear from you!

About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

  • HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

  • HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

  • HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

  • HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced and hands-on Controller to lead accounting operations, financial reporting, compliance, and financial close processes for a growing organization.

This is a leadership role for someone who combines deep technical accounting expertise with financial planning, team leadership, and operational excellence.

You’ll work closely with Executive Leadership, FP&A, Operations, Auditors, and Finance stakeholders to ensure the organization maintains accurate financial records, strong internal controls, audit-ready reporting, and scalable accounting processes.

If you enjoy balancing detailed accounting oversight with strategic financial leadership, this role is built for you.

Month-End & Year-End Close

  • Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes.
  • Maintain a five-business-day month-end close target.
  • Review and approve:
    • Journal entries
    • Account reconciliations
    • Accruals
    • Payroll allocations
    • Depreciation schedules
    • Intercompany transactions
  • Prepare complete financial reporting packages, including:
    • Profit & Loss Statements
    • Balance Sheets
    • Cash Flow Statements

Financial Reporting & Executive Insights

  • Prepare GAAP and IFRS-compliant financial statements.
  • Deliver executive reporting including:
    • Variance analysis
    • Financial commentary
    • Dashboards
    • Executive reporting packages
  • Support:
    • Board reporting
    • Investor reporting
    • Strategic planning
  • Translate financial data into actionable business recommendations.

Internal Controls & Compliance

  • Design, implement, and strengthen accounting controls.
  • Ensure compliance with:
    • GAAP
    • IFRS
    • Tax regulations
    • Audit requirements
    • Regulatory obligations
  • Coordinate external audits and manage PBC (Prepared by Client) requests.
  • Maintain organized, audit-ready financial documentation.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Management

  • Partner with FP&A teams on:
    • Annual budgets
    • Forecasting
    • Scenario planning
    • Capital planning
  • Monitor:
    • Cash flow
    • Liquidity
    • Working capital
    • Debt compliance
  • Provide recommendations that improve financial performance and operational efficiency.

Accounting Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop the accounting team.
  • Review work for:
    • Accuracy
    • Completeness
    • Timeliness
  • Establish scalable accounting processes and quality standards.
  • Drive continuous improvement across accounting operations.

Process Improvement & Systems

  • Lead initiatives involving:
    • ERP implementations
    • Accounting automation
    • Workflow optimization
    • SOP development
  • Improve reporting systems and accounting infrastructure.
  • Reduce manual processes while increasing scalability and efficiency.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Strong balance of technical accounting expertise and business insight.
  • Highly organized and deadline-driven.
  • Comfortable presenting financial information to executive leadership.
  • Able to lead teams while remaining hands-on.
  • Proactive in identifying risks and process improvements.
  • Passionate about building scalable financial systems and controls.

Required Experience & Skills

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in:
    • Accounting
    • Finance
    • Related field

Experience

  • 7+ years of progressive accounting or finance experience.
  • 2+ years of leadership or supervisory experience.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of:
    • GAAP
    • IFRS
    • Internal controls
    • Financial reporting
    • Financial close management
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems such as:
    • NetSuite
    • SAP
    • Oracle
    • QuickBooks Enterprise
    • Similar platforms
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets.
  • Strong financial analysis and reporting capabilities.

Nice-to-Have

  • CPA, ACCA, or MBA.
  • Previous experience as:
    • Controller
    • Finance Manager
    • Accounting Manager
  • ERP implementation or M&A integration experience.
  • Industry experience in:
    • SaaS
    • Professional Services
    • Real Estate
  • Experience using:
    • Power BI
    • Tableau
    • Looker
    • Financial dashboards

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review reconciliations and approve journal entries.
  • Monitor month-end close progress and accounting deliverables.
  • Prepare financial reports and variance analyses.
  • Meet with leadership to discuss financial performance.
  • Coordinate audit and compliance activities.
  • Mentor accounting team members and review work quality.
  • Improve accounting processes and automation initiatives.
  • Analyze financial trends and recommend operational improvements.

In short: You’ll ensure financial operations remain accurate, compliant, scalable, and strategically valuable while supporting leadership with reliable financial insights.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Month-end close completed within five business days.
  • Zero material audit adjustments.
  • 100% on-time regulatory and tax filings.
  • Accurate and timely executive reporting.
  • Strong accounting team performance and development.
  • Improved efficiency through automation and process optimization.

Why Join Us?

    • FP&A
    • Financial Reporting
    • Internal Controls
    • Process Improvement

Interview Process

  2. Practical Financial Review Task
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple initial screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your accounting leadership experience, highlight your expertise with financial reporting, month-end close, ERP systems, FP&A collaboration, and team management, and share examples of how you’ve strengthened financial controls or improved accounting processes. Your video will be reviewed by the hiring team before moving to the practical assessment and client interview.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

jobs.title: Senior Security & Compliance - Healthcare | Zenara Health
jobs.excerpt: Location: Remote - India Type: Full-time Working Hours: All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately 6:00 PM and 12:00 AM IST, overlapping US Pacific Time.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote - India

Type: Full-time

Working Hours: All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately 6:00 PM and 12:00 AM IST, overlapping US Pacific Time. Attendance in that window is required. Your remaining work is yours to schedule.

Commitment: Approximately 50 hours per week

Industry: Healthcare technology experience is preferred but not mandatory

About the Company

Zenara Health is a technology-oriented mental healthcare organization building clinical software for behavioral-health clinics. We work with sensitive patient data, so security, access control, vendor risk, AI-tool risk, and evidence of how our controls operate are fundamental to earning customer trust.

We are a startup, not a department. We move quickly and need a security and compliance program that is rigorous enough for healthcare and practical enough to work in a small, fast-moving company.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Security & Compliance Lead to build and own Zenara’s security and compliance program.

You will set risk priorities, define security and HIPAA-related controls, verify that they work, and lead our responses to customer security reviews. You will work closely with the Head of Engineering and our Platform Engineer, who owns day-to-day platform operations and implements and operates many of the technical controls.

You own the program’s direction and outcomes. The Platform Engineer owns the day-to-day operation of the platform. You will work together to turn security requirements into working practices, not just documents.

Here is the test: can you inspect a real technical environment, identify the risks that matter most, explain the trade-offs, and work with engineers to implement and verify effective controls?

We are not looking for someone who only produces compliance paperwork. We need a leader with healthcare security judgment, technical depth, and the willingness to remain involved until a control actually works.

Our Security and Compliance Vision

Security and compliance should be part of how Zenara operates every day—not a last-minute exercise when a customer sends a questionnaire.

You will build a program with clear control owners, practical policies, current evidence, tracked remediation, and tested response procedures. It should give engineering a safe path to move quickly while helping us protect patient data and answer customer questions with confidence.

Your remit includes:

  • HIPAA-related safeguards, policies, and evidence
  • Security risk assessment and remediation priorities
  • Technical control standards and verification
  • Patient-data flows and access controls
  • Vendor and AI-tool risk
  • Customer security reviews and audit preparation
  • Incident response and escalation procedures
  • Security practices for AI-assisted engineering

The goal is not to create the largest possible program. It is to establish the right controls, make ownership clear, and ensure those controls keep working as Zenara grows.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the security and compliance roadmap, including risk prioritization, remediation tracking, and follow-through.
  • Establish and maintain HIPAA-related policies, procedures, control requirements, and supporting evidence.
  • Review cloud infrastructure, access controls, secrets management, and other technical safeguards with the Platform Engineer.
  • Define what technical controls must achieve; partner with the Platform Engineer to implement and operate them; independently verify their effectiveness.
  • Review patient-data flows, vendors, AI tools, and LLM-related data risks.
  • Set requirements for how AI agents and tools access data, systems, and production environments.
  • Lead responses to customer security questionnaires and coordinate preparation for audits or other external reviews.
  • Establish incident response and escalation procedures, and help coordinate the response to significant security events.
  • Review the Platform Engineer’s security work regularly, mentor them, and identify gaps early.
  • Maintain a clear record of findings, decisions, exceptions, control owners, and remediation progress.

How You’ll Work With the Platform Engineer

These are closely connected roles, but they do not have identical ownership.

You will own: security and compliance strategy, risk decisions, control standards, HIPAA-related program requirements, verification, vendor and AI-tool risk reviews, and customer security responses.

The Platform Engineer will own: day-to-day infrastructure operations, deployments, monitoring, backups and restores, technical implementation of platform controls, and recurring operational checks.

For example, you may define the access-control standard and how its effectiveness will be verified. The Platform Engineer may implement it in Azure and operate the recurring checks. You will review the evidence, address exceptions, and remain accountable for whether the standard is adequate.

What AI-Native Security Means Here

Our engineering team uses AI agents to help build and operate software. That creates opportunities to improve speed and consistency, as well as risks that conventional security processes may miss.

You will help define:

  • Which tools and agents may access patient data, code, infrastructure, and production systems
  • What permissions and approval boundaries they need
  • How we assess AI vendors and data-processing risks
  • How agent activity and security findings are logged, reviewed, and escalated
  • Where automation can improve control monitoring and evidence collection

You do not need to be the person building every agent. You do need the judgment to govern their use and verify that automated checks are reliable. AI can assist with security work; it does not take accountability for security decisions.

What We’re Looking For

  • Senior-level healthcare security and compliance experience, including substantial HIPAA expertise.
  • Verifiable examples of security or compliance programs, safeguards, or reviews you have led.
  • Hands-on technical security knowledge across cloud infrastructure, access control, secrets, and data protection.
  • Ability to assess a real technical environment—not only review policies.
  • Experience establishing or improving security practices in a small or growing organization.
  • Ability to translate risks and requirements into controls engineers can implement and operate.
  • Experience guiding engineers while independently assessing whether their controls work.
  • Clear written communication about risks, decisions, priorities, and practical next steps.
  • Judgment about what to address immediately, what to plan for, and when to escalate.

Relevant Areas

  • HIPAA and healthcare data security
  • Azure cloud and AKS / Kubernetes security
  • Access and secrets management
  • Patient-data flows and technical safeguards
  • Vendor and AI-tool risk
  • Customer security reviews
  • Control evidence and audit preparation
  • Incident response
  • Security roadmap prioritization

Nice to Have

  • SOC 2 or HITRUST experience
  • Azure security experience
  • Experience building a program at an early-stage startup
  • Experience assessing AI/LLM vendors and agent access to sensitive data

What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will review our current environment with the Platform Engineer, identify the highest-priority security and compliance gaps, clarify control ownership, and establish a practical remediation plan.

Within 90 days, core HIPAA-related policies and controls will have assigned owners and supporting evidence. Priority findings will be tracked to resolution, and the team will have a working cadence for reviewing risks, control effectiveness, and customer security requests.

Over time, Zenara will have a maintained security and compliance program: current evidence, tested incident procedures, tracked exceptions, clear ownership, and the ability to respond confidently to customer security reviews. Success means we can demonstrate how controls work in practice—not merely point to documents saying they exist.

Schedule

This is a full-time, remote role requiring regular live collaboration with our US-based founder and India-based engineering team. India-evening overlap is expected; the specific hours will be confirmed during hiring.

Significant security incidents may occasionally require coordination outside the usual collaboration window.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, based on demonstrated expertise and experience
  • Fully remote work
  • Equipment allowance
  • Direct access to the founder and Head of Engineering
  • Significant ownership of the security and compliance foundations of an AI-native healthcare company

Who Will Thrive in This Role

This role is well suited to someone who:

  • Has real healthcare security and HIPAA experience.
  • Can combine policy knowledge with technical review.
  • Enjoys building a program and developing the people who operate its controls.
  • Prioritizes clearly instead of treating every finding as equally urgent.
  • Follows through from recommendation to implementation and verification.
  • Can balance startup speed with disciplined protection of patient data.

You may struggle if you prefer to advise from a distance, produce generic documentation without verifying implementation, or need a large established security team and budget to make progress.

If you want to own the security and compliance program for an AI-native health-tech company—and build foundations that work in practice—we would love to hear from you.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Support Cybersecurity Readiness Inspection preparation, assessment activities, findings management, remediation, and follow-up reporting.
  • Maintain and update the program Information Security Plan, cybersecurity policies, standard operating procedures, user guides, memoranda for record, and system interconnection agreements.
  • Review and validate system access requests and support enforcement of approved access-control requirements.
  • Evaluate systems and assets against applicable NIST, National Security Agency, Security Technical Implementation Guide, and approved desktop or platform security requirements.
  • Monitor changes to cybersecurity regulations, policies, technical requirements, and threat conditions, and recommend corresponding updates to program controls and procedures.
  • Produce accurate cybersecurity status reports, risk summaries, compliance metrics, inspection-readiness assessments, and executive-level briefings.
  • Validate the accuracy and completeness of cybersecurity data used in program reports, dashboards, and Government submissions.
  • Translate vulnerability data, security-control deficiencies, and technical findings into prioritized and actionable risk recommendations.
  • Promote consistent cybersecurity practices, lessons learned, and continuous improvement across the ENLIST program.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 12 years of relevant cybersecurity or information security experience.
  • Current Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) certification.
  • Demonstrated experience leading Department of Defense cybersecurity operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate technical cybersecurity findings into actionable risk recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience directly supporting a Government ISSM, Information System Security Officer, Authorizing Official, or system owner.
  • Advanced knowledge of the DoD Risk Management Framework, including authorization package development, security-control assessment, continuous monitoring, and authorization maintenance.
  • Experience applying DoDI 8510.01, NIST SP 800-53, FISMA, and related federal and DoD cybersecurity requirements.
  • Experience supporting Authority to Operate and Authority to Connect activities in a DoD environment.
  • Experience conducting or supporting vulnerability management using ACAS or Tenable, Endpoint Security Solutions, STIG Viewer, Security Content Automation Protocol tools, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience managing IAVA, IAVM, Plan of Action and Milestones, and corrective-action remediation processes.
  • Experience supporting Cybersecurity Readiness Inspections, security assessments, control testing, or Security Test and Evaluation activities.
  • Experience with eMASS or comparable governance, risk, and compliance platforms.
  • Experience developing cybersecurity policies, security plans, standard operating procedures, interconnection agreements, risk assessments, and executive briefings.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow or other workflow platforms used to manage security findings, risks, remediation activities, and performance reporting.
  • Additional certifications such as CISM, CCSP, CGRC, CASP+, or equivalent advanced cybersecurity credentials.

jobs.description:
ORDERYOYO

Lead Software Engineer – Payments

Remote · Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices · Competitive salary

About the Role

At OrderYOYO, payments sit at the heart of everything we do. Every order placed, every restaurant paid, and every dispute resolved runs through the systems this team owns and operates.

We're looking for a Lead Software Engineer – Payments to own the next stage of our payments platform's evolution — as a hands-on technical leader who can grow and manage a team of payments engineers, set the technical direction for a business-critical domain, and support our transition to a more scalable operating model across online ordering and in-store platforms (POS, Kiosk, and payment terminals).

You'll play a central role in shaping how OrderYOYO handles money — from authorisation and settlement to disputes and merchant invoicing — while building and developing the people who make that possible.

Role Mission

Lead the people, architecture, and delivery behind OrderYOYO's payments platform — enabling KYC onboarding, deductions, settlement/payout timing, dispute flows, and merchant invoicing — while growing a high-performing engineering team and raising the bar on reliability, security, and engineering quality in one of our most business-critical domains.

Core Responsibilities

People Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of payments engineers — providing hands-on technical guidance, regular feedback, and clear paths for career development.
  • Own hiring and team-building for the payments engineering function, partnering with recruiting to define role profiles, run interviews, and bring in strong talent.
  • Run day-to-day people management: 1:1s, goal-setting, performance reviews, and career progression conversations for direct reports.
  • Build a team culture where payments knowledge is documented and shared, not tribal — through design reviews, standards, and mentoring.
  • Represent the payments engineering team in leadership and cross-functional conversations, translating business needs into technical strategy and team priorities.
  • Balance hands-on technical contribution with people-management responsibilities, staying close enough to the codebase to lead by example and unblock the team.

Technical & Domain Ownership

  • Set the technical direction and long-term architecture strategy for payment-domain services, including gateway integrations, payment intent/authorisation/capture/refund flows, payout orchestration, and reconciliation.
  • Oversee marketplace capabilities: onboarding/KYC integration, merchant configuration, settlement instructions, deductions, and invoicing/merchant-statement alignment.
  • Ensure robust “flow-of-funds” primitives across the team's systems — idempotency, ledgers/events, and audit trails that are fully supportable for finance and compliance.
  • Own the strategy for PSP and partner integrations, with close attention to tri-party / sub-merchant implications where applicable.
  • Oversee dispute/chargeback and fraud-handling touchpoints across internal workflows and PSP tooling, and drive collaboration with Ops on runbooks and escalation paths.
  • Partner closely with Product, Legal/Compliance, Finance, and Support to convert requirements into safe, testable production behaviour.
  • Raise engineering quality in a high-change domain: automated testing, safe rollouts/canaries, observability, and incident-response improvements, with accountability for outcomes across the team.

Must-Have Requirements

  • Proven experience leading, mentoring, or people-managing a team of software engineers — including hiring, performance management, and career development.
  • Strong backend engineering background in distributed systems — microservices, async processing, resilient APIs, and eventual consistency.
  • Production experience with payment flows (auth/capture/refund, webhooks, reconciliation) and “money correctness” patterns such as idempotency keys, double-entry thinking, and auditability.
  • A solid security mindset: PCI compliance, PII protection, secrets management, least privilege, and secure coding practices.
  • Comfort working in an Azure-first environment (APIs, queues/eventing, monitoring), with strong CI/CD and automated testing practices.
  • Clear, confident communication with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders in high-stakes scenarios — incidents, financial breaks, and compliance requests.
  • Strong judgement on when to move fast, when to standardise, and when to say “not yet” with evidence — balancing team capacity, technical debt, and business priorities.

Strong-to-Have Experience

  • Experience scaling or restructuring an engineering team through periods of growth or organisational change.
  • Experience with sub-merchant, marketplace, or Payfac-like operating models (KYC, underwriting, settlements, fee deductions).
  • Familiarity with dispute tooling, card scheme rules, 3DS/risk rules, or fraud platforms.
  • Experience partnering with Legal, Compliance, or Finance leadership on regulatory or audit requirements.

Who We Are

At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. Personal development is central to how we work — engineers are encouraged to grow technically, take responsibility, and help shape how our products and platforms evolve.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps, and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

Through our partnership with AppSmart, the market leader in POS and in-store systems, we've become the largest restaurant-focused platform in Europe.

What We Offer

• Competitive salary.

  • A remote role — work from wherever you do your best work, with quarterly in-person gatherings at one of our global offices.
  • High ownership and autonomy, with a direct hand in shaping the team you lead.
  • A clear leadership mandate, with scope to grow further into broader engineering management responsibilities.
  • The opportunity to lead work on revenue-critical production systems.
  • A strong focus on security, reliability, and engineering best practices.
  • A collaborative, international engineering team.
  • Real emphasis on learning, mentoring, and long-term growth — for you and for the people you lead.

Reimagine the infrastructure of cancer care within a community that values integrity, inspires growth, and is uniquely positioned to create a more modern, connected oncology ecosystem. A note on level: We're open to candidates at the Associate Medical Director or Medical Director level depending on experience and scope of prior ownership in precision medicine.

What You'll Do

Flatiron Health is looking for a data-and technology-oriented clinician with oncology subject matter expertise who is passionate about real-world evidence (RWE) accelerating progress against cancer. You will be part of the Global Research Oncology team that operates across the US, UK, Germany, and Japan.

In this role you will collaborate with a cross-functional team of oncologists/clinicians, data scientists, epidemiologists, software engineers, product managers, account directors, and clinical data specialists to help develop, commercialize, and deliver our oncology research data and services leveraging a breadth of tools, including artificial intelligence. You will serve as a core medical resource with a particular focus in precision medicine and cancer genomics. You will also help biopharma clients apply clinical and molecular use cases across the full R&D lifecycle—from early pipeline discovery through post-market clinical development. In addition you will:

Help researchers validate preclinical hypotheses in real-world cohorts and explore clinical trial findings via reverse translation.
  • Clinical Development Translation: Apply clinical development and trial design principles to help biopharma clients bridge the gap between traditional clinical endpoints and real-world evidence (RWE). Help clients understand how real world data can support external control arms, historic cohorts, or synthetic control designs for niche or rare trial populations.
  • Commercial Pre-Sales & Scoping Subject Matter Expert: Proactively provide clinical and molecular data expertise to support teams during pre-sales, client scoping, and solution building utilising internal or off-the-shelf external AI tools. Partner with scientific and commercial leaders to translate a client’s clinical development planning, target validation, or complex inclusion/exclusion criteria into precise data specifications across our various data assets.

  • Operational Execution: You are able to handle multiple tasks concurrently, contribute to intermediate-complexity clinical data projects with guidance and mentorship from senior leaders, and meet ongoing deadlines in a fast-paced technology driven environment.

Where You’ll Work

The Business System Analyst - Oracle EBS/ Cloud Finance will join Motorola Solutions’ Enterprise Core Technology group, supporting the global Finance Organization.

Working at the intersection of business strategy and technology, you will partner closely with Finance business leaders and IT counterparts to adopt industry best practices, simplify financial operations, and implement scalable digital solutions.

About Darwoft

We partner with startups and high-growth companies to build high-impact digital products. Our culture is people-first, focused on technical quality, long-term relationships, and a collaborative mindset. We combine technical excellence with human proximity.

General Information

  • Contract Type: Contractor
  • Industry / Project: Fintech / Conversational AI & Infrastructure
  • Time Zone: Coordination with US / LATAM / Global teams
  • English Level: Advanced (C1)

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to support and execute a critical observability migration. In this role, you will lead the transition of our application and infrastructure telemetry from New Relic to a modern, OpenTelemetry (OTel) Collector-based architecture. You will be responsible for re-instrumenting applications, updating infrastructure manifests, validating telemetry outputs, and ensuring seamless monitoring coverage across our high-scale ecosystem without compromising operational visibility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Migrate existing application instrumentation, tracing, and telemetry configurations from New Relic to OpenTelemetry.
  • Update YAML configuration files, environment variables, and deployment manifests according to established architecture standards.
  • Execute unit tests and validation suites to verify that telemetry is accurately generated, transformed, and exported to target backends.
  • Perform telemetry gap analysis, comparing existing New Relic data against OTel outputs to identify missing traces, metrics, logs, or resource attributes.
  • Assist in updating dashboards, monitoring documentation, and troubleshooting guides to reflect the OTel architecture.
  • Investigate telemetry collection and export errors, identifying root causes and collaborating with core platform engineers on complex edge cases.
  • Maintain clear tracking and reporting of implementation progress, edge cases, and potential migration risks.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • Proven experience in software engineering with proficiency in at least one modern language (Java, Python, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript).
  • Hands-on experience with OpenTelemetry (OTel) concepts, including distributed tracing, metrics, logs, and OTel Collector configurations.
  • Deep experience with cloud observability paradigms and transitioning off legacy platforms like New Relic.
  • Solid understanding of HTTP, APIs, environment-based configurations, and reading/modifying complex YAML/JSON manifests.
  • Strong background in software testing, debugging, log analysis, and validating high-cardinality telemetry data.
  • Familiarity with modern software delivery workflows (Git, PRs, CI/CD pipelines).

Nice-to-Have:

You'll work closely with our R&D organization to secure CI/CD pipelines, harden build and deployment processes, and make sure security is part of engineering's workflow rather than a gate at the end of it

Location: Mumbai - Remote


Pipeline & Build Security

  • Partner with R&D to design and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines, from code commit through deployment.
  • Integrate static and dynamic application security testing (SAST/DAST), dependency and container scanning, and secrets management into the development lifecycle.
  • Harden build systems, artifact repositories, and deployment tooling against common attack paths.
  • Own infrastructure-as-code security: reviewing and improving how Terraform, Kubernetes, and cloud configurations are written and deployed.

Partnership with R&D

  • Act as the security point of contact for engineering teams, helping them fix issues without slowing them down unnecessarily.
  • Review new tools, services, and architecture decisions for security implications before they ship.

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work with the IT/ITSec Manager and Senior Compliance Analyst to make sure pipeline and infrastructure changes stay aligned with our compliance obligations.
